notes.title: Illinois: Truck Stops #2
notes.content:
[p]In the last edition of the [url="https://blog.scssoft.com/2025/04/illinois-truck-stops.html"]Illinois: Truck Stops[/url] blog, we introduced you to a few stops and rest areas that you can look forward to in the upcoming [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486960/American_Truck_Simulator__Illinois/"]Illinois DLC[/url] for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"]American Truck Simulator[/url]. We hope you're ready for the second batch today![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/eb41f711013d0e89ab3a95f75cd835431dbab6f5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Our first stop today takes us to the city of Rushville. Here, you’ll find small shops and local businesses to explore, adding to the charm of this small-town setting.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ce1e9fe282f84228a78b10dc38a148cd0cdabd42.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Another location offers a unique scenery with a shopping center perched above the highway on I-90. This rest area also provides easy access back to the interstate from both sides, allowing you to quickly get moving again.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/28c9ae7e56f9d3b38e66d4874b2553d238152f42.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Traveling along I-64, you might find yourself at a small, peaceful rest area surrounded by open fields. It’s a quiet corner of the Prairie State where you can relax for a while before continuing your route.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b96860b482b98c3ffba15ffeff7736a01210826b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Just outside Gilman (also known as The City of the Crossroads), there’s a big rest stop along US-24 featuring multiple places to rest and refuel. Whether you need a quick stop or an overnight stay, this location has all the facilities a driver could want.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4fb5f00ea7cee8f29a03635b941cf5bb1ce04db9.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/457650bbb7cf5f86afd51966a4b0354cd4ba7996.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Finally, we arrive in Effingham, home to a large truck stop surrounded by shopping centers and malls. This is an ideal spot to stock up on supplies or take a short break before you roll out again.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/dff4897617d61691bbfba938fb4ff2c656ba9d96.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/50d34db08b6d5253682588ff1c06a065e02e5d2c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We hope these previews give you a glimpse of what’s waiting for you in Illinois. As always, keep in mind that the DLC is still in development, so some details may change before release. If you’re excited to explore the Prairie State, don’t forget to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486960/American_Truck_Simulator__Illinois/#game_area_purchase"]add this map expansion to your Steam wishlist[/url]. And of course, stay connected with us on [url="https://x.com/SCSsoftware"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/scssoft"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/scssoft.com"]Bluesky[/url], and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware"]TikTok[/url], or [url="https://www.scssoft.com/newsletter"]subscribe to our newsletter[/url] for more updates. Keep on truckin' and we’ll see you on the road!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486960/American_Truck_Simulator__Illinois/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Gamescom & Future Games Show & Find Your Next Game
notes.content: [p]We hope you're all enjoying the summer roads, whether you’re cruising through [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/"]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] or exploring the great American highways in [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"]American Truck Simulator[/url]. August is already in full swing, and with so many exciting things happening behind the scenes, we wanted to take a moment to share what’s coming up for SCS Software this month. Spoiler alert: it’s shaping up to be a big one![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e5a837a8ee52888bcf69bda3fad4293e28c67831.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Gamescom[/b][/p][p]This August, we’ll be attending [url="https://www.gamescom.global/en"]Gamescom[/url] in Cologne, Germany - one of the biggest events in the gaming calendar! We’re proud to be representing the Czech Republic as part of the Czech National Booth in the B2B (Business-to-Business) segment.[/p][p]Our mission? Meet, network, and explore new partnerships with a wide variety of companies. We're thrilled to have meetings lined up with representatives from major platforms, including Sony, Microsoft, and many more, across both the gaming and automotive industries. We're excited about the future and are actively working on ways to expand our presence and content offerings for both of our flagship titles. And while our presence at Gamescom is focused on the B2B segment this year, there's always a chance we’ll run into some of you. If you spot someone from the SCS team, don’t hesitate to say hi![/p][p][b]Future Games Show[/b][/p][p]Make sure to keep one eye open for the upcoming [url="https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow"]Future Games Show[/url] this August, because we’ve got something special in the works! A brand-new exclusive teaser video will be making its debut there, and we can’t wait for you to see it. [/p][p][b]Find Your Next Game[/b][/p][p]Also on your watchlist this August should be the [url="https://www.youtube.com/gamestar"]Find Your Next Game[/url] show, which runs alongside Gamescom, where we’ll also be dropping something cool and exclusive, this time related to the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2780810/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Nordic_Horizons/"]Nordic Horizons DLC[/url]. We’re incredibly proud of what’s coming and are thrilled to be part of this show’s lineup. We’re working hard to bring fresh new content and experiences to both Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator. The journey is far from over, and exciting things are still to come! We’re truly thankful for the continued support and enthusiasm from all of you, the #BestCommunityEver. Whether you’ve been driving with us for years or just recently joined the road, we appreciate every single one of you![/p][p]Until next time, keep on truckin’, and we’ll see you out there on the road![/p]

notes.title: Louisiana: Bridges
notes.content:
[p]The upcoming [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012580/American_Truck_Simulator__Louisiana/"]Louisiana DLC[/url] for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"]American Truck Simulator[/url] will take you deep into the heart of the American South, a region defined not only by its rich culture and unique landscapes but also by its intricate network of waterways. And where there are waterways, there are bridges![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2b82f2356dd2e1f8749faa49a54e096a5b78d8fb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In today’s blog, we'll be showcasing a selection of iconic bridges that you’ll be able to drive across in this upcoming map expansion. These structures aren’t just impressive feats of engineering; they are crucial lifelines that connect Louisiana’s cities, industries, and communities. And yes, we’ve made sure they look just as grand in-game as they do in real life![/p][p]The mighty Mississippi River slices right through Louisiana, and crossing it requires some truly monumental bridges. Among them is the Horace Wilkinson Bridge in Baton Rouge, the highest bridge over the Mississippi and a vital link for both local commuters and long-haul truckers.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f5146e7ac05fa4bcacf2e28a903c4062d7d98ce2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Further south in New Orleans, the Crescent City Connection offers a dramatic skyline view as you roll into the heart of the Big Easy. Farther along the Mississippi, the Huey P. Long – O.K. Allen Bridge (also known as the Old Bridge) offers another scenic and historical crossing.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8adeeca5d0a3cf207d414bf228e6141504491a87.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/fcd391f57fa5b0683f4626d640cfd79f957caddf.jpg"][/img][/p][p]One of the most striking bridges in the DLC is the Lake Pontchartrain Causeway, the longest continuous bridge in the world. Trust us, hauling a heavy load over this expanse feels as epic as it sounds.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9cad8925d8e748442bd45b47ebae035bcfb7145c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Out west in Lake Charles, drivers will encounter the Calcasieu High Bridge and Calcasieu River Bridge, vital connectors in a bustling industrial corridor, surrounded by pipelines and the hum of refinery life.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3d4298291d15ccf7693dbe6d14bcf73a7cd58077.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8c191917a5f788ca4de5d551d6678b936fd317ad.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Houma Twin Bridges give you a glimpse of the coastal lifestyle, while the Leeville Bridge and the Louisiana Highway 1 Bridge lead you deep into southern Louisiana’s marshy edge.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2a86b12b91190ab2cf8dd0d191e8653cdaa7ddfb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ec8471773a5f424d462dfc7c986eb2ad0762dabf.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c283adf9f550467c137c619be6b631c8d9b762ec.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Add to that the Simmesport Bridge and the stunning Veterans Memorial Bridge, and you’ve got a diverse lineup of spans that each bring something special to your trucking journey through the Pelican State.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/af78bcb6d9f787e3a6daf88cbdf4261c2c1c8818.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2653340f2da6079ce4d4a35afcb152d7a45c7e41.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every bridge in Louisiana DLC tells a story of commerce, connection, and character. From towering steel arches to sturdy river crossings, these landmarks are a defining part of the state’s landscape, and we can’t wait for you to drive across them, take in the views, and maybe even snap a few screenshots along the way![/p][p]Stay tuned for more previews as we continue to reveal what’s in store for American Truck Simulator -  Louisiana. In the meantime, don’t forget to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012580/American_Truck_Simulator__Louisiana/#game_area_purchase"]add the DLC to your Steam Wishlist[/url] and follow us on [url="https://x.com/SCSsoftware"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/scssoft"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/scssoft.com"]Bluesky[/url], and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware"]TikTok[/url], or [url="https://www.scssoft.com/newsletter"]subscribe to our newsletter[/url] for more behind-the-scenes content, teasers, and announcements.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012580/American_Truck_Simulator__Louisiana/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: South Dakota: Meet the Team
notes.content:
[p]A couple of months ago, we announced that we had begun work on the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749870/American_Truck_Simulator__South_Dakota/"]South Dakota DLC for American Truck Simulator[/url]. Today, we're excited to shine a light on the talented individuals behind the project by introducing the team working on this upcoming map expansion![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/36e992b3fd95d44b4148536e54881b57a464cf5c.jpg"][/img]
[b]Saimon
[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9bbba5c3599d46e7b1116c2d19054e45c6e8fb6f.jpg"][/img]
"I've been working at SCS Software for almost nine years, and for most of that time, I’ve been leading our DLC projects. This role included designing the overall layout of new expansions, choosing all the cities, truck stops, landmarks, as well as coordinating the work of our team, collaborating with other departments, and supporting the growth and motivation of my colleagues.

After years of working on multiple DLCs, the time has come to pass the torch to some of our talented and ambitious teammates. I’m now transitioning into a new position as an Art Lead, where I’ll focus more on broader aspects of map development, ensuring visual consistency, improving efficiency, and coming up with fresh ideas and unique content for the ATS world.

I'm truly excited about this new chapter and I believe it will help us deliver even more polished and immersive experiences for our players."

[b]Vacky
[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4d01ffc807d87f7a3b5c1163294bfb71241ddd5c.jpg"][/img]
"Something about me? I’ve been at SCS for over five years now. I’ve always loved playing games since I was a little boy and dreamed of designing them one day. Dreams do come true! Among my favorite titles are old school classics like Red Alert 2, Caesar III, Age of Empires 2, Heroes of Might and Magic, World of Warcraft (Classic), and many others. From newer games I enjoy Cities: Skylines, Stellaris, Elite Dangerous, Transport Fever and lately, I’ve been slowly getting into soul-like games. When I am not playing something on my computer, I am painting and playing Warhammer miniatures – specifically The Old World at the moment.

I was really looking forward to working on South Dakota since our research trip in the USA, and now I’m really happy to be working on Rapid City and its surroundings."

[b]Tony

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/13d08c893461f82c51f0946d62524b69e384042d.jpg"][/img]
"I was lucky enough to visit South Dakota in person and experience its diverse landscape firsthand. I was especially drawn to the mountainous regions in the western part of the state; Black Hills left a truly strong impression on me. That’s why I’m excited to be in charge of bringing this area to life in our game. I’m working to capture not just the unique terrain, but also the atmosphere that made the place feel so special during my visit."

[b]Draky

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/530a82a10d5d6515a0f2605e7e6e39c8d1925d37.jpg"][/img]
"My name is Draky, a nickname that reflects my passion for mythical creatures and animals. I'm a creatively inclined person who enjoys visual arts, painting, and design. I usually spend my free time playing video games, especially those focused on survival or puzzles. Some of my favorite physical activities include archery and acro yoga. I'm currently working on a visualization of the Sioux Falls waterfalls, which captivated me at first sight. I believe they’ll captivate you too. My next stop will be the Badlands, and I’m incredibly excited about it!"

[b]Evgeny

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e69c8fe792cc27974dbb86b1c1a8e315180d2367.jpg"][/img]
"South Dakota is the fourth DLC I’ve worked on, and with each new project, I challenge myself to push the boundaries of what I can create in the map. I always try to bring something fresh to both my work and the player experience. My personal life strongly influences my approach.

I’m passionate about hiking, which helps me craft more immersive and natural landscapes in the game. My background in architecture gave me a deep appreciation for designing cities and settlements with structure and character. I also enjoy drawing, painting, and calligraphy, which helps me focus on the beauty of detail and how it all fits together within a bigger concept. On top of that, endurance sports like triathlon have taught me how to stay committed to long-term goals, manage my time, and maintain mental resilience. Each of us on the team brings something unique to the world of ATS, and I’m proud to contribute with my own perspective."

[b]Morrys

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/61df042316c1a353bcb102c6ba874c78d99eabcf.jpg"][/img]
"After the awesome Iowa project, which received great feedback, we’ve jumped right into South Dakota. It’s a state that offers a lot, and you know it! Here’s a little hint about one of the things I’m working on and really enjoying. It’s a location not far from the Nebraska border and the Missouri River.

Anyway, since the last article ("Iowa - Meet the Team"), I feel there’s been progress. I’d say my work has reached a new level, both technically and visually. At the same time, we’ve also become a bit more in sync as a team, which is great, and I’m looking forward to the projects we’ll tackle in the future.
Of course, work isn’t the only thing I do! I have a strong connection to sports thanks to my background as a professional judoka, and I try to stay active as much as I can. I also enjoy some quiet time with a good movie, whatever the genre (though sci-fi is my favorite).

Last but not least, I love gaming. Some of the very first games I played as a kid were DOOM 2 and the flight simulator MiG-29 Fulcrum. To wrap it up, I wish you lots of successful contracts and plenty of miles logged in ATS!"

[b]Viki

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/30affbb728b1757abcb4a6bc4c03770ab171c5fd.jpg"][/img]
"I’ve been working at SCS for almost 3 years, during which I’ve worked on several map DLCs. I started with a few smaller tasks in Oklahoma, then worked on Nebraska and Iowa from start to finish, and I’m currently working on South Dakota.

In my free time, I enjoy 3D modeling and printing, creating cosplays from movies and video games, playing D&D with friends, and of course, playing video games!

I hope you’ll enjoy driving through the streets of Brookings, Hot Springs, as well as part of the Black Hills including the Mount Rushmore National Memorial. I love creating authentic and detailed scenes that I hope you’ll all have fun exploring. The rest of the team and I are looking forward to giving you the best possible way to experience the beauty of South Dakota."

[b]Fregar

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/664ae3f51f09d295c2d8ca098c442bcb0344f80c.jpg"][/img]
"My real name is Petra. I'm from Prague and I've been working at the company for almost five years. In my free time, I enjoy drawing and painting, it helps me relax and express myself creatively. I'm also a fan of Warhammer, which combines strategy, storytelling, and miniatures I enjoy painting. Swimming is another passion of mine; it keeps me active and clears my mind. At home, I take care of three parrots: Sofi, Iggy, and Mona, the newest addition to the family. She's still settling in, but already showing a lot of personality."

[b]Maky

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/651a1de338ffa782cbcc868b46ca9be879e03b8c.jpg"][/img][b]
[/b]"It will soon be three years since I started working at SCS as a map designer. My first contribution to the game was on Texas 2.0, followed by work on Nebraska, Iowa, and now South Dakota. Within my team, my speciality, responsibility, and personal passion is designing truck stops. Outside of work, I love going to concerts and festivals, music is one of my greatest joys. I also enjoy building LEGO sets and other model kits, playing board games and video games, and reading. Lately, I've even been thinking about getting a pet snake!"

[b]Kaja (Citymanlive)

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8b527a16a941a4b03fa50f953f4acc14c0728940.jpg"][/img]
"It's time to set out on a new journey – this time to South Dakota! Staying true to tradition, I'm currently working on a town whose name is quite similar to the one I worked on in Iowa. Thanks, Saimon! While creating – or more accurately, while currently “mayoring” the town – I enjoy a good cup of coffee… though not as much as I enjoy the company of my colleagues. In fact, it's really them who give me the greatest inspiration and energy. Together, we make up one big, leveled-up team, and I truly believe there's a lot to look forward to!"

[b]Eren

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4bbad4e89c735a91df1f3960017f6c1909cd8fc3.jpg"][/img]
"This is my third Map DLC. In South Dakota, I'm responsible for two areas: Sioux Falls, the state's largest city located in the east (besides the local waterfalls, which are being worked on by Draky), and Spearfish, situated on the edge of the Black Hills. I chose the former mainly to further develop my technical skills related to building large cities, while I took on the latter for its picturesque, hilly landscape covered with coniferous forests.

Starting with this DLC, I'm also taking on the role of Road Designer, specifically an interchange designer. It's probably a good thing I’m starting here, since there are mostly basic interchanges in South Dakota and the complex ones will only come later in other states. It’ll be a kind of level progression, and honestly, I’m looking forward to it."

[b]Theo

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bdc8119730a1f65c08d60d985428e1b75ad5b3ee.jpg"][/img]
"In the upcoming South Dakota DLC, I have the honor of building the city of Yankton and the surrounding area. I’m really enjoying the open landscapes and river scenery, this part of map creation is my current favorite, probably because I just enjoy being outside in real life, whether hiking or going for a walk. (Though I also like a quiet evening with a good book or video game!) Since American Truck Simulator blends gaming with exploring the world and its beautiful nature, I feel lucky to be part of a project like this!"

[b]Eevee
[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/afd6e64d2df9510723e647dd2ff20765cfce24fb.jpg"][/img][b]
[/b]"Hi! I'm Ivana, aka Eevee. I've always been interested in art of all kinds, whether it's drawing or painting, video games, music or even just coding silly websites. One of my biggest inspirations is and always will be nature. I love hiking, foraging, collecting trinkets outside, and just the outdoors in general. All of my hobbies combined have made me try joining the ranks of map designers here at SCS, and luckily, here I am!

I've been here for a little over half a year by now. On the last project – Iowa, I've only worked on a small part of US-20, and mostly did work in later development stages there, since I came here just a few months before the Iowa DLC release. Now I'm working on an entire part of South Dakota, around the northern borders. I like the open scenery so far, and have been working on a small city as well. I can only hope the players will like it as much as I'm enjoying working on it!"

[b]Miya

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a1a316d7f51d417564d303369f84847bdaf8147a.jpg"][/img]
"I joined the team recently, and South Dakota is my very first project. My passion for art is what brought me to SCS! For years, I’ve dedicated myself to illustration and drawing, often inspired by my favorite games across fantasy and simulator genres. Joining SCS feels like the perfect combination of everything I love.

Right now, I’m working a bit on everything, which I really enjoy. It’s a great opportunity to explore and find what suits me best!"
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6fb987bc9387f34daee9704a6e805b2cbebd85f9.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3367e2f9a5df165f7cb99ff9ba4a2dbf6e32698e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e954d593807475be07cf123927dd0d59c361dc44.jpg"][/img]
We hope you enjoyed reading these messages from the team working on South Dakota, shared with you, our #BestCommunityEver! If you're excited to hit the road in the Mount Rushmore State, be sure to add it to your Steam Wishlist. We truly appreciate all your support and look forward to sharing more about this upcoming DLC for American Truck Simulator. Until next time, keep on truckin'!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749870/American_Truck_Simulator__South_Dakota/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Introducing KRONE Agriculture Equipment
notes.content: [p]We’re thrilled to share an exciting update on a project that has been growing steadily here at SCS Software. Today, we're officially introducing a brand-new DLC in development, KRONE Agriculture Equipment, coming to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"]American Truck Simulator[/url].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5d3de83cfe2e9fcbec03fcb3eecf427eff72888f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This new DLC marks the next chapter in our ongoing collaboration with [url="https://www.krone-agriculture.com/"]KRONE[/url], the globally renowned manufacturer of high-performance agricultural machinery. Building on the success of the KRONE Trailer Pack for ETS2, we’re now expanding the scope to bring you a whole new line of authentic, officially licensed KRONE-branded farming equipment.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1ba4b22729f186c2f2c998cb262d81c24be0bf8b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As you haul cargo through the vast American heartland, the KRONE Agriculture Equipment DLC will offer a selection of real-world agricultural machinery that reflects the diversity and strength of modern farming logistics.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4c8d60deaa4d01203586093decee1d7866fdff9e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This DLC will introduce new cargo types featuring large-scale agricultural machines used throughout North America, from harvesters and balers to rakes and mowers, all carefully modeled with a high level of detail and realism. These machines will be hauled on specialized trailers, bringing new delivery challenges and fresh experiences for virtual truckers across the American landscape.[/p][p][b]New cargoes:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Disk Mower - Krone EasyCut B 880 CV[/p][/*][*][p]Forage Harvester - Krone BiG X 1180[/p][/*][*][p]Mower Conditioner - Krone BiG M 450Rotary Rakes - Krone Swadro TC 1370[/p][/*][*][p]Round Baler - Krone Comprima V 190 XC[/p][/*][*][p]Square Baler - Krone BiG Pack 1290[/p][/*][*][p]Wagon - Krone GX 440[/p][/*][/list][p]Along with that, we're also bringing some KRONE accessories you can use to decorate your cabin interior in both games![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a143d979d2da83a65e5341e2d01f8719cae3d6f9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]While we're still finalizing the details, models, and gameplay integration, we wanted to bring our community in early because this is something we're genuinely excited about. The KRONE Agriculture Equipment DLC is shaping up to be a unique and immersive addition to the logistics landscape of ATS. Just keep in mind that everything you see here is a work in progress and may not represent the final product.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ef6b2c3f866d4d4ec88b02ff1833db6e633decc3.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e96f6306481025e0ecabbf87d71946f9674ada60.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’ll be sharing more screenshots and details as we get closer to release. Until then, rest assured that our teams are working hard to cultivate something special for all fans of heavy haulage and agricultural tech.[/p][p]So, are you ready to haul some serious machinery? Be sure to add Krone Agriculture to your Steam Wishlist and stay connected with us on [url="https://x.com/SCSsoftware"]X[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/scssoft"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/scssoft.com"]Bluesky[/url], [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware"]TikTok[/url], and [url="https://www.youtube.com/@SCSSoftware"]YouTube[/url], or by [url="https://www.scssoft.com/newsletter."]subscribing to our newsletter[/url] for all the latest updates. See you on the road![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3872930/American_Truck_Simulator__KRONE_Agriculture_Equipment/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Louisiana: Cities #2
notes.content:
[p]In our previous blog, we gave you a glimpse into some of the cities featured in our upcoming [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012580/American_Truck_Simulator__Louisiana/"]Louisiana DLC[/url] for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"]American Truck Simulator[/url]. Today, we’re back with Part 2, where we’ll explore four more locations that drivers will be able to visit and deliver to. From industrial ports to small border towns, let’s take a closer look at what awaits!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/78607964bd5ac2d492d96661b6298f1aabab6a1c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Lake Charles[/b][/p][p]Situated in the southwest corner of Louisiana, Lake Charles is a dynamic blend of heavy industry and entertainment. Home to several chemical plants and oil refineries, it’s one of the state’s most important industrial centers. But there’s another side to the city, one lined with towering hotels and glitzy casinos, making it a magnet for nightlife and leisure.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/28401a5a2c5d03e5111ef3a6b0e9a99a3d165060.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9caf004c1001853b83f2997b8a871496587adacc.jpg"][/img]

Deliver to industrial giants such as the Oil Refinery or catch a glimpse of famous resorts and arcades. Whilst you won't be able to visit these entertainment establishments, our team have recreated them in detail, bringing some of these well known landmarks to life![/p][p][b]
DeRidder[/b][/p][p]
Not far from the Texas border lies DeRidder, a charming small town surrounded by forests and known for its lumber and paper industries. While modest in size, its industrial presence is significant, and both the sawmill and paper mill here will play a role in your deliveries.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/227a038419b377278bc1ecdf4e01c6385f05c33a.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ad1e3f9bc348d1140f501618e750eddd5b4d34b8.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/069292610708e9e8f1c8097c383e9aa3ce0e8ce2.jpg"][/img]
Players will also notice some of DeRidder’s most iconic landmarks, including the historic Gothic Jail, a rare piece of local architecture, and the Beauregard Parish Courthouse. The town's humble charm and regional character offer a slower pace compared to Louisiana’s larger cities—but that doesn’t mean there isn’t work to be done.

[b]Port Fourchon[/b][/p][p]
Port Fourchon isn’t a city in the traditional sense, it’s a sprawling industrial hub located at the southernmost tip of Louisiana. Known primarily for its role in the offshore oil and gas industry, the area is home to shipyards, oil terminals, and a busy river port, all of which are represented in the DLC.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/095cb59e07ccd38f03888b79c3478b8cbf73e0ef.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ae40fc568d3a8c9eb7ba3641757f975b09f437f5.jpg"][/img]
Unlike other places in the state, Port Fourchon carries a rugged and weather-worn identity, having withstood multiple hurricanes over the years. This gave our team a unique opportunity to depict a less polished environment, reflective of the real-world challenges faced by this critical port.

[b]Alexandria[/b][/p][p]
Centrally located in the state, Alexandria is where many of Louisiana’s major highways, I-49, US-165, US-167, and US-71 intersect, making it a vital transportation hub for the state. For drivers, that means plenty of options when it comes to routes and cargo opportunities.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4e9b8b9f8045dbe59200872b77fd4705cea33ce5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/27e8c558ff9c9ea3ef659c75a7baba3b6fbf4c77.jpg"][/img]
In the game, you'll traverse this logistical heartland while spotting local landmarks such as the large powerplant, several distinctive churches, and the broader urban area that has made Alexandria a regional connector for generations. Whether you’re passing through or making a delivery, it’s a key stop for any 

We hope you have enjoyed today's blog! Remember to add the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012580/American_Truck_Simulator__Louisiana/"]Louisiana DLC[/url] to your Steam Wishlist and don't forget to give our [url="https://x.com/SCSsoftware"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/scssoft"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/scssoft.com"]Bluesky[/url], and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware"]TikTok[/url] a follow as you'll receive updates about our games straight to your feed, or [url="https://www.scssoft.com/newsletter"]subscribe to our newsletter[/url] to stay informed! We look forward to sharing more with you in the future.

notes.title: GTA 6 better watch out, as American Truck Simulator adds drivable cars
notes.content:
For over nine years now, fans of American Truck Simulator have been riding high in some of the biggest rigs around, precisely carving their way through a shrunken down USA with some precious cargo in tow. No longer will you be tied to just trucks, as a new DLC pack will bring some iconic road cars to the game - just don't expect to be robbing banks and hijacking fighter jets anytime soon...

notes.title: ATS Road Trip: Ford Car Pack
notes.content:
[p]We’re shifting gears! Today, we’re excited to reveal our planned DLC for the upcoming Road Trip module in[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"] American Truck Simulator[/url], introducing the[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3793200/American_Truck_Simulator__Ford_Car_Pack/"] Ford Car Pack[/url]![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/365b62a797676fd8f2da0f141b82821fdeef04d1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For those who may have missed our earlier announcement,[url="https://blog.scssoft.com/2025/04/project-road-trip.html"] Road Trip[/url] is a brand-new addition to ATS that introduces a more dynamic way to explore the game world beyond traditional trucking. This new gameplay module allows players to step behind the wheel of a variety of vehicles, expanding the ATS experience while remaining true to the spirit of the open road.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/faf46d28bea6c0871a7a0e1078b7d0ed757c43c7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Ford Car Pack brings together some of the most iconic vehicles ever to grace American roads. From a legendary pony car to modern workhorses and pick-up trucks, players will be able to get behind the wheel of the iconic 1967 Mustang, the all-purpose 2023 F-150, the modern 2023 Bronco, and the legendary 1998–2012 Ford Crown Victoria.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6cbf18bed68dd4540d1c4468ad2fe36e352b0720.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e61c1154320fccdf130a32597ce08ba3e08f890b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5058dcd00dc412a9b21a3441f59ea5b6e167d6a9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Please note, however, that we are still finalizing the specific details for each vehicle, including engine configurations and trim options, which we plan to confirm and share with you at a later date.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c46b981dd6c74a4b667910b0cbb7f420fa016b35.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/28cdd54888b798d56df93434a98dd6c7658158ad.jpg"][/img][/p][p]With the eventual release of the Ford Pack, and with any Road Trip vehicle pack, the Road Trip gameplay module will become available to players. This means that owning this or any future Road Trip DLC will unlock access to this exciting new gameplay experience. It’s a major step forward for ATS, and we’re looking forward to seeing how you explore the roads ahead in these legendary rides.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4502c3e42c4eebcf79db2e0745fe5bac8e4e4fd4.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4538a4e2c9fcc30b76e46d2f48af78a9e74796aa.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’re incredibly thankful to Ford for their trust and collaboration. Their support has allowed us to faithfully recreate some of their most iconic vehicles in American Truck Simulator, and we’re proud to have them as part of this exciting new journey.
[/p][p]Think you’re ready to hit the road in true Ford fashion? Make sure to add the[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3793200/American_Truck_Simulator__Ford_Car_Pack/"] Ford Car Pack for American Truck Simulator to your Steam Wishlist[/url] today! To stay up to date with the latest Road Trip developments, be sure to[url="https://www.blogger.com/u/1/#"] [u]subscribe to our newsletter[/u][/url] and follow us on[url="https://www.x.com/SCSsoftware"] X/Twitter[/url],[url="https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs/"] Facebook[/url],[url="https://bsky.app/profile/scssoft.com"] BlueSky[/url], and[url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"] Instagram[/url].

notes.title: Iowa: Community Spotlight
notes.content:
[p]Since the launch of the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/"]Iowa DLC in American Truck Simulator[/url], we’ve been overwhelmed by the incredible feedback, photos, videos, and comments pouring in across our official social media channels. It’s always a highlight for our team to see how you’re enjoying the roads, landmarks, and landscapes we've worked hard to recreate. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/05fb9fbf537b27f16970d4e7dec0fb0a6e1bdeae.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Just like with previous expansions, we’re excited to highlight some of the creations from our #BestCommunityEver as you explore everything Iowa has to offer.[/p][previewyoutube="_VCKUJtpMMU;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="OftWMl1Nq3w;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="x_ffiT8J0U4;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="qQEaMlALBNw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Have something exciting to share from your journey through Iowa? Be sure to tag us with #CruisingIowa on [url="https://x.com/SCSsoftware"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/scssoft.com"]BlueSky[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/eurotrucksimulator2"]Facebook[/url], or [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware"]TikTok[/url], or post your thoughts on the [url="https://forum.scssoft.com/"]official SCS Forum[/url]. A huge thank you to everyone who's already shared their adventures with us. Keep those posts coming, we love seeing what you're up to out there on the road![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/16aa3a388c00159d9bca9ba15cf9c3cfb055df11.jpg"][/img]Source: [i][url="https://x.com/ArnVtc"]@ArnVtc[/url][/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/59222ca3f1c11e7a34e6ed14b61d4e4c591eaf10.jpg"][/img] [i]Source: [url="https://x.com/P_Nezzie"]@P_Nezzie[/url][/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/80687f55d5801000780c6fc50e2d4e194dad0e67.jpg"][/img]Source: [i][url="https://x.com/xavior09"]@xavior09[/url][/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/989703f66317107a2ced274ed038dd8aa474d285.jpg"][/img] [i]Source: [url="https://x.com/GenadijOv"]@GenadijOv[/url][/i][/p][p]We also connected with a variety of content creators across the web to hear what they think about the Iowa DLC. Take a look at some of their impressions below! We really appreciate their insights and the time they put into creating content about our games. Be sure to check out their channels and give them a follow to show your support!  [b]A. P. 101 Gaming[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/992ffb956227850fac4316d37730bf1c3b98c345.png"][/img][/p][p][i]"SCS has done it once again! I really enjoyed the contrast of driving through small, remote towns and larger, bustling cities. It made the whole state feel alive and diverse. Trucking along peaceful country roads and then jumping onto major interstates like I-80 was super fun. Of course, one of the first places I had to check out was the largest truck stop, and SCS didn’t disappoint; it is HUGE! The new and unique industries are fantastic. Plus, there are so many small and big landmarks across the map. The attention to detail is absolutely incredible."[/i]- [url="https://www.youtube.com/ap101gaming"]A. P. 101 Gaming[/url][/p][p] [b]DaSimSimma[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/cec9ffb8c3f32f2eaf023b8e26e93c6646ea9b95.jpg"][/img] [/p][p][i]"I’ve always dreamed of visiting the world’s largest truck stop, but never thought a game would get me there first. The Iowa DLC surprised me with how personal it felt—pulling off at the biggest truck stop in the game and just soaking it in was one of those moments that remind you why ATS is so special. It’s more than a game—it’s a way to explore the country in ways you didn’t think were possible." - [/i][url="https://www.youtube.com/@DaSimSimma"]DaSimSimma[/url] [/p][p][b]Arrow's Realm[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1f2d9658f92e7ab2e24630df8b9521eb7a66334b.png"][/img][/p][p][i]"The Iowa DLC for American Truck Simulator is another stellar addition to the game’s line-up of expansions. As a detail enthusiast, I began my journey in Des Moines, where I spent over an hour marveling at the meticulously crafted cityscape. From iconic buildings and monuments to the vibrant flowers that brighten the surroundings, the attention to detail is impressive. Eager to explore further, I set out across the state, driving from city to city and uncovering real-world landmarks beautifully recreated by the development team. Kudos to SCS Software for making Iowa—a relatively flat state—visually engaging and far from monotonous. Even after hours of gameplay, I’m still soaking up new details like a sponge, though I’ve yet to spot that elusive Amish horse and cart. If you’re seeking hours of immersive exploration and fun, the Iowa DLC is a must-have. SCS Software continues to raise the bar with their commitment to realism and technical excellence. I’m already excited for what they’ll deliver next."  - [url="https://www.twitch.tv/arrowsrealm"]Arrow's Realm[/url][/i][/p][p] [b]Kworey[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/61985f8b0544243e0cea23c82bcfed0ff61a9a35.png"][/img] [/p][p][i]"DLC after DLC, the quality standards always increase. Iowa DLC's small details are outstanding. I am not familiar with the United States since I am from Europe, but when driving in American Truck Simulator, I can really feel the vibe of what it would be like in real life. Congratulations to everyone involved in the development of the DLC."  [/i]- [url="https://www.twitch.tv/kworey"]kworey[/url] [/p][p]As we close out this post, we want to express our heartfelt gratitude for your continued support. Your thoughtful feedback, generous reviews, and helpful suggestions truly matter to us. Our team is always striving to bring you the best possible content, and your encouragement drives us forward. Thank you!

notes.title: SCS On The Road: Star Nation Experience 2025
notes.content: [p]We're back with another unforgettable episode of SCS On The Road! Join Oscar and Beny as they take you back to Oregon for the Star Nation Experience 2025. Partnering once again with our friends at [url="https://www.westernstartrucks.com/"]Western Star[/url], the event brought together eight lucky contestants from across North America for a weekend packed with adrenaline, adventure, and—of course—trucks![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6e8a2310b023fe7155c7d3b7321f6fd362050a4e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Among the group were two members of the American Truck Simulator community, Tyler and Alex. Tyler, a seasoned truck driver, brought his real-world experience to the challenge. Meanwhile, Alex, despite it being his first time ever behind the wheel of a real truck, was brimming with excitement to test drive the powerful Western Star 49X! You can find more information about the two ATS participants in our [url="https://blog.scssoft.com/2025/05/star-nation-2025-update.html"]previous blog[/url].[/p][previewyoutube="F3z8PmXk4Bc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Kicking off the action-packed weekend was a team-based competition designed to test both skills and spirit. Tyler and Alex found themselves on opposing teams, turning friendly rivalry into pure entertainment.[/p][p]One of the highlights of Saturday was a test track experience. But before participants got behind the wheel of a real truck, their first challenge was to complete a course on the SCS Motion Simulator running American Truck Simulator. Once completed, they moved on to driving real trucks on the test track, taking on a series of driving challenges that brought the in-game experience to life.[/p][p]Another exciting moment came during a challenge at the High Desert Proving Grounds. Participants had to reverse trucks downhill, then stop precisely at a marked zone to score points. Next, they tackled another challenge at a quarry – guessing the weight of a gravel-loaded trailer and spreading it evenly between two cones. [/p][p]The adventure didn’t slow down on Sunday. With the sun barely rising over Oregon, the group kicked things off with a fly fishing session. Then came ATV riding, where the drivers embraced the dust, speed, and freedom of the Deschutes wilderness.  We were once again blown away by the skill and dedication of our American Truck Simulator community. Watching Alex transition from virtual to real trucking with such confidence and enthusiasm was especially moving – a true example of how games can spark real-world aspirations. Tyler’s journey was just as inspiring, as American Truck Simulator played a big role in helping him choose his future path in trucking and earning his CDL.  [/p][p]We’re incredibly proud of Tyler, Alex, and all the participants who made this year’s Star Nation Experience unforgettable. Whether behind a wheel or in front of a monitor, the passion for trucking runs deep in the #BestCommunityEver.  [/p][p]A huge thank you goes out to [url="https://www.westernstartrucks.com/"]Western Star[/url] for hosting and organizing this amazing event, and for continuing to believe in the powerful connection between simulation and reality. Until next time, keep on truckin’, and we’ll see you out there on the road! [/p]

notes.title: Louisiana: Wetlands and Forests
notes.content: [p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012580/American_Truck_Simulator__Louisiana/"]Louisiana[/url]'s lakes, rivers, swamps, bayous, and forests showcase a remarkable variety of landscapes. Today, we will take a look at the beautiful nature you will find in the Pelican State while on the road in this upcoming map expansion for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"]American Truck Simulator[/url]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a17a8b8f4093265292ccedc37994b0591f3479e4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Louisiana's warm, subtropical climate, thanks to its location within the Gulf of Mexico, sets the stage for some truly one-of-a-kind scenery. It's a big shift from some of the landscapes in our previous map expansions. The Pelican State's terrain is broadly divided into three distinct regions: dense forests, sweeping prairies, and expansive marshlands, each offering its own unique scenery and atmosphere. The state offers 22 national parks as well as many impeccable nature trails, paddling routes, fishing areas, and more. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/64a95e44d31b7d2c534ac4a3ecc83c188e7a0302.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/af2582c99a39d0f32cffeeca36ef7df9915f5c9b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8dea4e07e6b247e24b45ef6e640ba287f019902a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Mississippi River has played a big role in shaping Louisiana's landscape. For thousands of years, it carried huge amounts of dirt and sand from all across the country and slowly built up the southern coastline, pushing it miles out into the Gulf of Mexico. As the river shifted its path over time, it left behind old river branches that slowly sank and wore away, forming the mix of marshes, lakes, and winding bayous that make this area so unique today. You may follow the river upstream if you are traveling U.S. Route 65, which winds along the Mississippi border. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/0427054d80d27b585a0f7845cd8c8c0e80487a65.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you want to experience more of the bayou region, head down to the southern coast. From shadowy swamps with cypress trees to sunlit marshes, the bayous are home to unique wildlife, including diverse species of birds and alligators. This area is also vital for harvesting shrimp, oysters, and fish. For a scenic drive through this natural wonder, follow the LA-82. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8e5819e2cb225c2380ea8b5fabbc75e951b20ff7.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4c58603bb1920f2de60b8e710b99ede31bf2add5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ec73cb9cb49b213f9b7c05954e37f0c17d822887.jpg"][/img][/p][p]However, the lowlands are not the only type of landscape found in Louisiana. If you venture further north, you will discover the Red River valley, which has a low-elevation relief and typically features red soil. In the northern part of the state, you will mainly find some rolling hills, which you may come across while driving along I-20. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2e6460721b960e6e55f504b55f43ce4709a03ffe.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a50618d8ba69ff065940267099ddcf3579d343a7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And that's it for today! Remember to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012580/American_Truck_Simulator__Louisiana/#game_area_purchase"]add the Louisiana DLC to your Steam Wishlist[/url] and don't forget to give our [url="https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/scssoft"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/scssoft.com"]Bluesky[/url], and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware"]TikTok[/url] a follow as you'll receive updates about our games straight to your feed! Or [url="https://www.scssoft.com/newsletter"]subscribe to our newsletter[/url] to stay informed. We look forward to sharing more with you soon. [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012580/American_Truck_Simulator__Louisiana/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: South Dakota: Research Trip
notes.content: [p]A few weeks back, we announced that the work had already begun on the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749870/American_Truck_Simulator__South_Dakota/"]South Dakota[/url] map expansion for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"]American Truck Simulator[/url]. Now, before we are ready to share more in-game news, we would like to show you an interview with the map lead, Saimon, who will tell you more about their research trip to the Mount Rushmore State![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5195adf9d8e41d267cb0c943a6bc59d5dbbd5627.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In August 2023, members of the South Dakota map design team set out on an exciting road trip across Nebraska, Iowa, and South Dakota. "At the time, South Dakota was still a potential future destination for American Truck Simulator, but deep down, we had a strong feeling we'd be building it one day. So we decided to get ahead of the game and hit the road. And let me tell you, seeing the landscape with your own eyes changes everything. You start to notice subtle details that maps, photos, and videos just don't capture. The trip was absolutely worth it," says Saimon.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8bfa3eac5b8b02d669687e9d4d28a7ea944d757a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The road trip crew was made up of four dedicated team members from the original Nebraska map team. Since then, they've successfully finished Iowa and are now diving into South Dakota. Leading the team is Saimon, the project lead. Alongside him are Vacky, a seasoned senior with leadership ambitions; Tony, another senior who specializes in rocks and terrain formations; and Draky, whose keen eye for vegetation and terrain materials makes a significant impact in crafting believable landscapes. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e9a7b98a50f34e87d7372eb87f8a4c62cab9b0fd.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d21805e0eeb92a65910bac359dceb0784dcdd7c6.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a57fe45f2b0f9e7a0476781bcb8517d76590ba64.jpg"][/img][/p][p]"We entered South Dakota via US-385, coming up from Chadron, NE, and our first stop was the area around Black Hills. One of the first places we hit was Maverick Junction, where the gently rolling forested hills of the Black Hills welcomed us. We continued along US-18 into Hot Springs, and it took only a few minutes for us to fall in love with this charming town. With its historic buildings, public murals, sculptures, and unique atmosphere, we immediately knew it deserved a spot in the game," Saimon shares his team's first impressions.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/79ad21c2675a34c6469b1bea993c66b18fa1e1ad.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6f7626b5f59d422bdbd8669793664b3f31194ada.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/0753d8740fed43bad0b4ea4be4b17db44aa52ac9.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/559a088406a4927759c6d6c30d55bcd1aee57295.jpg"][/img][/p][p]"Driving through the Black Hills left us in awe. The region's vastness, hilly terrain, and breathtaking vistas felt almost otherworldly. Wildlife was everywhere - bison, pronghorns, prairie dogs - you name it. We stopped at several settlements, including Keystone, Three Forks, and the iconic Deadwood. Of course, we couldn't miss one of America's most famous landmarks - Mount Rushmore," says Saimon.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/93d32d0af8d985d7a90a18f275638112bc634dfc.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/250d7f84e9ad3d4c611139d7ad617921bfae77c7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]"What surprised us about Mount Rushmore is how much more there is beyond the famous faces of the four presidents. The approach to the memorial includes dramatic tunnels, winding roads, and scenic loops that are memorable on their own. The site itself is expansive, with a massive entrance plaza, countless parking areas, several distinct buildings, and a striking Avenue of Flags. We were genuinely impressed - and we're treating this location with great respect to ensure it's represented in the game as monumentally as it feels in real life," Saimon told us.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/bbd96cb1dc178a69248b9e97564626d992322d65.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/cde3b0f6ae2962b3caadd8cd6724aa80274f6d76.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d8d480ab5489fee3d3247a1a9de353fbfd1dcaad.jpg"][/img][/p][p]From the Black Hills, the team continued their journey eastward, heading toward Rapid City and neighboring towns. "Rapid City took us by surprise with its sprawling layout and how the city is embraced by tall hills. The town features some unique buildings and sculptures, along with a beautiful park and several industrial zones that we’re excited to showcase in future blog posts!"[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1ad49ac6ca167e9a9ec9b89bdad0a188a9d88623.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/33309c1ceeb6bf9d6d23322d8220fab0f4fb04a0.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/dbdca702b29791bbff3718b30d91535a07c1d0eb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Another place that made an impression on the team was Sturgis. Known far and wide for its legendary motorcycle rally and western saloons, the town had a distinct charm that was impossible to ignore. "At first, we weren't sure we'd be able to fit it into the game world at our scale, but after scouting the area, we found a way, and we're so glad we did," says Saimon.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9543c64e7264df49a42b137a244a918e959f3c15.jpg"][/img][/p][p]"Further down I-90, we kept seeing these bold, frequent billboards for a place called Wall. Every mile or so, another sign popped up. Eventually, we couldn't resist - we had to see what all the hype was about. Wall turned out to be more than just a town - it's a gateway to Badlands National Park and home to a true roadside icon: Wall Drug. What started in the 1930s as a small drugstore offering free ice water to travelers has since grown into a massive shopping complex. With quirky attractions, souvenir shops, restaurants, and even animatronic dinosaurs, Wall Drug is the kind of place you remember forever. It perfectly captures that larger-than-life roadside Americana we love bringing into ATS." [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/caeb8f3fbcaba8a1cfd466fc0ddb9f139b4f2938.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c6c9b2e411deb9e7e7f4f78ec1c1dc3e49021d39.jpg"][/img][/p][p]After that, the team ventured into Badlands National Park. "The dramatic landscapes - rugged rock formations, steep canyons, and vibrant layers of sediment - are like something from another planet. Driving through the park gave us a real appreciation for the geological history and scale of South Dakota's natural beauty. The shifting light, deep colors, and sense of quiet made it one of the most awe-inspiring parts of our entire journey," Saimon shares.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/cdff957ef53bef661e9646c1c5ecbb9ea5de4d98.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a2872b0f3a9088870e04eff3a659f74bc58c7e6e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/001f3b13d8f0fd19027b490900b34c97008a6edf.jpg"][/img][/p][p]"Before continuing eastward, we made a final stop in the small town of Murdo, another picturesque settlement with a unique vibe. But we'll save the stories from the rest of our trip - and the towns along the way - for future blog posts," Saimon concludes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f97073ae25017e5478ed4b42d5d7856682255438.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5df2fe03ca25da103df9c2d171a62b71db69ed88.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/cdb1057dcb0751063bb124f0ed10daef484ab122.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We hope you enjoyed this behind-the-scenes view of how the team behind this upcoming DLC gathers inspiration. Make sure to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749870/#game_area_purchase"]add the South Dakota DLC to your Steam wishlist[/url]! Remember to follow us on [url="https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware"]Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/scssoft"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/"]Bluesky[/url], and [url="https://www.youtube.com/@SCSSoftware"]YouTube[/url] for all the latest news from this map expansion and American Truck Simulator, or [url="https://www.scssoft.com/newsletter"]sign up for our newsletter[/url] to stay informed. Until next time, we wish you happy travels![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749870/American_Truck_Simulator__South_Dakota/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Iowa DLC Release
notes.content:
[p]You don’t need the eyes of a hawk to see what’s coming, the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/"]Iowa DLC for American Truck Simulator[/url] officially releases today! Get ready to explore everything that the Hawkeye State has to offer.
[/p][h3][b]The Iowa DLC for American Truck Simulator is now released! 
 [/b][/h3][previewyoutube="sVrwp9u93Lk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
It’s been quite the journey since we first revealed that Iowa was in development, and today, we're thrilled to finally share it with our #BestCommunityEver. With expansive road networks, charming towns, and plenty of jobs across the heart of the Midwest, there’s a lot to look forward to behind the wheel. We're also updating the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2638630/American_Truck_Simulator__Farm_Machinery/"]Farm Machinery DLC [/url]and launching a new World of Trucks event, so be sure to read the full blog to catch all the details surrounding this release.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9422857fcf35120c8a48396d2dfb2cfda8bfa9df.jpg"][/img]Make the most of your visit to the Hawkeye State and enjoy every moment as you:
[/p][list][*][p]Truck through 12 cities including Des Moines, Cedar Rapids, Dubuque, Burlington, Iowa City, and more![/p][/*][*][p]Discover beautifully recreated landmarks like the Iowa State Capitol, Historic Cedar Covered Bridge, Tree in the Middle of the Road, or the world’s largest grain bins.[/p][/*][*][p]Deliver cargo to or from new depots – the agricultural factory and agricultural dealer.[/p][/*][*][p]Visit the biggest truck stop we have ever built in ATS on Interstate 80![/p][/*][*][p]Become a vital part in transporting farm produce from the Hawkeye State all over the USA.[/p][/*][*][p]Explore more than 15 scenic towns (settlements) on your travels such as Spencer, Clear Lake, Dyersville, Oskaloosa, or Traer![/p][/*][*][p]Pick up and deliver equipment and goods to the Aluminum Factory, a brand-new prefab depot featuring custom-designed assets.[/p][/*][*][p]Admire the state’s stunning expansive hills with terraced fields and picturesque farms.[/p][/*][*][p]Keep goods flowing in and out of Iowa’s huge ethanol plant depots, supporting its lead in U.S. ethanol production.[/p][/*][*][p]Uncover Iowa’s hidden gems, find hidden roads, viewpoints, and more!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/938fe998bcc53d2ca568dc06724d0fb2db278efa.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fcfa0cc7c129b0d7d2aad82d09dd9c73c88adf98.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b0b1af994fbe85c9da6c2529a2fe39c26b8e2255.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b19ad4a87ba7bf0f329e1a83471021f7a8d3eaf6.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/44cc7f089089f285a1fe07df25e02d6bd344b6fd.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/33d4ee13c90c483ada8ab25b9b5e93d34f1a656a.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/05d561a77278fec0d798bd0266a4408951421364.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Cruise through lively river cities and quiet farming communities as you discover the diverse scenery of Iowa, from elevated prairie hills to expansive fields lined with silos and wind turbines. This map expansion brings detailed landmarks like the Iowa State Capitol and iconic bridges spanning the Mississippi. With a road network featuring major interstates, rural highways, and small-town streets, Iowa offers a unique and immersive journey for any driver![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/321c49b9a0776a2d91823917a18ad689e59c5565.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/055375eeb3686bf807e51715f197ede694686298.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/531698b26959d8da4ac2075c1913e8c940ee1baf.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c540029a70b79ffc4c1e1e145b0018970dda94b5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c210c75f4f63ad1a282bc9cfeeaa1a5f423d7995.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e54d63f95d8a177add86b6e3e2bca0159b4d8b4a.jpg"][/img]
[b]Farm Machinery DLC Update   

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/813aebfa787ba3cf7ef6dbdf14d8002b0f9c625e.jpg"][/img][b]
[/b]With the 1.55 update, we introduced a new cargo addition to the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2638630/American_Truck_Simulator__Farm_Machinery/"]Farm Machinery DLC[/url], the Windrower! This essential piece of agricultural equipment is used to gather and align crops into neat rows for drying and harvesting, and now it’s your job to haul it where it’s needed most.  The Windrower will be available on the job market in two color variants: a classic green and a yellow version branded with OWL, one of our in-game farming equipment manufacturers. Designed for lowboy trailers, it’s a wide and impressive load that brings more variety to your agricultural deliveries.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e50a0c187e8d85df673a8b572b4e0901d3995509.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can find the full details about this update[b] [/b][url="https://blog.scssoft.com/2025/06/155-update-farm-machinery-dlc-update.html"]here.[/url]

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2638630/American_Truck_Simulator__Farm_Machinery/"][/dynamiclink][b]Iowa Freight & Fields Bundle

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8b614b7659661a1e284714f32b0ebe008b403fb5.jpg"][/img]
Get ready to haul big cargo in style with the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/56131/Iowa_Freight__Fields/"]Iowa Freight & Fields Bundle for American Truck Simulator![/url] Celebrate the release of the Iowa map expansion, the heart of America's agricultural industry - with this special bundle which includes four DLCs: Iowa, Special Transport, Farm Machinery, and the Retrowave Paint Jobs Pack.[/p][p]Haul farming equipment across Iowa with the Farm Machinery DLC, from the iconic I-80 to the capital city of Des Moines, and through charming towns along the Mississippi River, and put your driving skills to the test with oversized cargo from the Special Transport DLC.[/p][p]Top it all off with bold, retro flair drive in vibrant ‘80s style with the Retrowave Paint Jobs Pack as you cruise through the Hawkeye State.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Cruising Iowa World of Trucks Event

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0776bd067288d522185d59691d2c0c36f1d4f099.jpg"][/img][b]
[/b]Right with the release of this map expansion, we are also introducing the [url="https://blog.scssoft.com/2025/07/cruising-iowa-world-of-trucks-event.html"]#CruisingIowa World of Trucks Event[/url] for you to enjoy! We challenge our #BestCommunityEver to achieve a collective goal of driving 125,000,000 miles while delivering cargo to or from any city in Iowa. The personal goal is to deliver cargo to or from all 12 cities in the Hawkeye State, with each job being 100 miles or more. You can read more about the event here.[/p][p][/p][p]Unique rewards await those who complete the challenge! Truckers who achieve their personal goal will earn the Golden Flight ATS truck paint job and a World of Trucks Achievement.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4d9f86a8066b5bb2fecc56657d3991cb01ecebda.jpg"][/img]When the community goal is met, and if you’ve also completed your personal goal, you’ll receive the beautifully crafted Porcelain Wild Rose hanging ornament for your cabin.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8d95ac0abd7ea509842cbb6e541452b909f2630b.jpg"][/img]But that’s not all, truckers who complete a job using External Contracts or the External Market[b] TO or FROM Iowa City[/b] will be rewarded with the Happy Hog cabin plush! Soft, snuggly, and full of Midwestern charm, this cheerful piglet pays tribute to Iowa’s proud farming heritage and is sure to keep you company on your travels! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1f1fb5be9577145404e38e94467a743d859de437.jpg"][/img]We can’t wait for you to start trucking through the Hawkeye State. Don’t forget to tag us in your photos and videos using the hashtag #CruisingIowa on [url="https://x.com/SCSsoftware"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs/"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software"]Instagram[/url],and [url="https://bsky.app/profile/scssoft.com"]Bluesky[/url]. If you’re enjoying your time #CruisingIowa, we’d really appreciate it if you left a review on the Iowa DLC Steam store page. We thank you for all your support and until next time, keep on truckin'! 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Cruising Iowa World of Trucks Event
notes.content: [p]Join us on [b]Thursday[/b], [b]the 10th of July[/b], to celebrate the release of our new [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/"]Iowa DLC[/url], by taking part in our [url="https://worldoftrucks.com/en/"]World of Trucks[/url] event - [b]Cruising Iowa[/b]! Get ready for an unforgettable ride through the heart of the Midwest and explore the rural beauty of the Hawkeye State, while on the job.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9212918e98e42af0542f0bdbab5b11ca76b14ab2.jpg"][/img] We're calling on our #[b]BestCommunityEver[/b] to achieve the goal of driving [b]125,000,000 miles[/b] (201,168,000 km) while delivering cargo to or from any city in Iowa. [/p][p]While #[b]CruisingIowa[/b], you'll enjoy losing yourself in beautiful scenic farms and crop fields. But don't forget to also visit Iowa's biggest cities Des Moines, Cedar Rapids or Davenport - especially at night, when the city lights create a magical atmosphere as you drive across its iconic bridges.[/p][p]The Hawkeye State is well known for its agricultural wealth and stands at the top in production, especially of corn, hogs, eggs, and ethanol. As you contribute to the state's economy by hauling not only farming goods but also machinery, you'll have the chance to explore new agricultural factories, dealerships, and ethanol plants along the way.[/p][p]While travelling through Iowa, you'll encounter breathtaking views and memorable highlights, including: [/p][list][*][p]Burlington, offering riverfront charm and historic streets in beautiful scenery[/p][/*][*][p]Dubuque Lock & Dam 11, vital to navigation and water control on the Upper Mississippi[/p][/*][*][p]Cedar Rapids, where innovation meets Midwest charm in the City of Five Seasons[/p][/*][*][p]Baseball Field, a legendary Iowa ballfield where dreams and nostalgia still echo[/p][/*][/list][previewyoutube="WCdQy2KkJhI;full"][/previewyoutube][p]As with past cruising events, you can use your own trailer and experience all the fun using the external market![/p][p]Explore 12 incredible cities in the Iowa DLC, and unlock a uniquely crafted reward by achieving your [b]personal goal[/b] of delivering [b]to or from every one of them[/b]. All event jobs need to be 100 miles (161 km) or longer.[/p][p]Are you ready to hit the road? Join us in #CruisingIowa and let's explore the Hawkeye State's endless prairies, crop fields, unspoiled nature and historic cities.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9893f97947d0e4fb46bc70dee474613851995baa.jpg"][/img] [/p][p][u][b]Rules[/b][/u] [/p][p]Using [b]External Contracts[/b] or [b]External Market[/b], with a World of Trucks-connected profile in American Truck Simulator, the [b]community goal[/b] is to drive [b]125,000,000[/b] miles (201,168,000 km) while delivering cargoes [b]to or from[/b] any city in Iowa.[/p][p]When a player completes a delivery [b]to or from[/b] 12 different Iowa cities, they will achieve their [b]personal goal[/b].[/p][p][b]All jobs[/b] for the event need to be at least [b]100 miles[/b] each (161 km), or more.[/p][p]You can check if your recent deliveries met these conditions using your [url="https://worldoftrucks.com/jobs"]Log Book[/url] in your World of Trucks profile.[/p][p][u][b]Rewards[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p][b]Personal[/b]: Players that deliver cargo [b]to or from[/b] 12 Iowa cities will gain a personal [b]World of Trucks Achievement[/b] and a [b]Golden Flight[/b] ATS truck [b]paint job[/b] Steam inventory item.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/828744e4dd134a939b675c67a6738b158a1d08b6.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Community[/b]: When the community goal of driving [b]125,000,000[/b] miles (201,168,000 km) during deliveries [b]to or from[/b] any city in Iowa is met, and if the player has also achieved their personal goal, then they will receive a [b]Porcelain Wild Rose[/b] hanging ornament Steam inventory item.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8d95ac0abd7ea509842cbb6e541452b909f2630b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Note[/b]: In order to qualify for any community reward, you must complete at least your personal goal in American Truck Simulator. Each reward will be a Steam inventory item for American Truck Simulator. Once completed, claim your reward in the Events page on your [url="https://www.worldoftrucks.com/en/events"]World of Trucks[/url] profile.[/p][p]The event will be concluded on [b]Sunday, the 14th of September at 23:59 UTC[/b].[/p][p]We can't wait to hear about your discoveries as you cruise through the beautiful Hawkeye state! So, please share your screenshots and videos with us using the hashtag #[b]CruisingIowa[/b] on our [url="https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs/"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://twitter.com/scssoftware"]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], and [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"]Instagram[/url] profiles and we will share our favourite ones (we may even feature some of them in a future blog post!).[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Illinois: Quincy
notes.content: [p]Nestled along the majestic Mississippi River, the city of Quincy is full of rich history, stunning architecture, vibrant arts, and beautiful nature. Let's see what it looks like in our upcoming [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486960/American_Truck_Simulator__Illinois/"]Illinois[/url] map expansion for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"]American Truck Simulator[/url]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/246aa64008ae0a53a31fd2bd5406874d3ad92e3c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The seat of Adams County is located on the western side of the Prairie State, right on the border with [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730870/American_Truck_Simulator__Missouri/"]Missouri[/url]. Quincy is also called the Gem City, and it's no wonder, as it features beautiful parks, a scenic riverfront, historic neighborhoods with some of the most stunning houses in the country, and a vibrant downtown.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/be0565e7361e12a8dd64a5ba68928c209cc9a637.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8d8f5f73feb61e9ff67fc2fd8da7438270d39e55.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/372205c219c2d0855fae10560d24318828204449.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We just couldn't leave out some of those wonderful buildings found in Quincy and decided to make them as landmarks, recreating them to faithfully represent how you can find them in the real world. These include the historic boat club building, the architecturally stunning church in the city center, the local community center, the museum, the marina, and the water treatment facility. As previously mentioned, the town is home to some lovely parks, so our map team has made sure to include Washington Park right in the heart of the city.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/231c4dead2e1d6c75322aa15bacb76dd42ab3b3a.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/92369141ec7215005b329a02f4196e3a23a38751.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/dbb3c8ec5a5f5579e378446ff5c5c80f6884c876.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And of course, both the Bayview Bridge and the Memorial Bridge which span the Mississippi River and connect the city to Missouri have also been recreated. Near those bridges, you can also come across a sculpture, a small detail breathing in a little more realism into our recreation of Quincy.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e8005baffa6b18403c38930b1ecdd9147955da30.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ac19b828b4bd42e60942a55e7d5f3508974778e2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Regarding the industries that truckers can find in this city, there will be plenty to choose from when you are looking for a job! You will be able to deliver in and out of a home improvement store, a parking lot construction site, a garden center, a factory producing superstructures for pickup trucks and similar vehicles, and a grain elevator. You'll also come across two other depots, one of them brand new and currently in development, specifically for this map expansion. We won't spoil the surprise just yet, so stay tuned for future blog posts![/p][p]If you enjoyed this preview of the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486960/"]Illinois DLC[/url], make sure to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486960/#game_area_purchase"]add this map expansion to your Steam wishlist[/url]! Remember to stay tuned for more American Truck Simulator news by following us on [url="https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware"]Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/scssoft"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/scssoft.com"]Bluesky[/url], and [url="https://www.youtube.com/@SCSSoftware"]YouTube[/url]. We would also really appreciate it if you could [url="https://www.scssoft.com/newsletter"]sign up for our newsletter[/url]. We will see you on the road![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486960/American_Truck_Simulator__Illinois/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Louisiana: Settlements
notes.content:
[p]On your journey through American Truck Simulator’s upcoming [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012580/American_Truck_Simulator__Louisiana/"]Louisiana DLC[/url], you won’t just be visiting major cities, you’ll also pass through quaint, rural towns full of Southern charm. Today, we’re shining a spotlight on some of these smaller communities you’ll be able to drive through or stop at along the way.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/12ad5c70e3187a940bac84af29602dd658c8a6c8.jpg"][/img]
[b]Winnfield[/b]

Located in northern Louisiana, Winnfield offers drivers a glimpse of classic Southern town life. Drivers passing through can spot local landmarks such as the Winn Parish Courthouse, a prominent building with traditional brickwork. Nearby, you can also find the town's Post Office and the First Baptist Church, which stands out with its tall and modern freestanding steeple. This town has long been shaped by its forestry industry and regional rail links, which once played a key role in its development.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/942d6f2542538e2c732de5b0772b909bfaa1390c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/66afd9a2e58c2e1609968218f051e661821140ea.jpg"][/img][b]
Mansfield[/b]

Mansfield, Louisiana is a quiet town with deep regional roots, developed as a local hub for agriculture and trade and shaped by its position along historic travel routes. Drivers can spot several key landmarks along the way, including the De Soto School, the local bank, and the First United Methodist Church, established in 1847. The town is also known for its historical significance, with a major Civil War battle having taken place nearby.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e357e9f18f65d5b4313f9a8a2d070d57d7b49698.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c71ac43df78de8e31d8113d1502dcb3e0a881c5a.jpg"][/img]
[b]Oberlin[/b]

Oberlin, Louisiana is a small town with big historical character. As you roll through, keep an eye out for the Allen Parish Courthouse, built in 1912 and listed on the National Register of Historic Places, along with the Oberlin City Hall just down the road. Surrounded by pine forests and bayous, Oberlin offers a quick but memorable glimpse of classic Louisiana charm on your journey.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/43d82f7962eb0ab65938956551d0d85ab39c0e52.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/956cb2be9b4e91c92c20c9ed5d5748eac4d1dc40.jpg"][/img]
[b]Cameron

[/b]Along Louisiana’s Gulf Coast, Cameron offers a striking shift in scenery. Located in an area frequently affected by hurricanes, this area has a rugged and weathered look. You’ll notice buildings raised on stilts, which is a practical solution for storm surges and flooding, along with visible storm damage in parts of town. Key landmarks include the Cameron Parish Library, a local school, and a bank set among shipyards and industrial lots. With boats docked nearby and storage yards along the road, Cameron has a coastal, working-town character that stands apart from inland settlements.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0c54eb0dd5e14ab8a8b5b2cffb559844054f31a0.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7cfcb1d0b791c2cc9948b91f8a39d03ee5a3ed8d.jpg"][/img]
[b]Tallulah

[/b]Cruising through northeastern Louisiana, drivers will find themselves surrounded by the golden patchwork of cotton, corn, soybeans, rice, and wheat fields, which surround Tallulah. Known for its deep farming roots, this scenic town showcases the agricultural heartbeat of the region. Along the way, you’ll catch sight of local landmarks like the First Baptist Church and the Madison Parish Courthouse, adding a touch of small-town charm to the open road.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fb64cd2c19d35978e61910beafaf52b355d388de.jpg"][/img]
