Looking forward to exploring and delivering in Louisiana for American Truck Simulator? Then be sure to add it to your Steam Wishlist! We can’t wait to share more development news about this upcoming map expansion. To stay up to date, make sure to subscribe to our newsletter and follow us on our official social media channels. Until next time, keep on truckin’!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012580/American_Truck_Simulator__Louisiana/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: American Truck Simulator: 1.55 Update Release
notes.content:
[p]We’re excited to share with our community that the 1.55 update for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"]American Truck Simulator[/url] is now officially released! This update brings new content, implementations, fixes, quality of life improvements, and more. Let’s dive in and take a look at what’s in store.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e895fa9e38e4a456cb0f18e1db64b40c71516770.jpg"][/img]

We’d also like to give a huge shoutout to everyone who participated in the Open Beta, shared feedback, and reported bugs. Your invaluable contributions have helped us fine tune the content and fix issues that initially slipped through the cracks. We hope that you will enjoy the new features, changes, and more that come with this update. [/p][previewyoutube="we_zmfTVaAE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]
Driving Academy - Truck Driving Proficiency
[/b][/p][previewyoutube="jXEfpl0jWM0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]This new Driving Academy module, called Truck Driving Proficiency, will introduce a set of much more challenging scenarios, which will test even the most skilled drivers to the limit. For this new module and set of scenarios, we will also introduce a new reward system. The most important thing is still to precisely complete a scenario by driving along the designated path and avoiding any collisions.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5bdc9a5c5a05c5f7ae99f9f8df561e0eca04c8d2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6bef522a94ad8b0367d644f97ddd79011d2a1bd4.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ae60ba88bd63f82e9c94ab4f46724df55e5f0d6e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/280090ee67cce826157aac1cb877a2e9ed18e0f3.jpg"][/img]
Players will also be able to achieve up to 3 collectable stars in this module, which can be earned by meeting additional conditions such as only using the interior camera, limiting gear shifts between drive and reverse, or completing the scenario in the set time. To really test your skills, you won't find any pre-recorded video tutorials, and you will have to use all the knowledge we taught you in our first module of Driving Academy.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2afa70a1ee8fa61a43c798cfbbba3143d3fef2f2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0bd22c3c50d2aaffb35fbea5307509f818a4ecf9.jpg"][/img]
We've also prepared new, exciting rewards that players can use on the same profile in the base game! As you may know, finishing the first module grants a blue traffic cone cabin accessory and a customizable Driving Academy truck paint job. Completing all Truck Driving Proficiency scenarios unlocks an orange traffic cone accessory, while earning 3 stars in every scenario adds a matching trailer paint job and a golden traffic cone, giving your truck and trailer the full Driving Academy look.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Asynchronous Loading[/b]

We have been hard at work implementing a major overhaul in the way our game loads and processes data, a new system we call Asynchronous Loading. This system is designed to improve the loading process by ensuring that the game and loading screens remain uninterrupted while assets are loaded in the background. The primary benefit here is the mitigation of stuttering, resulting in a smoother experience overall.

We’d like to extend a sincere thank you to everyone who shared their feedback during both the Experimental and Open Beta phases. Your input played a key role in helping us refine this system, and we’re excited to share that Asynchronous Loading is now fully implemented with the release of the 1.55 update![/p][p][/p][p][b]Fifth Generation Freightliner Cascadia Update[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3ce898ea4880403c1d52039cd10e9370d6dc91dd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]
A range of new accessories and improvements have been made to the Fifth Generation Freightliner Cascadia. From a paintable airdam and sunvisor to chrome mirror and filter options, you’ll have more ways than ever to personalize your truck’s look. Inside the cabin, you can now choose from updated tan, grey, or the newly added black interiors, along with either a classic or modern dashboard layout, bringing the total to six interior variants per sleeper![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fdaee6999cf1e6ba387c977a2db03ee734da411f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/cfe66010f2550bfddec3717d4a90575eab42e2b8.jpg"][/img]
Exterior updates include refinements to the 72" sleeper side walls, improved blind spot sensors compatible with both traditional and digital mirrors, and revised camera arms with more accurate turn indicator behavior. We've also smashed some bugs along with this update too!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b00849979119d2f98d98bcbc18eb92fa21249e74.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/257cc4409c7a50a9d8f4b0cef17775d321f63592.jpg"][/img]
You can check out the full list of changes and additions at this [url="https://blog.scssoft.com/2025/06/ats-155-update-freightliner-cascadia.html"]blogpost.[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Kenworth T680 Update
[/b][/p][p]The Kenworth T680 is getting an update! First released in December 2023 to celebrate Kenworth’s 100th anniversary, the truck was developed on an accelerated schedule with help from Kenworth’s team. Now, we’re expanding its customization options to give players even more control over how their truck looks and performs.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4dc951249efd874e58adf698fc05e5a15bf55a02.jpg"][/img]
Players will be able to choose between three cab variants as we are adding the 52" Mid-Roof and the 76" High-Roof, offering more flexibility and personality on the road. The chassis lineup will expand by seven configurations, including 6x4 options for all cabs in both short and long hood versions, as well as 4x2 setups specifically for day cabs.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8d173fbf67cd7c0ad6beafe0e2c224cf4e51f214.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d3ffb709146b8be5a1c60133df3dc9937ef2ec5e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c79d7f7c7acbb475e0f149b9c8ddeceada591b9a.jpg"][/img]
A total of 20 interior variants will be added: eight for the 76" High-Roof cab and eight for the 52" Mid-Roof, each in both single and double bunk layouts, plus four tailored for the day cab. Every interior will come in Diamond VIT and Vantage trims, with stylish Tan and Grey color options.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0cd6ef59941944f2649bfbf3c670778264f14ce6.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d91fc7081ce49cc50c520e2716bda77e560a9769.jpg"][/img]
Under the hood, drivers will have even more options, as we are adding seven powerful engine variants from the Cummins X12 and X15 series, and also five new transmission options to match their driving style. To top it off, all paint jobs, including those from DLCs, are now fully compatible with the T680. Whether you're going for style, performance, or both, the updated T680 offers everything you need to create your perfect rig.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5419edbac6037d115feb6115d579ebdb92080c82.jpg"][/img]
Check out the full dedicated blog to read about all the changes and updates coming with this [url="https://blog.scssoft.com/2025/06/155-update-kenworth-t680-update.html"]update here[/url]![b]

New additional content for the Nebraska DLC

[/b]New roads ahead! We're happy to share that with 1.55, a free update has rolled out for all owners of the Nebraska DLC. 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/52fd7a5dd2cd329a370ad25e9d4385c6667feebe.jpg"][/img]
This addition expands the northeastern corner of the state with three key highways; The US-20, US-75, and US-81. On these new routes, drivers can discover a new truck stop, a weigh station, and several scenic landmarks.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3e305823b216c1d300e33f3f5e420be13c318cec.jpg"][/img]
You’ll also now be able to travel through the settlement of Laurel, offering a slice of small-town charm rooted in farming heritage. Whether you're just free-roaming or passing through with a delivery nearby, there's even more reason to revisit the Cornhusker State.

Check out the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543810/American_Truck_Simulator__Nebraska/"]Nebraska DLC for American Truck Simulator on Steam here.[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Farm Machinery DLC Update[/b][/p][p]We’re excited to introduce a new free cargo addition to the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2638630/American_Truck_Simulator__Farm_Machinery/"]Farm Machinery DLC[/url], the Windrower! This essential piece of agricultural equipment is used to gather and align crops into neat rows for drying and harvesting, and now it’s your job to haul it where it’s needed most.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/813aebfa787ba3cf7ef6dbdf14d8002b0f9c625e.jpg"][/img]
The Windrower will be available on the job market in two color variants: a classic green and a yellow version branded with OWL, one of our in-game farming equipment manufacturers. Designed for lowboy trailers, it’s a wide and impressive load that brings more variety to your agricultural deliveries.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7db0c55610f9181b83b27d28184d0183f65704ab.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can find the full details about this update[b] [/b][url="https://blog.scssoft.com/2025/06/155-update-farm-machinery-dlc-update.html"]here[/url].[b]

FlowBelow Painted Parts

[/b]We're introducing a visual enhancement for select trucks featuring FlowBelow aerodynamic parts in American Truck Simulator. These drive wheel closeouts, designed to improve fuel efficiency and airflow, now come with the option to be paintable.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/83c97dc2d9e9f7412fcfe0ca6031ec894f5774a1.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bd17e79b28d44f7ce718aae6d25cab666fcde513.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2f0a43314e015ab07d21abcdb128b1eeab3259e3.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1006e4b3585717ad9dbbaf30041fd430cce663ac.jpg"][/img]
This means players can now customize these components to match their truck’s color scheme, creating a more polished and unified appearance. Whether you're aiming for a clean fleet aesthetic or giving your rig a show truck vibe, we’re confident this small update will help you tailor your truck even more to your personal style.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9527206885aa07272cfb7e421d1514e52a0f30b0.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f8c68f4c4814677239d0a1bed77f2e26cd1f58e4.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ae1ddfd4310eee8892e95d32a3ae2532fe52cd2e.jpg"][/img]
Don’t forget to share your fresh paint jobs with us on our social media channels!
[b]
Custom City Intros for New Mexico DLC[/b][/p][p]With this update, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/684630/American_Truck_Simulator__New_Mexico/"]New Mexico[/url] has received several new Custom City Intros! These special cutscenes play when a player selects a starting city while creating a new profile.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e3b607d85164a4043ff2d9feeb081d6e9959c46e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You’ll now find these intros available for the following cities in New Mexico:[/p][list][*][p]    Farmington[/p][/*][*][p]    Las Cruces[/p][/*][*][p]    Roswell[/p][/*][*][p]    Santa Fe[/p][/*][/list][p]We hope that new players, or those starting afresh, will enjoy these additions, which showcase the area where your journey begins!  

[b]Mail UX Redesign
[/b]
The mail screen has been reworked to provide a cleaner layout and a smoother navigation experience. Messages are now displayed in a two-column format, with a scrollable list on the left and an enlarged message view on the right for better readability. Messages load from the top, and when the list gets longer, intuitive paging helps keep things tidy. Navigation has been improved across all input methods, and embedded links or actions can now be accessed directly from the message content.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1d17cd9ce137bd9dd124ed49e1fb5913fa319779.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Options QoL Improvements

[/b]In this update, we’ve added a small but useful quality-of-life improvement to the graphics settings menu. You’ll now see example screenshots next to various settings, giving you a better idea of how each option affects the game’s visuals.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/257037ec32065191ac5ca3ae01b05747aac6d228.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9257afed5d1c5d7b31cae48047d1275b17cfbebd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Whether you're tweaking things for smoother performance or aiming for the best possible look, these previews should make it easier to find the right balance for your setup.[b]

Map Improvements - "My Location" Hotkey

[/b]We are adding a "My Location" hotkey as part of our map improvements. When pressed, it instantly centers the game map on the player's current location. We hope you find this small addition useful on the road!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f4cbbe2d6b22ab4488f1830fe1173f0839d04a76.jpg"][/img][b]
Change of Steam Achievements 
[/b][/p][p]Our team is working around the clock on engine updates, many of which are not visible during regular gameplay. Some of these are visible instantly, such as new light systems, but we also need to work on changes that are not normally visible when you play.[/p][p]Updating the achievement system gives us foundations that will allow us to make different and new types of achievements, as well as manage existing ones that often rely on different DLCs and regions. As a part of that, we have a new system coming out in 1.55.[/p][p]Along with this new system, some small changes were made to existing achievements and their goals to prepare us for any changes future developments may bring. If you would like to share any feedback about this, you can do so on our forums.[/p][p]
[b]Changelog[/b]

[b]Gameplay[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Driving Academy - Truck Driving Proficiency[/p][/*][*][p]Map Improvements - "My Location" Hotkey[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Map[/b][/p][list][*][p]New additional content for the Nebraska DLC - US-20, US-81, US-75 & the settlement of Laurel [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Vehicles[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fifth Generation Freightliner Cascadia Update[/p][/*][*][p]Kenworth T680 Update[/p][/*][*][p]FlowBelow Painted Parts[/p][/*][*][p]Farm Machinery DLC Update [/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Visual[/b][/p][list][*][p]Custom city intros for New Mexico DLC[/p][/*][*][p]Mail UX redesign[/p][/*][*][p]Options QoL Improvements - Graphics settings visualisation[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Other[/b][/p][list][*][p]Steam achievements update with text and icon improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Save manager improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Asynchronous loading[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: BIG In Iowa
notes.content:
[p]Abnormal Loads ahead! Those looking for an extra challenge in our upcoming [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/"]Iowa DLC[/url] can find new [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/962750/American_Truck_Simulator__Special_Transport/"]Special Transport[/url] contracts in the job market. Think you've got the skills to deliver heavy and oversized loads? Let us show you what's on the road ahead!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2dcbb5dfdafba6f4250dd58e770a2fb72d87bd6d.jpg"][/img]
Drivers ready to take on the challenge will find 3 new Special Transport jobs in the Hawkeye State, each of which have been carefully planned ahead with escort vehicles and local police enforcement ensuring a smooth delivery. Even with the extra help and clear roads, completing these job contracts will require careful driving and full attention to the road, especially when manoeuvring around built-up areas.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fb21c3f1d71cf8d62e8f09a2fc497a3b0aebd9d1.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/077077da3eee5d24701acf790e3b60a56bff731c.jpg"][/img]
Whilst the job is tough, drivers who do successfully complete these Special Transport deliveries will be paid pretty well! If you're up for the challenge, look out for Special Transport DLC job contracts in Iowa between the following cities:[/p][p][b]Dubuque to Mason City
Burlington to Iowa City
Sioux City to Des Moines

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7b8abed2642c90e3aa101c2d87b2e32ab6f91797.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d7b2dc41ad1e278486c0e392a4dc3c678f24936e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e891bbabdd11a1297548d74e2ff18611c729b939.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you already own the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/962750/American_Truck_Simulator__Special_Transport/"]Special Transport DLC[/url], these new contracts will be ready for you to pick up once the Iowa DLC is released on July 10th. Excited? Don’t forget to add the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/"]Iowa DLC[/url] to your Steam Wishlist to be notified of its release. We appreciate all your support and look forward to seeing you take on these challenging deliveries. Until next time, keep on Truckin'! 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/962750/American_Truck_Simulator__Special_Transport/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Iowa: Des Moines
notes.content: [p]The capital city of the Hawkeye State is getting ready to welcome truckers from all over the country. Today, we're sharing a preview of this key stop in the upcoming [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/"]Iowa DLC[/url] for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"]American Truck Simulator[/url] - another look at what's coming for our #BestCommunityEver.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9c91047e036da3adfbddb4d63f18803143d8662a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Des Moines sits at the confluence of the Des Moines and Raccoon Rivers. It began as a fort in the mid-19th century, but the community grew quickly and was officially incorporated as a city. In 1857, it took over from Iowa City as the state capital. From those early beginnings, Des Moines has grown into a major city with a population of over 214,000 residents. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f616fcad9ef7ea1876abf3a9b9a522f0617cd94e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/77a35559e80fd1b70c16aefd46e24e813aaf7dad.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We've already teased Des Moines' most iconic landmark in the Iowa DLC announcement - the State Capitol, featured prominently in the graphic. This striking building, known for its golden dome, was completed in 1886 and showcases the Greek Revival architectural style. Make sure to admire its beauty when passing by! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d40fb763d1d1dbdce62c2bb6c99dae769bce79a8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Of course, the State Capitol isn't the only landmark our map and asset teams have brought to life. You'll be able to drive through downtown Des Moines and spot several faithfully recreated locations, including the local sports arena, administrative buildings, bridges (such as the Iowa Women of Achievement Bridge), and even some local art, all carefully designed to reflect their real-world counterparts. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/cb381e48a13b5252eb46b5db16e13d8c0d19efd3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you head north from the Capitol, you'll spot a local liberal arts university founded in the late 19th century. Its campus blends classical and modern architectural styles, making it a distinctive and eye-catching part of the cityscape. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/325c8a4ca3c8344d59e444a7e4ec72e83d951b72.jpg"][/img][/p][p]When it comes to job opportunities for truckers, Des Moines offers two main logistics hubs for pickups and deliveries. In the northern area, you'll find a construction and a shopping mall depot, along with a key local tire factory that features a unique office building suspended above the road. The southern logistics zone is home to a chemical plant in need of regular supplies. In addition, there's a grain elevator and train service depot in the city that both require your hauling expertise. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e7154663fe47d7b06bf011c4fe154b63a6851ab5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5d4abda3df8292c87d2548538f744ac2a6db07a5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c8aa1e8ec1adfd203835f5cd95051c6e8608ca63.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e27c0f0bc0460faf3d77057853ca22a3f956f1bf.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We hope you are excited to visit this metropolitan hub in Iowa! If you do, make sure to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/"]add this map expansion to your Steam Wishlist[/url]! Also, remember to follow us on our social media ([url="https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware"]Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware"]TikTok[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/scssoft.com"]Bluesky[/url], and [url="https://www.youtube.com/@SCSSoftware"]YouTube[/url]) or [url="https://www.scssoft.com/newsletter"]sign up for our newsletter[/url] for more news from the world of American Truck Simulator. We will see you on the road!  [/p]

notes.title: Iowa Release Date + Video Trailer Reveal
notes.content:
[p]Are you ready to explore the Hawkeye State? Mark your calendars and get ready to hit the road, because we're excited to announce that the...
[/p][h2]Iowa DLC for American Truck Simulator
will be released on July 10th, 2025.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/03e651c683d0425391261e18910967891482c8ee.jpg"][/img][/h2][p]We're just as excited as you are, and to keep the anticipation rolling, we've released the official video trailer for the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/"]Iowa DLC[/url] on our [url="https://www.youtube.com/SCSSoftware"]YouTube channel[/url]! Created by our talented video team, this trailer offers a first look at the stunning landscapes, iconic landmarks, vibrant cities, industries, and hidden gems that await you in this map expansion. Check it out below 👇
[/p][previewyoutube="sVrwp9u93Lk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]As we get closer to release, our teams are focused on polishing the final elements of Iowa to ensure everything rolls out smoothly. We cannot wait for you to take your first journey!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5368c96e9e61f2924ce0a8ba9543d52714bd1619.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/938fe998bcc53d2ca568dc06724d0fb2db278efa.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fcfa0cc7c129b0d7d2aad82d09dd9c73c88adf98.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b0b1af994fbe85c9da6c2529a2fe39c26b8e2255.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b19ad4a87ba7bf0f329e1a83471021f7a8d3eaf6.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/25190b4181a36965abdf1a90558ae5c892bc7fdc.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c08ad6932c98ebb4051ee28f20fbad630551397d.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/44cc7f089089f285a1fe07df25e02d6bd344b6fd.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/33d4ee13c90c483ada8ab25b9b5e93d34f1a656a.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/05d561a77278fec0d798bd0266a4408951421364.jpg"][/img]
Whether you're making deliveries to vibrant cities like Cedar Rapids and Iowa City or cruising along scenic back roads through terraced fields and rolling farmland, Iowa offers a truly authentic trucking experience. From large agricultural depots and an aluminum factory to massive ethanol plants, there’s a wide range of industries to serve across the Hawkeye State. Be sure to watch for unique roadside attractions, hidden roads, and shortcuts around industries, there’s always something new to discover!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e54d63f95d8a177add86b6e3e2bca0159b4d8b4a.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ad3f221e2a096f0d082e7906893fd9e3b8cf7926.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/36a8f192ab5aa21c669af6ebdafef055035feafa.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c540029a70b79ffc4c1e1e145b0018970dda94b5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/531698b26959d8da4ac2075c1913e8c940ee1baf.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/055375eeb3686bf807e51715f197ede694686298.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/321c49b9a0776a2d91823917a18ad689e59c5565.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/94a0cc5142fb1a8c8c4513420313a0c169a6bfb7.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/295d12b99baa2ca1c9c22e9081234fd311e3626e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c443d7de9441dc3dcf104007471d1d5eb481b083.jpg"][/img]
Excited to get trucking? There's not long to wait! In the meantime, be sure to add the Iowa DLC to your Steam Wishlist! It really helps support our work and notifies you of its release. We thank you for all your support! We look forward to seeing you on the road in Iowa, until then, keep on Truckin'.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Route 66 Rework Project
notes.content: [p]If you've been wondering where our rework efforts will head next after the successful overhaul of California in [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"]American Truck Simulator[/url], we're happy to reveal that now. Our next step is the Route 66 Rework, where we'll revitalize selected parts of this iconic highway![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b42b0c76cad99e147537751b1b07029a69c7cd54.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Over the past couple of years, our team has completely [url="https://blog.scssoft.com/search/label/California"]reworked California[/url], one of the original states from the ATS base game. This massive project involved wiping it clean and rebuilding everything from the ground up to reflect the real-world Golden State more accurately, and to showcase just how far our game has come since its release. That rework was completed at the end of last year, and now our talented map designers have shifted their focus to the next exciting project.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/531cd4ce29ca2bcb21e0f0e2dd7b75c4920f6f88.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b09d1117976f683b6169cf8e320a109828fdf402.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/fb0c5832601e9b0ab1200af6a199867b9460d41b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]With the upcoming release of the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486960/American_Truck_Simulator__Illinois/"]Illinois DLC[/url], the historic Route 66 will finally be completed. However, not all of it currently lives up to the standards of our current map design. That's why we've kicked off the Route 66 Rework Project, focusing on key segments in Northern Arizona and parts of New Mexico, especially along I-40.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c39955f936536be22b2c4d1d21bae1c2e6634366.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/17369f66b6dff645004921b29c2a0ae44b8b0f1f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5f77be8586b41cd87c357dea6cbd6ea6c1d0d455.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We aren't reworking entire states just yet, but instead concentrating on towns, roads, and areas along Route 66 that need the most attention - everything will be rebuilt from the ground up to be brand-new for a more immersive experience for you![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5f8e0e57a325761aa94aaadc21714f0607b26a4e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d905e57950d2fdf13113b2a96c462d629256e30f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6907807dc4f4c7db951cad4132d9163057f4e605.jpg"][/img][/p][p]While this phase focuses on areas tied to Route 66, our teams have multiple rework projects across the map up their sleeves. So don't worry, there's more on the horizon!  [/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates as we continue our journey along America's most historic highway by following us on [url="https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/scssoft"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/scssoft.com"]Bluesky[/url], and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware"]TikTok[/url], or by [url="https://www.scssoft.com/newsletter"]subscribing to our newsletter[/url]! We look forward to sharing more with you in the future.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Iowa: Davenport
notes.content: [p]Welcome to the third-largest city in the Hawkeye State! In today's blog, we bring our #BestCommunityEver another preview from the upcoming [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/"]Iowa DLC[/url] for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"]American Truck Simulator[/url]. Let's take a tour of Davenport![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/295c512cdc4343c76c55c92438d170960c2c8c81.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This city is part of the Quad Cities, a complex of cities at the Iowa-Illinois border which actually includes five metropolitan hubs, Rock Island, Davenport, Moline, East Moline, Illinois, and Bettendorf, Iowa. This area is the only place where the Mighty Mississippi runs east to west. With the release of the Hawkeye State, you will be able to visit the Iowa part of the Quad Cities, but you can also look forward to trucking to the rest of this complex when [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486960/American_Truck_Simulator__Illinois/"]Illinois DLC[/url] releases.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9b4205b443b5609c9ff5b53429f1b148e0163f63.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/bee29c2ddd1a42a719224c78de0d9aea2529976d.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1e07cb83520b5d6596de9156b5ff6c6b959549b4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Davenport is nestled along the northern bank of the Mississippi River. This city is full of history and beautiful architectural gems, which our teams have recreated for this map expansion, so you will feel like you are really there![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/718d34cd1117d1dabdd1f20c321db42e5f75cdcc.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/cc5a7a6b0786c6a81572b9f82f7831af2eb1e462.jpg"][/img][/p][p]When you are driving through, keep your eyes peeled for landmarks like the Dillon Fountain, the Figge Art Museum, the Skybridge, the Arsenal Bridge, the Mississippi River Bridge, the City Hall of Bettendorf, and the Waterfront Convention Center, but also several stunning sculptures.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d92ae8657b3fa249c2c4c40f0519faf370509e7e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/af498583f8d1883455b2bbdc70ab83f2d45908ae.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you are looking for a job around the city, make sure to visit the local Aluminum Factory, a brand-new prefab depot created by our asset designers with fresh assets around it, nicely complementing the area. Other than that, you can also get yourself busy at the custom River Port and Quarry depots. With multiple companies to choose from, you can haul a wide variety of cargoes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b57f1cf967b2fc92f09dd5d9ae78b4cf7ccd4959.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5acb7f7d5475d32abcc24d207376dc9633b023bc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Excited to explore this urban hub? Then don't forget to support us by [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/"]adding the Iowa map expansion to your Steam Wishlist[/url]! Until then, make sure to stay up to date on any other news by following us on our social media ([url="https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware"]Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware"]TikTok[/url], and [url="https://www.youtube.com/@SCSSoftware"]YouTube[/url]) or [url="https://www.scssoft.com/newsletter"]signing up for our newsletter[/url]. We wish you safe travels![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: American Truck Simulator - 1.55 Open Beta
notes.content:
[p]Today, we are happy to share that the 1.55 Open Beta branch for American Truck Simulator is now available to try and test out. If you plan on participating in this Open Beta, we ask that you please help us by reporting any bugs you may encounter in the [url="https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=339"]appropriate section(s) of our official forums.[/url]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/732ff636f860bff46e79cbd15c57dc267eda90f3.jpg"][/img]
Your feedback and reports are truly valuable to our team, and we thank you in advance for taking the time to help us out. Please keep in mind that this is the first open beta iteration, and it is still a work-in-progress build that will receive updates throughout the open beta period.  

Now, without further ado, let's take a look at what the 1.55 Open Beta has in store.[/p][p][b]
Driving Academy - Truck Driving Proficiency[/b][/p][previewyoutube="jXEfpl0jWM0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]This new Driving Academy module, called Truck Driving Proficiency, will introduce a set of much more challenging scenarios, which will test even the most skilled drivers to the limit. For this new module and set of scenarios, we will also introduce a new reward system. The most important thing is still to precisely complete a scenario by driving along the designated path and avoiding any collisions. For proficiency level, there may be additional conditions you will have to meet to successfully pass the scenario.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1bde7d3024acbf14529ce0a36071b738de88376f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8579692c4c8cea73e817d7e8669fa3abf9c97ec0.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bb7f8cbef5fee345f50f3d0c8cf7bf317a86e903.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/054ae98cd2d14ce3ed9b78795e54eae2bf1a4283.jpg"][/img]Players will be able to achieve up to 3 collectable stars in this module, which can be earned by meeting additional conditions such as only using the interior camera, limiting gear shifts between drive and reverse, or completing the scenario in the set time. You'll earn a reward for completing all the scenarios, and you can unlock additional rewards by collecting all 3 stars in each one.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bdae6f9b912a871b31bc68ca6f12c22e16878ea2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/809ee9e7906f42f6e917dd77020079320f53674f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9af822607e1de46fc540071add225142c8f77b40.jpg"][/img][/p][p]To really test your skills, you won't find any pre-recorded video tutorials, and you will have to use all the knowledge we taught you in our first module of Driving Academy. Let us know how you get on!
[/p][p][b]Asynchronous Loading[/b]

We have been hard at work implementing a major overhaul in the way our game loads and processes data, a new system we call Asynchronous Loading. This system is designed to improve the loading process by ensuring that the game and loading screens remain uninterrupted while assets are loaded in the background. The primary benefit here is the mitigation of stuttering, resulting in a smoother experience overall.

We'd like to thank everyone who contributed their feedback to the Experimental Beta in Euro Truck Simulator 2, which was centred around this new update. Your feedback was incredibly valuable to our team, and now we are happy to be able to continue to bring this new feature forward into the Open Beta. You can help us fine-tune this feature by reporting any unusual loading behaviour in the [url="https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=339"]dedicated 1.55 forum section.[/url]
[/p][p][b]Fifth Generation Freightliner Cascadia Update
[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3ce898ea4880403c1d52039cd10e9370d6dc91dd.jpg"][/img]
A range of new accessories and improvements have been made to the Fifth Generation Freightliner Cascadia. From a paintable airdam and sunvisor to chrome mirror and filter options, you’ll have more ways than ever to personalize your truck’s look. Inside the cabin, you can now choose from updated tan, grey, or the newly added black interiors, along with either a classic or modern dashboard layout, bringing the total to six interior variants per sleeper!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bfab7ddbf51b89379f4e7415e363722291860e82.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/07cd1e701e90765e054c388aa0e6ae2fd73dd7df.jpg"][/img]Exterior updates include refinements to the 72" sleeper side walls, improved blind spot sensors compatible with both traditional and digital mirrors, and revised camera arms with more accurate turn indicator behavior. We've also smashed some bugs along with this update too!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4b15b4747faaf6e768933546139338c9011d935d.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/53df5eab2ab9ddbe6a09963976e11fa0d0ace76e.jpg"][/img]You can check out the full list of changes and additions at this [url="https://www.blogger.com/u/1/#"]blogpost.[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Kenworth T680 Update
[/b][/p][p]The Kenworth T680 is getting an update! First released in December 2023 to celebrate Kenworth’s 100th anniversary, the truck was developed on an accelerated schedule with help from Kenworth’s team. Now, we’re expanding its customization options to give players even more control over how their truck looks and performs.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2fc1ed2a26d268c4a7229754cc4a1087cdee402c.jpg"][/img]Players will be able to choose between three cab variants as we are adding the 52" Mid-Roof and the 76" High-Roof, offering more flexibility and personality on the road. The chassis lineup will expand by seven configurations, including 6x4 options for all cabs in both short and long hood versions, as well as 4x2 setups specifically for day cabs.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7331f3cd8b9dbfa9dfe91a3ad2e04393ceb36552.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/86cd450d3314b7f659ebab31666d6943f6391bd9.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0361c8a5e01075e1f83404d528580ce3df4a2f5a.jpg"][/img]A total of 20 interior variants will be added: eight for the 76" High-Roof cab and eight for the 52" Mid-Roof, each in both single and double bunk layouts, plus four tailored for the day cab. Every interior will come in Diamond VIT and Vantage trims, with stylish Tan and Grey color options.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a7cab483369d70c4d9f503bd2ab663ebc0d1cbdb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4e4b1a6ca69f82e5c906e1aec32605c99bae2f4f.jpg"][/img]Under the hood, drivers will have even more options, as we are adding seven powerful engine variants from the Cummins X12 and X15 series, and also five new transmission options to match their driving style. To top it off, all paint jobs, including those from DLCs, are now fully compatible with the T680. Whether you're going for style, performance, or both, the updated T680 offers everything you need to create your perfect rig.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/edf68690cf49bfae84ec73c8bebe612ef74f030c.jpg"][/img]Check out the full dedicated blog to read about all the changes and updates coming with this [url="https://www.blogger.com/u/1/#"]update here[/url]![/p][p][/p][p][b]Farm Machinery DLC Update[/b][/p][p]We’re excited to introduce a new free cargo addition to the [url="https://www.blogger.com/u/1/#"]Farm Machinery DLC[/url], the Windrower! This essential piece of agricultural equipment is used to gather and align crops into neat rows for drying and harvesting, and now it’s your job to haul it where it’s needed most.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4d50100a6eee32348345064349f626b4faaf8805.jpg"][/img]The Windrower will be available on the job market in two color variants: a classic green and a yellow version branded with OWL, one of our in-game farming equipment manufacturers. Designed for lowboy trailers, it’s a wide and impressive load that brings more variety to your agricultural deliveries.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8ff402d3008ec4fbb498c5bae314c857fba00f91.jpg"][/img]You can find the full details about this update at[b] [/b][url="https://www.blogger.com/u/1/#"]here[/url].[b]

FlowBelow Painted Parts

[/b]We're introducing a visual enhancement for select trucks featuring FlowBelow aerodynamic parts in American Truck Simulator. These drive wheel closeouts, designed to improve fuel efficiency and airflow, now come with the option to be paintable. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b88b0188df558b31f929df2ff455befb1e295155.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2dca53d3808d10170707b4b3dedda3b9f14cfa0e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/76314a35ccc08c5ae9fa396ad8ad3094e6cf8bd8.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2525760a3d9160e32b415f435c288492decfefa5.jpg"][/img]This means players can now customize these components to match their truck’s color scheme, creating a more polished and unified appearance. Whether you're aiming for a clean fleet aesthetic or giving your rig a show truck vibe, we’re confident this small update will help you tailor your truck even more to your personal style.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/509288176a2ab05c5f5868618493b8301d164790.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/24f14cebf0f3b850a79be58bc7f0c7c91e71b224.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/cb771d95b464c242a9b03728ce2adc029741e90a.jpg"][/img]Don’t forget to share your fresh paint jobs with us on our social media channels!
[b]
Custom City Intros for New Mexico DLC[/b][/p][p][/p][p]With this update, [url="https://www.blogger.com/u/1/#"]New Mexico[/url] has received several new Custom City Intros! These special cutscenes play when a player selects a starting city while creating a new profile.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/57b86436914e9ad22edbcd21c5ee16e63b7780e4.jpg"][/img]You’ll now find these intros available for the following cities in New Mexico:[/p][list][*][p]    Farmington[/p][/*][*][p]    Las Cruces[/p][/*][*][p]    Roswell[/p][/*][*][p]    Santa Fe
[/p][/*][/list][p]We hope that new players, or those starting afresh, will enjoy these additions, which showcase the area where your journey begins!  

[b]Mail UX Redesign
[/b]
The mail screen has been redesigned to enhance UI, UX, and controller navigation. It features two main sections: a mail list on the left and the mail content on the right, which is now larger for improved readability and easier to scroll through. Mails populate from the top, and when the list exceeds the screen, pagination is used. Users can navigate through emails using the arrow keys or the controller's D-pad, with emails opening instantly on selection. Mail content may include clickable or keybind-accessible embedded links.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/10c27a220db68fab7d44ea767eba9a9364bf89b9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Options QoL Improvements

[/b]In this update, we’ve added a small but useful quality-of-life improvement to the graphics settings menu. You’ll now see example screenshots next to various settings, giving you a better idea of how each option affects the game’s visuals.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e7569661cef4cc6fb021d2577feec11e6294d4e6.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3bec53aca73f324b474fa52ae50d82fd4160abb4.jpg"][/img]Whether you're tweaking things for smoother performance or aiming for the best possible look, these previews should make it easier to find the right balance for your setup.[b]

Map Improvements - "My Location" Hotkey

[/b]We are adding a "My Location" hotkey as part of our map improvements. When pressed, it instantly centers the game map on the player's current location. We hope you find this small addition useful on the road!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/47cef5c98998e3d496c8ee59b8b48581f66b6a6d.jpg"][/img][b]
Change of Steam Achievements 

[/b]Our team is working around the clock on engine updates, many of which are not visible during regular gameplay. Some of these are visible instantly, such as new light systems, but we also need to work on changes that are not normally visible when you play.

Updating the achievement system gives us foundations that will allow us to make different and new types of achievements, as well as manage existing ones that often rely on different DLCs and regions. As a part of that, we have a new system coming out in 1.55, which we would like to test in open beta. 

To ensure that the new code is well tested before release, some small changes were made to existing achievements and their goals to let us see if the changes we make are working smoothly for all of our users.

[b]Changelog[/b]

[b]Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p]Driving Academy - Truck Driving Proficiency[/p][/*][*][p]Map Improvements - "My Location" Hotkey[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Map[/b][/p][list][*][p]Map Improvements - "My Location" Hotkey[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Vehicles[/b] [/p][list][*][p]     Fifth Generation Freightliner Cascadia Update[/p][/*][*][p]     Kenworth T680 Update[/p][/*][*][p]     FlowBelow Painted Parts[/p][/*][*][p]     Farm Machinery DLC Update[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Visual[/b][/p][list][*][p]Custom city intros for New Mexico[/p][/*][*][p]Mail UX redesign[/p][/*][*][p]Options QoL Improvements - Graphics settings visualisation[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Other[/b][/p][list][*][p]Steam achievements update with text and icon improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Save manager improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Asynchronous loading[/p][/*][/list][p]
So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an open beta, not a stable public version - so you may encounter bugs, instability, or crashes. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to get there faster, we'd appreciate all of your feedback on our forum and your [url="https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=339"]bug reports in the dedicated section.[/url]

Please check our modding wiki to get details pertaining to mods for the game.

If you wish to participate in this Open Beta, you can find this version in the Experimental Beta branch on Steam. The way to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right-click on American Truck Simulator  → Properties → Betas tab → Beta Participation drop down menu → public_beta. No password is required. Sometimes you will have to restart your Steam client to see the correct branch name there.[/p]

notes.title: 1.55 Update: Kenworth T680 Update
notes.content: [p]In December 2023, we released the [url="https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/12/kenworth-t680-100-years-anniversary.html"]Kenworth T680 Anniversary Edition[/url]. Now, with the upcoming 1.55 update for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"]American Truck Simulator[/url], we will introduce more customization options for this beautiful truck, including new cabins, chassis, interior designs, and more![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2fc1ed2a26d268c4a7229754cc4a1087cdee402c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The initial release of this truck was done on a super-accelerated schedule as we wanted to bring it to our #BestCommunityEver for Kenworth's 100 years celebration, and we made it happen on time thanks to smooth cooperation with experts from [url="https://www.kenworth.com/"]Kenworth[/url]. Now you will be able to truly customize this beauty of a truck thanks to the additional work of our vehicle team![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9e50904582f9ef3d15dd3882cee931f8433bf4f0.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/0361c8a5e01075e1f83404d528580ce3df4a2f5a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Players will be able to choose between three cab variants as we are adding the 52" Mid-Roof and the 76" High-Roof, offering more flexibility and personality on the road. The chassis lineup will expand by seven configurations, including 6x4 options for all cabs in both short and long hood versions, as well as 4x2 setups specifically for day cabs.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/89ab90992726a642a7b7b56d537cf671865518dc.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/edf68690cf49bfae84ec73c8bebe612ef74f030c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A total of 20 interior variants will be added: eight for the 76" High-Roof cab and eight for the 52" Mid-Roof, each in both single and double bunk layouts, plus four tailored for the day cab. Every interior will come in Diamond VIT and Vantage trims, with stylish Tan and Grey color options.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4e4b1a6ca69f82e5c906e1aec32605c99bae2f4f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a7cab483369d70c4d9f503bd2ab663ebc0d1cbdb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Under the hood, drivers will have even more options, as we are adding seven powerful engine variants from the Cummins X12 and X15 series, and also five new transmission choices to match their driving style.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f14b82ba957e24b837d491d34fdb4031ef9c37f5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a77652d0a28faef1e7a4bb320250f963e9663462.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A massive range of new accessories will come too, giving you the freedom to personalize nearly every aspect of your rig. This includes bumpers in both chrome and painted finishes. Cab extenders will be available for all cabin types, and classic exhausts are being added for the Day Cab and 52" cab. You'll also find chrome detailing for the front grill and side filters, plus two hood versions, short and long, designed to accommodate larger engines.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/86cd450d3314b7f659ebab31666d6943f6391bd9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/7331f3cd8b9dbfa9dfe91a3ad2e04393ceb36552.jpg"][/img][/p][p]New physical mirror models will come in both chrome and painted variants, and white fenders will give a fresh look to your setup. For even more customization, you'll be able to add or remove aero kits, chassis skid plates, and deck plates in a variety of styles. Vent-style side windows, removable rear extenders, and three new steering wheel variants will add even more flexibility. And yes, removable sun visors will now be available across all cabs.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6980311f2f898961c6ebc213393dba1e258a27f3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d29df54321c3ff40802f7fa43ec4580729cd84ed.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And to tie it all together, all paint jobs, including those from DLCs, will now be fully compatible with this truck, giving you even more options to create your perfect ride.[/p][p]Get ready for the ride of your life with the updated Kenworth T680 when the 1.55 update releases! Don't forget to give our [url="https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/scssoft"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/scssoft.com"]Bluesky[/url], and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware"]TikTok[/url] a follow as you'll receive updates about our games straight to your feed, or [url="https://www.scssoft.com/newsletter"]subscribe to our newsletter[/url] to stay informed. Safe travels![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Illinois: Rockford
notes.content: [p]Just ninety minutes outside of Chicago lies the city of Rockford. And today, we would like to tell you more about this beautiful city that our teams are currently working on for the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486960/"]Illinois DLC[/url] for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"]American Truck Simulator[/url]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5d70282e21642b7513b081a3f379a80a6872a6d1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Rockford is often referred to as the City of Gardens, thanks to its 4,000 hectares of parks and public gardens featuring a variety of themes, including Japanese and historic styles. This city is a fantastic destination for tourists, not only because of its beautiful natural surroundings, but also due to its wide range of outdoor activities, vibrant cultural events, diverse food options, and lively markets.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e2f4a84fafcdef4f039275779ea888b12711b7f9.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c25371889db294e6eec644ccb442586beee2c6a4.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/60b77d803b85f20775cbe4fdba2eb2ad85a5db3e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The city is also full of stunning architectural gems, where historic and modern buildings blend beautifully. Our asset and map teams have put together a lot of work to recreate some of the most significant buildings to make this city stand out and make you feel you are really there.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8615339e1537a745abfd2327c3a4a55da0eab0a1.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2d586f75b7033e143092dc5ba44c4cb6fa6a832e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]These include a well-known local hotel, a historic theater, several distinctive churches, a college, the Justice Center, Rockford's East Center, both the old and new City Halls, a school, and even a number of public sculptures.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/cffd497d7e8dde33db31c1e316fd088401ac4ab9.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/304d542c8e84e8ad8dcee83c4babade5ba3830dc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you're in town looking for cargo to haul, you'll find four depots within the city limits: the road garage, two distinct warehouses, and a chemical oil facility. Just outside Rockford, four more companies are ready to load your trailer, including a wind power plant, an electric substation, a farm, and a quarry. With such a variety of options, there's always plenty of work to choose from![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9379840d2e23043879cbd6b134047229d616f58e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/acda7f050a93340f855688ebfe5db5cb6e1b0727.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you enjoyed this early preview of the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486960/"]Illinois DLC[/url] for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"]ATS[/url], make sure to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486960/#game_area_purchase"]add this map expansion to your Steam wishlist[/url]! Just don't forget that this DLC is still a work in progress, so anything you see here may be adjusted. [/p][p]Don't forget to stay tuned for more American Truck Simulator updates by following us on [url="https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware"]Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/scssoft"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/scssoft.com"]Bluesky[/url], and [url="https://www.youtube.com/@SCSSoftware"]YouTube[/url], or by [url="https://www.scssoft.com/newsletter"]signing up for our newsletter[/url]. We will see you on the road![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486960/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Cruising Missouri Event Conclusion
notes.content: [p]This past Sunday marked the conclusion of the #CruisingMissouri [url="https://www.worldoftrucks.com/en/"]World of Trucks[/url] event, which ran for over two months in celebration of the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730870/American_Truck_Simulator__Missouri/"]Missouri DLC[/url] release for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/"]American Truck Simulator[/url]. Now, it's time to officially wrap things up and share the final stats with you![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/211115d09a7c320fec0ab271c9ceefad63854d26.jpg"][/img][/p][p]First and foremost, we would like to extend a huge thank you to everyone in our #BestCommunityEver who participated in #CruisingMissouri, as well as to the incredible team behind this event. We are already excited for what's coming next![/p][p]At the start, we set two goals for you. The community objective was to collectively drive 125,000,000 miles by hauling cargo to or from any city in the Show Me State - a milestone you surpassed more than three weeks before the event ended! Altogether, you logged an impressive 151,084,082 miles (243,146,261 kilometers).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b6b508abfc2e4098cb3a2bf6c94e7068140d7be1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The personal goal involved delivering cargo to or from all 12 cities in Missouri, with each job covering at least 100 miles (161 km). In total, you completed 457,465 qualifying deliveries! Congratulations to the 28,991 dedicated truckers who achieved this and unlocked their well-earned rewards: the Beast of Burden ATS paint job, plus the Striking Mule ornament, and the Show-Me Pillow cabin accessories.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/55bd77e371079b10dd5788fdcabf930a9802bb37.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b18c26a15101d61210dd2891dca6982f0624e238.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3d9934a54e17726f3e87069b6039cd8dc3cc37d7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you couldn't fully complete this event, we hope you still enjoyed taking part! You know what they say, it's not about the destination, it's about the journey. Don't forget to follow us on [url="https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware"]Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/scssoft"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/"]Bluesky[/url], and [url="https://www.youtube.com/@SCSSoftware"]YouTube[/url] for all the latest news about upcoming events and other news from our games. You can also [url="https://www.scssoft.com/newsletter"]sign up for our newsletter[/url] to stay informed. Until then, keep on trucking![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730870/American_Truck_Simulator__Missouri/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Iowa: River Ports
notes.content:
We're back on the road in Iowa to bring you another look at our upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/]Iowa DLC for American Truck Simulator.[/url] This time, we’re focusing on a key industry rooted in the state’s waterways: river ports, which have long served as gateways for trade, transport, and industry. Let’s take a closer look at some of them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ac1fc5d8989f00406302bf2596573e41e382afcf.jpg[/img]
First stop, Dubuque! Located along the upper Mississippi, its port area sits right next to the city’s scenic local marina, creating a unique contrast between commercial industry and public space. With direct links to rail and road, the port here plays a key role in local logistics, offering drivers various cargo contracts to deliver to and pick-up from here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/634e8b793fb1653d425e8c5dbef3a4e6ec8cc87e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0c34f4e9ed07b8cfdc95d547eab72e64373ada50.jpg[/img]
Further downstream, Davenport stands out for its open riverfront and flood-resilient design. As part of the Quad Cities, its port remains well-connected and active in regional logistics. Today, you’ll find facilities that specialize in handling heavy lift and specialty cargo, as well as historic sites like the 1917-built Freight House, reflecting its longstanding role in river trade. With a blend of industry and scenery, players can expect a variety of job opportunities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b4146541c486e2017c13347278223379afb9be86.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c32f67a82517b1cea68687e7b1fb72ccc9f1dd0f.jpg[/img]
In Burlington, the port has a rich history dating back to 1928, once serving as a key hub for river commerce during the steamboat era. Strategically located along the Mississippi and connected to major rail lines, it played a vital role in moving goods across the region. Today, while the site also functions as a state Welcome Center, its legacy as a logistical link between river and rail remains strong, offering players a glimpse into the deep-rooted transport heritage of the Midwest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/18539c7631cb1a3bb2317c5bfad6b78e66abaa48.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6d3c844cff8a9d058a1a43036b9f50e20c961ed7.jpg[/img]
On Iowa’s western edge lies Sioux City, where the Missouri River powers a key logistics hub. The port here connects truck, rail, and river freight, making it one of the most active industrial areas in the state. Historically tied to agriculture and packing, Sioux City’s modern infrastructure keeps goods moving, and gives players a chance to experience a true Midwestern freight gateway.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bdd5f70e54573dbacc3e64100f884197fd5910c5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bcdd31b3d89adfc52fa89cc20796a34849943ba0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e70fda6879b224edc8a2f2f40190e51d3bd7143e.jpg[/img]
These river ports highlight just how much Iowa’s waterways continue to influence regional industry. Each offers a different layout, setting, and story, ready for you to explore behind the wheel. Stay tuned for more news from our upcoming Iowa DLC, and we’ll see you on the road!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/

notes.title: 1.55 Update: Farm Machinery DLC Update
notes.content:
[p]We're always working on new ways to keep things fresh on the road! Today, we're happy to share that in our upcoming 1.55 update for American Truck Simulator, we're bringing a small free update to the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2638630/American_Truck_Simulator__Farm_Machinery/"]Farm Machinery DLC[/url] that includes a new cargo! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e002899ea3f6fb0ef80e982f49fdca7af2bbd483.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Say hello to the Windrower! If you’ve ever seen neat rows of cut hay or crops lined up across a field, this is the machine behind that magic. Windrowers are used to cut and gather crops like hay or grains into long, tidy rows called windrows. This process helps the crops dry faster and makes it easier for the next machines, like balers or harvesters, to come in and collect them.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8c1a611850daf5b454ada94ad17514910544c8db.jpg"][/img][/p][p]They're big, wide, and built for the fields, but when it’s time to move them, it takes a skilled trucker with a lowboy trailer to get the job done. It'll come in two color variants, there’s a green variant that looks right at home on any farm, and a yellow one that proudly features the logo of OWL, one of our in-game farming equipment brands.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8ff402d3008ec4fbb498c5bae314c857fba00f91.jpg"][/img][/p][p]So whether you're hauling a Windrower between farms, or delivering one from the depot, we hope you’ll enjoy this new addition to our DLC. We can’t wait to see your screenshots from the road.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d193ad1a1fdcaff4449f0336ab9d20fce1a6d8ff.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We look forward to seeing you haul this new cargo on the road in the near future! Until then, make sure to keep upto date with all the latest American Truck Simulator news, by following us on [url="https://x.com/SCSsoftware"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs/"]Facebook[/url] & [url="https://bsky.app/profile/scssoft.com"]Bluesky[/url]. Until next time, keep on truckin’!

[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2638630/American_Truck_Simulator__Farm_Machinery/"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2638630/American_Truck_Simulator__Farm_Machinery/[/url][/p]

notes.title: Introducing South Dakota
notes.content: [p]We are excited to unveil our next map expansion for American Truck Simulator, which will offer a blend of beautiful nature, vibrant cities, and the joy of the open road. Our teams are currently hard at work on...[/p][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749870"]South Dakota for American Truck Simulator[/url][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="qdUm0PQ1QiQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Welcome to the Mount Rushmore State! Nestled in the North Central Region of the United States, South Dakota offers a beautiful site for truckers to admire. The state is dominated by peaceful, wide-rolling plains - its eastern region belongs to the Prairie Plains, while the western part forms a portion of the Great Plains. This part of the landscape transitions from flat river valleys in the east to plateaus, buttes, and a canyon-scarred terrain in the west.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/7fa9b0920f759a63121bdab96ffb4fdbb908a10b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And don't miss the rugged beauty of the Badlands - one of the world's richest fossil beds and a haven for diverse wildlife. This striking landscape draws visitors from around the globe. Just west of the Badlands lies the breathtaking Black Hills, a dome-shaped mountain region filled with dense forests and picturesque scenic byways.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d4c3b24ecd7eaa5f4b3a6bad65c577b651753852.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/35412f7ac11849f802fe3a2e5341a9e7ab5722ce.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Whether you're drawn to big-city hustle or the charm of small towns, South Dakota offers unforgettable sights at every turn. You can look forward to delivering in and out of Sioux Falls, Mitchell, and Rapid City, while also passing through beautiful settlements such as Deadwood, Wall, and Sturgis, to name just a few. Right at the heart of the state lies its capital, Pierre, located on the banks of the Missouri River. Though modest in size, Pierre boasts some impressive architectural gems - well worth a stop on your route![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/039888c03cea40b5f42377e23f0c663546b5415d.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ff0d6e1fe71b6ffaa6bcec1652a3d03acb82baed.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Mount Rushmore State is mostly agricultural, with corn, alfalfa, rye, flaxseed, wheat, and soybeans being the most common crops grown there, but forestry and mining also play significant roles, meaning you can expect to haul a diverse range of cargo. Two major interstates make traversing the state efficient: Interstate 90 runs east to west across the southern half, while Interstate 29 cuts north to south through the eastern region, making sure your deliveries stay on schedule.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/757a6034f6c466968062d13520976210ee5dff40.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e76cbe0b0c0e22b4ed9999d8ac051847f37a8594.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Home to nine Native American tribes, South Dakota offers a unique opportunity to experience a rich diversity of Indigenous cultures. The state's natural beauty is equally unforgettable - from bison and other wildlife roaming the west, to the striking rock formations, expansive forests, and sweeping prairies that stretch across the landscape. In the central and eastern regions, vast fields of golden sunflowers paint the countryside each summer. At the heart of it all flows the mighty Missouri River, which cuts the state in two and stands as the second-longest river in North America. Whether you're drawn to serene wilderness, vibrant city life, or the simple joys of the open road, South Dakota truly offers something for everyone.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8962a1300441f860ebef33f966872040b2567f66.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/bb92da73f7e135baaf2994c72cff823f174ec28e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you are excited to be trucking in this state, make sure to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749870/#game_area_purchase"]add it to your Steam wishlist[/url]! Remember to follow us on [url="https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware"]Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/scssoft"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/"]Bluesky[/url], and [url="https://www.youtube.com/@SCSSoftware"]YouTube[/url] for all the latest news from this map expansion and American Truck Simulator, or [url="https://www.scssoft.com/newsletter"]sign up for our newsletter[/url] to stay informed. Until next time, we wish you happy travels![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: ATS 1.55 Update: Freightliner Cascadia 2024 Update
notes.content:
As part of the upcoming 1.55 update for American Truck Simulator, we’re excited to introduce a range of improvements and new customization options for the Freightliner Cascadia 2024. This includes new accessories, updated interior and exterior options, and more. Let’s take a closer look, shall we?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c6afeafb7ec24656c4034a37c86a71d46e558221.jpg[/img]
Several new accessories have been added to allow for even greater personalization of your Freightliner Cascadia. This includes a paintable airdam, a vertical exhaust system, chrome side mirrors and filter fins, and a paintable sunvisor for the sleeper variant. We hope these additions make it easier than ever to fine-tune your Cascadia’s appearance to match your style or virtual trucking company's branding! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/53df5eab2ab9ddbe6a09963976e11fa0d0ace76e.jpg[/img]
Inside the cabin, we've added a new black interior variant, while also updating the existing tan and grey versions. Drivers will also have the choice between a traditional gauge cluster on their dashboard or a modern digital dashboard layout. With these additions, each sleeper configuration now includes six unique interior variants, giving you more options for your cabin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bfab7ddbf51b89379f4e7415e363722291860e82.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/07cd1e701e90765e054c388aa0e6ae2fd73dd7df.jpg[/img]
On the exterior, we’ve worked on improving the sleeper's details as well. The 72" sleeper side walls have been remodelled, particularly around the window area. Blind spot sensors have also received an update, allowing them to function correctly with both the traditional A-pillar sensors and the digital mirror displays. The camera arms have also been adjusted, with their marker lights now functioning solely as turn indicators, reflecting real-world behavior more accurately.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4b15b4747faaf6e768933546139338c9011d935d.jpg[/img]
Alongside these updates, we’ve made several under-the-hood improvements, including various bug fixes and animation updates to enhance your overall driving experience with the Freightliner Cascadia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/02a3ead91da5493cf01a7e68777cd7091d669f79.jpg[/img]
We’d like to thank our partners at Freightliner for their ongoing cooperation. We hope you enjoy the refreshed Freightliner Cascadia experience, and we look forward to seeing how you make it your own when 1.55 update rolls out. Until next time, keep on truckin'!

notes.title: Louisiana: Cities
notes.content:
Visit the bustling cities of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012580/American_Truck_Simulator__Louisiana/]Louisiana[/url] on your trucking adventures! Today, we bring you a preview of selected urban hubs that our map designers are recreating for the Pelican State in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url], so if you are excited for the Louisiana DLC, keep on reading!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b28f5ba2534a901ae7bf93bb0010a9853f7cb194.jpg[/img]
[h3]Lafayette[/h3]
This vibrant city nestled along the Vermilion River in south-central Louisiana has deep roots. First settled in 1763, it began as the village of Vermilionville before being renamed in 1884 for the French general, the Marquis de Lafayette. As truckers drive through this historic town, they'll pass by beautifully recreated landmarks like the Cathedral of St. John the Evangelist, First Presbyterian Church, Episcopal Church of the Ascension, and Lafayette Middle School - each one a tribute to the city's spirit and architectural legacy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3c329d96a2351fed92c9ac579e361a5690bb5ccc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/deb390f0adadcef0de572a8aaf344e3fbe817d02.jpg[/img]
[h3]Houma[/h3]
If you venture southwest from New Orleans along Route 90, you will come across the seat of Terrebonne Parish, the city of Houma. In its early days, the settlement developed as a fishing, fur, and shrimp port. Now it is known as a centre for seafood and lumber products. Our talented assets and map teams recreated some architectural gems there, too, such as the Terrebonne Parish Library, the Hancock Whitney Bank, and the Terrebonne Parish Government Office.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/392c22fa00100a03fee96ee162ac7b10474696a3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e62abb99584051ca0a8601b0e800f484cab6cd9c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5672d4a0031c828a3ba9644ba0ea6db3093e204a.jpg[/img]
[h3]Monroe[/h3]
In the northeast corner of the Pelican State, truckers will find themselves delivering cargo to and from Monroe, a key hub of manufacturing and commerce for the surrounding rural parishes and the 9th largest city in Louisiana. Along the way, keep an eye out for notable architecture like the beautiful First Baptist Church and the vibrant campus of the University of Louisiana, a hotspot for education in the region.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/fa1a4e938a3ef4b5993469fbe664a35018c557df.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/0797bef6b6ac2965a809bf4467009b4fb07b5a98.jpg[/img]
[h3]Natchitoches[/h3]
Rolling into Natchitoches, the oldest permanent settlement in the Louisiana Purchase, truckers find themselves cruising through a town steeped in history and Southern charm. It is nestled along the scenic Cane River Lake in west-central Louisiana. Drivers passing through can spot standout local landmarks like the Central High School and the Louisiana School for Math, Science, and the Arts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/19bc0269e166379b3e2f81720234bde686e9c212.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/66bcea685b620361f84f687259d525f2b0ae69b0.jpg[/img]
We hope you have enjoyed today's blog! Remember to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012580/American_Truck_Simulator__Louisiana/#game_area_purchase]add the Louisiana DLC to your Steam Wishlist[/url] and don't forget to give our [url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/scssoft.com]Bluesky[/url], and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url] a follow as you'll receive updates about our games straight to your feed, or [url=https://www.scssoft.com/newsletter]subscribe to our newsletter[/url] to stay informed! notes.title: Iowa: Cedar Rapids
notes.content:
Do you want to visit the beautiful city of Cedar Rapids? Today, we invite you to take a drive with us through this charming seat of Linn County in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/]Iowa[/url], our upcoming map expansion for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url]. Let's see what's in store for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4fd312b10c19f91bccd83f52bb1b664c8c5b0d0b.jpg[/img]
The second largest city of the Hawkeye State, situated along the scenic banks of the Cedar River - a tributary of the Iowa River - is a vibrant hub of arts and culture with a great theater, live music, and museums. Truckers can soak in Cedar Rapids' history through its striking architecture. With dynamic urban renewal efforts and plenty of eye-catching public art on every corner, the city offers a blend of beautiful architecture and progressive energy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d9205b716a334ced15717ddf9b88b94f05914d56.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ae99a882da56b6e2deb2856c238a532c2cabb139.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5f770146d4da8f0819618126629266ae5f0002d8.jpg[/img]
Truckers driving into the city will be greeted by a recognizable welcome sign at the edge of town, and as you head into downtown, you'll notice a skyline dotted with local landmarks. Keep an eye out for the Cedar Rapids Arena, based on a real-life venue that hosts everything from concerts to sporting events, as well as the stately Veterans Memorial Building nearby.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4046d2c029a0fe5c1ba094d5f138e038958d774f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c7a3a3712abf8a671f897136f3a7152e6ee7cb72.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/70ae5a7ad78979facb483443b690bd112d6e6cd1.jpg[/img]
However, the most important location in town is a familiar-looking food processing facility near the city center. Fans of breakfast oats and cereals might recognize the inspiration behind this unique depot and landmark. Our map designers have also recreated the Cedar Rapids Airport, where two delivery locations await truckers looking for a job. And if you venture east, you'll find opportunities to service the local paper mill or a generating station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/19ceaeaacd3cd1ad13e8eac15e20b5e66ddcd70b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/45178b8fbd1a491808fbd71a4cc90ec04aaff70a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/294edb911c9b4adcb5621c36678bed4360bd9039.jpg[/img]
