notes.title: Under the Hood: Reimagining Legacy Assets
notes.content:
Since the release of Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator, the processing power of personal computers has made some serious advancements. In turn, we've continually brought updates to both our titles to introduce new technology and techniques, which has allowed us to introduce higher levels of visual fidelity to our content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/1789c1232b5ffd3f120da594f95c1c51be5255c4.jpg[/img]
One such rework that has been happening over the last couple of years is the 'reimaging of legacy assets', which aims at enhancing the quality and optimization of game models that have started to look outdated and inconsistent with newer additions. The project team consists of two people, Pavel C and Robert P, both of whom we've had the pleasure to talk to about this project to share with you today. We will let them introduce themselves! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/c76663de716fbdef5e648d86daa5ae63ed167991.jpg[/img]
"My name is Pavel C. I've been working at SCS Software for about three years as a 3D Graphics Designer, and I am involved in reimagining legacy assets for our title American Truck Simulator and its DLCs." 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/33b7ddb5379eea68ed996a205fe3b853875f7ff0.jpg[/img]
"My name is Robert P, and I've been working as a 3D Artist at SCS Software for over three years. I've contributed to several DLCs, including Texas, Oklahoma, Nebraska, and Arkansas."

So, what is the goal behind this project? "Our goal is to create models that not only look realistic but are also well-optimized," Robert explains. "Many of the assets, although well-made, have started to show their age—especially those in use for nearly a decade. As technology advances, there’s an increasing demand for optimized assets with higher levels of visual fidelity."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/af5bc0c9caeea04389e8e6c967eae21a52d9aa7a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/9aa18e3832ac3bc794c234e3735cb80badc423ad.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/93ffaf76c58eacf42cbca7c836f27c1696524ed0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/382fae011c7bc049a6f20b22cb59be5750fd04cf.jpg[/img]
Beginning a project like this can be quite challenging, especially on such a large scale, Pavel adds. "Initially, we faced many challenges as we realized we couldn’t rely on our current tools and technology for this project. We therefore had to take a different approach and develop a new workflow, often involving multiple programs and new techniques. Our focus was on finding the shortest path to the best results."

"The initiative to give our older assets a ‘facelift’ began about two years ago. Since then, we’ve organized the project and started creating newer versions of assets commonly used throughout the game world," Robert shares.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/e87aa1ddad86b3ecc93db7766b3ecaa043a30a9d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/c47fea542e2cecd28198274cae343a185e82dc82.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/a7b647ece98cc8499ce485c5d18b18ac982fc7c6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/a92b7c13747a8df54ae4a1aac27d34f0734abb92.jpg[/img]
So, what is the process behind reworking older assets, and which programs are involved? "We start by analyzing the current models and planning each rework. Each asset needs to be recreated with high visual fidelity while being optimized for performance," Pavel says. "First, we analyze the assets we have and consider what can be reused." Robert adds, "Though most assets need to be remade from scratch."

The next step is gathering references, which we either handle ourselves or, if the task is large, assign to our Research Department. We then design a new logic for the asset, focusing on how it will be used and how convenient it will be for Map Designers to incorporate. Pavel explains further, "We prioritize based on each DLC’s needs and the current state of existing assets, actively collaborating with other teams to ensure consistency across projects."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/569191170000ce0adae225cdfbab3e5ba43612e4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/33ba31b0fe626aadac6fbd36ae4d7269e2be409e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/b5e8ae30a8f46e15837296f17f65a1ea5dadbc98.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/7bb27f109794a53af63306e90d01ef11bb2341fb.jpg[/img]
"We have a list of assets in need of replacement, with priority given to those required for each new DLC. Many custom depots themed for various industries are being created, and during discussions on populating them, we often identify assets in need of a remake. We work with the Map Designers since they are the ones who will place the assets into the game world. They have valuable insights on which assets are effective and easy to use versus those starting to show their age.

We work closely with the Research Department, which helps us gain insights into real-world functionality to enhance the player experience and make it even more immersive," Robert explains. "We also collaborate with external partners, like our friends at 60FPS, to manage the workload of creating numerous new assets for each DLC".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/61cd1cdda1c2ebbc8eecb4c00f24675bcd6abf9c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/78fd05b824624e8b5eeec16365ab4e799a5a8075.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/7cd769ac9c9c414344c068a4523a925d7fb97cf0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/7bade468f4d70f3413719f27e0f602481511fa27.jpg[/img]
So, what challenges do you often encounter on this project? Pavel responds, "A common challenge is achieving high visual quality while keeping hardware requirements low. We aim to strike a balance between quality and optimization, which involves many iterations and testing various techniques. This is simply part of game development." Robert adds, "Primarily, it’s dealing with outdated technologies. Many workflows that were standard just a few years ago are becoming obsolete, so it's up to us to find an optimal workflow for each asset."

As mentioned earlier, multiple programs are used for this project, and Robert goes on to share more about them. "Our primary software is Autodesk Maya, which we use for most of our modelling, organization, and exporting to the engine. We also use a variety of other tools, such as ZBrush for virtual sculpting, Marmoset Toolbag for mesh baking, and the Adobe Substance suite (Painter and Designer) along with Adobe Photoshop for texturing."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/73367072178ab73abd592b26543d49b241f0aee1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/141086d73a26d095d39892629ddbed27e74a9c61.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/5f892dacaf63cda945a50998c403ef562f74a003.jpg[/img]
"Modern tools and fewer limitations allow us to make new assets more detailed and varied, avoiding repetition while staying faithful to real-life references. This enhances the overall immersive experience for the player." Pavel adds, "Better quality and optimization mean that players can enjoy a smoother and more visually appealing experience. Details such as refined textures, optimized geometry, and LODs (Levels of Detail) contribute to a more realistic environment."

"It's an interesting learning experience to work with both traditional and up-to-date workflows simultaneously." Robert shares "We compare the strengths and weaknesses of each and leverage the best aspects of both. It’s never the same; each asset feels unique and requires individual attention, bringing new challenges with each DLC. These assets are also used in reskins and redesigns of older areas of the map, so even if you don’t play the newest DLC, there’s a little something for everyone". 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/397f586058d3887a72ed3875812c44decb2b83b2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/41f424503b02c2d8c4291d5b5f3377fd22de7412.jpg[/img]
So next time you drive by some bales of hay or a stack of pallets, we hope you can appreciate a little more the work behind that asset. We'd like to thank both Robert and Pavel for taking the time to share their work with us, and for providing detailed information for this Under the Hood Blog! If you enjoyed today's blog, be sure to leave a comment in the replies or on our social media channels, we'd love to read about it! Until next time, keep on truckin'.

notes.title: The Making of Texas Book
notes.content:
Howdy, partners! Today, we're celebrating the release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1465750/American_Truck_Simulator__Texas/]Texas[/url], our largest map DLC for American Truck Simulator, which launched two years ago today. To mark the occasion, we have something special to share with all of you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/326811b95e6d5d3f1b8b893ca8f8d9c92bcc7171.jpg[/img]
The team behind this massive map project came up with the idea to create a special Making of Texas book. This book would contain memories, behind-the-scenes content, and artwork from the DLC, including pictures and notes from the research trip, work-in-progress images of 3D modelling and depot designs, and much more. Today, we're excited to announce that this idea has become a reality!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ce802d91ceae92517e8758ca0f5a6a5d13850186.jpg[/img]
After putting in so many hours of hard work and passion, we couldn’t let this special book go unseen by our community. So, we’ve decided to release a digital version for everyone to read, browse, or download for your viewing pleasure! [url=https://americantrucksimulator.com/booklet/makingoftexas/]You can take a read of it here.[/url] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/435af85c39d30e247b5b310c8dae1e418955b332.jpg[/img]
While the physical book was initially meant as a gift for employees and colleagues at SCS Software, we managed to get a few extra copies that we'd love to give away to some lucky members of our #BestCommunityEver.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a0a058766b4c405d925345016fc0e7dc8003ac39.jpg[/img]
If you'd like a chance to win one, simply post a screenshot of your truck at your favourite spot in the Texas DLC and share it with us on social media channels ([url=https://x.com/SCSsoftware]X[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs]Facebook[/url]) using the hashtag #2YearsOfTexasTrucking. Our team will pick their favourites, and winners will receive a copy of the book! Feel free to include a short message about what you enjoy most about this DLC, we’d love to hear from you.

notes.title: SCS On The Road: Star Nation Experience 2024
notes.content:
Today we're excited to bring you a special SCS On The Road Episode. Earlier in the year we announced we'd be teaming up with our friends at Western Star Trucks for the Star Nation Experience 2024! Hosted at various locations across the US state of Oregon, our 2 lucky American Truck Simulator players, Brendon and Connor, were chosen to experience wild, adrenaline-fueled experiences filled with trucking, fly fishing, ATV fun and more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2e98d5ccdcd6bdc5f8e15668b5aac16c912e19fe.jpg[/img]
Join Nemiro and Mark as they take you along for the journey from Europe to the USA to participate in Star Nation Experience 2024 and share with you what they got up to during this one-of-a-kind adventure! The highlight for us was undoubtedly the opportunity to drive some of Western Stars' iconic trucks at Daimler Truck's High Desert Proving Grounds in Madras and, of course, meet Starsquatch! 

[previewyoutube=dQ5DDzLEPjo;full][/previewyoutube]
But that's not all! Connor, one of our lucky Star Nation winners from our ATS community, amazed everyone with his exceptional real-life trucking skills, which have been entirely honed through playing American Truck Simulator. Though he had never driven a real truck before, Connor quickly impressed us all with his precision and control and even went on to win a reversing competition against experienced truck drivers including our resident expert, Mark!

Inspired by Connor’s talent and passion, YouTuber Casey LaDelle, owner of a heavy-haul rescue company in Oregon, came up with the idea of supporting Connor’s journey to earn his CDL license. From this idea, we at SCS Software, along with Western Star Trucks and Casey LaDelle, have agreed to come together to help Connor achieve his dream by collectively covering the expenses associated with obtaining his license. This story is a powerful testament to the overlap between virtual trucking and real-world skills, highlighting the potential for gamers to pursue a career in the trucking industry.

We wish Connor all the very best on his journey and we can't wait to see how he progresses. You can watch our recent live stream with Connor on our YouTube channel, check it out here! 

We'd like to thank Western Star for the opportunity to become an official partner of Star Nation 2024 and for organizing an incredible itinerary of activities and experiences. We hope you enjoy this after-movie that we put together for you, our #BestCommunityEver to enjoy and experience first from our POV what the Star Nation Experience is all about!

notes.title: Missouri - Water Bodies
notes.content:
Looking to take a break on the road and enjoy some peaceful time by the water? Today, we're excited to guide you through some of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730870/American_Truck_Simulator__Missouri/]Missouri[/url]'s most iconic and scenic water bodies, beautifully recreated by our map designers for this upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] map expansion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/961ca63eea7da327de197e161fb43b6453c51f33.jpg[/img]
The most prominent of these is the Lake of the Ozarks, a large reservoir formed by damming the Osage River. It was created by the Bagnell Dam which was completed in 1931. The lake has an iconic dragon shape when seen from above, and is located in the center of Missouri within the Ozark Mountains. It covers an astonishing area of 54 thousand acres (220 square kilometers).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3f03bc7fbc58ac6b1792a717583d1a9f857a4c17.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b5083ddca207d9e6b490434ff9ea2852f9fe5604.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1c245b1297441f45d21e8fe03875c3c64a62ec24.jpg[/img]
Another major reservoir included in this map expansion is the Harry S. Truman Dam and Reservoir, situated along the Osage River, just west of the Lake of the Ozarks. This vast body of water spans over 55 thousand acres (225 square kilometers), closely matching the Lake of the Ozarks in surface area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/947da175d29b06d3e9ea23385477cbf9e9f4d75f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f167e6764446395ee3c94eba88c43f66a469825f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/abc2f2e7aa19f4d612c0378f8d2f2401463672b9.jpg[/img]
Other than these two reservoirs, the region features a variety of rivers and streams, offering drivers scenic crossings over bridges as they journey through the Show Me State.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1f4cffe152f943e4142348b39cf69968914a72ce.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ce78dba56d7c85f4e44bd0fdb104dabeeb9b511e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/63c8c4511f1150801ad0402db1c27b3e5fd5dea0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b98ec7cb904b7f91b600c625c69a15705965240f.jpg[/img]
You'll encounter iconic rivers like the Fox, Fabius, and Saint Francis - tributaries feeding into the mighty Mississippi - as well as the Chariton, Grand, and Platte rivers, which wind their way toward the Missouri. Beyond these larger rivers, we've also included local gems like the Weldon, and Whetstone rivers, and a part of the Headwater Diversion Channel, along with some other creeks that make Missouri's terrain so richly textured.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c171a16cd35442543a801eb004f192e98ce1750f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a54b95b351a3298b6a62bbf30a74d11eda8ea323.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/649e140a8dbb7011ffbba818e788898d73ba71a8.jpg[/img]
We can't wait to explore Missouri once it is released in ATS! Want to show us that you are also looking forward to trucking in this map expansion? Then [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730870/American_Truck_Simulator__Missouri/#game_area_purchase]add it to your Steam Wishlist[/url]! Remember to follow us on our [url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@SCSSoftware]YouTube[/url], so you won't miss out on any American Truck Simulator news. Safe travels!

notes.title: SCS On The Road: Freightliner Fifth Generation Cascadia Walk-Around
notes.content:
Today we're happy to share with you a very special SCS On The Road episode! Join us at the Daimler Truck North America High Desert Proving Grounds, in Madras, Oregon USA, as we check out the Fifth Generation Cascadia from Freightliner which was [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/10/ats-introducing-fifth-generation.html]recently added as a driveable truck in American Truck Simulator, alongside the launch of the real truck.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5ad5d89c740c212ffb30349b208ef64b8657ddca.jpg[/img]
During our visit, Oscar, our Director of Global Partnerships, had the pleasure of meeting with Tim Norton, Powertrain Product Marketing at Daimler Trucks North America. Tim provided us with an in-depth tour of the new Fifth Generation Cascadia, inside and out. This episode is packed with detailed information, including the history of the Cascadia, the key changes in each generation, and what makes the Fifth Generation Cascadia their most advanced and aerodynamic on-highway truck to date.

[previewyoutube=x5mv2NiBukI;full][/previewyoutube]
We'd like to thank our partners at Freightliner for allowing us to film and share this episode with you and for the team's kind hospitality during our visit. We really learnt a lot and we are sure you will too. 

If you enjoyed this episode, we'd love to hear your comments! Be sure to let us know your favorite new feature of the Fifth Generation Cascadia, along with a like and a subscribe, it really helps support our channel and videos. We will see you soon for the next episode, until then, keep on truckin'!

notes.title: American Truck Simulator - 1.53 Update: Open Beta
notes.content:
Today, we are happy to share with you that the 1.53 Open Beta branch for American Truck Simulator is now available to try and test out. If you plan on participating in this Open Beta, we ask that you please help us by reporting any bugs you may encounter in the [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=330]appropriate section(s) of our official forums[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e8bf6fb9213dc0f0b730c6aa92b0d93cbc19406e.jpg[/img]
Your feedback and reports are extremely valuable to our team and we thank you in advance for taking the time to help us out. So, without further ado, let's take a look at what the 1.53 Open Beta has in store.

[h3]California Rework - Phase 4[/h3]

Phase 4 of the California Rework project focuses on the southern region of California and includes 10 cities, 3 of which are entirely new to the world of American Truck Simulator. Drivers working in this region can look forward to making deliveries to and from the cities of Bakersfield, [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/07/california-rework-santa-maria-oxnard.html]Santa Maria[/url], [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/07/california-rework-santa-maria-oxnard.html]Oxnard[/url], Mojave, Barstow, Indio, Blythe, [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/10/153-california-rework-los-angeles-san.html]Los Angeles[/url], [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/10/153-california-rework-los-angeles-san.html]San Diego[/url], and El Centro. Similar to previous phases, much of the original base map was removed and reworked entirely from the ground up including the cities' surrounding areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8b99e44b367951f966819a25a015ce11a2acaeed.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/faa3ee5dcde9b86fb1163ee3026f713204aa6893.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4ab76d6861859a7dbf5917d9e9d033f912efe36f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/29518364b2cc03b204b4b0c38d0cae6ec0768199.jpg[/img]
Our team also focused on reworking key routes, including major coastal highways such as the US-101, CA-1, and I-5. In addition, several other important routes have been revamped, such as the CA-58, CA-14, and CA-99, along with interstates I-10, I-15, I-40, and I-8, which serve as vital connections to neighboring U.S. states. You can read about this phase of the rework project in more detail in a [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/10/153-california-rework-phase-4.html]dedicated blog post[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8a5fbe5fcc6118c32fc3e7fe03c0290778109d15.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5e42029323fee2cae9ce9cfc7a29690c9842bf2c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/96c034031e2ba29460a484de2589f256f5138cf5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3fa1512364a2d06ccccba73cf2eebb7b2e144de6.jpg[/img]
[h3]Dynamic Cargo (Un)loading Update[/h3]

Since the 1.50 update, we have implemented and then further expanded the dynamic cargo loading and unloading feature. So far, truckers have been able to experience this feature when hauling a grain hopper, a chip van, or a bolster logger. When using the logger, truckers were able to transport logs and enjoy the animated loading and unloading only in Arkansas. With the 1.53 update, we are happy to share with you that this feature will be available throughout the whole USA!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/90d679ec629a48442ea89267a13387ec806959de.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ec475ee1d734c02329dc7d37bebb95d5387a5d31.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/7209303143c97909650521348ff3e30b14a3a843.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/727e61b4ab5f15c85e3141e0a1440302986efcbe.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/98a6e2dbb3fb16dfe9a3d800a84508a7b6cdef39.jpg[/img]
[h3]Driving Academy Fifth Generation Cascadia[/h3]

In the 1.53 update, [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/10/ats-introducing-fifth-generation.html]The Fifth Generation Cascadia from Freightliner[/url] will be implemented into [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/10/driving-academy-release.html]Driving Academy[/url], our brand new game module introduced in 1.52. This state-of-the-art truck is the newest addition to the ATS truck roster, and now you will have the option to try it out in various challenging scenarios in Driving Academy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3f5082838e8381bf16744061927ce23e12b5ea01.jpg[/img]
[h3]Options QoL improvement[/h3]

We're happy to introduce a feature that we believe many players will find helpful, especially those who often adjust their settings to fine-tune what is best to their liking and setup. When changing an option with a default value, players will now have a visual indication of when a setting has been moved or changed from its default state. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/341b26bf660fe0d3711229eb8bde13f734f4e277.jpg[/img]
Settings that have been adjusted from their default value will now appear with a small visual indicator alongside that setting. We hope this helps users find which settings have been altered from default.

[h3]Smooth and Auto Camera Centering[/h3]
Another new feature that we are happy to include with this update is Smooth and Auto Camera Centring! Players can now enable this new option to return their camera to the central position automatically after moving it. When activated by the player or by moving forward, the smooth centering feature becomes noticeable as it gently transitions the camera to the central position.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6d667dffe53f7bcac02f6a0d66d1c49c4bd8af84.jpg[/img]
This addition comes with a range of personal preference options, including three options of speed, which controls how fast or slow the camera returns to the center; as well as the option to set how many seconds of delay there should be before re-centring occurs.

For players who use a third-party head-tracking solution or prefer to adjust the position of the camera manually, also have the option to disable this feature altogether.

[h3]Special Transport Update[/h3]

We are also updating the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962750/American_Truck_Simulator__Special_Transport/]Special Transport DLC[/url]. As part of the California Rework project, we have added a new route for truckers to haul oversized cargo - between the rebuilt cities of Los Angeles and San Diego via I-5 route.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8461606a8878208da1d6fd81de769b68d9123351.jpg[/img]
But that's not all. In response to community feedback, we've decided to raise the maximum speed limit for special transport deliveries. Escort vehicles and the transport trucks themselves can now travel at speeds of up to 55 mph, an increase from the previous limit of 40 mph. We would like to ask our players to try out this update and share feedback on whether it enhances immersion and improves the overall smoothness of these jobs.

[h3]Sliding Tandems Update[/h3]

In the 1.53 update, we're also introducing a new sliding tandems feature. Previously, players could only set trailer axles in a fixed forward or rear position. Now, select trailers come with updated chassis, allowing players to slide the axles freely to optimize the weight distribution for their load.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d50e3043927fb1e91138b5ef72e62eaced0fbc1c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ca455c16ab2aacd4700c2ff0a1f7d29750e4f643.jpg[/img]
But be cautious! To make this feature as realistic as possible, if the trailer's rear axle's distance exceeds 40 feet from the kingpin, you risk receiving a fine at California weigh stations and, in some cases, directly from the police.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1fc8cb4c3506f70491f19d0c6fa6c6eba8eb5e15.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4efc5cb5226190343d2f215388e3ae4b6eedd191.jpg[/img]
[h3]Changelog [/h3]

[b]Map[/b]
[list]
[*] California Rework - Phase 4 release
[/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Dynamic cargo loading & unloading of logs available throughout the USA
[*] New Special Transport route from Los Angeles to San Diego
[*] Raised speed limit for Special Transport jobs from 40 mph to 55 mph
[/list]
[b]Vehicles[/b]
[list]
[*] The new Fifth Generation Freightliner Cascadia® added to Driving Academy
[*] Fully functional sliding tandems and fines system
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Visualization of changed options in the settings
[*] Smooth and Auto camera centering
[/list]
So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an open beta, not a stable public version - so you may encounter bugs, instability, or crashes. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to get there faster, we'll appreciate all of your feedback on our forum and your bug reports [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=330]in this section[/url].

Please check our modding wiki to get details pertaining to mods for the game.

If you wish to participate in the open beta, you can find this version in the public_beta branch on Steam. The way to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right-click on American Truck Simulator  → Properties → Betas tab → public_beta → 1.53. No password is required. Sometimes you may have to restart your Steam client to see the correct branch name there.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/

notes.title: 1.53: California Rework - Los Angeles & San Diego
notes.content:
Another two cities will be getting a brand-new look in our upcoming 1.53 update for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url]. The [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/search/label/California]California Rework project[/url] just doesn't stop, so let's take a look at how our map designers and assets teams remade Los Angeles and San Diego!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8b99e44b367951f966819a25a015ce11a2acaeed.jpg[/img]
[h3]San Diego[/h3]
"America's Finest City" was rebuilt from the ground up. We managed to use the best areas from the original version while also adding new locations which have been highly requested by our community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/67297c0af91c879123590ba083b961415e9ad697.jpg[/img]

Truckers can look forward to cruising through San Diego on I-5, almost reaching the Mexican border, or taking in the views of the Snapdragon Stadium as they drive along I-8. CA-905 will take you right to the border, passing through a sprawling warehouse district. And for a fresh perspective, you'll now be able to cross the iconic Coronado Bridge, offering stunning views of San Diego from a whole new angle.

Like San Diego, the City of Angels was completely revamped. Some places from the original L.A. remain (although rebuilt as well) like Santa Monica, the beginning of I-10, and the major intersection of routes I-10, I-5, and US-101.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/85ca1d58af2e850402ee4ea1bf05b5bcd271f9ff.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 1.53: California Rework - Phase #4
notes.content:
Over the last few years, our dedicated rework team has been hard at work revitalizing one of the base game areas in American Truck Simulator. We're of course referring to the California Rework project, and today, we're excited to give you a more detailed preview of what they've accomplished in the final phase of this project. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8a5fbe5fcc6118c32fc3e7fe03c0290778109d15.jpg[/img]
Phase 4 of the California Rework project focuses on the southern region of California and includes 10 cities, 3 of which are entirely new to the ATS economy. As you can imagine, this has been a monumental task for the team. Similar to previous phases, much of the original base map was removed and reworked entirely from the ground up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ce28de6e5432f6acf2e87370ce8e39c259072a08.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b43f2d18d4e461cda521a62e97cfcce81a9313f4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/85a6f0255461e012dd7bdcbc48fa31a80d0836cb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3591bd411be2b9b3bef2c03a5f54e23e3c7c7548.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5c084ee5e6254c114a991ba472ab2122d27e88d0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/250da6aa87c6ff4c1b1ded8fc157a4f69a4b37fc.jpg[/img]
Drivers working in this region can look forward to making deliveries to and from the cities of Bakersfield, Santa Maria, Oxnard, Mojave, Barstow, Indio, Blythe, Los Angeles, San Diego, and El Centro. This has been by no means a small feat; our team has meticulously utilized a huge area during this rework phase to incorporate as many details as possible, including accurate city layouts, industries, and road networks, all while working within the limitations of our game engine, map scale and of course, realistic trucking routes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/72b608f31768be1a47bd7f1f4aba0e7f117d3a58.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f293eef7b3984ec43f0f19b7e61c6e44d0fcac70.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/aab4122d841c7821641df56d0d468b8eedd443b9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c846b58923da9cc56ab75f2a54ca210156d78154.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8d1f7210f6cd06d51a67545171db2dbd40b065f0.jpg[/img]
Road networks are just as important as the cities themselves, ensuring drivers can reach their destinations quickly and safely. Our team focused on reworking key routes, including major coastal highways such as the US-101, CA-1, and I-5. In addition, several other important routes have been revamped, such as the CA-58, CA-14, and CA-99, along with interstates I-10, I-15, I-40, and I-8, which serve as vital connections to neighboring U.S. states.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/73da85b673d65a889042e490baa90c841d01b2bb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4ab76d6861859a7dbf5917d9e9d033f912efe36f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9ae919528c1f1feb21ee4d53c115652bdf8a713f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/deb51af420bb2e44a3d6634332c35f7c33319e49.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/acedffa04e9b8caea0c0258badcd9b032a04a322.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/341bc22cbb7a197febd02b897ed5423520963529.jpg[/img]
You'll also encounter numerous rest areas and truck stops, which have been thoroughly reworked as part of this update. Additionally, California's agriculture inspection stations, crucial for protecting the state's crops, wildlife, and produce, have received the same detailed attention. These stations play a vital role in safeguarding California’s agricultural industry.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/96c034031e2ba29460a484de2589f256f5138cf5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/29518364b2cc03b204b4b0c38d0cae6ec0768199.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a8f986dd076ac0ff364a6ffd7d5f362dfb670a41.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/01d60af7725a998be0f21ddfe8d557236d01ffd4.jpg[/img]
The final phase of the California Rework is scheduled to arrive with the 1.53 Update, which will be free for all owners of American Truck Simulator. In the meantime, we still have another blog post planned that will highlight a couple of the larger cities that have been reworked, trust us, you won't want to miss it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3fa1512364a2d06ccccba73cf2eebb7b2e144de6.jpg[/img]
Until then, we hope you enjoy the screenshots and work the team have put into California Rework. Be sure to share your comments and initial reactions with us on our official social media channels and our official forums, as we'd love to hear them! Until then, keep on truckin'.

notes.title: Happy Hauloween Event
notes.content:
Greetings truckers, and welcome to our [b]Happy Hauloween[/b] - [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url] event! The fun all starts today, Thursday 24th October...

As twilight fades and shadows grow
    You realise that it’s time to go
        And join the crowd of jolly ghosts
            That beckon you, as kindly hosts,
                With spooky pumpkins all in hand,
                    What fun awaits this merry band!
                        They float and glide with eerie grace,
                            In search of treats from place to place.
                                So, start your rig and take the lead,
                                    With all the hungry mouths to feed.
                                        Tonight’s the night, and you’re the one
                                            To bring to all some spectral fun!

                                                For Hauloween is in the air,
                                                    And there’s no time to flee nor dare
                                                        To hide away from all the treats
                                                            That wait for you, but not to eat,

[h3]Rules[/h3]

Using External Contracts, with a World of Trucks-connected profile in Euro Truck Simulator 2, American Truck Simulator or both, the community goal is to achieve 1,300,000 deliveries of Halloween Treats cargo, from any city in any trucking territory.

When a player completes [b]13 deliveries[/b] of Halloween Treats cargo across any trucking territories in either game, it will complete their personal goal.

[h3]Rewards[/h3]

[b]Personal:[/b] Players that complete 13 or more deliveries of Halloween Treats cargo will gain a unique World of Trucks Achievement as well as a spooky Booing Ghost cabin item as a Steam inventory item for Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/23471830533e48683a83cda8aef18c092659877a.jpg[/img]
[b]Community:[/b] When the community goal of achieving 1,300,000 deliveries of Halloween Treats cargo from any city is met, and if the player has also achieved their personal goal, then they will receive a Grumpy Ghost hanging toy as a Steam inventory item for their cabin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e57c2122d0e835b9a42e9b8566c4ade526faf4a1.jpg[/img]
[b]Note:[/b] In order to qualify for any community reward, you must complete at least your personal goal in Euro Truck Simulator 2, American Truck Simulator or both. Each reward will be a Steam inventory item for both Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator. Once completed, claim your reward in the Events page on your World of Trucks profile.

[b]The event will be concluded on Sunday, 17th of November at 23:59 UTC.[/b]

notes.title: Missouri - Poplar Bluff
notes.content:
We have another glimpse for you of the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730870/American_Truck_Simulator__Missouri/]Missouri[/url] map expansion for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url]! This time, we will take you to the town of Poplar Bluff which will be included in this DLC. What is awaiting you there? Let's take a look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/7c1847cbbd31fdb7712a7588ad2a0313ee2429f2.jpg[/img]
Located in southern Missouri, Poplar Bluff is home to around 17,000 people. The town was established in the 19th century and named after an uninhabited bluff on the Black River where it was built and the beautiful poplar trees that grew there. Today, it serves as a regional hub for education, health care, and business.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3bf9f362f6dddb85e74178f8b8e4c3a763add86c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c170c276b9a03f9e7373658fc598274c2fed7f17.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9c2383f73bf7c7c329ed27a6850304cb3c3e4212.jpg[/img]
How did our team recreate this charming town? You can look forward to some beautiful buildings inspired by real ones such as the Poplar Bluff bank, courthouse, sheriff department, theatre, and also a couple of stunning historic churches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b3b38f9b894232405aeaccf80a2650916702cf2f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b0f55dee19cf8fcc6627775a1b3f5a42df6eae48.jpg[/img]
Looking at what the industry has to offer in and around the city, truckers hauling goods from Poplar Bluff will be able to find jobs in six companies. In the city, you will find a warehouse, sawmill, metalwork, and construction site that all need your help with delivering supplies. And if you don't feel like going to the city center, you will surely find a job at the timber harvest site or furniture factory in the suburbs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5bc949e7bbae14983787b6e8637e69b565d4a8bc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/60bf217d5fd8528bdb6e6b2ee5554946975266c5.jpg[/img]
We hope you are looking forward to trucking in the Missouri DLC and visiting this town. If you do, make sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730870/American_Truck_Simulator__Missouri/#game_area_purchase]add this map expansion to your Steam Wishlist[/url]! And don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@SCSSoftware]YouTube[/url], so you won't miss out on any American Truck Simulator news. Until next time, drive safe!

notes.title: Driving Academy Release
notes.content:
Today, we are very happy to announce that Driving Academy is now available for American Truck Simulator! A few weeks ago, we announced this new game module in [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/09/152-update-driving-academy.html]this blog[/url] and showed you a preview of it in some of our [url=https://www.youtube.com/@SCSSoftware/streams]live streams[/url], and now you can finally try it out for yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1cfe871d0f77b58dadbbdc4125669b3efa6eefa8.jpg[/img]
As was mentioned in the previous blog we released about Driving Academy, we are venturing into new territory, inspired by years of feedback from players who have told us that our games have helped them grasp the basics of truck driving. Many have used it to get a sense of handling a truck and trailer, learning how to maneuver and reverse. With this in mind, we thought we'd take it a step further with this free update which includes sets of scenarios designed to improve and expand these skills in a fun and captivating way. 

We've prepared a short video just for you, explaining everything you need to know about Driving Academy. It also includes a brief yet comprehensive guide on how to get started and make the most out of the game module.

[previewyoutube=fav9uncyvYA;full][/previewyoutube]
This new game module will provide you with various scenarios of increasing difficulty inspired by instructions given to real-life students. You will go from basic driving to navigating intricate courses and complex parking maneuvers with a detailed explanation via driving instructions including diagrams, pointers, and directions. We also wanted to allow drivers to analyze their drive so we have implemented a new replay feature into this game module as well.

notes.title: ATS: Introducing The Fifth Generation Cascadia
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the arrival of the The Fifth Generation Cascadia from Freightliner in American Truck Simulator, which is now available to purchase and drive in-game. This release is especially exciting, as we've worked closely with the team at Freightliner to synchronize its real-life premiere and launch with our virtual implementation. 

[previewyoutube=Gm803sX3nyM;full][/previewyoutube]
Ready to hit the road? Let's take a closer look at the newest generation of this iconic on-highway truck. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4df2c627199a1ce6954492fdc08c062b3f376113.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1209cd2ffd6d5989e44e66b83873a1c0fecff897.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c04ed36e633a3bc05227d9747124bd2c253e043d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fd7f57354efe06160be743e3a5a5430c081f270f.jpg[/img]
The Fifth Generation Cascadia is the most advanced on-highway truck Freightliner has ever offered, featuring a cutting edge aerodynamic package with chassis fairings, skirts, cabin extenders, roof fairings, front wheel closeouts and a new aerodynamic hood. These features help streamline airflow and reduce drag, extending the fuel efficiency and range on each journey.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bc993abbaa263ee00bc81895817b8870bb49cdd5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f6aa0f6440f7dbc465a4ff2d2cfbb6d8de4a8897.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/652c650426932eb96d9577d75788631a61226893.jpg[/img]
Drivers can also take advantage of the new MirrorEye® digital camera system on the Fifth Generation Cascadia, which provides considerably better vision for the driver, even when light or weather conditions are challenging. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8ccb430ef2488e6ba03e25ccfb738d59cefd3368.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8bfe089fe6431826db73ff7b4e1de8be79f3f217.jpg[/img]

The design of The Fifth Generation Cascadia has been inspired and tested by The SuperTruck II, a prototype truck from Freightliner which is used to push the boundaries of Freightliner's vision for sustainable design by optimizing current technologies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5531d92e5523dbe049f91275e4f3c9e0625c4cda.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4ca6c1694b45dc38cc705b1f091dc6f1c1d25469.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ab9c809d1f0427cc08947bb1a4ba934fcdf8119a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0b64417d6b8847bac8eabee7bb3ca583dde0d4c0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/675764fb7efcdd61abb5a56eaa1deeb681ed3141.jpg[/img]
We'd like to thank our friends at Freightliner and Daimler Truck North America for allowing us to work with them closely to launch this truck both the real world and virtual American Truck Simulator world with early access reference material. We know our community are going to really enjoy this new addition!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2c1aa7b0a0848e68eeacd87e60eee28180eaf5ca.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f42949cdef8c40f46fe5dfd7fc4165dab1d4fae7.jpg[/img]

We were also given the opportunity to collect our own reference shots and record sounds with the Fifth Generation Cascadia at the High Desert Proving Ground in Madras, Oregon. We look forward to sharing more about our trip and our time with the Cascadia in a future SCS On The Road episode!

notes.title: SCS On The Road: Mack® Pinnacle Walk-Around

Join us in Allentown, Pennsylvania, at the Mack Experience Centre as we check out the legendary Mack® Pinnacle, which was recently added as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3146090/American_Truck_Simulator__Mack_Pinnacle/]a driveable truck in American Truck Simulator[/url] as part of a free recent update ([url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/09/mack-pinnacle-mack-anthem-black-edition.html]see our blog about it here[/url]).

notes.title: Missouri - Maryville
notes.content:
Whilst Maryville isn't the biggest city in our upcoming Missouri DLC for American Truck Simulator, it still has plenty to offer to both truckers and visitors alike! Today we're happy to share with you more about this area, which our team has recreated in detail. Let's take a closer look, shall we? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/222ca8cf3b6f069680bbaefa63c2b610f6909f18.jpg[/img]
Located in the rolling hills of the northwest, Maryville is a small town with big hospitality. Whether you’re visiting or passing through on a long-haul drive, be sure to take a moment to admire everything this city has to offer. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6cae817f8da6f09f5d4d6f7763f32a4850710663.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4615f5597b8d213c0d9a75fa19efa60dfda007d3.jpg[/img]
In Maryville you'll come across several recreated landmarks such as the local church, which was originally built in 1897 (but has since been upgraded and expanded over time). The historic Nodaway County Courthouse, with its iconic structure and clocktower, and other notetable landmarks such as the local firehouse and the Maryville Treatment Center can also be found there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/661362ad71da47111a21a356940d369b3f05ac10.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/14357ed02d46f7466bc31c20398a52789f22abb4.jpg[/img]
If you're looking to pick up some work while you are there, Maryville has no shortage of industries that are looking for drivers! Downtown you'll find a range of industries from warehouses to construction sites and even car parts factory. If you happen to be travelling on the outskirts, you can find other industries such as farms with livestock and a wind power plant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d9f892a636ac05baeec35da52cf2b14b2485021a.jpg[/img]
If you're just in town for a break, be sure to take advantage of the local truck stop, where you can rest up for the journey ahead! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/07a60f71b1c2ac61859699ea9ba1da794e744cca.jpg[/img]
We look forward to sharing more previews from the Missouri DLC for American Truck Simulator in the near future. If you like what you see, you can support us by adding Missouri to your Steam Wishlist. A big thank you to everyone who has already, it really means a lot! Until next time, keep on truckin'.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730870/American_Truck_Simulator__Missouri/

notes.title: Introducing Louisiana
notes.content:
We know you have probably been wondering what our next state will be in American Truck Simulator after the teaser we published some time ago. Well, most of you guessed it right! Today we are excited to announce that our team is hard at work creating...

[h3]Louisiana for American Truck Simulator[/h3]

[previewyoutube=-xn9NyuSkBA;full][/previewyoutube]
Embark on a journey to the Pelican State nestled in the south of the U.S.. Discover the subtropical climate of the state which has provided the magnificent brooding scenery of the coastal bayous, and the lush, dank vegetation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/cc8e420b66afb09d5c2181fe40e10913755e9555.jpg[/img]
Truckers can look forward to the beautiful and iconic landscape of this southern state, historical cities like New Orleans and Baton Rouge, miles and miles of long stretching roads, and also the Mississippi River delta that has helped shaped how the area looks today.

The diverse landscape contributes to the unique beauty of this state, as visitors can find three types of regions there. The lowlands consist of the coastal marshes and the Mississippi floodplain. The Red River valley is typical for its red soil and many raft lakes. In the northern part of the state, you will mainly find some rolling hills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d8b1db99f568c9d23037f47cd9b9400fd77af4cc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9bcbfe01ad21dcb24c4cb63cab05d608f75a050f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b1127c540874357c9ca89a98c0f73c83e3818abc.jpg[/img]
Louisiana has a diverse variety of industries ranging from agricultural production, fishing, or forestry, to petroleum, gas, and coal. Thanks to this, drivers can haul plenty of different cargo types in and out of the Pelican State. We cannot understate the importance of waterways in this state, especially its canal system and the crucial role ports play, such as the port of New Orleans, which ranks among the busiest in the country in terms of volume of seaborne freight handled, so there is plenty of cargo to transport for everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/85430194d1f1a296b1e814ce6380538633f4c89a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f722bebbacd337c6a709636796f0659e7c253ea4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/96a41b23ce930f7c88a6fe15a01e8571fe6b9b46.jpg[/img]
We look forward to sharing more from this state with you in future blog posts. But for now, please remember that everything you see here is still very much a work in progress and may not represent the final product when it is released.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5da64e00791629db83f77d0a06f920a867bd4041.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c92f1b8380825e7de3d11baf450f70531f60c537.jpg[/img]
Excited about Louisiana? Then be sure to add this map expansion to your Steam Wishlist as it really helps support our future projects. notes.title: Pinktober 2024
notes.content:
Every October since 1985, organizations and people from around the world help raise awareness and support local charities in the fight against Breast Cancer. Known as [b]Pinktober[/b], this special month is marked by the iconic pink ribbon, a symbol of unity and strength. It also serves as a reminder that breast cancer impacts many lives, and that we should educate, inform, and empower individuals to make proactive choices about their health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/a0bdf0c2f63a29bd4fd196bdb0f0b6cff8308223.jpg[/img]
At the heart of Pinktober is the importance of knowledge and awareness. Recognizing the signs and symptoms of breast cancer can lead to early detection, which significantly improves outcomes. By committing to regular self-exams and professional check-ups, we can play a crucial role in safeguarding our own health. Moreover, sharing this vital information with those around us helps amplify the mission of breast cancer awareness.

Pinktober reminds us all that taking care of our health should be a top priority. Encouraging regular screenings, health check-ups, and advocating for these practices within our communities, friends and families is at the core of what this campaign stands for.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1068290/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Pink_Ribbon_Charity_Pack/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1162160/American_Truck_Simulator__Pink_Ribbon_Charity_Pack/

Since 2019, we've been proud to actively support and bring awareness to this important cause. Our community has been at the core in helping us raise funds for our local charity of choice, the Alliance of Women with Breast Cancer, by purchasing our special Pinktober DLCs for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1162160/American_Truck_Simulator__Pink_Ribbon_Charity_Pack/]American Truck Simulator[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1068290/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Pink_Ribbon_Charity_Pack/]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] from which 100% of the income goes to charity every year.

We've had the pleasure of meeting with those involved in this charity organisation, as well as hosting numerous educational talks at our offices in the past. We encourage you to check out their work at their website, which you can find [url=https://www.breastcancer.cz/]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/744da522b19f06bfc0ea9d522e097684653bff1b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/9540504cb0e7df3f4c9e9a225e35240122a146ee.jpg[/img]
We'd like to express our sincerest gratitude to every player who has purchased these special charity packs, your contributions have helped save lives and support those who are directly impacted by Breast Cancer. 

If you're looking to make a tangible impact and add some unique flair to your trucks, now is a perfect time to purchase or gift these DLCs. By customizing your trucks with Pink Ribbon designs and sharing them online using [b]#Pinktober2024[/b], you can help spread awareness while supporting the cause.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/1d5d759c68625974896527d5727ee10c04a94656.jpg[/img]
We are deeply grateful to everyone who has supported Pinktober over the years. Whether through donations, awareness campaigns, or participating in educational events, your efforts have a lasting impact. Together, we continue to bring hope and change to the lives of those affected by breast cancer.

notes.title: Iowa - Research Trip
notes.content:
Last year, a few members of our American Truck Simulator map team travelled to the USA to gather information and references for our upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/]Iowa DLC[/url]. In this blog post, we'll offer you a peek into the team's exciting adventures as they ventured through the state, and what they experienced whilst there! 

We spoke with Saimon, the DLC Lead more about this trip. "In the summer of 2023, we embarked on a Research Trip that took us across the states of Nebraska and Iowa." Saimon tells us "we combined these two destinations because the same team members who worked on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543810/American_Truck_Simulator__Nebraska/]Nebraska DLC[/url] were also responsible for the development of Iowa. This makes perfect sense since both states are geographically connected, share a similar culture and environment, and are close to each other in many ways."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2a7a50baf1259297777d0132e4552601d7735c31.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9d6022a3f891393463f335bf31f78cdef7873ac4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/31401fbe8fab24b9d381159879ed7e8032d88316.jpg[/img]
"Our map designers involved in this trip were Petra (Draky), Antonín (Tony), Jan (Vacky), and Saimon. Over five days, they travelled approximately 1,000 miles, visiting various large and small towns, driving on highways and back roads, and exploring different landmarks and logistical areas."

"Our goal was to thoroughly understand how the state looks and functions. We were interested in what might catch our attention and surprise us, as well as what differences we could find compared to neighbouring states that we would want to portray authentically. Let's take a look at some of these interesting discoveries together."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c5595122497175055933b6d62065f3ce426cb843.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/12e7826acde56921bd67a9debbac89f59c91fb48.jpg[/img]
Saimon goes on to explain "The first thing that caught our attention when traveling from Nebraska to Iowa were the expansive hills with terraced fields, picturesque farms with round silos, and countless wind turbines on the horizon. The way the highway rise and fell with the terrain, and wildflowers bloomed on the side of the road. Later, we learnt that the state of Iowa takes special care to protect native flowers and grasses as part of its environmental program."

"As we travelled through Iowa, its nickname "The Corn State" was fully on display. Cornfields alternated with soybeans, and vast plains and terraced fields stretched out in every direction. Agriculture plays a crucial role here, evident not only from the endless fields but also from the abundance of farming equipment, dealers, and agricultural machinery factories we encountered at every turn."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fb6bea2afac7d6fa8fde2535a0b3c80734117d27.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/202ab41898df4e8eb7e342c9c7f8aa7a5beb7d18.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ba9e7b9c2aad0482b91d578352b9b45d5662e9d0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/04be7fa4853b33181bb6910279c49588e8fbeed8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3e085bfff0600e4518a9d02019705353bc20f58a.jpg[/img]
"When we arrived from the vast meadows and plains into the towns, we were pleasantly surprised by their charm and rich culture. Many of these towns are situated along rivers, giving us the opportunity to admire majestic bridges, charming harbors, and interesting landmarks. We were struck by how varied the towns are, with historic buildings often adorned with red brick facades. At night, some of these structures are beautifully illuminated, and combined with the water features, they create truly breathtaking scenes."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fce036b6cf838d2dbbe7e90ba0232ccc9aea5b16.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3a8f5bc1d8420b294d058d923e5cac07ab5ae471.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/86a0040c49fe9a1ae988d4b11684a42cb5e4953f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9cd8d45bd06fd2b455206e855cf076d697c8446d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8ce107319d253466381c3676c7145fa62dabc7b1.jpg[/img]
"The vast logistics parks and industrial areas reminded us of the key role industry plays in Iowa and were a great source of inspiration for us. We also had the opportunity to visit a variety of trucks stop, both large and small! These stops not only provided our team with a break, but also a source of inspiration when it comes to trucking culture in America."

"The entire trip proved to be extremely beneficial for our development team. By personally visiting and exploring the state of Iowa, we now have a much clearer idea of how to authentically capture its character in the game."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e08bd358b4a3c71048102475e89e09ba3b0e6431.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a6dc6269e2869a5bf38fbc83cb04db69d1c9685f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a7c8bdbed78e1fb58fdbaa4ab4e6fe9da8e23ea8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/86638fd9d80d1bacecfa44bd4e5f5ab935f69139.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c452cd4cc630c71de7feb5624aa8622946cfe258.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3f445bfd6e4c9e734b2c8291e9f0525dea57b9c9.jpg[/img]
"We gained valuable insights that will allow us to convey the atmosphere of this region not only visually but also through gameplay mechanics and details that will immerse players in a world inspired by a real place. This experience provided us with the essential context that we could never fully grasp from maps and photos, and we're excited to bring this into our game."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5bab03f5b3c75d41935473c816509a2ac61e940a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ebca4b32b6c332e43b5dcc815b60ff90243c29f7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b589493c73cf76d5adb3a6afc24bddcec48d3321.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d9bd7c36e8295990f3b3214be1773868540baec1.jpg[/img]
We hope you've found this insight on the team's trip to Iowa interesting. Don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://x.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url] so you won't miss out on news about the development of the Iowa DLC for American Truck Simulator. Until next time, keep on truckin'!

notes.title: Missouri - New Assets to Build the World With
notes.content:
We have another preview of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730870/American_Truck_Simulator__Missouri/]Missouri[/url] map expansion for our #BestCommunityEver! This time, we would like to show you some of the new models our asset makers are working on which you will find scattered across the map in this upcoming DLC. You will also read about how they prepare the models from scratch for their final design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5356f079cd1b7cb1bb7c4da387607d0deaddf157.jpg[/img]
Keep in mind that these models showcased here are not the only new assets we have been working on, and that this DLC is still a work in progress. Among many other models, we are proud to show you these beauties inspired by the real-world locations in various parts of Missouri such as the Jefferson Performing Arts Center, the Joplin church, the statue in Kirksville, St. Joseph's water building or the pedestrian bridge in Rolla. But that's not all, in total, we have put together over 350 new models just for this map expansion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3300de4790c422aa923869182f075d47c4e6c140.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/7f473b222d886217f6c5d8dbb6072e2b836838c6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2399ef8b90f40bdda10fb934d854eb2b1d1053f2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9c824839b64ba6b51881385df1b19300ff71f452.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f16e458e2984ebd8881004d322a40f09192b095b.jpg[/img]
Are you interested to know how these models are put together? Our talented asset makers work on them in Autodesk Maya from the first draft to the final design. As you can see in the first image below, first they put together a basic model with no details and textures, serving as a placeholder for more adjustments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/501c6217f15448898032c0e9718f4bce363ef011.jpg[/img]
Once they have that done, they proceed to modify the geometry and add details. In this step, it is important to have an overview of the model structure, which allows them to modify the shape and detailed elements. In the image below, you can see the model in Shade mode without textures, with the wireframe view added. This shows how the model is structured and how the different parts of the model relate to each other.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f7f339ea208042a4459e6f3b6fcb7d8f9dc9949f.jpg[/img]
The last step is to apply the textures and make final adjustments. Now, you can see the final look of the model, ready to be used in a variety of applications. On the very first picture of this blog, you can also see this model's final look in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/aa94fb398aa7cc48640f362b079802aff2098b7c.jpg[/img]
We hope you are looking forward to trucking in the Missouri DLC. If you do, make sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730870/American_Truck_Simulator__Missouri/#game_area_purchase]add it to your Steam Wishlist[/url]! And don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@SCSSoftware]YouTube[/url], so you won't miss out on any American Truck Simulator news. Until next time, happy travels!

notes.title: Star Nation Experience 2024 Update
notes.content:
Earlier this year, we announced that we have teamed up with Western Star Trucks for the [url=https://www.westernstartrucks.com/star-nation/]Star Nation Experience 2024[/url] in [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/03/star-nation-experience-2024.html]this blog[/url]. Along with us, [url=https://www.westernstartrucks.com/]Western Star Trucks[/url], and members of the Star Nation community, two lucky [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] players had the chance to win an all-expenses-paid trip to Bend, Oregon, and take part in this unforgettable once-in-a-lifetime experience.

Unfortunately, the original date for the Star Nation Experience 2024 had to be cancelled due to the wildfires spreading in the area. As a result, Western Star, in cooperation with local authorities, firefighters, and sheriffs, made the decision to postpone the event to ensure everyone's safety. The new date has now been announced: the event will take place from September 27 to September 30! And today, we are excited to introduce the two participants from our ATS community, so let's meet them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d0439e7820fe05e4fbd64d671f487ec8497f6d56.jpg[/img]
But first, we shall remind you of what this amazing event is all about. In the heart of Oregon's untamed wilderness, Western Star Trucks hosted the first Star Nation Experience last year for eight lucky winners of their raffle, marking the first of its kind in the trucking industry. 

It is a wild, adrenaline-fueled experience filled with trucking, fly fishing, ATV fun, and more adventures celebrating everything that makes Western Star and the Star Nation community special. The highlight of the event is undoubtedly the behind-the-scenes tour of Daimler's High Desert Proving Grounds in Madras, where they took on the ultimate driver challenge last year, pushing Western Star X-Series trucks to their limits. And this year will be no different.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/732949fa3876669db8d985c963661ff7143accba.png[/img]
As we already mentioned above, for the Star Nation Experience 2024, Western Star has invited us to participate but also dedicated two slots of the team of eight lucky winners to members of our American Truck Simulator community. Our friends at Western Star received plenty of applications and a few weeks ago, they selected the winners. We are very excited to meet with all of them, especially with the two from our community - Connor and Brendan.

[h3]Brendan[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ee807b423802bf09aa81f35466afb67ec79e9667.jpg[/img]
Brendan's passion for trucking traces all the way back to his childhood. [i]"I’ve been obsessed ever since I was a kid. I would always play with toy trucks and pull wagons around in my yard,"[/i] he says. This early fascination grew into a full-blown obsession with trucks, leading him to discover the world of ATS and a career as a driver.

Since 2019, Brendan has been an avid player, drawn to the game's meticulous detail and immersive environments, which realistically replicated real trucking experiences. In ATS, Brendan's vehicle of choice is the Western Star 4900EX, inspired by his fond memories of riding in his father's truck as a child. Captivated by its iconic design and reliability, Brendan enthusiastically recreated his favorite truck in-game, using mods to enhance his virtual trucking adventures.

Outside of ATS, Brendan's dedication to trucking extends into his professional life, where he spends most of his time on the road, logging miles as a professional truck driver.

[h3]Connor[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f7958e7b226efbf51087e846dfcfba4c230294b3.jpg[/img]
Connor’s passion for ATS began with the original Euro Truck Simulator when he was just 12 years old. [i]"There was something about the open road and the sounds of the truck engine that always pulled me into playing more,"[/i] Connor recalled.

In the virtual realm of ATS, Connor drives his favorite truck, the Western Star 57X, relishing its smooth rides and long-haul comfort. The truck's iconic logo holds a special place in Conor’s heart; it resonates with him - something he identifies with. Beyond gaming, Connor values ATS for its ability to offer a temporary escape from the humdrum of everyday life as well as the opportunity for him to immerse himself in the role of an owner-operator, participating in virtual convoys and engaging with a community of fellow trucking enthusiasts.

We would like to thank Western Star Truck for this wonderful opportunity to be a part of this adventure along with the members of our American Truck Simulator community. Keep a close eye on Western Star's [url=https://www.facebook.com/westernstartrucks]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/westernstartruck]Instagram[/url], and our [url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@SCSSoftware/]YouTube[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url] so you don't miss out on any news from the Star Nation Experience 2024 which Nemiro and Mark will also attend. Get ready to embark on this unforgettable adventure with us!

notes.title: 1.52 Update: Driving Academy
notes.content:
We are excited to share with you that a new game module for both [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] will be introduced with the 1.52 update - Driving Academy. This free update will include sets of scenarios which we hope will teach our players a thing or two about driving and maneuvering a truck in a fun and captivating way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c814ec8671465340fbee68dd8838391ce6d9e570.jpg[/img]
We are venturing into new territory, inspired by years of feedback from players who have told us that our games have helped them grasp the basics of truck driving. Many have used it to get a sense of handling a truck and trailer, learning how to maneuver and reverse. With this in mind, we thought we'd take it a step further by introducing a series of challenges specifically designed to improve and expand these skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/616735b3fb7fb4f8c5a713ab58322ece2e38e9be.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/db5c8ca27aca099f7400d006ebd90c95941944fb.jpg[/img]
Driving Academy will help players learn to drive a truck, from basic driving to navigating intricate courses and complex parking maneuvers with a detailed explanation via driving instructions including diagrams, pointers, and directions. This new game module will provide you with various scenarios of increasing difficulty inspired by instructions given to real-life students. We also wanted to enable drivers to analyze their drive so we have also implemented a new replay feature into this game module as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/dd2ee32378a647b3ac5ac17174f182622dd92848.jpg[/img]

As we mentioned above, we are testing the waters with Driving Academy, but if we get positive feedback from our community, we would love to continue creating additional scenarios and special challenges in the future that real-life truck drivers may encounter on the road. Our dream is for this game module to offer a deeper understanding of both truck driving and the underlying systems, as well as when to use them. But that is still a long way to go.

notes.title: Arkansas DLC Release + Forest Machinery DLC Update
notes.content:
Today is the day, engines at the ready! The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2585150/American_Truck_Simulator__Arkansas/]Arkansas DLC[/url] for American Truck Simulator releases today and we can't wait for you to get haulin'. Are you ready to explore the Natural State and all that it has to offer? Let's get cruising! 

[h3]The Arkansas DLC has been released and is now available on Steam![/h3]

[previewyoutube=PPJABNHzQdY;full][/previewyoutube]
We cannot wait for you to embark on your first journey into Arkansas. Our team has been working hard to ensure everything is running smoothly for its release. From bug smashing to putting in additional polish on the map, we're ready for you to explore and deliver across the State! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/aac709c6142d27ee9461943bf8feb623ad08bb63.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Take your time and enjoy every moment as you discover:
[*] 10 explorable cities including Little Rock, Fortsmith, Fayetteville and Pine Bluff.
[*] See several landmarks unique to Arkansas such as the historical centre of Hot Springs with its Bathhouse Row and National Park, iconic art murals, the majestic Arlington Hotel, courthouses, churches and more.
[*] Enjoy trucking through 10 scenic towns (settlements)
[*] Discover a variety of different viewpoints across Arkansas
[*] See the famous Arkansas and Mississippi rivers which run through the State.
[*] Drive across the impressively large Emmitt Sanders Lock and Dam, which has been in operation since December 1968!
[*] Deliver to unique industries such as the Nuclear One power plant, and custom built River Port & Timber Harvest depots. 
[*] Experience the new dynamic loading and unloading of logs onto your trailer.
[*] Discover the hidden treasures of Arkansas's countryside, forest, swampland, viewpoints, road network and more.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0d9c0127a1f4d5493df7a7e3af9b4479b7447272.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5e1d014edbc3ad0f538c9733fb8594f05a9c4058.jpg[/img]

From cities large and small, Arkansas has something new to explore around every corner. From art murals, to swampland and the custom-made farms, grain elevators,  river ports and timber harvest depots, there is something for everyone to discover and enjoy.

[h3][b]Forest Machinery DLC Update[/b][/h3]
We are also happy to share that the Forest Machinery DLC will be receiving a free update with the release of Arkansas. With its many forestry and logging related industries, these companies often require lots of heavy duty equipment and vehicles, one of which we are excited to bring as a new cargo in this DLC!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3541f03d6babada59b0a8fa9d3c211595cc725da.jpg[/img]
Introducing the Forestry Skidder, a specialized machine used in logging operations to transport felled trees from the cutting site to a central location for processing or loading. It typically drags logs across the forest floor, either using a cable system or a grapple claw to secure the logs. Skidders are essential for efficiently moving timber, especially in rough or uneven terrain, and help streamline the process of harvesting trees in large-scale logging operations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b8110c13344203afcc335b1603b49ce3fa340cc7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/46a734773dc9f3786fbd855d7cf29938eab0bf1f.jpg[/img]

Including protective Ear Muffs, a mug and a road-sign themed hanging cabin item! We hope DLC owners enjoy hauling this heavy duty machine across Arkansas and beyond with this free update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/80248810b77d79a0e8dcfbffa61c2fe65291b063.jpg[/img]
If both the Arkansas DLC and the new Forest Machinery content takes your interest, consider purchasing our newest [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45098/Arkansaw_Bundle/]Arkan-saw bundle[/url] (get it?) which includes both the Arkansas DLC and the Forest Machinery DLC at a discounted price! It is the perfect bundle for truckers looking to get the fullest experience out of the Natural State.

This bundle operates on a "Complete the set" basis, ensuring you only pay for the DLCs that are not already in your library. Happy travels! 

[h3][b]Release Live Stream![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/cd1236c1c5c87d92351135826b61b7cb010ff78c.jpg[/img]

Can't wait to get trucking? Join Mark & Petr for the Arkansas DLC Release Live Stream! Also featured are special guests involved in the development of this new expansion. Don't miss out, tune in at our official Twitch or YouTube channels today from 4:00 PM CEST onwards. 

[h3][b]Cruising Arkansas Event[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/177a4e24b887bb4578ac24462b9d4b8ebcb9b77b.jpg[/img]

Excited to get driving? Don't forget, you can also join in on the #CruisingArkansas World of Trucks event, where you can earn unique in-game Arkansas themed rewards!  We are asking you, our #BestCommunityEver to help contribute and complete the community goal of driving 125,000,000 miles (201,168,000 km) while delivering cargo to or from any city in Arkansas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/298008204867df9f3eca42285fa0feb5aa3d37fc.jpg[/img]
Players who achieve their personal goal of delivering to or from 10 Arkansas cities will receive a lovely White-tailed Watch ATS truck paint job. If the community goal is reached, all players who have completed their personal goal will also receive a hanging Diamond Apple Blossom pendant for their cabin! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c506ef1de04ee976fee811d1bca8bf13a0159434.jpg[/img]
But that's not all! We also have another unique gift for you. If you take any External Contract or External Market job TO or FROM the city of Pine Bluff, you'll earn this adorable fluffy White-tailed Deer fawn plush for their truck cabin. We think it makes for the perfect mascot whilst trucking through the Natural state! 

If you'd like to learn more about this event, check out the dedicated blog here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5101c71d3695f31a30aba3547be0dc78d2d31231.jpg[/img]
We hope you enjoy cruising and discovering Arkansas! We cannot thank you enough for all your support leading upto to the release of this DLC. Our team would love to hear what you think of Arkansas, if you enjoyed it, please consider leaving a review on Steam! Until next time, keep on truckin'!
