notes.title: Nebraska - Cities
notes.content:
Today we're happy to share with you a preview into some of the cities you will be able to visit, and deliver cargo to in our upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543810/American_Truck_Simulator__Nebraska/]Nebraska DLC[/url] for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url]. Each one has their own unique character about them, which our team has worked hard to try best recreate in this map expansion. Let's take a look at some of them, shall we?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/86c66d373f0c970eae5fe9435e339cd44a3d5d66.jpg[/img]
[b][h3]Grand Island[/h3][/b]
Situated in the heart of the state, Grand Island is a vibrant city with a small town charm, home to a variety of cultures and backgrounds. Here you'll find a unique blend of urban amenities, including a marketplace where many folks from neighbouring States travel to visit. From its bustling downtown area filled with shops, restaurants, and cultural attractions to its picturesque parks and scenic riverfront, there is something for everyone here. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8ad323e4a8faaf8d4cf09d47f7a44bae63a8345f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8177844b9e65e6d27e29b7be5edfc532ade9bac0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/cfe65818a97750d814d0f48945be5d5ad6495f18.jpg[/img]
Why not take a moment to enjoy the scenery and check out Landmarks such as The Hall County Courthouse, City of Grand Island Townhall and more. You will be also able to visit one of the most famous Truck Stops around, best known for its unique displays featuring a racing car, a tank and more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4097c80f8bbd9315047f07e601bbddb1605a9f96.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6f0d28cffc625c30591c7cbf81d359c37be6d000.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1f31b2519e52568f323e4626f3c8b2c36bd0d333.jpg[/img]
Located in the State's Agriculture Region, Grand Island is also known for its fertile soil and production of crops such as corn, soybeans and wheat. Around the city, you'll find a variety of different industries, including a large Food Processing Plant which you'll be able delivery to and from.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/86ff4d6b50e604b21310730e51a22245c2027968.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/30ad29a4422ef31dbf41de082392ff1e3a86a4e7.jpg[/img]
Grand Island also has a history with Highways, being the second city in the United States to build a concrete roadway in 1915! With its proximity to the I-80, it surely is a must stop destination for any traveller young or old.

[b][h3]Norfolk[/h3][/b]
Located in Northeastern Nebraska, Norfolk as a hub for agriculture and manufacturing. One such depot you'll be able to deliver jobs to and from is the Nucor Steel factory, located North of the city. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/17e9fa7e35dec5226e6cd4e6858ec54dfa5c9c65.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/313eb835a96285446b6c73f710d39307f77d8c72.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/027fa3e9433d42d206ae37c70b1c759581bb1656.jpg[/img]
Here you can also find landmarks like the Elkhorn Valley Museum and the Memorial Park. Norfolk's welcoming atmosphere and diverse attractions make it an ideal stopover for truckers in the area. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e7d35d72e1d724e629b5375126f03533be963851.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3b1dd0d63999027cb264a930e53fd117b1e7de30.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0de69727b22ac8724cabfcf5ac5dcf0fc5a7e3dd.jpg[/img]
Don't forget to stop by the Karl Stefan Memorial Field Airport, named after a Karl Stefan who was originally born in the Czech Republic, who immigrated with his parents to Nebraska in 1885, and eventually moved to Norfolk in 1909. 

[b][h3]Columbus[/h3][/b]
Beckoning truckers with a unique mix of industry and charm, Columbus is known for its robust manufacturing and agricultural sectors. In the east of the city, you'll find a large ADM industrial zone, which is almost as big as another city! Here you'll be able to find several different depots to deliver to and from. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/04d30c238eeed6e099914f514deccc7a75ae84a5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/af11f80c0f562d53c3ab5ac626ffdcbbaca2cf80.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6ac887febbec11babd613077bbc01f10db416c63.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5d3a5dc8242904c911c0acbefa306d10f54e2953.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/01968dcaf53d725bc937bdee26747a006076f55e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f7407a89b375bf19f734f47ea087addf7ed7063d.jpg[/img]
On your travels, you'll surely come across the Platte river, which stretches for over 1,050 miles. Other notetable landmarks in the area include the War Memorial, which honours the men and women who gave their lives. 

[b][h3]North Platte [/h3][/b]
Located North of the River Platte near the I-80, this city is somewhat similar to Grand Island. Here you can find the the largest railroad classification yard in the world! If you want to learn specifically more about this industry, check out our recent [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/02/nebraska-rail-yards.html]blog here. [/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5cf6fde1302779325575a5652f60bf728c375411.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7fe9f8dfb59578094f740a197acd6809b95b47fe.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bd8a5385dd933080ae8225b84ace509e27f6363c.jpg[/img]
This city is surrounded by fields, used for agriculture of all kinds. You may even spot quite a few Sandhills on your travels, a region of grass-covered, stabilized sand dunes in the High Plains. They really are quite unique, and make for a certainly interesting drive through the area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/38dce883d45512bfb2071e338f56901d20fe7043.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/26251bdb8444ad991aaa8de74210dc314fa9f3c8.jpg[/img]
There will also be plenty of Landmarks to discover, from memorials to several significant buildings in the city. Be sure to look out for them! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/08b0c4828a41ce0c4e031c0844e1302c14d187ad.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/333ea732eb09d0f50fbed761ee0f81c4f1874ff3.jpg[/img]
Our teams hope they have been able to capture the spirit and charm of each city represented here. We hope that you'll take the time to check out all the cities of Nebraska when it is made available to you. We look forward to sharing more on the development of this DLC for American Truck Simulator, in the mean time, if you like what you see, be sure to add Nebraska to your Steam Wishlist! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543810/American_Truck_Simulator__Nebraska/

notes.title: Haulin' Hearts Event Conclusion
notes.content:
Over the past couple of weeks, we have certainly felt the devotion of our community, who has been 'Haulin' Hearts' across Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator. Whilst this event has quickly come to an end, we can still strongly feel the love in the air!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/5b93f5fc7d3d1cfacf326f5a9043faa6cb199b30.jpg[/img]

We'd like to thank everyone who took part and helped deliver an incredible 600,000 loads of Valentine Presents cargo across our trucking territories. It was great to receive so many screenshots and videos from all of you enjoying this event across our Social Media Pages. We hope that during this time, you were able to share your love of trucking with a friend or perhaps someone closer. 

So without further ado, let's take a look at some of the statistics from the event. You managed to complete the Community Goal on the 14th of February (which we think you planned..), and in total completed 922,487 jobs by the event's end! Check out our official infographics below. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/09edf0d8a9e694ccc114acbc3ded13ce9d11d0ca.jpg[/img]

Seeing so many of you take part in this event brought a lot of joy to our World of Trucks team, who worked hard to bring this event to life so quickly after the end of the previous ones. We'd like to thank all the teams involved for their dedication, beautiful artwork and rewards, which we hope you enjoyed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/e052797d11eb3a748c7271ef9e1036360fea4e77.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/2de5c99935d131b9361c0833f4ee9afbfb451073.jpg[/img]

If you did manage to complete your personal goal in-time, be sure to collect your rewards via the World of Trucks website, under the 'Events' tab on your page. However, the love doesn't have to stop there! You can continue to haul with hearts any time you like with our Valentines Paint Job Packs for both ETS2 and ATS. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/87ef38a08a7b72ad74a6e095b21bf9b2ee065ec7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/bb55ef5799951a5fa9217c93716c445734a5f36a.jpg[/img]

Once again, we are grateful for all your effort and the love you showed us during this event. We really hope you enjoyed it and we look forward to showcasing our next event to you in the future. Until then, remember love isn't just for Valentine's, but for anytime of the year. Happy Truckin'!

notes.title: California Rework - Yosemite National Park
notes.content:
The U.S State of California has a long history when it comes to the conservation efforts of preserving its natural heritage, so much so that it boasts having nine National Parks, more than any other state! In today's blog, we will be focusing on one such National Park you'll have the chance to re-visit as part of our California Rework project for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3a8a2f713d5b3a8e71ddffdd672616faed25eb0c.jpg[/img]
Nestled within the rugged Sierra Nevada Mountains of California,the Yosemite National Park features awe-inspiring granite peaks, majestic waterfalls, and pristine wilderness. Whilst this is not normally an area where trucks are allowed to travel through, we couldn't go without reworking this area from the ground up to bring it up to our current quality standards. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d57787cde8026d5fec98714a95d4c4be81b29eff.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f00548c35a810324c12013423b2685444ccf7e70.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b35c1534bfb982da188c507c7bdf2391bd46b92a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/019bca90aadc560513737cdaefeeda3f18107247.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/0711affbf00e266d836cc81a17793e4c9f0d7232.jpg[/img]
One stand-out feature you'll be sure to notice is the new models of granite rock which are mainly found here. These new models and assets combined give the Yosemite National Park quite the transformation, don't you think? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/30966234c5fb36d4f858316a0577f319546477e1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9c2e23eabfe8ef834a4f4da819707f63f065fdbf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e909125396352943171fcbd4ca411f0eda0bc70c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/72d22ed756ce1e9434a2c0974bc76ad128bb2213.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8e33a861b15640f66801d1ad349cc54494a93193.jpg[/img]
You'll be able to drive through CA-120 from Modesto to Lee Vining, which offers drivers some pretty breathtaking views of the natural beauty found across Yosemite National Park. We highly recommend taking a stop at some of the lookout points you'll find in the area including Olmsted point, Lake Vista Point or the Rainbow Pool Day Use Area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9c035b146e9b860c0c6c2927488ba69375d4912f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4011d5093f8e5b571d42cc70be82cce8a192ca4c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e71ab2fb654cdef99b00d5dc6d8c3ae91e0c269d.jpg[/img]
Looking to visit the Yosemite National Park? Previously, this area was not on your GPS map. With a fresh rework, comes a requested change; we are pleased to share that with Phase 3 of the California Rework, you will now be able to find this National Park (like others) on your UI map! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5589234ea76cc23ac810a245f1be11140bb5c49e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/82ada542c12c05d2b5d9c6dd1056262a7e87dc28.jpg[/img]
If you're travelling from Modesto, drivers can enter the Yosemite National Park at the Big Oak Flat entrance which features an information station. If you're looking to visit from the direction of Lee Vining, you can enter at the Tioga Pass Entrance, a high-altitude entrance point to Yosemite!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6dbd3870fda1ea824f3da22f97481819f6022b70.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d997f6085cdd2c7752b8ca9ffc5aec3be1588bae.jpg[/img]
While you may be familiar this area already, we look forward to you re-discovering the Yosemite National Park, along with other parts of California in Phase 3 of our rework in the future. We look forward to sharing more new with you on it's progress here on our blog. Until then, keep on truckin'.

notes.title: Nebraska - Rail Yards
notes.content:
Whilst truck drivers play a pivotal role in the movement of goods across America, they are often a part of a bigger process, usually involving multiple modes of transport. One such network that is prevalent across the States is the railroad network, spanning thousands of miles across the country. In our upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543810/American_Truck_Simulator__Nebraska/]Nebraska DLC for American Truck Simulator[/url], you'll find more than just train tracks! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9ce84ceb2c987cbe2cce7d176e247551e93d47c0.jpg[/img]
Nebraska is home to a lot of history, including The Oregon Trail, a historic route that played a pivotal role in the westward expansion of the United States during the 19th century. While Nebraska wasn't the longest stretch of the trail, it held significant importance as a passage through the Great Plains. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bd660c8044bad12c195c53e9e57cd09850381e2d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/301927d189e15c0fa2531ec90311343fb379ce20.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3abd2a600fbf0d2b43c0b4d25eec0113b487a432.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/72916eec83804ea1e76c066a7dacbe81d53aa2bd.jpg[/img]
Our team has re-created some of the landmarks and historical signage, offering information and education about those who travelled across the trail, which can be found on roadsides near the original trail's route. Be sure to look out for them whilst you travel across Nebraska! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b108484b4ec851eeef436705f7ab3b1f8682db22.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b7075e8f330f032977c035e1f4e175bd9dabba04.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/848bcdfe0dc873b76f8738e6a991fa3bb8aecf8e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c785e6a0df6ba4957b380a3299d46cbda0a3d895.jpg[/img]
Let's get back on track by introducing you to some of the train yards and railroads you'll find across the state. Nebraska is a crucial part of the USA's rail network, so much so that you'll find yourself driving alongside trains a lot of the time! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/99b2cf6d78c8cdbe80e2b6bf1dedb8b4bf8b62ec.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/00f3ee2838236e22e996b55ea9a92659860c839a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a87dc24eafacbcb1f23a2c16b781ad056513ec63.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9ba4db7a29502d1fe0a06ea3788898858e4b3fe9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/009642dbcbc980d342fb5c040173160749bbe5d9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2164c8e818b9cafec6c82d24c0c6b1ec8378c869.jpg[/img]
With all these trains on the tracks, where do they go when they need a rest or maintenance? The Train Yard of course, in which Nebraska is home to the world's largest! Better known as 'Baily Yard' located in North Platte, this impressive area handles 10,000 railroad cars every 24 hours. You may even be able to spot the famous 'Golden Spike Tower' which hosts a visitor centre and offers unique views to tourists. Our team continues to work hard on this unique industry. As you can imagine, there are a lot of details to try squeeze in and replicate! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e8bfff0de896e02f692aebb2c11bb37b35045a67.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ca90b7c5d3121295f44e1330eb22ee530b31dc7f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/18a31be15119a5f71952ca8dc7c78b0f7f40aaf9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/dd6ee82f0f2703a24f76441a383ca470ea386e92.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1886d861de4fdbd76667cf8f67fbcf8221576ce5.jpg[/img]
You will also find many other smaller Train Yards across Nebraska, some of which you'll be able to deliver cargo to in cities such as Alliance, Omaha and North Platte. We hope that you will appreciate the work and scale of representing this Intermodal Industry in this upcoming DLC. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/11ee34a875d5a11bf37f4ac70091a834385d2046.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3dc16dc5e622ae6db5b7cb044d8c3bb33f9d139c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1bd24f561780d85d9ebe90fbc9d4341c658b3482.jpg[/img]
All aboard for Nebraska! Excited to make your travels to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543810/American_Truck_Simulator__Nebraska/]Nebraska in American Truck Simulator[/url]? Stay on track with the latest news on our Social Media Channels ([url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url]) and be sure to Add the Nebraska DLC to your Steam Wishlist. Until next time, keep on truckin'.

notes.title: Under the Hood - Kenworth T680 Signature Edition
notes.content:
In December 2023, the Kenworth T680 100 Years Anniversary Edition was launched for American Truck Simulator. Seizing this moment, we engaged in a conversation with the developers responsible for the truck's design. In our latest 'Under The Hood' blog, we had the chance to chat with Daniel and Renju, key contributors to bringing this exceptional truck to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/37abe5278d46b40d65833c71984b4027d7d05f3f.jpg[/img]
The special edition Kenworth T680 100 Years Anniversary Edition showcases a range of premium features including an onyx-finished grill, a luxurious interior with red accents, advanced safety features, and enhanced aerodynamics. It represents Kenworth's century-long commitment to excellence and innovation in truck design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/bf915c1c05381068eb951a033468c635c4fce649.jpg[/img]
[i]Daniel - 3D Graphic Designer[/i]

"The project officially began in November 2022 with a visit to the Paccar facility center in Mount Vernon, WA, where we gathered photographic evidence for textures and photoreconstruction. My main role in this project was producing the truck's exterior model and project coordination, because there were many more vehicle artists involved in the final stages of the project. Renju started working on the truck's interior in February 2023, while the exterior development began in August 2023, just four months before the planned release. Effective coordination was crucial to ensure timely completion of all components," says Daniel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e8ee2871ca2899776e2f123ee9de5fdaea51cbf9.jpg[/img]
[i]Renju - Senior Game Artist[/i]

Designing this truck was not an easy mission. It had to be in-game by the end of 2023. "Meeting the project deadline was tough, even though work on the interior started ahead, the work on the exterior were delayed due to commitments on another project. We had to split tasks and coordinate carefully to ensure a smooth finish. Despite the challenges, I'm pleased with the outcome, and hope it brought joy to our players," Daniel told us.

"Kenworth celebrated its 100th anniversary and that's why it was planned to release the T680 100 Years Anniversary Edition by the end of 2023. As I began working on the project in February 2023, I had enough time to prepare everything in advance. We were meticulous in our approach to ensure the truck looked its absolute best," says Renju. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b8624a756f0f9e0f2c0b1f0beb30a7b213f66891.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f5c23f255b4db4b254ec4df62273b7a51e03dee6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d20feea4f6555a799ab3393cbab5146c47c89822.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/37294c7c865b78f4ffac83a85ca7e68c36a204ce.jpg[/img]
Adding anything new into our games is a long process that requires a lot of preparation, as Daniel explains here: "Project work always begins with thorough background research. Initially, we photographed a real vehicle to gather essential texture and photogrammetric data. Thanks to the excellent cooperation with Kenworth, we also obtained CAD files, ensuring maximum accuracy in transferring the truck to our game's 3D model. CAD data are basically 3D blueprints for vehicle manufacturing, so despite it being a full 3D model, it cannot be used in the game due to its complexity, so we needed to recreate the whole model from scratch using CADs only as a reference, keeping in mind the best possible optimization of model. When CAD data weren't available for specific parts, we used data taken from photogrammetry instead."

"The bulk of the work involves 3D modeling based on this data, which is the most time-consuming phase. Following modeling, we apply materials and textures and then perform UV mapping to ensure proper texture display. Finalization entails assembling all models and structuring them into a cohesive scene for export into the game. This phase includes creating files defining truck part parameters and their in-game economic values. Lastly, the finished model undergoes testing in collaboration with the testing department."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/0811b2a50092a389cd344cc77842aeaa6ab0d5f0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6137bbe4240a3138e83444b194845471fe632a0e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/58833d8eb7ad223d003f04258d095583eae565d1.jpg[/img]
Of course, this whole project couldn't exist without the great collaboration with Kenworth, which the designers working on this truck praised. "The data provided by Kenworth was excellent. We received all the necessary references from them, and the entire process went smoothly," says Renju.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/01b1ab05df4d668a330ecdce90743bafc27caab5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ae1303eef5c4b456ecbd26322eca20c1cc6e1ddb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/802a652d95947c1d0114699c1a15b52592a3c9dc.jpg[/img]
As was already said above, Renju focused on the interior of the truck and Daniel led the work on the exterior. What did they enjoy the most? "Working on both the dashboard and seats was a delightful experience. The final product exceeded my expectations, and I am incredibly proud of it," Renju told us.

"This truck was a very interesting diversion, as I don't get to model such large projects from start to finish as much in recent years due to my other responsibilities. And due to the impressive and modern design of the T680, I was able to enjoy the work and especially the modeling part again after many years," says Daniel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a6c164b11387b502d42b97734e97c7a8d965d30f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6554b8f84f652095c78572241ab5920fef54db65.jpg[/img]
And what do the guys behind this truck think of it?  Daniel told us: "I think the new T680 is really good. It is a beautiful example of modern aerodynamic yet sharply cut curves. The truck was a joy to model."

Renju agreed: "What a beautiful truck! I absolutely love its modern, aerodynamic design, and the interior looks amazing, especially the new digital dashboard."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/032a839b993689d5ece3d671fb8da6e78cc720aa.jpg[/img]
Daniel also shared about the future of this truck and its upcoming configurations. "The special edition release marks the start, not the end of our efforts. It was a celebration of Kenworth's 100th anniversary. We've finished interior designs for the other selected cabs, and exterior work is progressing well. The truck will offer standard cab and chassis options, along with familiar accessories for our players. Plus, it'll be fully compatible with all our Paintjob Packs."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b74bd09f0b4eedfd3ef0c52fe7275a057c9ff562.jpg[/img]
[i]mr.cenda - Multimedia Specialist[/i]

A big chunk of work was also done by mr.cenda who made a beautiful trailer for this truck to present it to our #BestCommunityEver. This also required a lot of background research and effort. "It was an honor and a pleasure to participate in this great project. I was fortunate enough to meet the folks from Kenworth at the Truck World event in 2023. To understand their concept, to touch the truck itself, it was a huge benefit for the final video."

"I needed to put as much information as possible into the footage, which is like a minute long, to generate the right excitement. Every detail alone tells you the love that was put into the production. I trust that players enjoy driving this Kenworth in our virtual world."

[previewyoutube=MqxUotz2QoE;full][/previewyoutube]
We hope you've enjoyed a look under the hood of designing the Anniversary Edition of the Kenworth T680. Don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url] so you won't miss out on news about our projects.

notes.title: Arkansas - Weigh Stations, Rest Areas & Welcome Centre
notes.content:
If you're travelling from afar, the first thing that may come to your mind after a long journey may be to take a well deserved rest, or perhaps a quick stop at a Welcome Center to find out what's on offer in the area. Like many other states, our upcoming Arkansas DLC for American Truck Simulator will feature both of these, welcoming in travellers from across the USA! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8a6e3fe2e834a62a01aa1a27384e135c2820363e.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Welcome Center[/b][/h3]

On your journey into Arkansas, you'll be able to discover two Welcome Centers, both designed for visitors and truckers alike. The first being on the border close to Louisiana, where you'll find a variety of parking spots, a resting area for truckers, dedicated covered picnic tables and of course, the main welcome center itself which features the state's name and official nickname, built from locally sourced native stone! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e5d32bf703a5b09dec6a2ca7263450841a51a441.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e5bb2f43263bb8e33fdbddd7cbed08d453451fae.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9f78341065a2d6155406bcdd50e885ad3a0dd0f8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/dfec4223036177d6281640184650850e0442862e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/39d5762900e8727e5eecc1cdde22e20cfb089ee2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c2c942008fa3238faa737341267e7ca616755ea9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/59cf97868727b2f0162edfebfcfc89325a0599a6.jpg[/img]
You'll find the second Welcome Center on the border with Texas on US-71, and while it features a similar design, it features a larger layout, parking and rest area. The design of the main building itself received a significant upgrade in 2017, increasing its size due to its popularity and proximity to the state line. 

[h3][b]Rest Areas[/b][/h3]

Taking regular rest breaks is vital for drivers to combat fatigue and maintain their alertness while driving long distances. While it is required for drivers to stop for at least a 30 minute break, feel free to pull in for a rest at one of Arkansas' Rest Areas whenever you like! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/eebe45d4360fd5e2056887e9b8a4d461f57507f6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/376222f07f3178adcf0fce9f596d01448c35eb8a.jpg[/img]
One such rest area you will find is the White River Rest Area, situated nearby the picturesque White River. This rest area beckons weary travellers with its tranquil ambiance and scenic vistas.

[h3][b]Weigh Stations[/b][/h3]

Whilst Welcome Centers and Rest Areas are not necessary stops on one's journey, you may be legally required to pull into a Weigh Station. Their purpose is to ensure heavy vehicles comply with state weight regulations, whilst promoting road safety and preventing damage to infrastructure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2a8a8191eae5a536d8bbf8cd8e4d1d1aa368d700.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f07825092b76470d603fb4cbd4fc8681165426a8.jpg[/img]
Make sure to pull in if you hear your weigh station alarm activate, failing to comply may result in a hefty fine! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e6bec88006ae134c15a9de8536d0cf99767da067.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4a89b06c3ae09dafa6b8d4a2859e3f58ad166c9e.jpg[/img]
With all these options to stop, we aren't slowing down our work on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2585150/American_Truck_Simulator__Arkansas/]Arkansas DLC[/url]. If you are excited about this upcoming state coming to American Truck Simulator, make sure to add it your Steam Wishlist! Until next time, keep on truckin'. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2585150/American_Truck_Simulator__Arkansas/

notes.title: Haulin' Hearts Online Event
notes.content:
Join us as we celebrate Valentines day by taking part in our latest [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url] event – [b]Haulin’ Hearts[/b]!

[previewyoutube=34vUacxAKVg;full][/previewyoutube]
Since the 14th Century Valentine’s Day has been recognised as a time to embrace the chance to give something special to those we hold dear in our hearts, whether it be a letter of love, a heartfelt poem or gift, and today is no different. With all the love on offer, there is plenty miles to cover and loads of Valentines Presents to deliver this year, and every bit helps.

 Today I’m Haulin’ Hearts afar,
    With nothing else in mind.
        And to this task I pledge my word
            For everyone in kind.

                And while I’m on the road out there
                    With fourteen loads ahead,
                        I’ll stop at nothing ‘til I’m done,
                            Then rest my weary head.

                                But not before I’m in your arms
                                    Oh darling love of mine.
                                        For one and all and all for one,
                                            And you my Valentine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c74f73270835f4d76ca3ccce146c5194bb0fdf7b.jpg[/img]

So we invite you, our [b]#BestCommunityEver[/b], whether you have a special sweetheart of your own or simply want to help others connect during this romantic time, to complete the community goal of [b]600,000 deliveries[/b] of Valentines Presents to loved ones around the world! Our special Valentines themed event trailers are all loaded up and ready to roll for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e052797d11eb3a748c7271ef9e1036360fea4e77.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/53e3adae149734c88cca3355cfbfdb49abc1edca.jpg[/img]
This is, once again, a great chance for you to create a romantic matching paint job with your truck if you happen to own the Valentine's Paint Jobs Pack DLC for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/588600/American_Truck_Simulator__Valentines_Paint_Jobs_Pack/]ATS[/url]!

Your personal goal requires [b]14 deliveries[/b] of Valentines Presents cargo, and as our thank you we are offering great rewards including  a special World of Trucks Achievement. So, come along and join the fun!

[h3]Rules[/h3]

Using External Contracts, with a [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url]-connected profile in Euro Truck Simulator 2, American Truck Simulator or both, the community goal is to achieve 600,000 deliveries of Valentine Presents cargo, from any city in any trucking territory.

When a player completes 14 deliveries of Valentine Presents cargo across any trucking territories in either game, it will complete their personal goal.

[h3]Rewards[/h3]

[list]
[*] Personal: Players that complete 14 or more deliveries of Valentine Presents cargo will gain a unique [b]World of Trucks Achievement[/b] as well as a [b]Winged Heart[/b] cabin item as a Steam inventory item for Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e83f5cebcdb6dc3a2bff891ada3cfc0470d77133.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Community: When the community goal of achieving 600,000 deliveries of Valentine Presents cargo from any city is met and if the player has also achieved their personal goal, then they will receive a [b]Trucker's Rose[/b] hanging item as a Steam inventory item for their cabin.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c0d2ccb98d6aeee13a1e72cb6d0711ecb5249c7a.jpg[/img]
[b]Note:[/b] In order to qualify for any community reward, you must complete at least your personal goal in Euro Truck Simulator 2, American Truck Simulator or both. Each reward will be a Steam inventory item for both Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator. Once completed, claim your reward in the Events page on your [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url] profile.

The event will be concluded on [b]Sunday the 18th of February at 23:59 UTC[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/df3f07e553e298821d41656a0acf37d3bfaf66db.jpg[/img]

In celebration of this event, we are introducing the Haulin' Hearts Bundle on Steam! If you are an owner of only American Truck Simulator or Euro Truck Simulator 2, this bundle will offer you a chance to fall in love with the title you are missing out on along with exploring the roads in special Valentine-themed paint jobs. Or perhaps, in case you are already having a good time in both of the games and you’re starting to feel a bit lonely, you can always gift the bundle to the special someone and set out on a journey together in the multiplayer Convoy mode.

notes.title: Beware: Wild Speculations
notes.content:
We hope this message finds you well and filled with excitement for all the incredible things happening in the world of SCS Software! Recently, we've noticed a significant increase in discussions across various platforms – social media, forums, YouTube, and more – speculating on our current and future projects as well as updates in development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4547d12b4747a48453030fc8a06734b1c1fe3171.jpg[/img]
First and foremost, we are grateful for the enthusiasm and genuine interest our community displays in everything we do. Your passion is what makes our community the #BestCommunityEver, and we're truly grateful for your unwavering support!

However, we'd like to take a moment to address a small concern. With the growing amount of content circulating online, it's becoming increasingly important to distinguish between official information and speculation. We understand that excitement often leads to curiosity, and we love that! But to ensure you get the most accurate and reliable news, we encourage you to follow our official communication channels ([url=https://blog.scssoft.com/]Our blog[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]SCS Software Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/eurotrucksimulator2/]ETS2 Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs]ATS Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@SCSSoftware/]YouTube[/url], [url=https://www.threads.net/@scs.software]Threads[/url], and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url]).

In this era of advanced technology, AI and voice-over applications, where creating believable fake news is becoming easier, we want to be proactive in ensuring that our community is well-informed. We may not always be able to react to every piece of misinformation or wild speculation. Following our verified communication channels is your guarantee to receive genuine information.

Your trust means the world to us, and we want to make sure you have the facts. So, join us on this journey – follow our official channels, be a part of the conversation, and let's continue making our community the #BestCommunityEver! Thank you for being amazing, and here's to the exciting adventures ahead!

notes.title: California Rework - The Golden State #3
notes.content:
Today we are happy to be celebrating American Truck Simulator's 8th Anniversary! Since its release in 2016, we've come a long way in providing so much new content and so many free updates. One such project we've been continually working on is our California Rework, which sees the one of the first U.S. states to be released with our base game, being rebuilt from the ground up by our talented team and brought upto todays map quality standard. Once complete, it will be released as a free update for all current and future owners of American Truck Simulator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ed65f803c66fcd0e631c2cd7c7fe222dbc25ef12.jpg[/img]

This blog serves as a part 3 on 'The Golden State', so we recommend taking a read of our previous [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/04/california-rework-golden-state-1.html]Part 1[/url] and [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/10/california-rework-golden-state-2.html]Part 2[/url] blogs, if you haven't already! 

[h3][b]CA-1[/b][/h3]

Our team has been continuing their work on the legendary CA-1/US-1 Coastline Scenic Route, which is being reworked completely from the ground up. This time, the team is focusing their efforts recreating the highway between Santa Cruz and San Luis Obispo. Along this part of the CA-1, you will pass through famous coastline areas such as Big Sur, San Carpoforo Creek and Willow Creek.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f8651e3d5e85b919c78e2d28e1b987547f779d40.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/33da82070eaf71408a69cfdcceaaa10a237b3bdd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0520b384f4467f031003dbf3f69c57b971218665.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/620701beb1366541bf5803334465dcb9a86220e1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a99714cf6d0ba94cd5ddf68de798c3401998fba6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fcac7d62e0cac0bbd1e8fa111ce310526280f97a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c4ef3795b25067be9a9f7e7aa7ac88f57e2d0b8f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/01b3d6826d1486c6523a3335efaffa0d513bd697.jpg[/img]
As you may know, this highway is incredibly scenic and will feature many bridges and creeks which lead onto the beautiful California coastline. It is a must-drive for any American road-tripper.. or trucker! 

[h3][b]I-5[/b][/h3]

We've also been working on part of the I-5, running between the south of Huron to Bakersfield. Along this route you'll find a mix of scenic landscapes, landmarks, and points of interest, making it a notable route for travellers. This segment of I-5 also traverses the San Joaquin Valley, which is also known for its agricultural richness and diverse scenery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/00067277a0ee247372691f054895e69668a54351.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/291de15921c3211c717d7af2c825b613989a2d0b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/897a44331804ca807c6d623f20151d86b509795a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/650784a26cecc97a7d48f3f96d1b30c4da2be090.jpg[/img]
You'll be sure to find scenic landscapes and a typical Californian climate environment when travelling on this part of the Interstate! 

[h3][b]US-99[/b][/h3]

The historic US-99, also known as the Golden State Highway, is also another route our team has been focusing on during this phase of the rework. Meandering through a diverse California landscape, the US-99 showcases the state's natural beauty. The highway will also take you past charming towns and cities, each with its unique character and landmarks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4903c338f41c2da005f87080bd70b479276207a1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/69039386d9ba73ae543b9c0d3c5f7872ce50674b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3454787bb1a72f5c7ec4b355c48a2e8a5928504e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4b5b9a0d24c562cb7dcb82b759a6e70eb73f84af.jpg[/img]
The route also offers glimpses of California's cultural and agricultural heritage, making it a delightful journey for those seeking the state's nostalgic charm.

[h3][b]Can you guess where these were taken?[/b][/h3]

The team has been kind enough to provide us with quite a few images from their progress of reworking California. So we decided it would be fun for you to guess the location of these screenshots! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/934ab8c2b7c6a9005d79cb75cda8f17a1804acac.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a6c1ebbf0592fde15ea34f31c2f25447d85e63ee.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/86823d95996f31fb3e3e8c0316d8ff84828e4666.jpg[/img]

Think you know? Share the answers with us in the blog comments below! We look forward to sharing more of the work taking place in this phase of our the California Rework for American Truck Simulator. Until then, keep on truckin'

notes.title: Nebraska - Scenic Towns
notes.content:
Embarking on a virtual journey in the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543810/American_Truck_Simulator__Nebraska/]Nebraska DLC[/url] promises not just highways and byways but a scenic exploration of charming towns. Uncover hidden gems as you navigate the picturesque landscapes of the Cornhusker State. Let's take a look at some of the towns you will drive through on your way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4449712e05403a2176e4dcfb7568eca0f9bb9bdc.jpg[/img]
[b]Alma[/b], a picturesque town, sits nestled along the Republican River. It's a small town that greets players upon arrival from Kansas. It's home to the great Harlan County Lake and also some nice historic sites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b007cf3f71446c6b0b68bf17c455602276617694.jpg[/img]
[b]Ansley[/b], another delightful destination, welcomes truckers with its small-town charm. Surrounded by the stunning Nebraska landscape, it offers a refreshing break from the open road. Ansley, like Basset, is on Route US-183 and that opens up an opportunity for us in the future to consider some other important roads in Nebraska.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/0742a47d670d36a6336a6540b32ef7bc6bd9b97b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d4f710d6eb707149464b401ad654350f89c6cb1f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/59a89798b6db0e6f73281f6c53bf7e10fc646e6c.jpg[/img]
[b]Auburn[/b], with its vibrant atmosphere, showcases the heartland spirit. As players roll through its streets, they'll encounter a blend of modern amenities and classic Midwestern warmth. You can find several colorful Honeybee sculptures there which is an unmissable landmark.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a2c49610e856e0874e7d9e4117268973bc730f13.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/83007eb98d20f99cc0678186aa36018f7ef87b28.jpg[/img]
Explore the charm of [b]Bartlett[/b], a quaint town that invites truckers to wander its peaceful streets. With its small-town atmosphere, Bartlett offers a scenic break from the open road.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/0e673bec81ce1f61294341cbc4b619a53ddd5462.jpg[/img]
As you cruise through [b]Bassett[/b], revel in the beauty of its wide-open spaces and take a moment to appreciate the simplicity of rural life. This town, surrounded by the picturesque Nebraska landscape, promises a peaceful driving experience that encapsulates the heartland spirit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/def0d6977d36a82a9688ca3caa2c1bcfff6ea6b2.jpg[/img]
[b]Beatrice[/b], a town with a rich history, invites players to discover its unique blend of the past and present. From historic architecture to modern buildings, Beatrice provides a delightful mix for those looking to immerse themselves in the region's diverse culture. We hope truckers will appreciate plenty of historic landmarks typical for this town, especially some of its beautiful churches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5d48cf963f071df73c7658a9f5dee6136391fb8d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/88af2cd11ba93cce5d31c16c44231ffef7ce8c41.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6bb3db48455154182ae147ebafccf59a939668fa.jpg[/img]
When you go to [b]Brownville[/b], you can't miss the iconic scenic river views. Thanks to its close proximity to the Missouri River, truckers can travel there to take a look at the dredging boat. This settlement could also serve as one of the entrances to the state of Missouri in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/87f8f19f1a3deea27bacab013fc833d627e09cf2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3c69834953ed616e66aba5fa599b51087e211231.jpg[/img]
Nestled in the Sandhills along Nebraska's Highway 2, [b]Hyannis[/b] boasts serene landscapes and occasional lakes, offering truckers a peaceful respite to enjoy the beauty and unwind from the highway.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f9e966d67c1ede4e0eb80de855e5f14f55849e63.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/44f72d0f09b6405b462a0ecbc2eaa99ef0ae726f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/369c4f6a8465a63aeef7b9bf3b0837c541ca26d0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f62707e42bfaa3abc658e8cfb9afa33ceb4b12d0.jpg[/img]
As the Irish capital of Nebraska, [b]O'Neill[/b] proudly showcases its Irish identity at every turn. Green shamrocks adorn the ground and walls, while signs and landmarks paying homage to Irish culture are abound, creating a distinctive and vibrant atmosphere as you drive through.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2ab94957f1b9442265dd63819e17376b8a792d42.jpg[/img]
[b]Ogallala[/b], situated on the edge of the Sandhills, offers a unique blend of history and natural beauty. The nearby Lake McConaughy adds to the allure, creating a lovely setting that captures the essence of Ogallala's colorful past.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b818e05af8ffb9978da241de04614539e37b2b33.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c06c2b8e8d80c61757cc19218e6d2e14fe5ea9ff.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ea20b24906661aa13d9b14923655087b73f3858c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4052e1025e3f5ebef3ee6f9c84b515014726f058.jpg[/img]
[b]Red Cloud[/b], the birthplace of renowned author Willa Cather, invites players to discover its literary heritage and explore the town that inspired some of Cather's most beloved works. Drive through the streets that echo with history and experience the connection between literature and the Nebraskan landscape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/7264b21534fc71b4c97bb5365eb082833f8dd1c5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2ca8fb9ba87bb0070e8fafe31f4c19c739875a6c.jpg[/img]
Situated along the same route as Hyannis, [b]Thedford[/b] bears the imprints of its fascinating past. Established as a crucial stop along the cattle-driving trail during the late 19th century, the town's roots are deeply intertwined with the Old West. Today, Thedford presents its Western heritage through well-preserved landmarks and remnants of structures that echo the town's pioneer spirit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f2f1b2f0abf67e2a82d9aaec5c81485dc01acae7.jpg[/img]
[b]Lusk[/b], Wyoming, joins the American Truck Simulator map as a crucial connecting point to Nebraska. This quaint town, set against Wyoming's picturesque backdrop, serves as a gateway between the two states. Explore Lusk's charm, from its small-town hospitality to the vast landscapes, as it becomes a notable addition to the Wyoming experience with the release of the Nebraska DLC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b2c4872e96a9fff4cf7e320b961c31a4b0bb827c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b563cb6d685c4d8d0ffc93547c4a556f9e61e007.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9af2f00a83e64ffbf1e05bfc2a136936b0f15d97.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/065d6d5c8997e19a970b02c9a01d2db50bbb0dd7.jpg[/img]
Keep in mind that the photos you see here are still a work in progress. We hope you are excited to see the whole map once it's released. Don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url] so you won't miss out on any news about the Nebraska DLC or other projects. And if you haven't already, make sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543810/American_Truck_Simulator__Nebraska/#game_area_purchase]add the Nebraska DLC to your Steam Wishlist[/url]. We'll see you on the road!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543810/American_Truck_Simulator__Nebraska/

notes.title: Missouri - Meet the Team
notes.content:
Not so long ago, we announced a new DLC coming to American Truck Simulator, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730870/American_Truck_Simulator__Missouri/]Missouri[/url] map expansion. Now seems like the right time to present the heroes working hard to deliver the DLC to our #BestCommunityEver as soon as possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/676e35593bd54d9e1b640c9c04226639c4050807.jpg[/img]
We trust you'll appreciate this showcase of the SCS map designers and DLC asset lead currently involved in the Missouri DLC and their brief messages to the #BestCommunityEver.

[h3]Patrik[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/fdbc48e3aab1a8d75c580775fb53704dbd19a57a.jpg[/img]
[i]Immediately after the research was done, it was obvious that Missouri is an interesting state with many things to offer for our game. As a leader and recent visitor to Missouri, I'm keen to deliver a beautiful DLC full of foresty nature, hills, nice views, and interesting cities. We are finally near the Mississippi River which was always a big milestone for me. 

So far we are trying to come up with ideas on how to squeeze so much beauty into our scale and not omit anything important. I watch forum discussions pretty often to see what players expect and I try to find optimal solutions with others. We try our best, Missouri deserves it.[/i]

[h3]Pavel[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d4755168799bfa8d8967c4e68ceccfd3c2f5f9d3.jpg[/img]
[i]It's been three years since I started working at SCS Software as a map designer. Today, I'm facing the biggest challenge of my career. St. Louis, which is a really big city. However, I've grown to love it because I've been there in real life and I've seen everything I'm creating with my own eyes. What I enjoy most is the technical side of the work and the ability to go deep into the engine, get to its limits, and pass on the experience to new colleagues. I enjoy cities and truckstops the most because they are technically challenging tasks.[/i]

[h3]Lukáš[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ad112b995b4dddd23fe565dc161564d0ad595f38.jpg[/img]
[i]My journey in SCS Software began during the Colorado DLC, where I experimented with my first country roads and small cities. Since then, I've been a part of the Texas and Kansas map teams. I'm always seeking new challenges. Right after Amarillo, Corpus Christi, and some parts of Houston, it was Kansas City that I enjoyed the most so far. In the upcoming Missouri DLC, I'll be working on something unique in terms of custom depots which you can look forward to![/i]

[h3]Dubak[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1bf49ee9003cd3355d7646e94f6c6b80f7e76922.jpg[/img]
[i]I have been working for the company for six years and every year the work gets more interesting. I worked on the Oregon, Washington, Colorado, Texas, and Kansas DLCs where I focused more on cities and depots. In Missouri, I will be working on Springfield, where you can look forward to many interesting areas.[/i]

[h3]Jakub[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f6d789496f17cfbec4c5b9f2f3ca56fd3585d646.jpg[/img]
[i]After Kansas, the Missouri DLC is my second project as a map designer in SCS. Although now I feel much more comfortable in the process of creating an interesting environment for the player, I am still trying to challenge myself and push the boundaries of what is possible to achieve. In Missouri, I really hope that I can capture the spirit of US-36 and the city of Saint Joseph, and bring you the hidden beauty of these inconspicuous places in a way that will do them the justice they deserve.[/i]

[h3]El[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/87bb656ecb59459d9858f82defc322fd904bbee4.jpg[/img]
[i]It's been a little over 4 years since I joined SCS as a map designer back in 2019. My main responsibility for Missouri is the city of Joplin and its surrounding roads. Outside of the map, I also focus on selecting generic models that would be best for our DLC, which are later created by our amazing 3D graphics team. What I enjoy creating the most are smaller cities and settlements as they usually have very unique architecture and atmosphere.[/i]

[h3]Jakub[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2021fa817cd1b09c44505dd9dfd8ecb11d4b67fc.jpg[/img]
[i]I am very keen on working on Missouri as it is almost contrastingly different from what I worked on before. To add to that, I will have to wrestle with making a city for the first time. so I am excited to see the result of that. I still look forward to working on interstates and highways, as that is what I think I'm most skilled at.[/i]

[h3]Falda[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/101cc42aea5d82395349759f0b7b81da1fd51842.jpg[/img]
[i]I am responsible for half of the custom depots for Missouri. I made some of them for Kansas and then for Nebraska but now I am working on several depots which were not announced yet. These new depots will bring new challenges and new experiences for players. That is the part that I love most about this job because creating challenging layouts makes me think about how will players react to everything that I prepared for them.[/i]

[h3]Filip[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/95e7d11c82f881c69bcee184b5f1c426c9e241ce.jpg[/img]
[i]In Missouri, I'm looking forward to creating Cape Girardeau, an unmistakable city on the Mississippi River. I hope to translate the genius loci of the riverside town both in the more industrial areas as well as in the urban part of the city.[/i]

[h3]Seki[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4785886eecd066e15df36ef4961528bf0d9c04c7.jpg[/img]
[i]I celebrated 8 years in SCS this month. As a DLC asset lead, I have the opportunity to influence what awesome landmarks, industries, statues, murals, and other buildings will make it into the expansion. I'm responsible for the perfect condition of these 3D models like the St. Louis Gateway Arch, Jefferson Capitol, or Springfield Underground that you come across on your travels. I am most looking forward to the new opportunities that this state will allow us to bring into our game. I won't talk about specifics so I won't take the surprise away from you. Our team will do everything possible to deliver the DLC at least as good as the previous one.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1adef65a002dccf96c892687a6c2bb3beea6c8ae.jpg[/img]
We hope you've enjoyed meeting the team working on the Missouri expansion. Remember to follow us on our social media ([url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url]) so you won't miss out on any news coming in the future. If you are excited about Missouri, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730870/American_Truck_Simulator__Missouri/]add it to your Steam Wishlist[/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730870/American_Truck_Simulator__Missouri/

notes.title: Arkansas - Cities
notes.content:
We are happy to bring you another update regarding the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2585150/American_Truck_Simulator__Arkansas/]Arkansas DLC[/url] for American Truck Simulator. Get ready for a sneak peek at some of the cities you will drive through when hauling cargo in this state!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/89309f78576884bbe25644fada6dcabec36bf38a.jpg[/img]
[h3]Texarkana: A City Divided[/h3]
Texarkana stands as a city divided between Texas and Arkansas, its heart sliced by the state border. To fully explore Texarkana's unique charm, players will need both the Texas and Arkansas DLCs. Notable landmarks include banks in the Arkansas half and a captivating tire factory, providing an exclusive cross-state experience. Texarkana is known for its vibrant cultural scene, offering a blend of Texan and Arkansan influences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9d44a5ab062dc39b44ef2f8e374d60ff1b660280.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0eb3b726111a1f3ab56a4e41d9ac9c982d07f256.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/381d876d9b97260e6ba96de429ccdabc4076604c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/cec874d24d31420049d5a8dbbf98c66029614445.jpg[/img]
[h3]Harrison: Quaint Charm with Hidden Gems[/h3]
Nestled in the picturesque Arkansas landscape, Harrison unfolds as a small town with an unexpectedly charming downtown. The City Hall, a historic hotel, a hospital, and a bank showcase its rich history. Venture to the outskirts to explore warehouses, where notable factories specializing in beverages and furniture are waiting to be uncovered. Harrison's welcoming community and stunning natural surroundings make it a hidden gem in the heart of Arkansas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9824ddbe361ed11c6bf665cb8e63d3521769b964.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/cc186f73abff3b3fdcb65cb52eb277db8dbf87be.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/56f4c6edf5c8f3efe6710fd3cd67342e1e184657.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5fc65f74734f1b27eb31bd339b743725b43f6fc6.jpg[/img]
[h3]Jonesboro: Picturesque Downtown Landmarks[/h3]
Jonesboro, one of Arkansas' larger towns, boasts a downtown full of landmarks, including churches, a courthouse, and quaint shops. Navigate through this vibrant city and discover a large rice storage and processing facility - a key player in the local industry, promising an immersive addition to the virtual trucking experience. The city's dynamic charm and architectural gems create a picturesque backdrop for an unforgettable road trip adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/11623b4b1586133958fcf71eb80f64eecc197656.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Nebraska - Truck Stops
notes.content:
Ready for another sneak peek at our upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543810/American_Truck_Simulator__Nebraska/]Nebraska DLC[/url]? [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5cd91c32cd0b2acd9228ae38a5236e40631ce783.jpg[/img]
The truck stops in Nebraska have a history as vast as the prairies themselves. These facilities have adapted to the ever-changing needs of the trucking industry, offering a blend of convenience and essential services. Whether you're in need of a quick refuel, vehicle maintenance, or a well-deserved break, the truck stops have you covered.

notes.title: Cruising Kansas & Christmas Winterland Events Extended
notes.content:
Since the release of Kansas for American Truck Simulator, drivers from around the world have been busy hauling deliveries across the Sunflower State. However, we understand that since that time, it's been quite a busy time with various other releases, as well as the start of our Christmas Winterland event, which has been hugely popular! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/3979f21c04aba6b409a7f84965a31f880d24e1b1.jpg[/img]

With all of this in mind, we realise it may have been a bit overwhelming for those who have limited time or had other commitments during the holiday period, such as spending with friends and family. This is why we have decided to extend both Cruising Kansas & Christmas Winterland Events! [b]You will now have until February 5th, 23:59 UTC to complete these events.[/b] We hope this creates a more a comfortable timeframe for you to enjoy both events and earn all the available rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/cef68e805cb15127ab773cc1e0444cba10bdcc94.gif[/img]

Both these events offer players some unique in-game rewards to decorate your truck & cab with! So far over 112,000,000 miles have been completed in our Cruising Kansas event. We are so close to the community goal of 125,000,000 miles, so we hope this extension can help you reach this! Want to take part? Read more here or watch our live-stream recording below which includes lots interesting info about the event and its creation. 

[previewyoutube=CwXMFg09YbI;full][/previewyoutube]
The Christmas Winterland event community goal has already reached its maximum potential, with all reward tiers unlocked, however you will still need to complete your personal goal to earn them. Please Note, The only thing that is not going to be extended is the presence of our in-game #ChristmasWinterland themed Desktop Background, which will disappear on the 15th of January at 23:59 UTC.

[previewyoutube=_2b5lCPc_T0;full][/previewyoutube]
You can find all the rules & details of the event [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/12/christmas-winterland-event-2023.html]here[/url] or watch our previous live-stream all about the event below!

We hope you enjoy both of these unique events to their fullest. Be sure to share your pictures with us on our Social Media channels using this dedicated hashtags ([b]#ChristmasWinterland & #CruisingKansas[/b]). Until next time, keep on truckin'.

notes.title: Introducing Missouri
notes.content:
Without further ado, it's time we reveal our next U.S. State for American Truck Simulator! From Iconic Landmark Gateways to the Ozark Highlands and the beauties of the Mark Twain National Forest, today we are excited to announce that our team are hard at working creating...

[b][h3]Missouri for American Truck Simulator[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/67941bb2c1355b203a236fc5f95c7474c0bc2b28.jpg[/img]
Nestled in the heart of the American Midwest, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730870/American_Truck_Simulator__Missouri/]Missouri[/url] beckons with a blend of historical significance, natural beauty, and vibrant urban landscapes. Known as the "Show-Me State," Missouri invites visitors to explore its diverse offerings.

The iconic Gateway Arch in St. Louis stands tall, symbolizing westward expansion, while the Ozark Mountains provide a scenic backdrop for outdoor enthusiasts. From the bustling city life of Kansas City to the serene landscapes, Missouri captivates with its unique charm and promises a journey marked by historic sites, such as Mark Twain's birthplace and a taste of authentic American culture. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2a1c6583bd9e72867ebe223e4ef15c2c4e60db19.jpg[/img]

Drivers in Missouri will also be the first to see the iconic Mississippi River in American Truck Simulator! As the second-longest river in the United States spanning over 2,000 miles, this impressive waterway flows through 10 different States.

There is no shortage of industries large or small in this state either! Agriculture, Underground Warehouses, Food Industries and more await drivers in Missouri. We look forward to sharing a showcase of them in future blog posts. For now, please keep in mind that everything you see here is still very much a work in progress and may not represent the final product.

notes.title: California Rework - Fresno & Huron
notes.content:
We're happy to share with you another look into our on-going California Rework project for American Truck Simulator. For some of our newer player base, a small part of our team has been hard at work to rework the base game state of California and bring it up to standard with our current map expansions as part of a free update. 

Today, we're happy to share with you some preview screenshots from the cities of Fresno & Huron! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/430f2d5027dd2718a19087070e61e4420c4c8a88.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Fresno[/b][/h3]

Nestled in the heart of California's Central Valley, Fresno is home to a unique blend of urban vibrancy and agricultural charm. Known as the "Raisin Capital of the World," this city boasts its title of  'the most productive farmland'. You may have even delivered to this city a few times before in American Truck Simulator. Let's take a look at some of the changes that have been made in the rework. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b2ccf985bc672ee52ddeb7444af4c7fd43ddd166.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b5ccc9ab15b182113fdf51002e217c0068723dfc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/92cc811dbdef3423fa8eca326ce9f629a16624fa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c368411a36f7bc0f8d82ed08d5d4ddc2f283b425.jpg[/img]
Much like many of the other cities in the California Rework, Fresno was completely reworked from the ground up. This means the city and road network from our current base map editor has been deleted and the team has rebuilt it from scratch. This allows the team to take advantage of techniques and tools we previously did not have, and really utilise the space to bring a more realistic layout and representation of the locale. 

Major road networks, such as the CA-99 which runs through the city along with many other connections in and around Frenso have been reworked. The team has also reworked industries in the area, and you may even find some new depots to deliver to. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/70bec76161c9df3fbbcc13f6aa16c8f625a4d2f2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b453ee7e9191a4192a4b758e054e955a69d96022.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/189a20564654809c29c97e0127f12e62d2302d2f.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Huron[/b][/h3]

Surrounded by vast expanses of farmland, Huron provides a tranquil escape from the hustle and bustle of big city life. Known for its colorful murals that tell the story of the community and its rich cultural heritage, Huron provides a glimpse into the heart of the Golden State's rural charm. 

Just like the work undertaken in Fresno, Huron has been built from the ground up, including its road networks and local industries. Nearby, you'll find a new Truckstop under the 'Vortex' brand located close to the I-5. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/34bca8b0b4d657dd7c1ce35d1f4ccf1db2fa1cd0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b860afbc60b1cc511699c2fac84717427e0db01c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/87cbb967c48f6f3e83e7a058c5a2f00b2c3ccee0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a95681521494d6009088bbbb4658202e712b7868.jpg[/img]
Like many other small towns and cities, Huron is home to a variety of Agriculture industries. In the surrounding area, farms grow soybeans, corn, and own livestock. It is also an emerging hub for the production of niche crops for specialty markets, as-well as a rapidly growing cluster of wineries. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c37334fc37f9c46b8c7cfd27d4248d75c6e52baa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/20d9a83ad76006a95ee438509b472e5951d51266.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/52746414c59077e725385bd8565530b4dbb1860a.jpg[/img]
Rest assured, the team is working hard on this project & we look forward to sharing more previews from this upcoming phase of the California Rework. If you missed out on any of the previous blogposts on this topic, be sure to take a read back here. Until next time, keep on truckin'!

No matter where you are in the world or how you observe this holiday season, we hope that you will find the time to take a pause and savour the joy and peace of this special time. Like many others, a majority of our ever-growing team here at SCS Software will take a short break to celebrate this festive season. We hope you don't mind us posting a little less than normal during this period!

Our offices are already filled with the spirit of the season, with the start of our most ambitious and festive [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/12/christmas-winterland-event-2023.html]World of Trucks Christmas event[/url] to date! Have you made your first journey through the portal to the magical [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/12/christmas-winterland-event-2023.html]#ChristmasWinterland[/url] yet? Join truckers from across the world in helping deliver supplies and gifts to and from this wonderland filled with holiday joy, snow and more! We invite you to join us in spreading cheer this holiday season. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4b5a1dda27064646762ff6b05194af17becff566.jpg[/img]
As we reflect on the year 2023, we will undoubtedly think about the moments that brought us joy and those that brought us sadness. It has been a challenging year for many people around the globe, and we sincerely hope that the world will become a better place in 2024. If you're curious about what SCS Software has in store for the coming year, we recommend checking out the recording of our [url=https://www.youtube.com/@SCSSoftware/videos]Special Christmas Live Stream[/url] which took place recently. It's packed with exciting news, glimpses of upcoming projects, and plenty of hints and teases from our development teams. 

From all of us here at SCS Software, we wish you all a very Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

notes.title: Nebraska - Fields, Prairies, and Rivers
notes.content:
We feel your anticipation building for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543810/American_Truck_Simulator__Nebraska/]Nebraska DLC[/url], and today, we're excited to satisfy that curiosity by offering you a behind-the-scenes look at its development. Prepare to be captivated by the diverse landscapes that await you, from grassy dunes to wavy hills, cornfields to meadows, and the enchanting Platte River flowing through it all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2bf092df1033f70024e891658516570d7213fd71.jpg[/img]
Nebraska is far from a monotonous stretch of land. In fact, the DLC promises to showcase the state's rich biodiversity through various biomes. The Sandhills, resembling grassy dunes, provide a unique and picturesque terrain. The Shortgrass Prairie, adorned with rolling hills and landmark mountains, promises an immersive driving experience as you navigate through its landscapes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/63cc17a2830d3b4e98c1b5ea0de341fd0ccfacec.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d2365c640620769b000cadc5f376021110672ac1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5e6ac5026a5aae643c3d54d824a44a654de3a616.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d0a26af513e637a1e558ca27eeada8d8cf70c3f8.jpg[/img]
The Mixedgrass Prairie unveils vast fields of corn, soybeans, and sorghum, creating a patchwork quilt of agricultural beauty. And for those who prefer the sight of taller grasses, the Tallgrass Prairie offers a blend of grasslands and fields, adding another layer to the visual richness of Nebraska. Each biome presents a new challenge, ensuring that every drive is a distinct adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/229a8b72c45322d2a567fef7657b1e7914a1a406.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e01c0767c67b4ff75b80f300e9f29eeaab6954bc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6b7c30277a03b678c11f7ec12edfa1d6ea345e65.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4dcb7b1648f47475fd54890d5b54db211f76a10d.jpg[/img]
One of Nebraska's defining features is its intricate network of rivers and streams. Prepare to encounter the most famous of them all - the Platte River. This iconic waterway winds its way through several towns, roads, and highways, offering a scenic backdrop for your journey. Crossing over its bridges or driving alongside its meandering course, the Platte River will become a companion on your travels, adding a touch of serenity to the hustle and bustle of the virtual road.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a27492f692e93ac8bee1a8a84bb40e6d2d2ede7a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8c71d817454e2fc2b9689be8b9076c4c845b69e7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3bd04c7195f5080ed64d21049243b45fee4c0278.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f45ff148fa2eb73a4c9c77d6f8b8791e384c317e.jpg[/img]
Moreover, Nebraska boasts a rich variety of vegetation, with wildflowers adorning the roads and landscapes. The state will have many flowers along the roads, including the ubiquitous wild sunflowers that seemingly grow like weeds. You can also expect the company of numerous cattle on the roads, adding a touch of rural life to your journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/473d99f5346275ae61e2dea8af5b1540e1a457f0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b9eedffa052494b110e3ad143c58f89bc916da11.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4da3bdc7c0b17fb025d2e232e24b4dc76b07ddd4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c9f0539bcaf2a526817c2525e8a82be6eecc4b8a.jpg[/img]
Nebraska may surprise you with its charm, making each drive not just a task but a memorable adventure through the heartland's hidden treasures. Are you already excited to travel to this new state? Let us know by adding the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543810/American_Truck_Simulator__Nebraska/]Nebraska DLC[/url] to your Steam Wishlist. Stay tuned for more updates by following our social media channels ([url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url]).
