notes.title: American Truck Simulator - 1.49 Open Beta
notes.content:
Today, we are happy to share with you that the 1.49 Open Beta branch for American Truck Simulator is now available to try and test out. If you plan on participating in this Open Beta, we ask that you please help us by reporting any bugs you may encounter in the [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=313]appropriate section(s) of our official forums.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/00dec11fbf4ba2aadad80a8625c42701cb4b2ac1.jpg[/img]

Your feedback and reports are extremely valuable to our team and we thank you in advance for taking the time to help us out. So, without further ado, let's take a look at what the 1.49 Open Beta has in store.

[b][h3]HDR Skyboxes, Moon and New Weather Effects[/h3][/b]
First and foremost, after many requests, we've added the Moon (back) to our night sky! It's a subtle but remarkable touch that adds an extra layer of realism and wonder to your virtual trucking adventures. Curiously, it's worth mentioning that what might appear as a simple addition – the Moon – has posed some significant challenges for some time. Integrating the Moon into the night sky has required casting, rendering, and calculating lunar light, managing reflections in water bodies, dealing with wet roads, and addressing mirror effects, among other things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a4b146af5d7f1cb6eac16133c7285590eaefef18.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a4d8096db6d647038980ece545f50bc50bcdcff6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8fc30ef8411bbd90cba5669d3c26ce0bb581661e.jpg[/img]
In addition to that, we've also reimagined the night sky, introducing dynamic stars that gently twinkle, enhancing the overall authenticity of the night-time experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/05602d797a0dfb16815dc910164b267e4f2c4aff.jpg[/img]

We are also happy to share that skyboxes will now be High Dynamic Range (HDR), which means that there will be richer, more vibrant colors in the skies and our weather visual effects have also received an upgrade. Thunderstorms now include visible lightning, offering a more immersive experience. And make sure to keep an eye on the night sky in certain regions, you might be pleasantly surprised with what you will notice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/524f65f191ca750d754f65c68bcd301206251a1f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d1f2b4e7c1622059b3a737707906ccb9d734f521.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ffafb06be4aa025c1785448042cbd84b7b841293.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2fe9b4553c344ddc6ac02c5426e2399e28cb0198.jpg[/img]

To sum it all up, we’ve also prepared a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A5QxMstGYzk&]special video[/url] for you showcasing all of these changes. It’s definitely worth checking it out along with the [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/10/149-update-hdr-skyboxes-moon-and-new.html]dedicated blog post[/url] we published previously!

[previewyoutube=A5QxMstGYzk;full][/previewyoutube]
[b][h3]PACCAR Technical Centre [/h3][/b]
Hidden within the vast landscape of Washington, a realistic recreation of the PACCAR Technical Center awaits your discovery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bfb2dd62b885d571208cb227db3655e7a77ef00a.jpg[/img]
Drivers will now have the opportunity to experience the PACCAR Technical Center firsthand. This realistic 1:1 recreation will offer a glimpse into the world of truck development. For years, the PACCAR Technical Center has been the epicenter of innovation and development for renowned truck manufacturers, Kenworth and Peterbilt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b79b6b09ca2543e87cc81eca4fe38ef56c9fd988.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/418ced78d973c89dbac71562999cad3df2867d3f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a477443bf70a1adaa3f2cdce8fb8bf72e82d5da3.jpg[/img]
This facility has been instrumental in testing trucks, powertrains, technologies, and more, and it's where the giants of the trucking industry push the boundaries of what's possible, creating the next generation of iconic trucks.

Even though the area won't be readily visible on the in-game map and UI, it will be waiting for curious players to discover with plenty of interesting bits to explore. We’ve also added an extra layer of excitement, a small Easter egg will be parked within the PACCAR Technical Center itself. We challenge you to keep your eyes peeled and see if you can spot this surprise. 

We hope you enjoy checking out this new and unique addition in American Truck Simulator!

[b][h3]Used Truck Dealers[/h3][/b]
We're also happy to introduce another highly requested feature. Used Trucks will be now available immediately in the main menu taking you to a selection of trucks that are more budget-friendly compared to brand new vehicles. However, these used trucks come with some mileage and wear, which is indicated by their star rating and a separate window that provides a detailed breakdown of the damage to various parts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/aa0caf2fe04d85147d42b554f1f847c3cad0a0ab.jpg[/img]
One of the most significant changes coming along with this feature is the enhanced damage and repair system. In the past, our approach was very simplistic - individual parts would accumulate damage, represented as a percentage, and you could repair them, resetting the percentage to zero. However, with the 1.49 update, parts will accumulate three types of damage
[list]
[*] Damage: This type of damage can be fixed by standard repairs, just as before.
[*] Parts Wear: When components accumulate significant wear and tear, you'll want to replace them.
[*] Permanent Wear: The permanent wear represents systemic aging and wear across the whole vehicle. It can only be nullified by Total Restoration of the entire vehicle. This is a more expensive procedure, but it's the only way to bring your truck and trailer back to pristine condition.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4c567622008b1fbc0941e668a572d634c758b5b4.jpg[/img]
With the improved damage system comes enhanced control over vehicle maintenance. You can now make informed choices about which parts to repair or replace based on your judgment. Alternatively, you have the option to seek professional advice for the best repair strategy for your truck or trailer.

We'd love to hear your feedback about this new addition [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=313]on our official forums.[/url] Happy (used) trucking! 

[b][h3]Keybind Modifiers [/h3][/b]
Another highly requested feature coming with 1.49 is the introduction of Keybind Modifiers! When previously creating a new bind in the menu, you could only assign a single key for an action. With the 1.49 update, you will now have the option to use a combination of the key and modifiers to bind an action. For example, you can now assign Shift + L to turn your lights if you so wish! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8f57105596f45658a4c8c1b8270be357761c7dc8.jpg[/img]

This opens up a whole new world of key bind combinations for you to use, allowing for more binding options, but that's not all! You will also now have the options to bind short press and long press key. Holding the key down will be recognised as a long press, and pressing a button as normal will be seen as a short press. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b888b89365d7764265061e9296d165f6456c5103.jpg[/img]
Keyboards isn't the only peripheral taking advantage of this change. Controllers will also be able use this new feature! We look forward to hearing [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=313]your feedback[/url] on this new change!

[b][h3]Changelog [/h3][/b]

[b]Map[/b]
[list]
[*] PACCAR Technical Centre added to Washington State
[/list]

[b]Visual[/b]
[list]
[*] HDR Skyboxes, Moon and New Weather Effects
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Used Truck Dealers
[*] Keybind Modifiers
[/list]

[b]So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an open beta, not a stable public version - so you may encounter bugs, instability, or crashes. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to get there faster, we'll appreciate all of your feedback on our forum and your bug reports in this section.

Please check our modding wiki to get details pertaining to mods for the game.

If you wish to participate in the open beta, you can find this version in the public_beta branch on Steam. The way to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right-click on American Truck Simulator  → Properties → Betas tab → public_beta → 1.49. No password is required. Sometimes you have to restart your Steam client to see the correct branch name there.[/b]

notes.title: Kansas - Agriculture
notes.content:
The agriculture industry in the US state of Kansas is a big deal! All year round, farmers grow a multitude of different crops such as wheat, corn and soybeans, as well as raising livestock. In today's blog, we will explore how this important industry is represented in our upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298430/American_Truck_Simulator__Kansas/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=Agriculture]Kansas DLC[/url] for American Truck Simulator. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7e20a5be07d8aa3b056b687da4752d04dc6d8e4e.jpg[/img]
The Midwest is known for its bountiful and diverse agricultural production. Its fertile lands and waters provide ideal conditions for growing a range of different crops. Today, Kansas is the nation's leading wheat producer. There are several types of wheat which are grown, but the state is best known for its Hard Red Winter Wheat. Thanks to its high protein and gluten, it is ideal for use in the food industry, especially for bakeries. Did you have bread for breakfast today? There's a chance it was baked from Kansas Wheat! No wonder some often refer to Kansas as the "Breadbasket of the world". 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/06e116c457bfa25f8c6337efb13aa66c49ba3625.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0dd6118d68ccc69d4b86720a41377ed51ae17b9e.jpg[/img]
Of course, we couldn't go without recreating an accurate representation of this major industry in our upcoming DLC. In Kansas, drivers will be able to deliver to new farm depots which have been created using references of real farms found across the state. However that's not all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/082b49fd7142b626780ffb19214667c6f03e1e1c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f8e4073649a86fd9f0588ec601320b4eb837be02.jpg[/img]
Grain Elevators are another important element in the economy chain. With its unmistakable appearance and high height, it is one of the truly distinctive icons of the Kansas landscape. Our map teams have paid particular attention to the locations of these silos and placed them in positions where they can be found in real life.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f57c854b330cda186cf6bbc8efaaa697ce514468.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/926a21b1a09aaee67a116e85d59585794329c475.jpg[/img]
But what happens to all these crops once they are processed? They are taken to one of many processing plants of course! You have the opportunity to deliver to and from food production plants, which includes a new and accurate representation of the unloading areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9c8ed8ad0aef88c115ad528a5b2b498b42e8ad46.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6737af5fa44e1ccfb8e62097cff0f43366cd09d1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5e795d722fac3d428ace245bd8bad55e49a09c00.jpg[/img]
From new names to familiar depots, there will be plenty of choices for drivers when it comes to delivering to and from agriculturlal industries. You'll still be able to find your favourite existing in-game brands and deliver much more than just grains. From farming equipment to livestock, you'll certainly have your work cut out for you! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c4cbc607e1161ef863b49161da889ce2d5ea058e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a0112e2cddd62d92050156947bd74b72073f4cb4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bc390e46c875c55c0e1dd3ce8ca8f15f922d6ec6.jpg[/img]
With many farming states in the pipeline, we aim to continue improving the experience of agriculture deliveries and already have a few ideas on the table! We look forward to sharing more news in the future. If you like what you've seen, then be sure to add Kansas for American Truck Simulator to your Steam Wishlist. Until them, keep on truckin'!

notes.title: Kansas - Rest Stops, Truck Stops & more
notes.content:
With the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298430/American_Truck_Simulator__Kansas/]Kansas DLC[/url] coming to American Truck Simulator, we have another exciting piece of the puzzle to reveal for you. Let's take a look at the Rest Stops you will find scattered across the Sunflower state! So have a little break, grab a coffee and a snack, and imagine you are there. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/e75d605a7955f0aef2ad823cf35967643e20cbbb.jpg[/img]
Driving through Kansas, truckers discover a different kind of rest stop – a break that goes beyond the usual. When the truck rolls into the stop, it's like entering a painting. Golden wheat fields stretch out as far as the eye can see, waving gently in the breeze. The sky overhead is vast, changing colors as the day goes on. The truck stop is a tiny piece in this big landscape, a pause where nature's grand show takes center stage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/e09f221d2e45850a8c4b9858f7f5a4b94175a8df.jpg[/img]

As the driver prepares to hit the road once more, they carry a piece of Kansas with them. The rest stop becomes more than just a pause in the journey; it's a reminder that the road, with all its challenges and triumphs, is a shared experience that binds travellers together.

notes.title: 1.49 Update: PACCAR Technical Center
notes.content:
As you may know, every update brings excitement and new adventures for players of American Truck Simulator. With the upcoming 1.49 update, we are introducing an awesome addition that will allow players to delve into an unmarked area like never before. Hidden within the vast landscape of Washington, a realistic recreation of the PACCAR Technical Center awaits discovery!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a477443bf70a1adaa3f2cdce8fb8bf72e82d5da3.jpg[/img]
For years, the PACCAR Technical Center has been the epicenter of innovation and development for renowned truck manufacturers, Kenworth and Peterbilt. This facility has been instrumental in testing trucks, powertrains, technologies, and more, and it's where the giants of the trucking industry push the boundaries of what's possible, creating the next generation of iconic trucks.

On our recent trips to the United States, we were fortunate to receive exclusive invitations from PACCAR to visit their Technical Center. While our primary purpose was to conduct sound recording sessions and 3D scanning of both legendary and new truck models, during our interactions with the team at PACCAR, a shared vision emerged. We realized that bringing the PACCAR Technical Center experience to ATS players would be a fantastic opportunity as we wanted to offer players the chance to explore this testing ground, just as we did. And so, with a shared passion for trucking, we set out to recreate this remarkable place in the ATS universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b79b6b09ca2543e87cc81eca4fe38ef56c9fd988.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/bfb2dd62b885d571208cb227db3655e7a77ef00a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/418ced78d973c89dbac71562999cad3df2867d3f.jpg[/img]
In the upcoming ATS 1.49 update, you will have the chance to experience the PACCAR Technical Center firsthand. This realistic 1:1 recreation will offer a glimpse into the world of truck development, and even though the area won't be readily visible on the in-game map and UI, it will be waiting for curious players to discover. But rest assured, intrepid truckers will quickly uncover this hidden treasure once the update lands on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d9bc7e688ee893c3e86db23f89761e56b476f545.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ca345399e19cf0a8542073bfb9cb9cdd6f6f1fb7.jpg[/img]
While the entire area has plenty of interesting bits to explore, we’ve decided to add an extra layer of excitement, a small Easter egg will be parked within the PACCAR Technical Center itself. We challenge you to keep your eyes peeled and see if you can spot this surprise. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ddd91ac438ebfe1645492de22d421d7f43420eb8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c037c75e631b7a43f6c5af7afbebb487cd53ec14.jpg[/img]
We can’t wait to show you more content that is coming with the 1.49 update over the upcoming weeks. Make sure to follow our social media ([url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url]) to always stay in touch with all the latest announcements and while you’re at it, let us know what you think about the PACCAR Technical Center showcased today.

notes.title: California Rework - The Golden State #2
notes.content:
Today, we're happy to share with you an update on Phase 3 of the California Rework, and what the team has been working on recently. This blog serves as a part 2 on 'The Golden State', so we recommend taking a read of that blog, if you haven't already! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/48e97f877f124710df732c23bdfc5ce2c744c11b.jpg[/img]
Focusing mainly on the western part of the state, the team has been hard at work reworking the layout of existing road networks by taking advantage of the space created by the rescale after the release of American Truck Simulator. This means we've been able to utilize more of the map to create more road networks, expand city sizes, introduce new industries in the area, and ultimately, bring the quality of the state up to date with our current DLC quality standards. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8a5f53a0c48f5e5a42f945bc1f7a337f6c066ea6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e5c222255b5841d9eec2865b73be6abbad3a4bef.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6c2e8447c831494aa1eecdf9e6bcf79d160a505b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c97bc7abef066b352ee8322ff7afff578f995f6a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/20d64d6a1eff70b2d0a4010db330fdb3f54d09df.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/693a63864d49965df5356f60e2d000b142945d7d.jpg[/img]
The team's focus recently has been on reworking the legendary CA-1/US-1 Coastline Scenic Route, one of the most iconic in the states. Specifically, the work has been taking place between the San Francisco and Santa Cruz section of the highway, which has been reworked with new assets and a new layout, built from ground up using the newer scale to allow for more details and accuracy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/37d8028ba6357d800b7bb0bc741598047685c9b5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/eb658ee53ec8c5cc023dc3c23faf43658413046b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b51a9e11160eb1493e59cdd4320c88426a0a19de.jpg[/img]

What makes CA-1 attractive for drivers is the unparalleled beauty of its natural surroundings. As drivers make their way along the highway, they are treated to awe-inspiring vistas of the Pacific Ocean on one side and lush, rugged coastal cliffs on the other. The road winds its way through rolling hills, towering redwood forests, and charming coastal communities. Our teams have paid particular attention to recreating these same views and areas in the rework. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a63d717d73fa9636e3623635b955710c2a542caa.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/989e4e1fb22d7f820bce0b5c11a9e93069dbcdde.jpg[/img]

We look forward to sharing more of the work taking place in this phase of our the California Rework for American Truck Simulator. Be sure to check out our previous articles if you missed them! Until then, keep on truckin'

notes.title: Kansas - Landmarks
notes.content:
From natural wonders to historical monuments, Kansas is home to a variety of landmarks which can be found across the state. Take a scroll with us as we share a preview of some of them that have been recreated for our upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298430/American_Truck_Simulator__Kansas/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=Landmarks]Kansas DLC[/url] for American Truck Simulator. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1087d5ea0e96588b39eb65707a6fc2df4fc64c4c.jpg[/img]

Many of Kansas' landmarks are steeped in history, dating back to the pioneer days and the westward expansion of the United States. Sites and statues tell the story of the brave settlers who crossed the prairies to make a new life in this vast and challenging landscape, and began to shape the towns and cities that still stand there today.

Museums across the state also preserve the history of Kansas, such as the Boot Hill Museum in Dodge City which is located on the original site of Boot Hill Cemetery, which highlights the glory days of the Old West. Another such example is the the Pittsburgh Historical Museum, located in Southeast Kansas, which became a hub for mining coal. Today an old yet impressive Marion 37 Steam Shovel is located outside, which was preserved by the museum and coal company.

Kansas' landmarks also highlight the state's natural beauty. From sweeping vistas to unique geological formations, these natural wonders offer breathtaking views and opportunities for drivers take a break and enjoy some of the local area. Whether it's the unique formation of the Monument Rocks or the rolling landscapes of the prairies, these landmarks showcase the state's stunning scenery.

notes.title: Nebraska - Research Trip
notes.content:
Earlier this year, 4 members from our American Truck Simulator map team were able to visit Nebraska, as well as other surrounding states in the USA. The purpose of their travel was to gather references and information, as well as to inspire them in preparation for future projects. In this blog, we will share with you some highlights of what the team got up to. However, please keep in mind that the information and media presented here do not confirm what our upcoming DLC will include.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/257043f5f95d5ef9d1263981fd53679e60500dae.jpg[/img]

The team consisting of Simon Endt (Saimon), Jan Vackar (Vacky), Antonin Kachlar (Tony), and Petra Garlikova (Draky), set off on quite the journey! Driving over 4,000 miles in 14 days, the team managed to visit major cities, depots, real-life viewpoints, truck stops, and many other locations too. 

"We visited the world's largest train depot in North Platte, looked at Lake McConaughy, and crisscrossed cities like Grand Island, Columbus, Norfolk, and more. We even went on foot to the Scottsbluff monument." Simon shares with us. They also visited some unique landmarks such as 'Carhenge' - a quirky pop-culture icon which consists of 39 automobiles painted and arranged to look like the famous 'Stonehenge' in the United Kingdom. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f75b03fb01dc6351ff7b4d074038163aeeb94000.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e49ea79631246050f473f5b521da6239d9248d97.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/91459e92df9188db9cfe4d1ca71b0a53ad4a9fc6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/400071fb5f906acf8b6b6815bfe4b639910dd39b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/22ed968bc21ce89475eb8cca1ef20d8307bf3bf9.jpg[/img]
The team was also able to explore some areas they were not expecting to visit; thanks to their GPS. One such journey led them through an off-road "shortcut" through a forest. Luckily for the team, the road warned them this was not the right path, as they found a golf cart stuck in the mud up ahead. This little moment reminded the team that having the right routes for truck drivers is important, but that challenging routes can be fun too.  

"We all agree that visiting America has opened our eyes. It is important (for us) to experience it and pass the information on (to our teams back in the office). The materials from which we use (from various online sources) are a wonderful inspiration, but seeing the traffic on the roads, the complexity of each logistics area, the diversity and depth of the landscape, you have to experience it." Simon tells us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/cd5280b416519ce5060d988aab728b4f632cc727.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1ba9839b10182cc069d22c8ea52959964f6f3449.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3975ac58267ee750e53bddd73de407646a6a0cf3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8ce4dfb1e8438d92378bae7eae490e956304b994.jpg[/img]
Trips like this are invaluable to the team, as online imagery can be deceiving, especially when it comes to height and distance. Simon tells us "What we realized is how different... the images we usually use (for references), because these images are often distorted compared to reality. The pictures are often captured with a small focal distance (fish eye) which makes everything smaller and further away, but in reality, it is the opposite, everything seems bigger and closer. That's something we need to relay to our team. And speaking of closer things, we also get pretty close to some bison at one location, so exciting!"

With each stop, the team learned something new about the area they were in. "America surprised us with its uniqueness, and we fell in love with something different in each State". Simon and the team also emphasised the importance of creating balance in each state the team develops. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/966511741d0de46b29e6080c3d35d9d84e7b01e4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/0f6d0578baaf8d9a6292bb161c61b822367af04a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/050af02deb87fc9bda43716112b8297cfd7d0848.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4e3c543b3a768fb9b1bdf27272122f26d891e7ea.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/028cec9bd46ba121f32f50f7e1e5617a02221832.jpg[/img]
"I believe every state has its own spirit." Simon tells us "something that is known, that is common everywhere and what defines the whole state. Sometimes it is all about small details, those details created through the history and culture of each state, but you will always feel something is different when you cross the borders". "It is something very important to me, so those who live there will recognize their state and visitors will remember it".

We look forward to sharing how these research trips translate over to our virtual recreation of the states in the future. Until then, we hope you enjoyed this little insight on the process of creating a new State/region, and how our teams gain experience and knowledge of the states. Don't forget to add Nebraska to your Steam wishlist!

notes.title: Kansas - Railroad Network
notes.content:
In 2021, the U.S. transportation system moved a daily average of about 53.6 million tons of freight using a variety of different modes including air and sea. Today's blog focuses on one such mode in our upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298430/American_Truck_Simulator__Kansas/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=railroad_network]Kansas DLC[/url] for American Truck Simulator, which has networks stretching across the states; the Railroad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4fab7ffa961f70546cb070f267e71b8ea8d1ddb5.jpg[/img]

Sixteen train lines operate more than 8,000 miles of track in and out of Kansas, and drivers in our upcoming Kansas DLC will have the opportunity to deliver to and from a busy railroad depot in Kansas City. This depot serves as a vital link to haul large volumes of cargo across very long distances. Many of the shipments bound for the railroad usually consist of heavy, large or high quantities of materials, equipment or chemicals. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/746ae9ea095d1ed6aa621a5811e6480aa526203f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/82431ed531ccce1a43f60686cb913bc0c2df34c3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/50c0c582cc42358c44bcb11399b3f087972e5731.jpg[/img]
In some cases, industries may even have a railroad running through or alongside their property as a convenient means to load or offload frequent deliveries. Drivers will need to pay attention however, as these areas can become quite busy with movements both on the road and on the tracks! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3e238d8956a5538fa5c83829342d204c0ccc799e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3c5d6a3d7eff0fbc9534c75bfaa20165bcfbd67e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8e25377d8aa03d8410ff9b8a45c7b2205852f7e3.jpg[/img]
In addition to the logistics side of the railroad, truckers in our upcoming Kansas DLC will be able to make deliveries of materials and equipment for the maintenance of the tracks. Keeping the trains rolling is just as important as keeping a truck on the road!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5adf207223d806251f8299dfcb3b3ecbb7c40029.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a95cf5631665390c9fa95f14b4ddcd521a07a927.jpg[/img]
With such a long history of railroads in the state, Kansas is also home to various rail related landmarks, including older steam engines that used to work the tracks, and art murals referencing the early beginnings of the network. So whilst we're out on the road, don't forget about our friends on the highways of the rails, skies and sea as you deliver around Kansas; you'll be sure to cross paths with them along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/23d134b211e763a28e1b52f5dcb94a446622fe29.jpg[/img]
Want to stay on track with the release of this upcoming DLC? Be sure to add it your Steam Wishlist! We thank you for all your support so far. We look forward to sharing more development news from Kansas in the near future.

notes.title: #Pinktober 2023
notes.content:
October is a special month worldwide, marked by a collective effort to raise awareness about breast cancer, known as [b]Pinktober[/b]. It's a time when pink ribbons make their appearance, symbolizing the solidarity in our fight against this devastating disease. Breast cancer affects countless lives, and Pinktober plays a crucial role in educating and empowering individuals to make informed choices about their health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2e583f6d53fbc6c82a0f630df869742e82a78b7b.jpg[/img]

The heart of Pinktober lies in knowledge and awareness. Understanding the signs and symptoms of breast cancer is crucial to early detection and better outcomes. Regular self-checks and consultations with healthcare professionals are essential practices that can save lives and by educating ourselves and sharing this knowledge with loved ones, we contribute to the larger mission of breast cancer awareness.

Pinktober reminds us that our health should always be our top priority. Prioritizing regular health check-ups, screenings, and promoting these practices among our friends and family is a fundamental message of the campaign.

 https://store.steampowered.com/app/1068290/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Pink_Ribbon_Charity_Pack/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1162160/American_Truck_Simulator__Pink_Ribbon_Charity_Pack/

Every year, compassionate virtual truckers come together to support the battle against breast cancer. While many choose to make direct donations or raise awareness in creative ways, we offered an alternative a few years ago, as our team decided to join this noble cause with a [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2019/10/pink-ribbon-charity-event.html]Pink Ribbon Charity Event[/url]. In 2019, we introduced two special DLCs for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1162160/American_Truck_Simulator__Pink_Ribbon_Charity_Pack/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign_pinktober2023]American Truck Simulator[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1068290/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Pink_Ribbon_Charity_Pack/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign_pinktober2023]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] from which 100% of the income goes to charity every year.

If you're looking for an opportunity to make a meaningful impact and add some unique paint jobs to your trucks, now is the perfect time to grab these DLCs or gift them to friends. You can also spread awareness by decorating your trucks with these paint jobs and sharing your support on social media under [b]#Pinktober2023[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6c3eda2ec2c29372abf46e2b0421816e91d06394.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/38732f14a8d89c2c7c055038f357cac1b5873416.jpg[/img]
Last year, we made a slight change in our charity approach - instead of dividing the funds, we decided to direct the entire sum raised from the DLCs to a local charity, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1068290/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Pink_Ribbon_Charity_Pack/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign_pinktober2023]Alliance of Women with Breast Cancer[/url]. This time we will keep the same approach, so, stay tuned to our blog at the end of the month as we'll provide an update on this year's Pinktober, including the final donation amount.

We’d like to extend our gratitude to all who have generously supported Pinktober throughout the years. Your contributions, whether through donations, raising awareness, or attending awareness seminars, make a significant difference in the fight against breast cancer. Together, we stand united in our mission to bring hope to countless lives!

notes.title: Kansas - New Industries
notes.content:
When you are out on the road hauling cargo while exploring the uncharted roads of a new map expansion, it’s easy to get distracted by the wonderful nature and historical landmarks. However, there are three things you should keep in mind wherever you go: where you are driving from, what is your destination, and what your cargo is. For many of you, new industries in the DLCs breathe fresh air into your journey, and we’re glad to showcase new content that you’ll find in the upcoming Kansas DLC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4f8710b65f61d26709886c5f29b990f9843d4f6a.jpg[/img]
[b]Battery Factory[/b]

Electrical energy is one of the main driving forces in today's world. Its production runs almost continuously, but its consumption fluctuates with demand. For this reason, it is necessary to store it somewhere, and that's where batteries come into play. Help keep humanity running by delivering batteries for electronics, warehouse power, and vehicles, including trucks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7a42f8b1cc3b8d743a4d60dc772a320283a72a2d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7f68801054231be8d78ea478483c3e9f78ecf5e6.jpg[/img]
[b]Aerostructures Factory[/b]

Kansas is known for its rich aviation history, and it remains a thriving hub for aviation production to this day. As a matter of fact, one-third of all commercial aircraft manufactured in the USA comes from this state! The main production center is the city of Wichita, which is globally recognized as the "Air Capital of the World". Here you will find a new landmark aircraft parts manufacturing depot set within a large complex. Inside and out, a significant amount of bulky cargo will be transported.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d94fbf9e87659ffba5971f0d6b9d3dc3ab7a9149.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c732579407635a4b5e7b24df6c6d187f343e90d9.jpg[/img]
[b]Aviation Services[/b]

Just like trucks, airplanes occasionally require maintenance or repairs. This is where the new Aviation Service depot comes into play. Workers here take care of various types of flying machines to ensure they continue to safely transport cargo and passengers worldwide. Deliver the materials they need, sometimes even directly to the hangar near the planes, but be careful, aviation equipment is expensive.

[b]Wichita Air Cargo[/b]

As mentioned earlier, Wichita is a city of the aviation industry, and a lot of cargo is transported to and from this city by air. This requires a suitable cargo terminal at the local airport and in Kansas DLC, we will have a new depot faithful to the real-world counterpart. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/64b17cd9485d15b3656f99217218eaa5f505dc2f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/251a296d80bc913ec14387bd556a53622c25fa97.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d779a7bb4db0ad6b82d5a30506b9770296e35ec1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0c175277497ee55aac6a7f4cb5fffde8bf0af174.jpg[/img]
[b]Building Material Factory[/b]

In the real world and in ATS, time and progress never stop. Whether it's building new structures, repairing existing ones, or modernizing, you need construction materials for everything. Our new company, Building Material Factory, supplies a range of materials that customers on construction sites, in warehouses, or in stores are waiting for. But before that can happen, you first need to deliver a variety of raw materials for production. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/eb865b998e2db16dc26435813848abe28bdcc793.jpg[/img]
[b]Car Factory[/b]

Kansas may not be among the most well-known car manufacturers, but you'll still find an automobile factory here. The factory in Kansas City used to produce airplanes, but it has been manufacturing cars since 1947. In this new landmark depot, you'll deliver various types of cargo necessary for car production, so that the finished vehicles are ready for delivery to their customers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/185678f5a6f2dafd53fbecc21fde459239aba7ac.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/406eee392f6b2328ee75ba32dfc249fea0789850.jpg[/img]
[b]Food Factory[/b]

Food. Who doesn't love it? It's a fundamental necessity of life. Most of us acquire food from the store, but it doesn't just appear there. It has to be produced in factories from various imported raw materials. And in Kansas DLC, you will find a new version of such a factory. A modern production plant produces a variety of delicious treats that customers can't wait to get their hands on. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/293ba37e396efcf1b04e7343114e66f07aea5921.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2bced812c1a34d411d5a280cfe282a4a3425fbcb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/943b48e5c41dd44a4ea29c97ec568db4f636afda.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2ea5be907350208cb8ca44b92e450049e056884c.jpg[/img]
[b]Salt Mine[/b]

Deep beneath the city of Hutchinson lies a great treasure: salt. It might seem mundane to some, but salt is an important resource for food preparation and the production of many industrial products. Animals love it, and it helps motorists get home safely. Help the miners from the local mine extract high-quality salt with your deliveries, which you can then distribute to various customers throughout the ATS world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/07f4de8a05e763f6c85260d546d17fee8a7f68dc.jpg[/img]
[b]Parking Lot Construction[/b]

Occasionally, there are breakdowns in underground networks, and excavation work is necessary to repair them. Now, you can encounter this in American Truck Simulator as well. Workers need fast deliveries of materials to ensure quick repairs and the full restoration of critical resources. Breakdowns can happen anywhere, so keep a close eye on the job list to make sure you don't miss any.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/439228a4ace5a760cbec7ea8dfe1b9f1b93bc325.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e719acef2d94c146ef7e178b43f2d8ef0b19c61c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/144e66b5b27599cfaf0da97e4231135b18290b55.jpg[/img]
So, go ahead and let us know in the comments which new industry you would like to first visit once the Kansas DLC is available. And, if you are already impatient to see more, show us your excitement by adding the map expansion to your Steam Wishlist and follow our social media ([url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook,[/url] [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url]) in order to stay in touch with all the latest news.

notes.title: Dynamic Billboards - Swift Transportation
notes.content:
After our first experiment featuring a giant of the American logistics industry on our in-game dynamic billboards, we are now opening this opportunity to yet another huge logistics company: Swift Transportation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/792713355e75387d74d15dbce70104c4ca49d275.jpg[/img]

Swift Transportation is a renowned and long-established transportation company with a rich history dating back to its founding in 1966. With a vast fleet of trucks and a dedicated workforce, the company specializes in providing a wide range of transportation solutions, along with a strong commitment to safety, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f98f9ae34f5cf8e132599855d5ae3edd8175b889.jpg[/img]

With this new cooperation, we hope to continue inspiring our ATS players who share a deep interest in real-life trucks. For those who have always been intrigued by the idea of a career as a truck driver, this could be the spark that ignites a lifelong journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a5ba342460dc65feb7556d103852464082479e93.jpg[/img]

We believe that even the smallest gestures can have a profound impact. By showcasing industry-related content within the game, we aim to create meaningful connections between virtual worlds and real-world opportunities. As countless players pass by our in-game billboards, who knows? Someone might see a recruitment billboard from Swift Transportation and take that as a sign to explore a career in trucking.

We are happy and honoured that Swift Transportation is another mega logistics company seeing huge potential within our #BestCommunityEver and helping us experiment with this innovative concept. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a58f29a0e6d921ad28ec2b1fc49f8f11cf11b7f8.jpg[/img]

We hope and believe that together, we have a chance to light the path to new careers and aspirations for our ATS players, who are not only virtual truckers but also real-life trucking fans.

notes.title: Kansas - Water Bodies
notes.content:
The beauty of Kansas goes beyond the endless plains and charming cities, as within its borders lies a number of aquatic wonders waiting to be discovered. So, fasten your seatbelt, and join us today on a journey to see what bodies of water you can expect in the upcoming map expansion for American Truck Simulator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/76fffdbf87e4604de97884a2d6acc2666ee1c8e3.jpg[/img]

In the heart of this landlocked state, you'll find a network of rivers that conveniently flow through the region. The mighty Missouri River flows majestically through the northeastern part of the state, while the Kansas River, also known as the Kaw River, meanders from Kansas City to Topeka, offering natural serenity amid the towns and farmlands. Further west, near Hutchinson and Wichita, the Arkansas River adds character to these urban landscapes, blending the natural world with the urban environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2f1335d2091faf3665d37d1ba8141c4787ca8b7e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0f3a0bafd8be96ea73dbe3147abc598adc28943b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9b884be0bd6b06cb421b37003efdf75f948a4b3c.jpg[/img]
One of the highlights is definitely El Dorado Lake, located not far from Wichita. While it may not be as expansive as some of the lakes in other states, El Dorado Lake covers a hefty area of 8,000 acres, with the deepest point reaching 60 feet. This reservoir plays a vital role in water resource management and flood control for the region, contributing to the economic and ecological well-being of the area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4624668c6c10f6a951d6144d36cc65797b360486.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/dced9ba318027f7ffedbc024643bda3a1722a9ac.jpg[/img]

In addition to these notable water bodies, Kansas DLC features several smaller dams scattered throughout the state. These dams, along with other reservoirs, though not massive, play essential roles in supporting agricultural activities and offering recreational opportunities. They represent the subtle yet significant part that water bodies play in the state's landscape.

notes.title: Kansas - Hutchinson: World's Biggest Silos
notes.content:
One of the cities to explore in the upcoming Kansas DLC for American Truck Simulator will be Hutchinson. The city is a true hidden gem with a rich history and streets that once thrived thanks to the salt mining industry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0eec3fbb39018023e5fc74cc23916b77ff97051c.jpg[/img]
Hutchinson traces its history back to the late 19th century when it was founded in 1871. The city's growth was closely tied to the expansion of the railroad, as it became a strategic railhead for a number of important companies. This transportation connection facilitated the movement of people, goods, and agricultural products in and out of the region, contributing to Hutchinson's early prosperity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/293096bb52562ca4455146751f9738e3e75ed510.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ac99baf0ae16d48293e8b68379c0ee8c978be38b.jpg[/img]
One crucial moment in Hutchinson's history was the discovery of vast underground salt deposits in the late 19th century. This discovery led to the establishment of a thriving salt mining industry, earning the city its nickname "Salt City." The salt mines became a significant economic driver for the area, and over the years, Hutchinson has evolved into a diverse and vibrant community, combining its agricultural heritage with modern attractions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/34ad0f6da947a7dd2556ce0cc415a38b20349af9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/aa22fb10a2f875e975fe5b6211eaed65ce0abad8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f64005648b76606b33d7cb5c006566fc6c5f4279.jpg[/img]
One of those modern attractions is some of the largest grain elevators and silos in the world. These massive structures play a crucial role in the region's agricultural industry, as they are used for the storage and distribution of grain, particularly wheat and corn. And, most importantly, the in-game Hutchinson will boast the World's Largest Grain Elevator, an iconic landmark that you can't miss. Towering over the landscape, it's a sight to behold as you haul your cargo through this city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2b7bedad698596ed39da42e567cdebd143a3cb2d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/97e0827b55fb2db0e7d279b6a34f1c2fbb2a2bf5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/67343b04f981b6908f66ae1b1b3660c745154e5b.jpg[/img]
If you are excited to check out the wonderful city of Hutchinson in Kansas DLC, make sure to let us know by adding the map expansion to your Steam Wishlist. notes.title: Introducing Arkansas
notes.content:
We're continuing our journey across North America onto a new state in American Truck Simulator! From stunning mountain vistas to towering forests, this US state is also known as "The Natural State". Today we are excited to officially announce that we are creating [b]Arkansas for American Truck Simulator[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/cfe27616066d74442916ba68db365a36fcf5d9f3.jpg[/img]
Located in the south-central region of the United States, the state is a nature wonderland with three national forests, over 40 State Parks, nearly 9,000 miles of pristine streams and rivers like the Arkansas and Mississippi, as well as the ever-stretching Ozark and Quachita mountain ranges. While hauling cargo, you will be able to not only see these beautiful landscapes and areas, but travel through a variety of large and small towns and cities, where you'll find industries, landmarks and more.

notes.title: Nebraska - Nature in General
notes.content:
Nebraska’s nature is unlikely to attract crowds of tourists, yet it's clear that exploring this charming state offers a wonderful chance to uncover some of the state's lesser-known treasures. This region boasts quite a number of unique characteristics, such as the Sandhills and an impressive amount of rivers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e5841733d9d058c3e519c20b94a37f4471f03a55.jpg[/img]
Nebraska's landscape is characterized by its vast and open spaces, with much of the state being part of the Great Plains region, which stretches across much of central and western Nebraska. These prairies provide habitats for various species of wildlife and offer a true sense of freedom and tranquility for visitors and locals alike.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5c1d8287dd8d34f90aa1dee067fbe4836cf5d98b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fd65447332ed22ebb6b3471339424bd368a0ecdf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6c790d7dc927b601228b504d6518964a47bf192c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/49663fddbea642cad66088e2b7e71efcbecfecec.jpg[/img]
With so much open and natural space, Nebraska provides the perfect conditions for a variety agriculture businesses. Therefore it is of no surprise that you'll see and deliver to many farm areas, growing a variety of plants, crops, corn, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/df098f46af87b7b41f378491e10998578b9876b3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d846907ad382f367b2c037b289fb11e74aee92d6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6ae7be9d03295b5f47e6b17e9d1aa3cf68ad417b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/39edd2ccf9adb50dba7f6865ab9cefd69bfa39e5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8896e713e00ffd8e7a2d807a8a425e1b09241665.jpg[/img]
In the Sandhills region of Nebraska, you'll find a unique and striking landscape of rolling sand dunes covered in native grasses. This area is known for its distinctive beauty and relatively untouched nature, which makes this special environment a peaceful sanctuary that feels far removed from the bustling world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/68739104df14b90c39bb9c0f16c99498b90c5c48.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/df098f46af87b7b41f378491e10998578b9876b3.jpg[/img]
Given the states vastness and open areas, our teams aspires to portray Nebraska's reality, however, this comes with a few challenges. We continue to remain mindful and aware of the players POV, to create create a journey that has purpose and matches expectations both gameplay and scenery wise. We hope we can find the right balance given how vast and open Nebraska truly is. We are open to hear your thoughts on how this could be achieved in the blog comments or on our forums.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d3ef540730009dc09dbde520531e8ad5b9525bad.jpg[/img]

Are you already excited to travel to this new state? notes.title: Kansas - Emporia
notes.content:
Described as “the loveliest site in the world for a town,” Emporia was founded in 1857. Today, it is known as an "authentic small city" located on the edge of the Flint Hills of Kansas. Today's blog features the work our team has undertaken to recreate the industrial part of the city in our upcoming Kansas DLC for American Truck Simulator, and what drivers can expect to find there. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/10719e92b1d3df654465c0087d6e163696242a99.jpg[/img]
Don't let the small town atmosphere fool you, this city has quite the busy industry area, featuring warehouses that supply local businesses, shopping malls for its residents, gas stations, factories and even a food plant! You'll find no shortage of delivery contracts in this area. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e06821c7efb2b2bfc2c5c4366a053bc680217b51.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/nightmare_se][h3][b]nightmare_se[/b][/h3][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/be780ed327d29e02b7aeee57cf3876265745102e.png[/img]

[i]The new Oklahoma DLC for American Truck Simulator offers an immersive and authentic driving experience through the diverse landscapes of the state. From bustling cities to rural farmlands, the DLC provides a well-crafted depiction of Oklahoma's beauty. Being a former over-the-road truck driver in the United States before moving to Sweden, this helps me reminisce back to the days when I used to travel the I-40 Interstate through Oklahoma. The attention to detail in the road networks, landmarks, and scenery enhances the realism of the game. Whether you're a dedicated trucking enthusiast or simply looking for a refreshing addition to the game, the Oklahoma DLC is a solid choice.[/i]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC2yE7nrxq8EBOU3TZIbBfzQ][h3][b]PoderakGames[/b][/h3][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/288fed9d4b3a5eb29dea3fec7d0f1411f3e1d822.jpg[/img]

[i]Absolutely thrilled to have had the chance to experience the Oklahoma DLC for American Truck Simulator! As a truck lover, diving into the diverse landscapes and vibrant cities has been an absolute joy. The state's rich history and thriving industries, like bus factories and tire factories, make for an engaging trucking experience. The attention to detail in places like Gloss Mountain and Beavers Bend State Parks truly makes this DLC a trucker's dream. The peculiarity of this map, which surprised me and especially my community during the live broadcasts, is the presence of some particular roads that make the journey more intriguing and exciting. Can't wait to continue this exciting journey on the road![/i]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/@Lissaets2][h3][b]Lissa[/b][/h3][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/18f7ac11cdd338b5c08c9e5e4b7c37d3591a585f.jpg[/img]

[i]In my opinion, Oklahoma is one of the most beautiful states in America, and I am very glad that our dear developers have finally added it to the game. The detail of all ten cities and landscapes is amazing. My viewers and I enjoyed spending time checking out new roads and cities, and we even found an interesting hidden road! The views in the expansion are really nice and you can look at them for ages! Everything looks very nice and the DLC is definitely worth your attention. Thank you, SCS Software for the new and great addition to the game. I am sure that it will be even better and better from now on![/i]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/@RyaStream][h3][b]RyaStream[/b][/h3][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4e54394f5f3743fcea60eff28302482ddf486f64.png[/img]

Oklahoma is OK! (Get it? Eh? *Cricket noises*) Honestly, this state is simply a relaxing and unique one to drive through! I love when we get a new state like no other before because, during my live streams, everyone from the state always points out the realistic recreations of towns that are important to them and things you can only see in Oklahoma. From the truck stops to the Tulsa Airport and the School Bus Factory, you will find scenery and pickup locations that look like no other in the game. SCS did a great job of showing the wide open plains as well as the mountain parts of the southeast. It connects the bordering states with many more back roads than I ever expected! Thanks, SCS, for yet another wonderful addition to the ever-expanding American Truck Simulator!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9fe768cc1cef334b4078c8f8e6dd6508fb47da43.jpg[/img]

Alongside the DLC launch, we launched the #CruisingOklahoma World of Trucks event and in just over two weeks, you've managed to surpass over 75% of the community goal of 111,000,000 miles (178,637,184 km). Really good going! No need to rush though; you still have until the 1st of October at 23:59 UTC to secure your personal rewards and help out with the community goal. More details are available in the [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/07/cruising-oklahoma-world-of-trucks-event.html]dedicated blog post.[/url]

In conclusion, it's evident that we've been absolutely overwhelmed with feedback since the release. To tackle The Sooner State and make it as diverse as possible posed a challenge to our developers, and we're thrilled that the project has garnered much attention. A heartfelt thank you to each and every one of you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2209650/American_Truck_Simulator__Oklahoma/

notes.title: Kansas - Colby & Hays
notes.content:
Today we're happy to share with you not one, but two cities from Kansas, our in-development map expansion for American Truck Simulator! From local industries to landmarks, let's delve into what these areas can offer truck drivers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/595d58d7ea09ead210ec6dc1689288aeddfee9fc.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Colby [/b][/h3]
Nestled in-between the High Plains, where the horizon stretches as far as the eye can see, is the city of Colby. Established in 1884, it has grown into a progressive agricultural community predominantly featuring farming industries. From farms, to machinery services to livestock auctions, there is no shortage of work for drivers looking for a job!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/db1229719b72e019c76756846b4353d46289b6cb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/973618b901e7d1be638728a90f51c2c1c4da21c1.jpg[/img]
If the fields aren't for you, you'll also find a supermarket, car dealer and a new dynamic depot nearby; and whilst you're in town, why not take a moment to admire the sights! Near the city limits, you'll find the visitor centre, also known as the 'Grain Bin' thanks to its unique design which incorporates traditional Kansas limestone with a a real grain bin. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0fb5583286cb2c50febb6f6c73c4f3e2c8d5687f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bbbf415776e668a0391e9b17432f0917843f7de7.jpg[/img]

From there, you'll come across other prominent landmarks such as the Thomas County Courthouse, the First Presbyterian Church, the Pioneer Memorial Library and the Colby Mall. Be sure to explore a little when you do pass by, you'll never know what you might find! 

[h3][b]Hays[/b][/h3]
Welcome to Hays, a city where history, education, and natural beauty can all be found! Located amidst the rolling plains of the Sunflower State, Hays invites you to explore its captivating blend of past and present.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fee0e866e730c3a0487e8cf0c434197690d064a1.jpg[/img]
Founded in 1867 as the southern branch of the Union Pacific Railroad, it has become a bustling city with a variety of local industries. On your visit in American Truck Simulator, you can find jobs to and from the battery factory, local city works, a dynamic parking depot, car and truck dealer, furniture and supermarket stores. On the outskirts of the city, you'll also find a Steel metal depot, Oil Service and a  Livestock Farm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b167131dde23df51b4377d2462f5b854b4f5f0d7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1543f14407b680a4f95537ebb3b5e6e791fb081b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/69101400c8e5cbaaf2acb7f3f5746a16b0a7f71a.jpg[/img]
If you happen to find yourself in Hays with some downtime, why not check out the local landmarks and attractions? Here you can find a Movie Theater with an accompanying art mural, statues of some of Hays' personalities, the Hays Veterans of Foreign Wars Post 9076, the Hays Public Library and more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/11be34f9c0ef54b52de8e431f49ace783faa8145.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/268175b394ba252ef13af196634b95f94951929b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/04d3f3a6e54c957b3bf98ecabd17d455e1f3f8ab.jpg[/img]
No matter which city you choose to visit first, history and industries await you on the road! We hope you enjoyed this insight of what is to come with the Kansas DLC. If you like what you see, be sure to add it to your Steam Wishlist! Until next time, keep on truckin'. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298430/American_Truck_Simulator__Kansas/

notes.title: Introducing Nebraska
notes.content:
A few weeks ago we released a blog post teasing new content for American Truck Simulator that we started working on during the development of two map expansions. We hope today’s map DLC announcement will get you excited just like the previous two, because officially we are... [b]Introducing Nebraska for American Truck Simulator[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1037d3469f1c082a80791a46ef88559f79500247.jpg[/img]
Located in the heart of the Great Plains, Nebraska’s vast and diverse landscape consists of prairies, rolling hills, and the crucial Platte River. While hauling cargo through the Cornhusker State along historic routes, you will have many opportunities to witness iconic landmarks and truly immerse yourself in the state's spirit, from its pioneer history to the modern energy of cities full of ever-growing industries. Our goal is for the DLC to offer a fusion of peaceful landscapes and the rhythm of a buzzing economy that's unlike any other.

notes.title: American Truck Simulator's Oklahoma DLC adds ten cities and a bee plush
notes.content:
Studios like Rockstar can capture the essence of New York in a video game, but New York is a city full of famous landmarks. SCS Software, by comparison, have become masters at capturing the essence of places of no significance. The long freeway, the vacant parking lot, the anonymous storage warehouse, the nowhere town; all are rendered with such care and detail in American Truck Simulator that they become as compelling to me as any virtual Times Square.

The latest example: Oklahoma, now available in ATS's latest DLC. Watch the launch trailer below and see if it doesn't make you want to take a road trip.

notes.title: W900 Tuning Pack Release
notes.content:
Today we are excited to share with you big news for American Truck Simulator. Our teams have been working hard to bring a HUGE addition to a legendary icon in the trucking industry.... 

[b][h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2386530/American_Truck_Simulator__W900_Tuning_Pack/]Introducing the W900 Tuning Pack![/url] [/h3][/b]
[previewyoutube=zOPygbc7NkA;full][/previewyoutube]
Kenworth's W900 design allows real-life truckers to customize their ride in many different and unique ways. We wanted to reflect this by bringing some of the most popular combinations to American Truck Simulator, as we know how important customising rigs is to our community. Turns out, there are A LOT of tuning options available for drivers of the W900, so our team decided to go big with this project. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c1a1dfc07c3eb48e66a1f63fe009c9773e0c65ed.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/946015e091cac02ad562883d9816922a36093666.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2ed51f6cc825a457031784870e311167089982a3.jpg[/img]
As a symbol of individuality on the road, drivers have embraced the W900's potential for personalization, resulting in a vibrant market of aftermarket additions. A majority of the external and interior parts that are included in this pack have been inspired by these third party modifications, allowing us to bring a large variety of customisations to this iconic truck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3376109a6d04d3b949562af04c4ac62bc72e5503.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/550046e7eb9b636437a8a4de6e35feefdb1f10d4.jpg[/img]
The W900 Tuning Pack features over 500+ individual tuning parts for both the interior and exterior of the truck, giving you a massive range of options to personalise your Kenworth W900 just the way you like it. This includes (but is not limited to) bumpers, cab door accessories, exhausts, filters, mirrors, fenders, mud flaps, exterior lights, grille, hood, roof window, chassis cover, side skirt, sunshield, deflectors, fuel tanks, headache racks, special turn light options, different headlights and headlight covers,  air filters, trim options for windows, paintjobs, interior cab customisations and so so so much more; making it our biggest Tuning Pack to date! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/71787a179729489415978ffbc84d665f8608b08a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1b6d2b61cbab6fcadca26f73cd2c97234a40a438.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/66edd56543e1f0308dcf43bf7d3b33d2cab1f786.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b9b56d831be2b0521de4e2e871bd53dc3cee6ecd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/77b9e2934e1963b93d22c00a585690885c8d542b.jpg[/img]
We know how much our community loves to customise their rigs, so we've also made almost every exterior part paintable, giving you even more options! We really look forward to seeing how you get creative with this option; but that isn't all. To continue the celebration of 100 years of Kenworth, you'll also find a range of interior accessories such as toys, mugs, caps and more to have decorating your cabin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b8799a3724ca2db631962496146de60097be2009.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/740ea89b7fdcb3b5e923a075b3d6f1024ba01f0e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/93189e9c53564c7a32bc280610dcbc303da5cf76.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/87d755cdc8ca0300a98df6586eb2d555179a7db9.jpg[/img]
Ever dreamt of creating and owning your own Show-worthy truck? Now you can with the option to add 'Show Truck' parts to your W900; such as rear fenders, front and rear bumpers and more! Along with these, you'll also find a variety of interior trims to match the exterior paint jobs, to help complete your rig's look. We look forward seeing you show these off to friends in convoy mode or at other virtual Truckfest events. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8192e32ff4ad678d607d3e4d234025f93b6ac48e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d0a06c9bf7eb3cb05fd9aaf4e95d0a9981984b6c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/942e50b167fb51d7be6bc5c7ffad36c0772d70e4.jpg[/img]
This massive undertaking doesn't go without credit to our teams behind the scenes who brought this all to life. From research, to modelling, to testing and everyone in-between, it really has been a labor of love and we are so happy to bring so many options to your garage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d0cd2b0e341bdbaa7bed9b72fed8fbd551e79387.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2a9c15d2b0d3bf67d664900b85438985bdf0a2b5.jpg[/img]
We can't wait to see how you'll customise your Kenworth W900. Be sure to share your custom creations with us on our social media pages (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter) and we'll feature our favourite ones! 

Time to get tuning! Check out the[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2386530/American_Truck_Simulator__W900_Tuning_Pack/] W900 tuning Pack DLC for American Truck Simulator, now available on Steam.[/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2386530/American_Truck_Simulator__W900_Tuning_Pack/

notes.title: Oklahoma Release
notes.content:
The wait is over, #BestCommunityEver! After careful preparation, research, and hard work, we are thrilled that Oklahoma DLC for American Truck Simulator will be released today! Get ready to hit the road as we take you on an unforgettable journey through the Sooner State.

[b][h3]Oklahoma for American Truck Simulator will be released today shortly after 7PM CEST for everyone on Steam![/h3][/b]
[previewyoutube=L0x21pq-cCY;full][/previewyoutube]
Oklahoma map expansion offers a vast playground for you to explore. We suggest you take your time to savor every moment as you encounter the following features: [list]
[*] Discover 10 explorable cities including Tulsa and Oklahoma City
[*] Enjoy trucking through several scenic towns (settlements)
[*] Discover and deliver to Oklahoma's important industries like Bus Factory, Tire Factory, River Port and more
[*] See several landmarks unique to Oklahoma including Skydance Bridge, University of Tulsa, and Route 66 Museum.
[*] Admire and explore Gloss Mountain and Beavers Bend State Parks

[/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a0a052f3ff536f3a62407d58bff32633a9324291.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fca3e8e9d429b3310bb804594eb20db693db1341.jpg[/img]

Check out our[url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/07/cruising-oklahoma-event.html] dedicated blog post[/url] for full event details and rules. The event concludes on [b]1st of October at 23:59 UTC.[/b]

We also have a unique gift for you. If you take any External Contract or External Market job TO or FROM the city of Oklahoma City, you'll earn a Honey Bee Plush, which can be used as a cabin accessory. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c2e44d8df2e239531221830f96881268227c5569.jpg[/img]
Join us for a special release stream on our official Twitch channel starting at 16:00 CEST. Tune in for exclusive insights, developer interviews, and a sneak peek at what Oklahoma has in store for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/efeb9a5d0de3fe6f58849aa39a6d0bac207584df.jpg[/img]
We can't wait to see you on the roads of Oklahoma. Share your first journeys with us using the hashtag [b]#CruisingOklahoma[/b], and remember, there's always more to the Sooner State than it might seem at first glance and the next awesome adventure might just be around the corner. We’ll see you on the road!

notes.title: Cruising Oklahoma World of Trucks Event
notes.content:
We are delighted to invite you on [b]Tuesday, the 1st of August[/b], to celebrate the release of our new Oklahoma DLC, by taking part in our latest [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks event[/url] - Cruising Oklahoma! From mountain ranges and forests, over prairies and savannas to creeks and rivers, you'll explore the diverse landscape and economy of this incredible state.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fca3e8e9d429b3310bb804594eb20db693db1341.jpg[/img]

We are asking our #BestCommunityEver to achieve the community goal of driving [b]111,000,000 miles[/b] (178,637,184km) while delivering cargoes to or from any city in Oklahoma.
While #CruisingOklahoma and enjoying the beautiful landscape it is also worth knowing that it is home to a wide variety of animals and insects, like the common honey bee and Black Swallowtail butterfly, two national state symbols that are important for Oklahoma's biodiversity. The state holds populations of bear and fox in the mountains, as well as the prairie dog and the iconic American bison in the prairie regions.

Oklahoma is also known as the [b]"Sooner State"[/b], symbolizing the energetic, progressive can-do spirit. Truckers can look forward to exploring many new industries, like delivering iconic, yellow School Bus parts to the bus factory, Big Tires for machinery from the tire factories in Ardmore and Lawton, or Yard Trucks that are needed at Tulsa Airport.

During your journey through Oklahoma, you can look forward to many beautiful views and highlights such as:

[list]
[*] Gloss Mountain State Park, unique natural landmark with mesas in north western Oklahoma
[*] Tulsa, metropolis center for energy, aerospace, and technology
[*] McAlester, picturesque historical city in East Oklahoma
[*] Beavers Bend State Park, beautiful park in the mountainous region of south east Oklahoma
[*] Hugo Lake Spillway, dam on the Kiamichi River in south east Oklahoma
[*] As with past cruising events, you can use your own trailer and experience all these in the external market!
[/list]
Oklahoma DLC is offering 10 fantastic new cities to explore, and we have a special reward for completing your personal goal, which will require you to deliver a job to or from all 10 cities of Oklahoma. All jobs for the event need to be 100 miles each (161 km) or more.

Join our journey with the newest DLC of American Truck Simulator and set out on a trip over high plains, prairies and low wetlands, while discovering the unique factories and industries of Oklahoma! Get ready for a terrific ride through the Sooner State!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a0a052f3ff536f3a62407d58bff32633a9324291.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Rules[/h3][/b]
Using External Contracts or External Market, with a World of Trucks-connected profile in American Truck Simulator, the community goal is to drive 111,000,000 miles (178,637,184 km) while delivering cargoes to or from any city in Oklahoma.

When a player completes a delivery to or from 10 different Oklahoma cities, they will achieve their personal goal.

All jobs for the event need to be at least 100 miles each (161 km), or more.

You can check if your recent deliveries met these conditions using your Log Book in your World of Trucks profile.

[b][h3]Rewards[/h3][/b]
[b]Personal:[/b] Players that deliver cargo to or from 10 Oklahoma cities will gain a personal World of Trucks Achievement and a beautiful Wild Stampede themed truck paint job Steam inventory item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0e59eb2a6ab558ae5c4d89885e83fc0dbd0f59b8.jpg[/img]

[b]Community:[/b] When the community goal of driving 111,000,000 miles (178,637,184km) during deliveries to or from any city in Oklahoma is met, and if the player has also achieved their personal goal, then they will receive a hanging Black Swallowtail ornament Steam inventory item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8039b881c9bac7f31b467494838a3b12a2333c23.jpg[/img]

The event will be concluded on [b]Sunday the 1st of October at 23:59 UTC.[/b]

We wait with bated breath to hear back from you about your new adventure, with so many new places to explore and discover. We think you will love cruising the Sooner State, from its ancient mountain ranges and forests in the high plains region, through central prairies, savannas and mesas, to the low wetlands revealing creeks and rivers, and we look forward to seeing all your photos! So, please share your screenshots and videos with us using the hashtag #CruisingOklahoma on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/scssoftware]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url] profiles and we will share our favorite ones (we may even feature some of them in a future blog post!).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2209650/American_Truck_Simulator__Oklahoma/

notes.title: Kansas - Dodge City
notes.content:
We know you are used to blog posts about individual cities in upcoming map expansion projects arriving a bit later in the development process, but it’s good to freshen things up from time to time and try something else. So, without further ado, check out what you can expect from Dodge City in the upcoming Kansas DLC for American Truck Simulator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ee350b9d7ae2a25efdb9c49ec4ffa6e65e57cd17.jpg[/img]
Dodge City is a famous Wild West town that served as a frontier and gateway to many areas for a long time. As a result, it developed a thriving economy centered around cattle processing, which continues to this day and the local economy chain includes a food factory, livestock auction, and livestock farm. The city's Wild West history is also evident by the presence of the well-developed local railroad, which holds great significance in the city and the entire Kansas as well, connecting it to various depots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/11bd956410b39e08c0fadccecba35dfd755698fc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3ded469f7fd0b460e679366689ada0ddce6b1ee1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2316578df5280191529f404f16457a57b7550fa4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7285def0933799f36d4ad323fcfa7e50673915aa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/61aa610f5ad818895b7669c2a64b655a4622fd75.jpg[/img]
At the heart of the city stands a historical railway station building that can be seen from all sides if you visit the nearby rail supply depot. The town's railroad and Wild West heritage are further commemorated in a Wild West museum that displays historical locomotive. Other depots in the area include a food mill, towering above a row of fast-food establishments, a grain elevator, a shopping mall, and outside of the city, there is a chemical plant and wind turbine construction (typical for the region).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7a63bd380bec1d8f31927f541b8a1384d4fdca9e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/979d2baade20c913535f521a3c9c9d21abf63169.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f3847c6f90ed31efdd9dcd9bad3ec0c094e41cf5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1ea12aa3979bcabd2418bd1aa81bcab64a5a5010.jpg[/img]
Generally, our vision of Dodge City is divided into three main areas:

The northern "edge" along US-50 that bypasses downtown, with a more open feel, housing a shopping mall, baseball field, suburbs, and warehouses.

The downtown area in the center, with a preserved historical core and a more enclosed urban atmosphere - featuring the railway.

The southern industrial area, with depots connected to the railway, a hotel, a swimming pool, and a significant industrial presence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/953f05453a0f6eab454991fd55653db1f053f307.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3f024d668f7dd805cfedc19f9ab39755fd0c9e40.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6a08bba07adbd85c7e90e4ade044a489931ab092.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ff141d8e76df5bea84cd3a12629121d43024dca7.jpg[/img]
We hope the city will provide for enough reasons to hang around and you will not Get out of Dodge. If you like what you’ve seen so far, make sure to add the map expansion to your Steam Wishlist, and to stay in touch with all the latest news, give our social media profiles a follow ([url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url]).
