notes.title: Texas - Agriculture
notes.content:
The relationship between trucks and agriculture is something that some people might find trivial, yet it’s important to realize how crucial this cooperation actually is. Gone are now the days of small-scale farming in the backyards since the modern dedicated lands are growing in size rapidly. And what better place to look at as an example of this development than the state of Texas, which has 127 million acres of agricultural land?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4e96a52989c6334b0d11b980153a17347015616e.jpg[/img]

It is said that grain elevators are such massive and complex structures that even the employees who operate within them can get lost from time to time. While that might possibly be true, we assure you if you will see a high frequency of these buildings on your journey through the Lone Star State, you are most likely (but don’t bet on it) located in the northern area, as this part of the country features most of them.

This facility is designed to stockpile or store grain, and with over 248,000 real-life farms, you can imagine why it was necessary to feature several of these complexes in the upcoming DLC. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ea50b63ec97f0a2e4adf8560fbf87275bcf37f95.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/35fbf7c1210e8a763a906269fe5f102cd38a6d04.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c14792fc015e03c9c62f470495172c4b1f4d928e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8b05e623f32901fbc15a6105fcd0ddb15f1217ad.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/85e30642b97f0902893638ca1fe66ef9ee8d5c69.jpg[/img]

While vineyards are a bit less common, Texas ranks fifth in the US wine production, and the history of this particular industry dates back to 1650. After so many years, there are currently over 400 local wineries with several of these locations being the destinations of the so-called "wine tourism". And even though in our game you can only head out to these areas on a business trip, they are still a worthy sight to behold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8e7a75d9856afe4f789410a94393a0137cebc180.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/792be831225ac1d8ef432ead51701f076fc2b101.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/878b1b9f1e720c92191292da759d1e33b39fb5e4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/18a8d0a6448fbd4e750d1b29fa602011965bb125.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6da2553a8da3025d4d5405791e053a968e2452ef.jpg[/img]

You will also be able to haul to and from areas dedicated to the cattle industry, which contributes billions of dollars to market products sold every year, and the cotton industry (more in our previous article). Additionally, there will also be farms growing watermelons, since Texas ranks 3rd in US production and this fruit state’s largest annual horticultural crop. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/14cdafa6c6ab96f9ca3f8fbd4546da6395d5acc7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2cfb819c668215b82d96adabdc5a07faef597600.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Montana Release
notes.content:
Dear [b]#BestCommunityEver[/b], the day is finally here! We are excited to let you know that the final preparations to release the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811080/American_Truck_Simulator__Montana/]Montana DLC[/url] for American Truck Simulator are quickly approaching the finish line.  
[h3][b]Montana DLC is now available on Steam for everyone!![/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=uwmDVa9QvLc;full][/previewyoutube]
So what exactly does our Montana DLC have to offer for truckers? These are just a few of the things we think you will love: 
[list]
[*] Deliver to and from 15 cities and discover 17 settlements 
[*] Discover and deliver to Montana's important industries like Sugar Plants, Talc Factory, Silane Gas, Electric Network Service, and more!
[*] Drive on the Going-to-the-sun road.
[*] See landmarks unique to Montana
[*] Visit Glacier National Park and part of the Yellowstone National Park and get bird's-eye views with many new viewpoints.
[*] Admire accurate representations of cities like Helena, Bozeman, Missoula, Kalispell, and more!
[*] Visit and take a rest at famous Montana rest stops & gas stations.
[*] Unlock Montana-specific Steam Achievements
[/list] ...and much more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d0af5d564620df153d985a8e9aa9bd3098f57d25.jpg[/img]

We will also have a [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2022/08/cruising-montana-event.html]World of Trucks event [/url]for those who will set out on a journey across The Treasure State, with unique rewards to be earned once you complete delivery to or from 12 different Montana cities and drive a certain amount of miles. You can learn more about the rules in yesterday’s blog post and take part in [b]#CruisingMontana[/b] at WorldofTrucks.com, where you can register an account for free. We can’t wait to see your photos and clips across our Social Media channels using the hashtag (feel free to tag our official accounts - [url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url])!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f3fff80696194a0a8adb01b68badd514a5194fda.jpg[/img]

The event will be concluded on [b]Sunday the 25th of September at 23:59 UTC[/b]. Since we don’t want anyone to feel pressure to rush through the DLC as fast as possible, we hope this time frame will give everyone enough freedom to drive through this wonderful state at their own pace and still get rewarded for being an early adopter of the map expansion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/adbc71cb190fe2f3ae2783c1a0cda91bdab401e4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ecc228ce006107fae67454971677a80f8de0aab6.jpg[/img]

Oh, and we also have one more special reward for you. If you will take any [b]External Contract or External Market job to or from the city of Kalispell[/b], you will earn a Mountain Goat plush toy as a cabin accessory! While not listed as a state symbol, these "climbers" are quite often seen in the elevated rocky areas above the roads and we figured since Kalispell is the closest to the mountains you might feel like taking of these interesting fellas on a trip all around the US in your mighty truck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d09fbfe677ba9a0cd8adefd5e09502f4b7e82a3b.jpg[/img]

We would also like to invite you to a special Montana release live stream on our official [url=https://www.twitch.tv/scssoftware]Twitch channel[/url] starting at 17:00 CEST. Don't miss out on this broadcast as we talk with Davido (DLC Lead) PLUS a special guest appearance from Pavel Šebor CEO of SCS Software! We will be answering questions from the community, talking in-depth about the DLC, giving away free Montana Steam keys and of course, releasing the highly anticipated map expansion LIVE on stream!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/46473c8057165db0efb0e749ede66386de1573f8.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811080/American_Truck_Simulator__Montana/

We hope you’ll enjoy exploring what Montana has to offer! We will see you on the roads!

notes.title: Cruising Montana Event
notes.content:
Join us tomorrow,[b] August 4th[/b], as we celebrate the release of our new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811080/American_Truck_Simulator__Montana/]Montana DLC[/url] by taking part in our [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World Of Trucks event[/url] - Cruising Montana! From majestic mountains to crystal clear lakes, Montana will take your breath away with its unspoiled nature as you deliver to various farms, ranches and new industries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1c3009c739d8996f538eb23fa5ff81cc54799c7a.jpg[/img]

We are asking our #BestCommunityEver to achieve the community goal of driving [b]100,000,000[/b] miles  (160,934,400 km) while delivering cargoes to or from any city in Montana.

While #CruisingMontana you'll experience an untamed wilderness due to its large open lands and small population. Drive with us from the prairies in the east to mountain ranges in the west. Be delighted by views of the Rocky Mountains, home to mountain goats and the endangered grizzly bears. This Treasure State is not only known for its gold and silver mines, but it also enjoys a rich agricultural heritage, with ranching and farming bringing forth economies like livestock, sugar and grain production. So, you truckers play an important part in Montana's industry.

In Montana we offer plenty of viewing platforms, allowing you to take in spectacular views and highlights of this Big Sky Country:

[list]
[*] Glacier National Park, a large wilderness area of glacier-carved peaks and valleys.
[*] Great Falls, a series of five waterfalls located on the Missouri River.
[*] Flathead Lake, the largest natural freshwater lake west of the Mississippi.
[*] Yellowstone National park, a large wilderness area with volcano and oldest national park in the world.
[*] And, as before, you can experience all this in the external market with your own trailer!
[/list]
Montana DLC is offering 15 charming new cities to explore, and we are offering a special reward for completing your personal goal, which will require you to deliver a job to or from at least 12 of them. All jobs for the event need to be [b]100 miles[/b] each (161 km) or more, and don't forget to check out the rules.

Get ready for our latest addition to American Truck Simulator and share your adventures with us, as you discover a wide variety of farms and industries across the state, while enjoying the unspoiled nature, charming small towns, and spectacular views of Montana.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d0af5d564620df153d985a8e9aa9bd3098f57d25.jpg[/img]

[b]Rules[/b]

Using External Contracts or External Market, with a World of Trucks-connected profile in American Truck Simulator, the community goal is to drive 100,000,000 miles (160,934,400 km) while delivering cargoes to or from any city in Montana.

When a player completes a delivery to or from 12 different Montana cities, they will achieve their personal goal.

All jobs for the event need to be at least 100 miles each (161 km), or more.

You can check if your recent deliveries met these conditions using your Log Book in your World of Trucks profile.

[b]Rewards[/b]

Community goal: When the community goal of driving 100,000,000 miles (160,934,400 km) during deliveries to or from any city in Montana is met, and if the player has also achieved their personal goal, then they will receive a hanging Sapphire Meadowlark ornament Steam inventory item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ecc228ce006107fae67454971677a80f8de0aab6.jpg[/img]

Personal goal: Players that deliver cargo to or from 12 of the 15 Montana cities will gain a personal World of Trucks Achievement and a majestic Montana Grizzly themed ATS truck paint job Steam inventory item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/adbc71cb190fe2f3ae2783c1a0cda91bdab401e4.jpg[/img]

The event will be concluded on [b]Sunday the 25th of September at 23:59 UTC.[/b]

We can't wait to read about your inspiring journeys through Montana, from its prairies to the mountain ranges of this Treasure State, or even somewhere in-between, and we are really looking forward to viewing your latest photos from cruising this amazing new map! Share your screenshots and videos with us using the hashtag [b]#CruisingMontana[/b] on our [b]Facebook[/b], [b]Twitter[/b], and [b]Instagram[/b] profiles and we will share our favourite ones (we may even feature some of them in a future blog post!).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811080/American_Truck_Simulator__Montana/

notes.title: Western Star 57X Coming to American Truck Simulator

notes.title: Big In Montana + Yellowstone National Park
notes.content:
Did you know that one of the nicknames for Montana is "Big Sky Country"? While the state has earned this name for the seemingly infinite and unobstructed local skyline, we also have some BIG news for you today, which might just turn things upside down for a moment while driving through the roads of this upcoming DLC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9452efbd03478ddde32c47d99de480b047a75fcb.jpg[/img]

As is often the case with the release of the new expansions, we will be introducing brand new Special Transport missions with the Montana DLC. These jobs were designed with the intention of providing you with an additional challenge and enhancing your trucking experience. Our team has managed to create these four routes that you can look forward to taking head-on:

[b]Havre to Lewiston
Thompson Falls to Kalispell
Laurel to Glendive
Butte to Bozeman[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ec0f0f0b512a6c35d840768e7a611e290572a230.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b26a159260f65c774872475bef0a19d1e1f15a12.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4d564044404cec745c4109e21a441b4ab6cf0ecc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2c76a12da0a1e751a6fce7213e1178e9abcfed6c.jpg[/img]

Also, we know that since the release of Wyoming DLC you’ve probably been wondering if we’re eventually going to further extend any road leading through this amazing national park. We are glad to inform you that after the addition of US-14 in the 1.45 game update, in Montana DLC we are extending the US-191 road which will lead from Wyoming through West Yellowstone village to Bozeman, and it will further open up the possibility of one day having the entire Yellowstone area fully represented within our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/656ebf6aee68f35fb0c9fe2389f0cd337ba5c81c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/021adf5c3ff07895b4996b8aed819121a70506bb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ea355a8f3b27c2a1e05e96a1bf44e987795374eb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/45360df6f119f9b70f2719628eddb9576fccb110.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9322810f49bf88a4a6c32e6030907f466db14111.jpg[/img]

And even though the Glacier National Park is still most likely the main local natural attraction, we hope our representation of this part of the Yellowstone National Park will still give you plenty of opportunities to look around and enjoy the wonderful nature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/386fcb17fe13c0eda4b223becb322ce464f3a0e4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9318e740a5063da52634699e43334d6740372381.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5178c6d478979a77b76c70c4d500215e605f2407.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ccf6c66c29d1b7c55c065401b1d55ee8dd5016fa.jpg[/img]

What do you think? Will you set out on a journey from Wyoming to Montana, or vice versa, through this lovely park? We sure hope so! And if you haven’t done so yet, make sure to add the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811080/American_Truck_Simulator__Montana/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=big_in_montana]Montana DLC[/url] to your Steam Wishlist, and if you don’t want to risk missing out on any new information about the map expansion, follow our social media profiles ([url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok)[/url], [url=https://www.scssoft.com/newsletter]subscribe to our newsletter,[/url] or check out our[url=https://americantrucksimulator.com/montana/] Montana microsite.[/url]

notes.title: American Truck Simulator: 1.45 Update Release
notes.content:
We are happy to share with you that the 1.45 update has now been released for American Truck Simulator. This update features quite a few changes, so we recommend reading through them all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f7dc16e8818f08501864bf6d83d8828f79f66b4a.jpg[/img]

 We'd like to thank everyone who participated, provided their feedback, and made bug reports during the Open Beta of 1.45. Your valuable input helped us make tweaks, and changes and smash some bugs we may have missed the first time around. We hope you can now begin to fully enjoy the various new features which are included in this update.

[previewyoutube=XxXJIhHa98U;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Cody + US-14 Wyoming DLC Addition[/b][/h3]

A much-requested update to the Wyoming DLC from our community has arrived with 1.45, which includes the additions of the city of Cody and the US-14! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/001ac1f71441017cb104903553e8719278e1cb64.jpg[/img]

Self-proclaimed as the “Rodeo Capital of the World”, Cody offers drivers the chance to see famous landmarks and attractions such as the Buffalo Bills visitor center and the Rodeo Stadium; and that's not all! Drivers will also be able to discover and deliver to new industries in Cody, a Truck Trailer service, and a Waste Transfer Station too, which are a small taste of what you can expect to find in the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811080/American_Truck_Simulator__Montana/]Montana DLC.[/url] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e0432a8e47a53dcd1e1dcec1c66a8003346b5e6f.jpg[/img]

Cody is also known for being the gateway to the Yellowstone National Park, located 52 miles from the east entrance to the country's first national park, which also brings us onto the US-14. Beginning at the east entrance to the Yellowstone National Park is U.S Route 14, one of the original United States highways of 1926.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2d2215e64e25cdb5fe3858f35c46e657f7fa11d1.jpg[/img]

Drivers will have plenty to see on their drive on US-14, including the Buffalo Bill Reservoir and Dam, Pahashka Teepee, and of course, the stunning scenery and natural beauty that Yellowstone offers its millions of visitors every year. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fdd21c6c58c18af4a143a7147a4bb12c3ddc407f.jpg[/img]

We can't wait for you to explore it for yourselves. The Cody + US 14 update comes free for current and future owners of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1415692/American_Truck_Simulator__Wyoming/]Wyoming DLC[/url] for American Truck Simulator as part of the 1.45 update.

[h3][b]Ownable Tank Trailers[/b][/h3]

We are also happy to share with you another long-awaited addition coming to the selection of purchasable trailers - ownable trailers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/30e438875e22186641e5bf7aad672eaa823291e8.jpg[/img]

For now, we will be adding two different types of tank trailers into our games - Fuel Tanks and Silos (Dry Bulk trailer). Both types will have different customization options and uses. And don’t worry, we plan on bringing more versions of this trailer to you in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c641c0016f27736a14147960fdad32adaa0b2f21.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f8b4e4e6c428ec5db8237cc41e654d762e4627d7.jpg[/img]

The fuel tanks in American Truck Simulator will be used for the transportation of combustible liquids. They will feature 6 connection types (Single, Double, B-double, Rocky Mountain Double, Turnpike Double, Triple) and 2 different customizable body types (Single drain pipe, 4-way drain pipes)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e7907e163728970af19db6c020ccd2fdcd5c4d90.jpg[/img]

Silos will also be an addition to ATS and you will be able to deliver a number of bulk materials with them, for example, sand, concrete, or grain. Apart from having 5 connection types (Single, Double, B-double, Rocky mountain double, turnpike double) and a single body type (Classic), it will have plenty of customization options as well.

[h3][b]Gas & Truck Stops Rebranding[/b][/h3]

We've revisited 6 of the brands which we've used for in-game truck stops and gas stations which have been present since the game's release in 2016. Originally our resources for the environment and brand creation were much more limited compared to our current amazing team of dedicated 2D artists and talent at our disposal, which now allows us to add so much more detail to the game world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a16d2c85d2ff791be890898a6ad52b5f1f56c524.jpg[/img]

As many of you might have seen originally from our concept art from the Texas and Montana DLC microsites, these new designs bring a fresh, modern, and more realistic look to gas stations and truck stops, wouldn't you agree? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6c03bfff1444d38f4584fc2ab0b5bd07bf8c6edf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6cc886f41d46e25aab0493a895af659167c02e05.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/723baf992b9b8f3ee6717aad04e5f0b300bef6ac.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy seeing these newly rebranded areas on your travels throughout American Truck Simulator. Let us know which one is your favourite via our Social Media Channels! 

[h3][b]Optional Mods Support for Convoy[/b][/h3]

One feature our teams have been working on for Convoy, our in-game multiplayer, is support for missing modifications. We recognise that many players do play with third party modifications created by our talented community, but we also understand that not everyone would like to download all the required modifications to join a friend's convoy session.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/dd859d306980c5b59f0eda1c4fe128bc9d0d5d6e.jpg[/img]

Thus, our team have come up with a solution to allow you to join Convoy sessions without the need to have all of the required modifications of the host's session. There will be options to opt-in, both on the server's and client's side to enable this if you choose to use this. In most cases, the session will not display the modification that is missing, however in some cases, such as if a player is using a vehicle that you do not have, it will show as a coloured placeholder box instead that replicates its size. 

If you are a modder in our community, please note that your modification must be tagged as "mp_mod_optional" to be recognised as a MOD that can be ignored by a convoy server that allow for missing optional MODs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5c88a2db29c3f18df924e6bc64863f2fd1dc9007.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Rain Sensor[/b][/h3]

When you are out travelling on the road for a while, you are bound to come across a bit of rain at times. Whether it's just a short passing rain shower or a full-on storm, it's important for drivers to stay safe while driving on the road during variable weather conditions. 

One of the more common safety features found on vehicles today are Rain Sensors! This nifty piece of technology does exactly what it says on the box, it detects the density of the rain and in turn, adjusts the speed of the wipers for you. This feature is active when you set the wipers of your vehicle to the first position. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ef05d4f98728763de29d01105a84c4672ef7e59b.jpg[/img]

This new feature will be available as an option that you can choose to enable on the settings page. So next time you are driving towards some liquid sunshine, you won't have to worry about adjusting your wipers.

[h3][b]Option to hide inaccessible road markers [/b][/h3]

Another new UI option that we are introducing in this update is the ability to show or hide the X markers which mark inaccessible/undriveable roads for the player. This new option may make the game feel more immersive for some drivers, however, we do urge players to take care and follow the correct route, as the invisible barriers which stop you from driving down these areas will still exist and appear for a short time if you hit them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fd6cf35b0068823db84a61a5a88fd24b28cb2604.jpg[/img]

We hope that you will enjoy this small addition which we know many of you from our community have been requesting for a long time!

[b]Changelog

Map[/b]
Cody + US-14 Addition to Wyoming DLC 
Gas & Truck Stops Rebranding

[b]Gameplay[/b]
Optional MOD Support for Convoys
Rain Sensor Option
Option to hide inaccessible road markers

[b]Vehicles [/b]
Ownable Cistern Trailers (Dry Bulk and Fuel Tank)

notes.title: Texas - Car Factories
notes.content:
While trucking and exploring the vast state of Texas in the upcoming DLC for American Truck Simulator, you might end up picking up a job or two from a couple of large car manufacturing plants. Today we will take a closer look at these two car factories and their impact on the local economy and industry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/61ac807ea47f33edac00bf1ff738b113890c2a5c.jpg[/img]

One of the car factories is located in Arlington, a part of the Dallas-Fort Worth region, and it has been producing vehicles for over 60 years. Built in 1954, the size of the facility is currently over 4 million square feet (about 371 thousand square meters) and we have done our best to transition this size as close to reality as possible in the game. It’s safe to say that an area producing over 1,300 vehicles per day certainly doesn’t deserve anything less. Especially since its production seems to have no intention of slowing down any time soon, considering over a billion dollars were invested into the plant since 2015.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/169d46b10d494c95f89b99270375fa60286d927b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2b1f26bb196bf0d9dee95a0c496aa6411b5c6efb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6b45efa01f31036ab8f9fbb519d81b860686a2c8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/33ed6a0efe2ca21b31e69e6e1739e8920a588334.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/83146d64378a19ad95787c830a591fa4eb1c16a5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/02e432c43cad7a7650c3ff93d73784e19696fb1c.jpg[/img]

The other factory can be found south of San Antonio and in real life, it belongs to one of the top car manufacturers in the world. It is said that a new vehicle rolls off the line every 60 seconds, which paints a clear picture of the high level of production. In addition to the 2.2 million square feet (about 204 thousand square meters) facility, there is also a railway in the nearby area, on which the produced vehicles are transported all over the country by trains.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f8736bd2ebcab3e698f01dfcedaa2e22d7770ec6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ceaf734163d06014db4ad899f32ed650dfc2bcb8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fa2de18a444b652a7d0fab13d1347b6043298a98.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/754ea91abc7f26389080e14395cb2de674a770f2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/69c170ee3d40ece1ebf0453520e7ff7313a613d2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/501a8bff847dc9051fdca2665a42b4bf633fba48.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7fa7a7e8aa05288a6bcc0e5e741bc9c754c25934.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e3759e97ed036d5e45e875d5ed613b7d08d7df0c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2858632c5e178e77e8ba79a88f6ec97877fd0029.jpg[/img]

If you cannot wait to visit these famous and important factories in-game, make sure to add the expansion to your Steam Wishlist to show us how excited you truly are. notes.title: Montana - Helena
notes.content:
You might be wondering what could possibly be so special about this person in Montana named Helena that we have decided to write a blog article about them? The thing is, we are actually going to present to you the capital of the Treasure State, which, as the main representative among other cities, has quite a rich history and strong economy that is definitely worth looking into.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/708118afb7b6be3f59ecd09f887df5d8f9718215.jpg[/img]

The early beginnings of Helena date back to the year 1864, when four men, known as "Four Georgians" discovered gold in the area that is now the main street of the modern city. Once the news of this location spread, the population has rapidly grown, increasing the need to create a formal settlement with an official name. While the sources vary in regards to the initial options, the final decision has most likely been influenced by a city called Saint Helena in Arkansas. Although some tales claim it has been chosen because of the St. Helena island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ee513a046576c3b43ed0971c7715e91d65795526.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0c7b0287df367e0b2309b839324ef27424bff6db.jpg[/img]

When it comes to the implementation of the city into our game, there will certainly be no lack of landmarks to see, as we have featured some interesting buildings in the area, such as the Capitol, banks, an airport, and a truck stop at the center of the town. And speaking of distance, you will also be able to see the Sleeping Giant mountain while driving through the city, with which we have done our best to represent the view as accurately as possible. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/16fe93e82dd8b5adca70518934445036ecd5de1f.jpg[/img]

Who would’ve thought that the name of this city has absolutely nothing to do with Helen of Troy? Weird! But anyway, if you are still impressed with what you’ve seen in this post, make sure to add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811080/American_Truck_Simulator__Montana/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=helena]Montana DLC[/url] to your Steam Wishlist, and if you cannot wait to see more information about the map expansion, follow our social media profiles ([url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url]), or check out our [url=https://americantrucksimulator.com/montana/]Montana microsite[/url]

notes.title: American Truck Simulator: 1.45 Open Beta
notes.content:
Today, we are happy to share with you that the 1.45 Open Beta branch for American Truck Simulator is now available to try and test out. [b]Please note, this Beta branch has been released earlier than usual and is a work-in-progress build that contains known issues & bugs.[/b] If you plan on participating in this Open Beta, we ask that you please help us by reporting any bugs you may encounter in the [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=296][b]appropriate section(s) of our official forums.[/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a46e0a00f2744c3a4264dce90a49c36166ed734f.jpg[/img]

Your feedback and reports are extremely valuable for our team and we thank you in advance for taking the time to help us out. So, without further ado, let's take a look at what the 1.45 Open Beta has in store.

[h3][b]Cody + US-14 Wyoming DLC Addition[/b][/h3]

A much requested update to the Wyoming DLC from our community has arrived with 1.45, which includes the additions of the city of Cody and the US-14! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c1bef2da39bc5b10192254745b90266396942f64.jpg[/img]

Self-proclaimed as the “Rodeo Capital of the World”, Cody offers drivers the chance to see famous landmarks and attractions such as the Buffalo Bills visitor center and the Rodeo Stadium; and that's not all! Drivers will also be able to discover and deliver to new industries in Cody, a Truck Trailer service, and a Waste Transfer Station too, which are a small taste of what you can expect to find in the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811080/American_Truck_Simulator__Montana/]Montana DLC.[/url] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4aa66a8cfaccddcccda52ed402017ce8c1527f94.jpg[/img]

Cody is also known for being the gateway to the Yellowstone National Park, located 52 miles from the east entrance to the country's first national park, which also brings us onto the US-14. Beginning at the east entrance to the Yellowstone National Park is U.S Route 14, one of the original United States highways of 1926.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7a32396456958741f5da93805e92b2687c184e81.jpg[/img]

Drivers will have plenty to see on their drive on US-14, including the Buffalo Bill Reservoir and Dam, Pahashka Teepee, and of course, the stunning scenery and natural beauty that Yellowstone offers its millions of visitors every year. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/804bc7f5cafefed0b42a8746e483d817c61078fe.jpg[/img]

We can't wait for you to explore it for yourselves. The Cody + US 14 update comes free for current and future owners of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1415692/American_Truck_Simulator__Wyoming/]Wyoming DLC[/url] for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] as part of the 1.45 update.

[h3][b]Ownable Cistern Trailers[/b][/h3]

We are also happy to share with you another long-awaited addition coming to the selection of purchasable trailers - ownable cisterns!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4d2be819a499095675f57f30df727a4be9a43607.jpg[/img]

For now, we will be adding two different types of cistern trailers into our games - Fuel Cisterns and Silos (Dry Bulk trailer). Both types will have different customization and uses. And don’t worry, we plan on bringing more versions of this trailer to you in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b7673c436e53a3a881da5e404b81a3ad9b697114.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/454c6d5786e66a7214596872b2b36f6cfbcf4b34.jpg[/img]

The fuel cisterns in American Truck Simulator will be used for the transportation of combustible liquids. They will feature 6 connection types (Single, Double, B-double, Rocky Mountain Double, Turnpike Double, Triple) and 2 different customizable body types (Single drain pipe, 4-way drain pipes)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4f4f8d51df49c80ba260b20f20e8663e3e4df8bc.jpg[/img]

Silos will also be an addition in ATS and you will be able to deliver a number of bulk materials with them, for example, sand, concrete, or grain. Apart from having 5 connection types (Single, Double, B-double, Rocky mountain double, turnpike double) and a single body type (Classic), it will have plenty of customizable options as well.

[h3][b]Gas & Truck Stops Rebranding[/b][/h3]

We've revisited 6 of the brands which we've used for in-game truck stops and gas stations which have been present since the game's release in 2016. Originally when we first designed these areas, we did not have the amazing team of dedicated 2D artists and talent at our disposal, which we have now at SCS Software. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/10d28ea919b4018709098f4078e8bfe8fbc0fb1c.jpg[/img]

As many of you might have seen originally from our concept art from the Texas and Montana DLC microsites, these new designs bring a fresh, modern and more realistic look to gas stations and truck stops, wouldn't you agree? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/79705c5fa2c1864dc66d04f58037d7c7b3b3bf46.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/272b7e4145eda73e30cf3bf881215644a3918513.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3b4de4b213bb904972d0b3861db075411ae585eb.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy seeing these newly rebranded areas on your travels throughout American Truck Simulator. Let us know which one is your favourite via our Social Media Channels! 

[h3][b]Optional Mods Support for Convoy[/b][/h3]

One feature our teams have been working on for Convoy, our in-game multiplayer, is support for missing modifications. We recognise that many players do play with third party modifications created by our talented community, but we also understand that not everyone would like to download all the required modifications to join a friends' convoy session.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/34549d7ea6db3afdb8b0f51341914d5fa4b1de51.jpg[/img]

Thus, our team have come up with a solution to allow you to join Convoy sessions without the need to have all of the required modifications of the host's session. There will be options to opt-in, both on the server's and client's side to enable this if you choose to use this. In most cases, the session will not display the modification that is missing, however in some cases, such as if a player is using a vehicle that you do not have, it will show as a coloured placeholder box in that replicates its size. 

[b]If you are a modder in our community, please note that your modification must be tagged as "mp_mod_optional" to be recognised as a MOD that can be ignored by a convoy server that allow for missing optional MODs.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/81b8fa9cb43f27048d33a06aa573a79242812379.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Rain Sensor[/b][/h3]

When you are out travelling on the road for a while, you are bound to come across a bit of rain at times. Whether it's just a short passing rain shower or a full on storm, it's important for drivers to stay safe while driving on the road during variable weather conditions. 

One of the more common safety features found on vehicles today are Rain Sensors! This nifty piece of technology does exactly what it says on the box, it detects the density of the rain and and in turn, adjusts the speed of the wipers for you. This feature is active when you set the wipers of your vehicle to the first position. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c92fcb91f83d298987cc21f6d0f976fbd4ee0cf5.jpg[/img]

This new feature will be available as an option which you can choose to enable in the settings page. So next time you are driving towards some liquid sunshine, you won't have to worry about adjusting your wipers.

[h3][b]Option to hide inaccessible road markers [/b][/h3]

Another new UI option which we are introducing in this update is the ability to show or hide the X markers which mark inaccessible/undriveable roads for the player. This new option may make the game feel more immersive for some drivers, however [b]we do urge players to take care and follow the correct route, as the invisible barriers which stop you from driving down these areas will still exist and appear for a short time if you hit them![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9963b42ae129f8112230eff17115a94b8f130268.jpg[/img]

We hope that you will enjoy this small addition which we know many of you from our community have been requesting for a long time!

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]Map[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Cody + US-14 Addition to Wyoming DLC 
[*] Gas & Truck Stops Rebranding
[/list]
[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Optional MOD Support for Convoys
[*] Rain Sensor Option
[*] Option to hide inaccessible road markers
[/list]
[h3][b]Vehicles [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Ownable Cistern Trailers (Dry Bulk and Fuel Tank)
[/list]
[b]So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an open beta, not a stable public version - so you may encounter bugs, instability, or crashes. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to get there faster, we'll appreciate all of your feedback on our forum and your bug reports in this section.

Please check our modding wiki to get details pertaining to mods for the game.

If you wish to participate in the open beta, you can find this version in the public_beta branch on Steam. The way to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right-click on American Truck Simulator → Properties → Betas tab → public_beta → 1.45. No password required. Somtimes you have to restart your Steam client to see the correct branch name there.[/b]

notes.title: Texas - Intermodal Terminals
notes.content:
When you get your hands on the wheel in American Truck Simulator, after hours and hours of driving on the roads it can be easy to sometimes forget that cargo and materials can be transported by other means as well. In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1465750/American_Truck_Simulator__Texas/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=intermodal_terminals]Texas DLC[/url], you will have the chance to visit Intermodal Terminals, which are special areas where the so-called transport modes meet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ec592a42a0c5d852f5529191b42ec98abfde8424.jpg[/img]

In case you are new to the name of this unique area or you just need a brief revision, intermodal is a term that is being used when referring to transportation involving two or more modes of transport. Therefore the terminals serve as places that offer a swift and safe movement of goods; which are mostly stored in whole trailers or containers without the need to unpack and repack; from trains, trucks, or ships. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/dfd34225a2d25e9a9c66341b9da1cb9e2d160b64.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9050713415d9032ff37dad7d7dc75cb852987a8c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4c59fe3afe722760525bc8341536bc3c5a92573a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/cf14367c3a1aa3ab1ba0bffea776e96de5604694.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/87b0280d43796d9ffc5c75e947d40cfea2f734f5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/29c80d735fe02bce7f44045e268c8810fae5c41c.jpg[/img]

For Texas, in addition to trucks (of course!), trains play a very important part in this process and the immersion overall. After all, the arrival of local railroads has managed to change the entire economy of the state due to the travel no longer being slow and unreliable. This is why you will have a chance to see several railway stations on your trucking journeys and miles of busy railroads.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e6b241e992b3a694e8a1191c91bc6684c43375fc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6fcb8a94b7012d1829669c67bbb2baae970e3c1a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Montana - Mining Industry
notes.content:
Among other industries featured in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811080/American_Truck_Simulator__Montana/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=mining_industry]Montana DLC[/url], there is only one with state-defining historical importance. So, without further ado, let's dig into what the Mining Industry will have to offer in the upcoming map expansion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3fdb89dff970a7666f61bfc00c1b3d5fa239b28f.jpg[/img]

There’s a good reason why Montana has the nickname The Treasure State and why the front and center of the state flag are a miner’s shovel and pick, with the state motto "Oro Y Plata", which means "Gold and Silver" in Spanish. The first gold was discovered in the local area in 1852, which, along with a discovery of other major minerals, paved the way for gold rushes in the region in 1862, attracting tens of thousands of miners to the area. This rapid increase in population also meant the expansion of the economy and railroads system, so it is not surprising that in 1889 Montana officially became a state.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d46340c9e90c94c2ccdc36383c566feca004c74c.jpg[/img]

Even though modern-day Montana looks at many treasures other than minerals, the industry still remains quite a strong part of the local economy. Thanks to this, you will have the chance to travel to a landmark Signal Peak Coal Mine. Even though this mine uses mainly trains for the transport of coal, truckers play an important part in the area due to hauling of materials to the adjacent Heavy Machine Service, which is used for fixing large dumpers used for extraction in the mine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e46efb25d26146fe348eaf67afae6129d1f99745.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d5e4273ce4a67c122454f8ff7b11c8bd0e932cba.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ffe3baa32acf0856aa63563ea037e71647805ff2.jpg[/img]

Part of the mining industry is also Silene Gas Factory and Talc Factory. We have already touched on these structures in our previous blogs, but it’s important to mention that these depots will be unique and exclusive for Montana. The former was created according to a 1:1 reference, and the latter will be featured in two locations within the state. Both of these factories will offer plenty of job opportunities and materials to haul.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ce6546b788b073d5019468d56b95dfc329fa4d02.jpg[/img]

notes.title: American Truck Simulator - 1.45 Update: Cody and US-14
notes.content:
Despite the fact that our feature-packed 1.44 update was released just weeks ago for both [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2022/05/euro-truck-simulator-2-144-update.html]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] and[url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2022/05/american-truck-simulator-144-update.html] American Truck Simulator[/url], our teams are already working hard to create new content for the 1.45 update for American Truck Simulator, some of which we are thrilled to share with you today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9fa0c968ab5b6a917a23ec1e35580e93a8be1c23.jpg[/img]

[b]The City of Cody[/b]

Step into the world of the Wild West in Cody, a small Wyoming frontier town with immense natural beauty and cultural attractions. Founded by the legendary Colonel William F. "Buffalo Bill" 1896, this Old West town offers an authentic western experience for visitors around the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4aa66a8cfaccddcccda52ed402017ce8c1527f94.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e6311b9c8fcc377af60758d05be0581eb0bb232e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a268ad4024ab39e90f027621805c0d944e47b1f9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/751486a25fc8ef34de88bf726602d64535fbaaed.jpg[/img]

Self-proclaimed as the “Rodeo Capital of the World”, Cody offers drivers the chance to see famous landmarks and attractions such as the Buffalo Bills visitor center and the Rodeo Stadium; and that's not all! Drivers will also be able to discover and deliver to new industries in Cody, a Truck Trailer service, and a Waste Transfer Station too, which are a small taste of what you can expect to find in the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811080/American_Truck_Simulator__Montana/]Montana DLC[/url]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/043b5d3f8489c34588a1542c40a281ce550ca26e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6da12a799f28b9006f579fab8e7dddd4a55828b9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0eef9ede93b899a2a27cd11319db3b820aa8dd68.jpg[/img]

Cody is also known for being the gateway to the Yellowstone National Park. Located 52 miles from the east entrance to the country's first national park, which brings us to our next topic... 

[b]US-14 [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c1bef2da39bc5b10192254745b90266396942f64.jpg[/img]

Beginning at the east entrance to the Yellowstone National Park is U.S Route 14, one of the original United States highways of 1926! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/804bc7f5cafefed0b42a8746e483d817c61078fe.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/043b5d3f8489c34588a1542c40a281ce550ca26e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5d043140e868004c5dd6b2ba7f346edba5734482.jpg[/img]

Drivers will have plenty to see on their drive on US-14, including the Buffalo Bill Reservoir and Dam, Pahashka Teepee, and of course, the stunning scenery and natural beauty that Yellowstone offers its millions of visitors every year. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7a32396456958741f5da93805e92b2687c184e81.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/92fe65bc73dcdf1c98cfd80e5a00cf969e4f3c8f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/89a00287ee4c814f00659c1af0a4805499dcf760.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bc3ede752f72a1351ca1b034f757f7d25b7bedb0.jpg[/img]

From Yellowstone Lake to the hot lava lakes and geysers, drivers will be able to explore even more of this beautiful part of the world. We highly recommend not being tied down with a delivery slot when exploring this area, as you'll want to take your time around here!  

We can't wait for you to explore it for yourselves and like our previous updates, all this content will come free to the owners of Wyoming DLC for American Truck Simulator as part of the 1.45 update. We will be sure to let you know when it will be ready, so make sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/scssoftware]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/SCSSoftware]YouTube[/url].

notes.title: Texas - Water Tanks
notes.content:
What if we told you there is a massive structure type in The Lone Star State with a fairly underrated meaning and purpose that might just go over your head (literally) from time to time? Today, we will draw attention to the local Water Tanks featured in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1465750/American_Truck_Simulator__Texas/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=water_tanks]Texas DLC[/url], so you will always remember to look upwards when passing them by on your trucking journey throughout this wonderful state.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b7f9b30e9e648575099b26739ca6922ac99c2f9a.jpg[/img]

The reason why we have labeled water tanks as "underrated" is that you might think to yourself that they are simply massive storage tanks located at the edge of cities. It is, however, precisely due to their placement within the town area that quite often gives them a purpose of welcome signs as well. This means that they serve as sort of beacons of status and displays of pride in cities and their local citizens. After all, the names are usually written in big, bold letters, so you are always perfectly aware of where exactly you are at that moment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2e6b989bedc5d2f9898f9f2090ecb5953faf1010.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f016e0926c8c8fa4dac5f674613849a0b91f2924.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5f345a5ea8f238e2280ad0a7d7a01c6b085a4d5f.jpg[/img]

And if you were wondering why these structures are built so high above the ground (from 100ft/30m to 200ft/60m in the map expansion), it has a very logical and practical explanation. The height makes good use of gravity in order to provide a pressurized flow of water to the buildings in their surroundings. With some of the tanks dating back more than half a century ago, this is quite a well-thought-out system.

notes.title: Montana - Water Bodies
notes.content:
Imagine a world in which you are driving through a vast and colorful nature of a state, you look out of the window, and you see only fields and forests. While it depends on the situation, in general, this sounds pretty dull, right? Thankfully, the wonderful [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811080/American_Truck_Simulator__Montana/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=water_bodies]Montana DLC[/url] and its environment will offer plenty of variety due to the water bodies, such as rivers, lakes, and dams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1255c43a962c16ae8b81be29af528e46379d122c.jpg[/img]

There are two noteworthy rivers featured in the upcoming map expansion - the Yellowstone River (approximately 692 miles/1,114 km long) and the Missouri River (about 2,341 miles/3,767 km long). While the latter is actually the longest river in the whole US, both of these examples flow through quite a hefty of locations that you will be able to drive through, whether it will be some of the cities, or simply in the open environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/df3fa08d4158bc30a5288a60e954b8a101c12cdb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/18fd8b43a8c3895a9911be3822a4e292c2c17735.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/725ad1446b2c206b14123bb999686158f7996fd9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8a7e8b1d805b8cb8113964ea2240358cc0457836.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3f0804a6567767615850e4d01776add92cddfa4e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7cd2007f4ee6f3c46013fa71825dde287dd9afc1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d68811e45771d42bc473dd180975e5aff3ade4eb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2812b87fbaf60871bbf7bf0d1acd8996973dd9b8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f1707c4d70878b1776c2d4911f1d43b06cfb2887.jpg[/img]

Other water areas that you will be able to pass by are lakes. And trust us, the Flathead Lake, located in northwest Montana, is unlike any other. After all, how often do you hear about a lake covering 197 square miles (510 square km), that has a monster living in its waters?! Indeed, the so-called "Flessie", inspired by Loch Ness "Nessie", is a mythical creature that is supposed to be dwelling in the depths of this lake according to Native American legends and local stories. Well, at least our relaxing truck simulator has zero chance of giving you a serious scare in the form of a beast, or does it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/37bfe8e31fb872bb5f3b61137b9398ad1e16d8a6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e847cf7039091742c7039e3b3b2dedc54ec29f12.jpg[/img]

One more major reservoir to mention is the Fort Peck Lake, which is the fifth largest artificial lake in the US, and it is formed by Fort Peck Dam and the already mentioned Missouri River. The dam actually has quite a popular spillway, which is used as an "overflow" during high water levels. 

And finally, the Lake McDonald (fast food meal not guaranteed), is the largest lake in the Glacier National Park, and it is hardly a surprise the adjacent nature presents a wonderful view for anyone who visits this area. Would you pay this national park a visit if you had the chance?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fdd65cd205dfb3dccdb375ffc8485832337676da.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ac98c1bb378c0aed80accac12edb77396cacdcec.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9b0c5ba4846ab32ffef49d48b9723881edb0ddfd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/67ae5f9e38d948abd64ff6100e1f7c7b9f4703c5.jpg[/img]

We hope you will be able to keep your head above water while driving past all these marvelous places in the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811080/American_Truck_Simulator__Montana/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=water_bodies]Montana DLC[/url] for American Truck Simulator. notes.title: Lode King & Prestige Trailers DLC Release
notes.content:
There were many theories circling around about this potential project for quite a while and today we are truly excited to share the great news with our [b]#BestCommunityEver[/b]. We can now officially announce that we have teamed up with Lode King / Prestige in order to bring their amazing trailers to American Truck Simulator!

[previewyoutube=WA08c5WiPxU;full][/previewyoutube]
Lode King Industries is an extremely popular and reliable Canada-based trailer manufacturer. Since its founding in 1980, the company became one of the most important manufacturers of commercial highway transport trailers and it boasts a strong reputation due to their high-quality product design and highly skilled employees. 

In addition to using the name for a special trailer line, Lode King has also decided to create a company called Prestige, with which they offer their amazing products specially adjusted for the US market and customers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/82ad14fc0ee5562a2e13f8940a10ab17fe799d7d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fa7deca92e3ebd74304e478a2268f0bb1fc3754d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/823ff67efe102068479babb01feb46dc0b4371a0.jpg[/img]

For the Lode King brand, there will be 8 different trailers - 3 drop decks, 3 flatbeds, 2 grain hoppers, with every model of the drop decks and flatbeds having different color styles and unique accessories. The special Prestige line will offer Single and B-double configurations, each with its own unique axle setup.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/eddbc175e6b4024e4811e14612fac9dbda073083.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/262d41e8d0981f52fd626a3eb62f180193ef8e39.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/efe73e7b5bac50328756fc7fa742d93826a904ef.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b1dc49dc3610adcb483f2591aaf9ebabacc6be2a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8210cb0cefcaca8638778434d1fe55abdb4844a3.jpg[/img]

From the Prestige brand, the game will offer 7 trailers - 3 drop decks, 3 flatbeds, 1 grain hopper. The drop decks and flatbeds will have up to 10 different axle configurations, with an option to select one from up to 3 different floor materials.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/65a5c8e95dceb91750742bcad41bd9abd7453626.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Montana: Butte & Port of Montana
notes.content:
Nestled in the Rocky Mountains, between Yellowstone and Glacier National Parks, is the historic mining city of Butte. Previously nicknamed as 'The Richest Hill on Earth', this city once was thriving with industrial activity in the 1800's because of its abundance of mineral wealth. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/725787c1492c0dcb5e557dc4f6fe1c383e5ebea7.jpg[/img]

While many of the mines from the 18th Century no longer operate, many of the old mining towers still stand as reminders of the past across the city. Each one of them are unique, and even have their own names! The downtown portion of Butte is rich in monuments and architectural buildings from the past, which our team have done a great job of recreating for our upcoming Montana DLC for American Truck Simulator. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1dca9cab85f693639f8bf5dc85a71ed74e5a48ab.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6d8fba856688ec957ff0e76eece2016be3fb3b09.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/96851f591859411cfe3d65960d836a8798869149.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f069971c5efbae7552d5a31075f2748339bf4aa7.jpg[/img]

Drivers visiting Butte can find several industries to deliver to and from, including an electric network service and electric substation. One unique industry players will be able to work with is the Port of Montana, which is located nearby Butte. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ca24f9efc79c46fbc5ee0dbc18cb6ff73cfc76d8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7f3365ab91f29d13c0ae32c849a9ef2e79283042.jpg[/img]

The Port of Montana is an industrial transload, distribution and warehousing facility with easy rail and highway access to directly benefit businesses throughout the region. It also include a unique Silene Gas Factory, which has been created according to a 1:1 reference! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/df985c671a91bcd16a9f433e9155bf59b6d76b6c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3af7becb98e021c6c6ac0b565db0feab88cfce54.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/49a33616c7717a6c5e3acbfca4d7cbc1b83bb46c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9a02ede02328cb82bda167e0f6d5eaa09ff8e252.jpg[/img]

With so many reasons to visit Butte, we hope you take a moment to stop by and admire all that it has to offer. Excited? notes.title: American Truck Simulator update 1.44 lets you refund mods
notes.content:
Following several months of preview posts, the big 1.44 update for American Truck Simulator has finally arrived. The update includes a major rework for the state of California, a new system that lets you refund in-game currency used in mods for the trucking game, some enhancements to the UI in the garage, and more.

The big addition in this free update, of course, is phase two of the California rework, which removes the city of San Rafael (sadly enough) but rebuilds Eureka, Ukiah, Sacramento, Redding, and Truckee "from the ground up" to include more local landmarks and architecture.

For modders, there's a handy new feature included in this patch. American Truck Simulator mods frequently add new pieces of equipment to buy in-game, but what happens when you uninstall the mod, or it becomes incompatible with a game update? Until now, you've lost the in-game currency you spent on it, but with update 1.44, American Truck Simulator will recognise when you've lost a piece of equipment this way and give you the option to accept a refund for the amount lost. Nice!

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Texas - Logging Industry
notes.content:
Due to the sheer size of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1465750/American_Truck_Simulator__Texas/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=logging_industry]Texas DLC[/url], driving through the eastern and western parts might sometimes feel like two different sides of one coin. Texas is home to approximately 62 million acres of forestland, so it is probably not a surprise that the logging industry has been in constant development for quite a while - in fact for over 180 years! There are records indicating the existence of sawmills near the Gulf coast and inland around the year 1820, which is truly amazing and it just shows exactly why the industry is contributing quite a lot to the current economy of the state.

notes.title: American Truck Simulator: 1.44 Update Release
notes.content:
We are happy to share with you that the 1.44 update has now been released for American Truck Simulator. This update is packed with new features and changes, so we recommend reading through them all. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d5b2f553f1cebe40a86f97f5ae0ec3f93cc14439.jpg[/img]

We'd like to thank everyone who participated, provided their feedback, and made bug reports during the Open Beta of 1.44. Your valuable input helped us make tweaks, changes and smash some bugs we may have missed the first time around. We hope you can now begin to fully enjoy the various new features which are included within this update.

[previewyoutube=onqw3VhuafA;full][/previewyoutube]
[b][h3]California Rework: Phase 2[/h3][/b]
We are excited to bring Phase 2 of the California Rework as part of this free update for all owners of American Truck Simulator. The focus of this projects sees the cities Eureka, Ukiah, Sacramento, Redding, and Truckee which have been rebuilt from the ground up, along with local landmarks, architecture and surrounding road networks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/41bb7935d9b9984218e4294935d79ea8631b1206.jpg[/img]

We will also be saying goodbye to the city of San Rafael. Due to the map scale, we had to make the hard decision to remove the city from the in-game economy. To make up for this, we will be introducing a brand new city, which will be larger and of much greater importance in California's road network in Phase 3 of our ongoing project! Any guesses which one it might be? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/92707eff410041d73b6044fbaba960282bc38e9b.jpg[/img]

New rest areas and truck stops have also been implemented, but that isn't all! You will also find new assets, vegetation, and textures too, giving the area a completely new look and feel. We can't wait for you to explore it for yourselves. You can read more all about the rework on previous blogposts which have highlighted the cities and more which have been reworked. [b][url=https://blog.scssoft.com/search?q=california&max-results=20&by-date=true]Read more here[/url]. [/b]

[b][h3]Mod Refund Feature[/h3][/b]
Since the introduction of third party modification support in our convoy mode, our team has been working to improve the mod support experience. In this update, we are happy to share a new feature which we hope will further improve players gameplay when playing with modifications. 

We like to call this new addition the 'Mod Refund' feature. In simple terms, after a player has downloaded a third party modification and used it on their truck, they may in the future want to remove it (or it even may have become incompatible). This new feature reads and recognises the data from the modification, even if it has been removed, and refunds the player the difference with the in-game currency. This removes the problem of players losing money after using a modification. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/42efe038462a9ab9bfe04d7e32547ef99cd1473e.jpg[/img]

It works by recognising that a crucial part is missing (such as the chassis, engine etc) and replacing it with a default part. Players will be prompted with a pop-up containing information that some parts are being refunded and will be given the option to accept or reject this refund. If you decide to reject the refund and reactivate the mod instead, the truck will now revert to its former glory even if you have saved the game in the meantime.

So, whether you're trucking with friends in a convoy session with mods, or you want to remove a certain modification after use, this new feature will make sure you won't go out of pocket!

[b][h3]Licensed vs Aftermarket Customization Options in UI[/h3][/b]
Players customising their truck or looking at new parts in the garage may see some new icons appearing in the list. In total we have added 4 new icons to represent what type of accessory it is. When you hover over them, they will show if they are classed as a:

[list]
[*] [b]Factory part[/b] - A stock part sold by the manufacturer (including interiors)
[*] [b]Licensed part[/b] - Anything that is officially licensed that is not produced by truck factory
[*] [b]Aftermarket part[/b] - Any additional accessory that is not related to the brand.
[*] [b]Unknown part[/b] - A part that is not recognised or in some cases, a third party modification.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/334dc08eb8090211865d2eae0335e976d7e71a75.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b1eb601425aec41da8bd4233e9cbe7833af1649e.jpg[/img]

This should help drivers when it comes to customisation if they wish to keep it within the manufacturers customisation options, or tune their truck further with aftermarket parts. We hope you enjoy this small yet helpful feature!

[b][h3]Unmarked Roads Exploration[/h3][/b]
With the 1.44 update, we are bringing into ATS and ETS2 a new feature; once you drive onto an unmarked road, you will be notified about having done so with a message in the route advisor, and the explored road will appear on the map as an orange dashed line, with any unexplored part ahead of you shown in grey. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f0d3005de1fea8423c1c79142bfd66238d2142f3.jpg[/img]

On one hand, this will ensure that you will immediately be aware of the fact that you have found something interesting, and on the other hand, if you ever decide to re-visit a hidden zone you will know where to go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2396a8ebaba5e2831423e4c855f97c4c93ea42bb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2a31aa0181dade9f49fdb3b099f399df3196dd7d.jpg[/img]

Map explorers, do not panic! These unmarked roads do not contribute to your map discovery percentage, but they do add a nice addition to your GPS if you do come across them. You can read more about this new feature [b][url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2022/02/144-unmarked-roads-exploration.html]here[/url]. [/b]

[b][h3]Force Feedback Upgrade[/h3][/b]
This update also includes a few new upgrades to the force feedback experience when playing ATS or ETS2. These changes have been made to represent a more realistic driving experience, which includes:

[list]
[*] New gearbox grind effect simulating vibration of missed gear when using manual shifting.
[*] New understeer slip effect simulating tyre slip when vehicle is understeering
[*] Revisited power steering curves and pressure gain of self centering effect to improve steering feel.
[*] Revisited internal friction force giving better feedback depending on the speed of steering.
[/list]
Since self centering and internal friction were updated[b], we highly recommend that you reset the FFB settings to their defaults again.[/b]

[b][h3]Smart Sequential Shifting[/h3][/b]
Smart Sequential Shifting is now available to truckers, if they wish to enable it via the options. So what does it do? In simple terms, when you shift up or down sequentially, it will automatically shift by more gears at once based on the current torque or speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/17d91c342e3279fa20ded0f372a26c6d317ae3ed.jpg[/img]

For this to work, drivers will still need to trigger the shifting process, but once working, should require less input from the driver. 

[b][h3]Interior Camera Horizontal Lock[/h3][/b]
This new option allows truckers driving in the first person view (in the cabin) to lock the camera view to the horizon, so that it moves more independently from the position of the cabin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4df0b2933aebe5f3543869d4313f050de07455b6.jpg[/img]

With the introduction of this new feature, players can find a slider in the options that defines the locking factor; with the slider being to the left disabling the locking and to the right, being the strongest locking option. 

[b][h3]Adjustable Suspension Height[/h3][/b]
Sometimes, when you are driving a big rig, trailer pick ups can be a bit tricky. Adjustable suspension height should help drivers eliminate the problem of hooking upto sometimes problematic trailers or in difficult pick up/delivery area. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5ae4e0db92e07b5fff805b0f9f949f473571000d.gif[/img]

Drivers now can lower the suspension of their truck to get the correct height for hooking up their trailer, without damaging it. Players will be able to find the inputs for this new adjustable suspension in the options. Its inputs are front up/down and rear up/down. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/899a03d110dec6e3c4cbce7505060099bbb7f68a.jpg[/img]

We have also included a new UI prompt which appears when the drivers are having trouble hooking up their trailers after a few attempts. We hope this makes picking up deliveries of any size easier in the future!

[b][h3]Ownable Drop Deck Trailers[/h3][/b]
In this update, we are happy to introduce a brand new ownable trailer type as well - the drop deck trailer! What makes this trailer special is the fact that it has a lower center of gravity, and it combines the advantages of flatbed and lowboy, which results in a flat surface and a high weight-bearing capacity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/43967a5f45fb53c21d148baa777d8be4682e25c8.jpg[/img]

It is perfect for hauling items and materials such as aircraft engines, backhoe loaders, forklifts and so much more. Also, because drop decks are low, we had to design new small tires, rims, nuts, and hubs, specifically for this trailer type.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/294f4bd8cf4844f45e3c58dde0f28f3b8635682d.jpg[/img]

In addition to having 3 customizable body types (wood floor, aluminum floor, sliding tarp) and 2 different chassis lengths (48ft or 53ft) with a choice of two, three, or four axles, here is a detailed list of everything you will be able to customize:

[list]
[*] Front walls
[*] Wind deflector
[*] Warning flags
[*] Aluminum boxes
[*] Chrome boxes
[*] Side markers
[*] Rear banners (long load, oversize load, wide load)
[*] Rear bumpers
[*] Mudflaps
[/list]
We hope you enjoy trucking with this sturdy, reliable, and practical trailer type in the 1.44 update. 

[b][h3]Cascadia MY2022 Interior Options[/h3][/b]
Among other changes arriving in American Truck Simulator in the 1.44 update, there will also be a rather small addition, that is technically actually bigger than it might seem. We are excited to let you know that we are bringing new interior options for Freightliner Cascadia trucks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0f9938a0e718738209fd61b20b9732c3875eb26d.jpg[/img]

In total, there will be 3 new interior trims added for the Freightliner Cascadia in order to line-up with what they are now offering in real-life. The all-new trim designs will be available in all 4 cabin types. But we have also taken a step further with the 72" cabin versions because these trims will include a table with seats in the back as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6558dc966c22f8567655302921b4bfd674176c11.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy trucking with these new interior options for the Cascadia. You can read more about the arrival of these new customizations at a previous dedicated blogpost [b][url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2022/04/144-my2022-freightliner-cascadia-update.html]here.[/url] [/b]

[b][h3]New Special Transport Routes[/h3][/b]
From oversized cargo to challenging routes, the Special Transport DLC offers players a unique trucking experience; and today we are happy to share that 8 new routes will be arriving to the roads American Truck Simulator in this update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/443afee716c9c176036c5933dbaba507a0c849a0.jpg[/img]

Much like our previous addition of new Special Transport routes to Euro Truck Simulator 2, our team wanted to bring new additional content for our drivers in ATS too! You can find these new contracts between:

[b]Lewiston to Sandpoint
Burlington to Lamar
Salina to Cedar City
Omak to Yakima
Dalles to Salem
Santa Fe to Socorro

Winnemucca to Carson City[/b]

notes.title: Montana - Forestry
notes.content:
With every new map expansion, we are edging closer to realizing complete production chains in the game’s economy. While we are not quite there yet, but important pieces fall into place bit by bit. In the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811080/American_Truck_Simulator__Montana/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=forestry]Montana DLC[/url] for ATS, apart from being able to admire the wonderful local scenery, you will also be able to haul to and from several key points that are part of the forestry process!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/85ebd94db4dec08f065dbe633b0bc3042fc337c6.jpg[/img]

With Montana’s forests covering approximately 26 million acres, it is quite clear why this production cycle deserves to be represented in the economy of the state. Especially since the need for truckers is constantly increasing due to the rapid improvement in technology and productivity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8b5953f3452f6bb2d4224931b2d023d7a79c3fce.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4690f800e0cc2c47beb45c45207fc20caf50a762.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/aae4f2cfb488868dfd2f953c0bd4a0449ac085d2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0372b8af6f4b793eaa8ea067ac00f8c05a0556df.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/82102ca2492e601a078b217a5e7389ef49bb266d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b536987d085bd5aa6b55517100a1cc17eb24a1d9.jpg[/img]

It all begins with the felling of the trees at Timber Harvest, which is probably an area most difficult to reach, as it is often located fairly deep into the woods and only gruesome, dirt roads lead to them. To make matters more challenging, you will have to haul the material through these paths again and head to the Sawmill, a facility where logs are cut into lumber. Afterward, a brand new depot called Landscape Supply comes into play. This area is technically a garden center, that will offer various seeds to be hauled back to Timber Harvest - a step that will make everything come full circle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a55aca2cd725927a6d1312cf978308eb285abb2f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/42731d3155ac78aaf80e0d5a9bfb2fcbbaa19a2b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/534a3f4eae315740417f9acfbb718460919ccf74.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3bcd51ba42ebd3fb85adc9ed8049817239e7ee87.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bcdedb1536f17341009e4342d43742af4bf438ac.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/52132e9e3a8c35699039cc6abe4c4593a9f80b28.jpg[/img]

We hope you have enjoyed the look at the Forestry of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811080/American_Truck_Simulator__Montana/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=forestry]Montana DLC[/url], and we wish you a safe journey hauling between all of these areas, knock on wood. The Treasure State still has a lot of topics to be covered, so if you want to show us your excitement for the next one, make sure to add the map expansion to your Steam Wishlist! Also, to never miss out on anything important, you can also check out our social media profiles ([url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url]) and give them a follow, or [url=https://www.scssoft.com/newsletter]subscribe to our newsletter.[/url]

notes.title: California Rework - Sacramento
notes.content:
We have already shown you several interesting locations on our blog from the upcoming California Rework project for American Truck Simulator. However, today we will present to you the changes of something truly special. After all, every state can only have one capital city, and in this case, it is the well-known city of Sacramento!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/292755465e129025d6bba45a0f24b4db752148cf.jpg[/img]

Sacramento has technically been the capital of California since 1854, so you can clearly see the historical importance that this entire area has nowadays. But, as is often the case, long history goes hand in hand with progress and development of the local industry, therefore, in order to better represent the city’s rich economy in our game, we have decided to not only generally expand it but we are also adding a large logistical park to the southeastern part of the city. Apart from having a very special entrance that will lead to various industrial buildings, such as warehouses, the addition also serves as a great example of our desire to showcase the zoning of cities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c61094d197e0d7f4cfd98a9d99f4657f3e3fcc9d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e9990e3b43752d651bf4fe8ae390f61e1e0a409b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7d511e037f3d5abbc90ac1903146b3434f2d33ed.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b353b0f0a836dc875563666e9b105e45cb478df7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/206cb34b437fd73b40aff57491b44b40c200549d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9c3f04daf8634017b5d680cc60a4e3b2595f30ac.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6551c9c7335b8ff9f129472094b6167e4448b9cf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/93c842a9adf7c907a827494cc466246defeb19b3.jpg[/img]

From the perspective of overall infrastructure, the original layout of the city in the game was doing a fairly insufficient job of representing the real-life counterpart. That is why we have made several corrections to the junctions and the road layout, and hopefully, all those who are familiar with Sacramento in the real world will now see the similarities. This road network change has also presented an opportunity the add a part of the long request US 50 road, which we are planning on further extending in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c969eacfe610f4ca2048cdee72ea3d365ea7dfd6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0de1ea37acc91a6c00e9e99b6671455841df7491.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bcc277a7a1eb59d041366508417190f2dd892309.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/419dd2b22fef813f5939ac1aa6ef333ed825f4bf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/44977280ea400ec8a2b516fff46b119f94a7f397.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7112d22cf4d9fab3be4a5e882eda5dc6f932c1b4.jpg[/img]

The updated scale of the city will cover almost four times the size of the original one, which also means an addition of several new landmark buildings, small details around the center, and even an opportunity to spot a landmark tram on a specific location! And an interesting fact for those who are familiar with the real location, we've included a famous truck stop as well!

Finally, the reworked downtown is going to receive a great improvement as well, and it will be really close to a 1:1 scale. Your experience of entering the city from this side will also further be enhanced by several new in-game assets, which were specifically designed for this area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/20ffa49fd9ed7ca9ade35abecf85ad3faa0f34f0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e30b82dc05bc5e510044b224c142b3978de6a2a3.jpg[/img]
