[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/437c343f59e2136a56740597051ff2ed7e8cd7fe.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/437c343f59e2136a56740597051ff2ed7e8cd7fe.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/3d64239a316f52d4be7dfc5c8d31a550dbe63871.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/3d64239a316f52d4be7dfc5c8d31a550dbe63871.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/68947e866608e84f60d84a296ce45ba0156f6014.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/68947e866608e84f60d84a296ce45ba0156f6014.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/1e53c30e06128729ecc44e9d10566f09df4e5a7b.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/1e53c30e06128729ecc44e9d10566f09df4e5a7b.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/058d1fcbef8f8fc99fc7d41e43800e01ab8b75d6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/058d1fcbef8f8fc99fc7d41e43800e01ab8b75d6.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/b792aa0351a1650402760c7369c63254ef142b82.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/b792aa0351a1650402760c7369c63254ef142b82.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
When all the internal light computations are done, we have to adjust the resulting values for the screen by emulating camera [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exposure_(photography)]exposure[/url]. Much like a modern camera in your mobile phone, we need to take all the rich values and variety of incoming light - sun or shade, early morning, high noon, dusk, or deep night - and "squish" or "expand" the values into the range appropriate for the screen. Our exposure emulation system has a critical impact on the final look and feel of the game - it's partly physics, but also partly about a subjective artistic feeling too. It has to be adjusted dynamically not just based on incoming light from the game world, but it also has to take into account the difference between the light inside and outside of a vehicle's cabin, to allow dashboard instruments to be legible. The human eye is an incredible creation, able to adjust and adapt to a vast range of light intensities as focus switches between objects. We had to use a lot of smart math when analyzing the light [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Histogram]histogram[/url] for each frame and between frames to fit all these values into the screen's inevitably limited dynamic range and [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gamut]color gamut[/url], in order to make everything that's portrayed both believable and discernible. Some improvements were a cherry on top, like the fact that with the internal range of floating-point buffers of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cube_mapping]cube maps[/url], we can have much shinier reflections off of glossy surfaces, such as water bodies, glass, or car paint. We have followed this development path in a small team happily until the realization that while the intermedia results were promising, we won't be able to pull this off without re-balancing ALL the existing materials/textures on all game objects. When a ray of light is cast on the surface of any object, what is reflected or refracted depends not just on the properties of the incoming light, but largely on the properties of the object's surface. Over the many years of development, we have accumulated tens of thousands of textures, some from photographic sources at various settings, some painted by hand, some through the process of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Procedural_generation]procedural generation[/url] in various smart tools. As the years went by, the authoring of these sources has been subject to various schools of thought, or different creation pipelines, but the "old light" system was held together by the proverbial duct tape and was in any case imprecise enough to reveal certain imbalances that were present. The new exposure emulation system is way more sensitive and simply requires physically correct brightness [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albedo]albedo[/url] values. Our concrete surface can no longer be [i]some[/i] sort of grey, and a tree cannot just be [i]nice and green[/i]. And that was when a vast majority of our art team had to be involved for a major overhaul.

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/c8e0ec2281322946a5f2d71ced6e37779f2c7ba5.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/c8e0ec2281322946a5f2d71ced6e37779f2c7ba5.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/dd4c81bbf964e564aa812886b8350c176b9bed3d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/dd4c81bbf964e564aa812886b8350c176b9bed3d.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/31a3d0ea766b47dd6b391181184fd9d1a3da5886.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/31a3d0ea766b47dd6b391181184fd9d1a3da5886.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/059f68770d6bdec0c35117234b715d0bcb588d5c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/059f68770d6bdec0c35117234b715d0bcb588d5c.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/a5d771e426ddbf760c6c41677acd9c8c2f04a78a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/a5d771e426ddbf760c6c41677acd9c8c2f04a78a.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/a1fc4d074d3f35887ba518eaa47112a8c6bfc08a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/a1fc4d074d3f35887ba518eaa47112a8c6bfc08a.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/7ebf5ffae4810fbed1832f77697d6830950962a5.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/7ebf5ffae4810fbed1832f77697d6830950962a5.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/aace537aadd05b4c2a934e018895b2950b38df79.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/aace537aadd05b4c2a934e018895b2950b38df79.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
[h3][b]What had to be changed?[/b][/h3]
Once our small pioneering cross-discipline team implemented all of the necessary code and GPU [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shader]shader[/url] changes, which took many months of experimentation, we had to involve a lot more people. First, we had to readjust all the light sources in the world and any vehicle lights to the new logic. In some cases, it was a relatively trivial numeric conversion somewhere in a table. In others, it may have required a map designer to revisit a particular location to make the manual adjustment. In many cases, it meant that a game object like a whole factory or delivery yard with pre-defined light sources had to be re-opened, adjusted, and re-exported again in a 3D tool like Maya. We are talking thousands and thousands of such retouches, in some cases involving not just a few dozen "numbers" defining lights, but also major changes to [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lightmap]lightmaps[/url] of the objects, where fake shadows and light effects were "baked in" for a better look in the old light system. Finally, for some weeks, the majority of all our teams had to stop working on anything else related to our future projects, and go over all the game objects, vegetation, vehicles, and effects; re-balancing things, again and again, to sync them on a shared agreed-upon albedo reference table. We had to revisit the fundamentals of many sub-systems, very notably the vehicle lights and bulbs taking many iterations and fine-tuning to make them look good at various daylight settings. We have a new set of skyboxes at a higher resolution, and a slightly richer variety of weather, too. Ultimately, no stone was left unturned, as we had to evaluate and adjust every single element of the games.

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/7172b84035ba21ffe8359f48f824e967bd4e9678.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/7172b84035ba21ffe8359f48f824e967bd4e9678.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/fba1de0f3a97ab6b62da2e4a63aba3d3d5b27c52.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/fba1de0f3a97ab6b62da2e4a63aba3d3d5b27c52.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/840b201dea51d5013c616fcd2dbbe318f30f1479.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/840b201dea51d5013c616fcd2dbbe318f30f1479.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/d6265e801abb7d40e2500077ba5805167af67c78.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/d6265e801abb7d40e2500077ba5805167af67c78.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
[h3][b]What does this all mean?[/b][/h3]
The new light system and the start of our new physical light model is a critical step towards a complete and better physical model of the whole world in our games. We are not quite there yet with true [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Physically_based_rendering]physically based rendering[/url], but the 1.40 update represents a major step in the right direction. Cleaning up the old art and basing all light intensities and operations on fundamental physics make future systemic work in this area finally possible. As with many things in long-term development, while this step is a minor revolution, it is at the same time only a milestone towards a bigger vision. 

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/65b98b2b6567d916d9f3b312cb9e7d33c1e415b2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/65b98b2b6567d916d9f3b312cb9e7d33c1e415b2.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/9ab7b10c26680f88ed4846fcede878d2526782aa.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/9ab7b10c26680f88ed4846fcede878d2526782aa.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
From the graphics artists' point of view (but this applies to mod authors, too!), we are introducing a new concept of creating and keeping all game art "in check" and in balance with the rest of the art. Materials based on photos, frequently used as sources of in-game art, now have to go through a calibration process before they are applicable, otherwise one may end up with a surface that is either too dark or too bright, affecting the exposure and the perception of the general scene. Often, it's worth exploring alternate material creation methods, like the high-resolution procedural generation in tools like Substance Designer. More trust is placed into the engine's rendering system now; rather than faking and baking subtle shadows and light effects into models. Between new light and SSAO, our shader code now plays a greater part in creating the final look; this results in a bit less responsibility, control, and possibly work from the artist. This may be both good and bad depending on what one is trying to achieve in each particular case.

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/7dfbe433c18991f601dacbf70ff44b435de117f5.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/7dfbe433c18991f601dacbf70ff44b435de117f5.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/7cb44e677d964c5789819cefdef1f9a6cc13b6c2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/7cb44e677d964c5789819cefdef1f9a6cc13b6c2.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
As with each major change, there were a ton of teething problems, a lot of dead-ends to reverse from, and the amount of effort we have been through far exceeded the expectations we had a year ago. We still have a bit of Open Beta ahead of us to iron out the last few wrinkles. But even now, we are very confident that the changes are worth all the hard work. Just wait until you drive your truck in the early morning hours along with the coast of Italy, or on a nice late afternoon in Sweden, in a drizzle in Washington state, during scorching noon in Spain, or pulling into a well-lit truck stop deep into the night. Through all the process of changes, we tried our best not to cause any major increase in the load on the CPU or GPU. A few of the new effects have a slightly higher performance cost, but overall we believe the changes are very well balanced, or allow for sensible trade-offs in game options, to keep the performance acceptable. We definitely do not want to lose players and fans that play our games without the newest hardware by pushing too hard on graphical effects. We are looking forward to bringing you further improvements and new features, so hold on to your steering wheels!

More of a fan of changelogs? Let's look at:

[b]The major internal changes[/b]
[list]
[*] The scene is lit using real-life intensities (illumination: tens of thousands of lux for the daytime,  tens of lux at night) 
[*] To get light ratios into play - the rising sun overpowering street lamp lights and truck headlights, etc. This means we had to adjust all light sources and also readjust every emissive material in the game.
[*] We have a new display mapping function for better artistic control (exposure, contrast, toe, shoulder) 
[*] We needed to get those real-life intensities onto the computer screen in a similar way as a camera's exposure works. 
[*] Improved and more sensitive histogram for exposure selection
[*] This is due to the actual exposure being selected differently in every scene, and this varies also with differing light levels and the current weather type. 
[*] Light source (street lamps, vehicle lights) changes. 
[*] We have switched light sources to a more physical attenuation ('inverse square falloff'). 
[*] We are in the process of switching to a physical-unit-based configuration to reduce guesswork. 

[b]But also many smaller visual tweaks [/b]
[*] Relightable reflection 
[*] Reflections in shop windows and smooth surfaces better matches the time of day and weather 
[*] Improved reflection behavior 
[*] On truck paint, shop windows, and glass in general 
[*] Sun horizon shadow
[*] Visible when the sun rises or sets 
[*] And a zillion other small tweaks, fixes, and changes.
[/list]

As you can imagine by now - all this has been a tremendous amount of work for our team. The initial bright spark (pun intended) that made this all possible came from a small team of programmers and a visual effects artist (pictured below). They have kept hacking, iterating, and laying out plans until the whole team had it "[i]easy[/i]", and all that was left to do was just to throw in many years of additional man-hours to adjust everything to the new logic. 

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/fce158b569f6841c8557632dce802a404ac8310c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/fce158b569f6841c8557632dce802a404ac8310c.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/e9cd4fd41619009c0d9f59a40a977c37b23ecf5d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/e9cd4fd41619009c0d9f59a40a977c37b23ecf5d.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/f3ae732a7c809c0db5b20ea5381dbfa4d47f8948.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/f3ae732a7c809c0db5b20ea5381dbfa4d47f8948.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
The new light system, just as the implementation of FMOD support for the SFX part of our games, is still under further development, polishing, and tuning. And there is still a lot of work ahead of us. At this juncture, we feel that it's already more or less in a presentable shape, and you may experience it too if you decide to give it a try in an open beta build right now on Steam.

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/d73e366d630246284ebacc515d2d5331c930b3fc.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/d73e366d630246284ebacc515d2d5331c930b3fc.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/c0b136b285bb933c4703e4f7611ee69a60ad483a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/c0b136b285bb933c4703e4f7611ee69a60ad483a.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/c20c12dba61a20da4b34ced9a5e36bc6fd74f152.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/c20c12dba61a20da4b34ced9a5e36bc6fd74f152.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/ea8daad2f8f8229e0bc150ba54f44c1be3036b91.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/ea8daad2f8f8229e0bc150ba54f44c1be3036b91.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
So please, if you'd like to help us - put on your favorite sunglasses and help us catch the perfect sunrise! We're looking forward to reading your thoughts and opinions on the new light system. Thank you very much!

notes.title: The next American Truck Simulator DLC is Texas, but it's too big for a release date
notes.content:
American Truck Simulator's next DLC will continue the game's slow journey east with a stop in the Lone Star State. Yes, Texas is coming to ATS, and yes, it's coming all at once. If you're not familiar with North American geography, Texas is huge - much bigger than any other DLC state released to date - and thus the devs at SCS Software aren't quite sure when the state will launch.

Texas is currently "very early in development," the devs say in the announcement. "Being one of the largest U.S states, it will bring its own challenges during the various stages of production. Whilst we know many of you are very excited about this HUGE addition to American Truck Simulator, we cannot commit to a release date that is within the year."

Don't expect Texas to launch any time soon, but there are plenty of gorgeous early images in the blog above, as well as on the expansion's newly-listed Steam page. Wyoming is still set to arrive before Texas, so your virtual US will be getting a little bit bigger in the relatively near future.

Read the rest of the story...

American Truck Simulator reveals Wyoming DLC and graphics overhaul
You can now fill your American Truck Simulator cab with fuzzy dice and fast food wrappers
American Truck Simulator's Colorado DLC tops the Steam top seller chart

notes.title: Introducing Texas
notes.content:
With all the excitement surrounding the development and upcoming release of Iberia and Heart of Russia, we thought we'd share some news for our American drivers too! Today, we are happy to officially announce the development of an upcoming DLC which we originally showcased and teased during our most recent [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8M1vBAIwz0w]Christmas Special Stream[/url]. Please give a big howdy to... 

[h2][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1465750/American_Truck_Simulator__Texas/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=texas_announcement]Texas for American Truck Simulator[/url][/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9a80d342b5e32f2cb6bca5a3c297282af14eafe8.jpg[/img]

As the second-largest U.S state both by area and population, the Lone Star State offers a wealth of unique attractions and landmarks for visitors and residents alike. From the cities to the coastal beaches, mountains, and desert, Texas is both geographically and culturally diverse. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ee727024589e57b0ba41ae72ffb40aecd4734a78.jpg[/img]

Texas is also one of the top U.S states for business! Texas boasts the second largest economy in the U.S., behind only the State of California, with an enormous number of companies and industries. From livestock to energy and aeronautics, Texas has plenty of jobs to keep drivers out delivering on the roads all year round.

We are excited to confirm that we have two U.S. states under full production, as our production pipeline continues to speed up and our team grows. Whilst the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1415692/American_Truck_Simulator__Wyoming/]Wyoming DLC[/url] is a little further along production-wise, it should be emphasized that the Texas DLC is still very early in development. Being one of the largest U.S states, it will bring its own challenges during the various stages of production. Whilst we know many of you are very excited about this HUGE addition to American Truck Simulator, we cannot commit to a release date that is within the year.

notes.title: Wyoming: Industries
notes.content:
From towering, snow-capped mountain ranges to world-famous national parks, Wyoming is a state of rugged natural beauty. Whilst admiring the scenery on your delivery, it's important to remember the reason for your journey! Let's take a closer look at some of the key industries that will be featured in our upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1415692/American_Truck_Simulator__Wyoming/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=wyo_industries]Wyoming DLC[/url] for American Truck Simulator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/904cbea612dfc1c38b1a842688697a98e35248bb.jpg[/img]

Before we dive deep into this topic, we'd love to remind here that the Wyoming DLC is still in a very early phase and that everything shown here is still very much in a 'Work in Progress' stage, as you can probably tell from the screenshots below. But we thought it might be good to let you know how some of the prefabs look like when they are being created. As you will see on some of the shots here, our teams use special markers placed on them to decide where future job trailers will be spawned (green), and where the parking options are, with red for the most difficult one, yellow for medium difficulty, and blue for the easy parking option.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/160472714a7b92cd8f491e3bdd4f2843943c59b4.jpg[/img]

As one of the least populous and least densely populated states in the United States, Wyoming has a lot of open lands. This makes it a perfect location for the agriculture industry, which is of the state's largest contributors to the local economy. 

While crops, fruits, and vegetables make up a large percentage of this industry, the production of beef is the largest part of Wyoming's agriculture sector. Many of the cattle are usually sold and exported around the world from Livestock auction houses, which will be one of the new industries arriving to Wyoming for American Truck Simulator. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4fcc53647745b5bef8db78e08701339438c7aafd.jpg[/img]

Another form of logistics that is prominent across the state is the railroad. Wyoming railroads date back to the Union Pacific when the railroad reached the state’s eastern fringes in 1862; today, these serve as an important connection within the United States. Drivers will be able to contribute to the maintenance of the locomotives that serve the railways as you deliver important rail parts to and from the Rail Supply Depot, as-well delivering and picking up cargo from the freight trains that arrive daily. 

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e7f8b1234f8163b82738e209ed4fb2c8ec0d7901.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e7f8b1234f8163b82738e209ed4fb2c8ec0d7901.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/59a838f0d3be67d1f7256fa1fa0c670a489901b5.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/59a838f0d3be67d1f7256fa1fa0c670a489901b5.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b660383e58328e0056d1c77509073745fbe36731.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b660383e58328e0056d1c77509073745fbe36731.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
The mineral extraction industry is Wyoming’s most important industry. The industry remains a major economic driver of the state and is one of the top contributors to the local economy. One such example that will be included in our Wyoming DLC will be the Soda Ash Mine located near Rock Springs. This has been created as a replica of our reference. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c454ecb1a59b8b56ff97b98444aff10bedafa31b.jpg[/img]

Chemical plants and quarries will also be other locations where drivers can pick up and deliver various parts and materials from. These loading points are always located on the edge of the refinery or quarry to keep drivers safely away from the active mining areas. 

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fe54482046504af891590ddf7b76679e5ff9e4f8.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fe54482046504af891590ddf7b76679e5ff9e4f8.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/90b17c93627bbd148de7cad558566d9112a0bd20.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/90b17c93627bbd148de7cad558566d9112a0bd20.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

Another type of vehicle you'll find working around the quarries are dump trucks. Drivers will have the opportunity to haul dump truck parts and bodies to and from a manufacturer to industries that require their use! 

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3027532088e9ffef196c25e33288e5b108f2075e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3027532088e9ffef196c25e33288e5b108f2075e.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3020099f7f17a4345074904afaf9b25a11f09c2e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3020099f7f17a4345074904afaf9b25a11f09c2e.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e7ab567d4209cdc2767e5932a7e231fd5927e5ff.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e7ab567d4209cdc2767e5932a7e231fd5927e5ff.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
These are just a handful of the many industries you'll be able to discover and deliver to and from in our upcoming Wyoming DLC for American Truck Simulator! We look forward to sharing more development updates with you in the near future, but until then, make sure to add Wyoming to your Steam Wishlist! It really helps support the development and release of our expansions, thank you. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1415692/American_Truck_Simulator__Wyoming/

notes.title: #HaulingHope Event Conclusion
notes.content:
Towards the end of January, we introduced to you #HaulingHope, a World of Trucks event focused on recognizing the selfless drivers and support crews that are working hard to deliver COVID-19 vaccines around the world. Today, after an event extension and over a month later, hundreds of thousands of truckers from our Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator community have participated in this special and memorable event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/b06fe27840c24a04e9ecc331a80074a0ed4886c2.jpg[/img]

The task was to complete 7 deliveries, undamaged, using our special #HaulingHope trailers, which many of you achieved in the first few days of the event! For us, this was an inspiration, as we always love to see how the community comes together for these special events, especially when centres around such an important subject. We thank you for joining us in paying tribute to those around the world working hard, day and night, to deliver everything from important life-saving equipment to our groceries, during this challenging time. 

So, how far did our drivers travel during this unique event? Let's take a look at some of the stats!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/cd8d30c91975f9a6c47d2cdf10fc2a49ec3e88df.jpg[/img]

Incredible work truckers! We cannot thank you enough for your support. It really does bring a lot of joy to our team to see how much you enjoy participating in these events. We hope you ride with pride with your newly acquired and well-deserved Hope Trucker Hanging Accessories.

notes.title: #HaulingHope Extended!
notes.content:
Dear #BestCommunityEver, we trust you all gained some well earned relaxation this weekend, and with today being Monday, we thought we’d kick it off with some good news. Although the fight against COVID-19 continues, the worldwide vaccine rollout is now entering full swing, and so is our [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2021/01/hauling-hope-event.html]#HaulingHope[/url] event! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/f275001b7a933cb39b78279bf6c752fe95d63bea.jpg[/img]

So far, almost 100,000 American Truck Simulator and Euro Truck Simulator 2 truckers have reached their personal goal of 7 deliveries in our special #HaulingHope event, with thousands more already past the halfway mark - so close. Not to mention our social media profiles are still receiving a lot of amazing posts under the #HaulingHope event. 

So, in an effort to give those players some more time to finish their personal goal, and continue our salute to the real truckers and support crews out there on the front line, [b]we’ve decided to extend the #HaulingHope event until Monday 15th February 23:59 UTC![/b]

With the exciting release of the Western Star® 49X in September 2020, we mentioned that 'larger sleeper variants will be added in time' and today; we are excited to share with you those said updates and more that have been rolled out with the 1.40 Beta for American Truck Simulator.

[previewyoutube=_3K_4SsxbLc;full][/previewyoutube]

If you were in the co-driver seat on our special Western Star® 49X Update stream yesterday, then you already know what new options and awesome parts are coming for this truck. But if you have missed our live session full of fun, jokes but also a lot of in-depth info on this truck - don't fret because you can watch its recording right now on our YouTube channel.

notes.title: American Truck Simulator 1.40 Open Beta
notes.content:
We love to bring you new game updates, especially when they contain some cool features that have been requested for a long time! Today, we are happy to share with you that the 1.40 Update Open Beta for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=1_40_ob]American Truck Simulator[/url] is now ready to be tested and tried-out by our community!

However, please keep in mind that this is the first iteration of the open beta, which is still very much a work-in-progress build. If you want to take it for a spin, you can help contribute by reporting any bugs you may encounter in the appropriate section of our official forums. Your feedback and reports are extremely valuable for our team and we thank you in advance for taking the time to help us out.

[b]Please bear in mind that this huge update will likely render many community MODs incompatible. MOD authors may need to adjust and update their mods to work with this update. We strongly recommend that you use a profile without any third-party modifications if you wish to participate in the 1.40 Open Beta. [/b]

So, let's take a look at what the 1.40 update has in store!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bd26368d5d5ae456ccba6d22e73983f0144f1bfc.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Visual Lighting System[/h2]
One of the biggest changes you'll notice when you first hop into your truck cab is the implementation of our new visual lighting system. However, this isn't just a simple change of our skyboxes; our new light system is fully dynamic and can now change not just according to current weather, but also based on simulated camera exposure taking into account not just current daylight intensity and weather, but also surface properties of game world elements in the view.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/40d8eac5d9af9f54a03385c93356544fa6239af9.jpg[/img]

This new light system and the start of our new physical light model is a very important step towards a complete and better physical model of the whole world in our game, and how real it looks and works. All of our lighting is now based on real physical ratios and units, to make it as realistic as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7b905deeb8395bc6ec23487305f0fcaada4d6171.jpg[/img]

To prepare for this new light system, our teams had to make a lot of changes to existing in-game world objects; including a majority of the in-game assets, textures, and materials to better work with the new physical model of the new light system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b9de8c9f83b83e4a5ff91e128c19d36ee764e42c.jpg[/img]

We are very excited for you to be able to experience and immerse yourself in driving in the new light. The result is the combination of thousands of hours by our programmers and visual effect artists and many other teams involved in the creation process of this new system. 

During this open beta, your feedback is incredibly important and valuable to us, so we ask that you please submits yours to us in the 1.40 section for American Truck Simulator on our forums which you can find [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=279]here[/url]. 

[h2]Extended Chassis update[/h2]
For the 5th anniversary of American Truck Simulator, we wanted to bring a heavily-requested feature to our community to celebrate its progress and journey so far! This suggestion has always frequently appeared in our suggestions pile, and today we are thrilled to bring you an extended chassis range to all current truck models.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/080f62e146715ac6149a06958b5c4ba257ac4ebe.jpg[/img]

Our vehicle team has worked hard to bring you a range of long and short chassis types, allowing you to customize your truck for the job at hand. This update will feature 4x2, 8x4, and 8x6 chassis types which are used for a range of different trailers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/06942a4093771806bc133681cbcaaaa2b8532eb4.jpg[/img]

4x2s, also known as single-axle trucks, are frequently used for local distribution deliveries by supermarkets and by logistic companies for hauling doubles. 8x4 and 8x6 chassis are the big guns of the heavy-haul industry and can handle just about any load you decide to take on. All of these new options bring more variety to you, the driver! So we hope you enjoy this surprise addition to 1.40.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0852b2ad6bf1f15d7d48a746d22e894e4d3e5f9a.jpg[/img]

Here's a full list of all the new extended chassis options now available in the open beta:
[list]
[*] Freightliner Cascadia: Day cab 4x2
[*] Mack Anthem: Day cab 4x2
[*] International LoneStar: Day cab & Sleepers 8x4
[*] Peterbilt 389: Day cab & Sleepers 8x4 & 8x6
[*] Volvo VNL: Day cab 4x2, Day cab & Sleepers 8x4
[*] Peterbilt 579: Day cab 4x2
[*] Kenworth W900: Day cab & Sleepers 8x4 & 8x6
[*] Kenworth T680: Day cab 4x2
[*] Western Star 49X: Day cab & Sleepers 8x4 & 8x6
[/list]

[h2][b]Western Star 49X Update:[/b][/h2]

With the exciting release of the Western Star® 49X in September 2020, we are happy to share with you that with the arrival of 1.40 for American Truck Simulator; the 49X will receive 2 sleeper cabin options as well as a lot of other new options. In fact, this truck just became the one with the most chassis options available, with up to 36 possible chassis/cabin/fuel-tank combinations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ce5a5283bd5100d885fd01b30768a083d11d2370.jpg[/img]

We have just finished covering and showing the options which are coming for this truck in our special live stream on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/scssoftware]Twitch[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]Steam[/url], and [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCb9XDB0X13EEqUqCSsOhonQ]YouTube[/url]. Don't fret if you've missed it, as you can always watch it again on our official YouTube channel. Additionally, we will be releasing a dedicated blog post in the near future with more information, images, and also a very cool video; be sure to keep an eye out for it!

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e896ac64bed722d381b149e095168cb0e98f902f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e896ac64bed722d381b149e095168cb0e98f902f.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/010470f77a49a6230e37ee7d8e6333f748f6eda6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/010470f77a49a6230e37ee7d8e6333f748f6eda6.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/df295e8daa497c78c1fe5e6e631c115c7f3884f6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/df295e8daa497c78c1fe5e6e631c115c7f3884f6.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

Plus, if you are very eager to check out the new updates, be sure to join the 1.40 Open Beta and check it out for yourself!  

[h2]New Mexico & Oregon DLC Viewpoints[/h2]

Back in October last year, American Truck Simulator saw the arrival of viewpoints to the states of Washington and Utah after their popular debut in Idaho! Today we are happy to share with you that 1.40 sees the introduction of new viewpoints to the states of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/684630/American_Truck_Simulator__New_Mexico/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=1_40_ob]New Mexico[/url] & [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/800370/American_Truck_Simulator__Oregon/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=1_40_ob]Oregon[/url]. 

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1f232f726f9dac290879e9248a002059d77f2ea2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1f232f726f9dac290879e9248a002059d77f2ea2.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/42999a592ffb41d2f778ae669af24dea83ad08a5.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/42999a592ffb41d2f778ae669af24dea83ad08a5.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

For newer players of our titles, Viewpoints are certain spots found across the map, where drivers can activate a special in-game cutscene with a short showcase of a near location or place of interest.  These can be found displayed as a grey question mark on your GPS, so be sure to stop and discover them on your journeys. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e9e54b7292cdaceaea9e022c0d79243120155847.jpg[/img]

You also have the option to skip the viewpoint or replay it if you wish to watch it again. From populated cities to historic monuments, each viewpoint highlights a point of interest or industry, so make sure to discover them all!  

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[b]Visual:[/b]
New Visual Lighting System
[b]Map: [/b]
New Viewpoints in New Mexico & Oregon DLC's
[b]Vehicles:[/b] 
New 4x2, 8x4, and 8x6 chassis
Western Star 49X update including sleeper variants and Set-Back configurations 

[b]So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an experimental open beta, not a stable public version - so you may encounter bugs, instability, kinks, or crashes. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to move there faster, we'll appreciate all of your feedback on our forum and your bug reports in [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=279]this section[/url].[/b]

[b]Please check our modding wiki to get details pertaining to mods for the game.[/b]

[b]If you wish to participate in the open beta, you can find this version in the public_beta branch on Steam. The way to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right-click on American Truck Simulator → Properties → Betas tab → public_beta → 1.40. No password required.[/b]

notes.title: American Truck Simulator 5th Anniversary: Chassis Update
notes.content:
Happy 5th Birthday [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=ats_5_anniversary]American Truck Simulator[/url]! It's incredible how time has flown since we released this newer trucking title in February 2016. Since that time we are proud to have brought you 9 U.S States (California, Nevada, Arizona, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/684630/American_Truck_Simulator__New_Mexico/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=ats_5_anniversary]New Mexico[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/800370/American_Truck_Simulator__Oregon/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=ats_5_anniversary]Oregon[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015160/American_Truck_Simulator__Washington/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=ats_5_anniversary]Washington[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104880/American_Truck_Simulator__Utah/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=ats_5_anniversary]Utah[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209470/American_Truck_Simulator__Idaho/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=ats_5_anniversary]Idaho[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209471/American_Truck_Simulator__Colorado/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=ats_5_anniversary]Colorado[/url]) with 2 more in development, 7 major truck brands, and 13 DLC's such as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477840/American_Truck_Simulator__Cabin_Accessories/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=ats_5_anniversary]Cabin Accessories[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962750/American_Truck_Simulator__Special_Transport/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=ats_5_anniversary]Special Transport[/url]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/080f62e146715ac6149a06958b5c4ba257ac4ebe.jpg[/img]

To celebrate this special occasion, we wanted to bring a heavily-requested feature to our community to celebrate its progress and journey so far! This suggestion has always frequently appeared in our suggestions pile and today, we are happy to announce that American Truck Simulator will receive new chassis options for all current trucks in the upcoming 1.40 update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0852b2ad6bf1f15d7d48a746d22e894e4d3e5f9a.jpg[/img]

Our vehicle team has worked hard to bring you a range of long and short chassis types, allowing you to customize your truck for the job at hand. This update will feature 4x2, 8x4, and 8x6 chassis types which are used for a range of different trailers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/cfe84c55d169b42d881e587318e2e26aef687369.jpg[/img]

4x2s, also known as single-axle trucks, are frequently used for local distribution deliveries by supermarkets and by logistic companies for hauling doubles. 

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/cbd6a6b615eed7ad9311ae17cee954e6bd446234.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/cbd6a6b615eed7ad9311ae17cee954e6bd446234.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]

[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/668128d8dced5595ef0827379229d8d768db0fc8.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/668128d8dced5595ef0827379229d8d768db0fc8.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

8x4 and 8x6 chassis are the big guns of the heavy-haul industry and can handle just about any load you decide to take on. 

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e7ef8fa1e1abe1e346b0d08725cd76e627e02b88.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e7ef8fa1e1abe1e346b0d08725cd76e627e02b88.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]

Interested to know the details of what chassis types each truck will be receiving? Here's a full list of all the new extended chassis options coming to our range of trucks in American Truck Simulator:

[list][*]Freightliner Cascadia: Day cab 4x2[/*][*]Mack Anthem: Day cab 4x2[/*][*]International LoneStar: Day cab & Sleepers 8x4[/*][*]Peterbilt 389: Day cab & Sleepers 8x4 & 8x6[/*][*]Volvo VNL: Day cab 4x2, Day cab & Sleepers 8x4[/*][*]Peterbilt 579: Day cab 4x2[/*][*]Kenworth W900: Day cab & Sleepers 8x4 & 8x6[/*][*]Kenworth T680: Day cab 4x2[/*][*]Western Star 49X: Day cab 8x4 & 8x6[/*][/list]
All of these new options bring more variety to you, the driver! So we hope you enjoy this surprise addition to 1.40. We want to also take a moment to thank every single member of our community for your on-going support for American Truck Simulator! We look forward to bringing you even more content and updates in the near future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/38daa6752dec601e1f0038edeb1079a69c12f3d2.jpg[/img]

But that isn't all! Tonight we will be hosting a special 5th Anniversary Live-Stream where we will be giving you a first look at these new chassis options and celebrating with you, the community, with giveaways and more! You can join us live from 6pm CET on either [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]Steam[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/scssoftware]Twitch[/url], or [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCb9XDB0X13EEqUqCSsOhonQ]YouTube[/url]! We hope to see you there.

notes.title: Hauling Hope Event
notes.content:
Virtual Truckers of the world, we are all still enduring hard times, as the world continues to battle COVID-19. The fight is not over, but we can see light at the end of the tunnel, we see hope in the creation of the COVID-19 Vaccines and their rapid worldwide roll-out. We would like to, once again, recognise the selfless drivers and support crews working so incredibly hard to achieve this goal. So, we are inviting you to take part in personally delivering these vaccines, across any and all trucking territories in the World of Trucks Hauling Hope[ event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/9a878b68fab38052e4e639252072a71f1cf13262.jpg[/img]

Last year, [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2020/03/truckathome-event.html]in March[/url], we asked you all to respond in the way we thought best, which was to take part in the unprecedented #TruckAtHome event. The community effort was incredible, it was at a level of participation that we had never seen before. We celebrated with you all further, by delivering financial support and supplies directly to those on the front line, for each new milestone that the community reached.

This time, it will be your own personal journey. Our slogan is [u]#HaulingHope[/u], and the goal is for you to deliver this fragile and precious cargo undamaged, so you will need to be extra careful when making your delivery. The cargo will have a zero-damage tolerance and will require a Fragile Cargo skill, level 1, to be carried.

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/95d5919b1111d1b0cf32a0127a7263372df0ffd1.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/95d5919b1111d1b0cf32a0127a7263372df0ffd1.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/6027a4349bca31e8e8196c9a344ab848a5847c6a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/6027a4349bca31e8e8196c9a344ab848a5847c6a.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

This event is a chance to take part in delivering something more than just a cargo, it's a chance to deliver hope to the world, if only virtually.

Where you go and how far you haul will be up to you. What is important is that you enjoy the event, spread the word so that others can share the hope, and stay safe and healthy.

[h3][b][u]#HaulingHope Event Rules:[/u][/b][/h3]

Using [b]External Contracts[/b] with a World of Trucks-connected profile in Euro Truck Simulator 2, American Truck Simulator or both, your [b]Personal goal[/b] is to complete at least [b]7 undamaged deliveries[/b] of COVID-19 Vaccine cargo across any trucking territories. To be able to see and carry this cargo, you need to have a Fragile Cargo skill of at least level 1.

[h3][u][b]Reward:[/b][/u][/h3]

[b][u]Personal goal:[/u][/b] Your contribution of 7 or more deliveries of [b]COVID-19 Vaccine cargo[/b] will gain you: 
[list][*]A [b]World of Trucks Achievement[/b].[/*][*]A prestigeous, [b]Hope Trucker Insiginia, cabin item[/b] to hang in your truck.[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/9b2fa7f5955a4274b2d5300083c556603e39a7ec.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/45752a68f54643a096e8ceca3027dce3cbf4471c.jpg[/img]

The event will be concluded [u][i]on Sunday 7th February 23:59 UTC.[/i][/u]

notes.title: #XmasWiseGiving + #CruisingColorado Conclusion
notes.content:
The holiday season is a time of rest for most people, but for the logistics industry, it is the busiest time of the year! Over the past couple of months, drivers from across the world have united to deliver gifts wisely on both sides of the Atlantic in our Christmas Wise Giving Event.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/7f0cad9f2c089a17bfbd05a6683e9641f3fc1900.jpg[/img]

Thousands of deliveries needed to be made for cities across both Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator and our #BestCommunityEver delivered! We thank you for all the hard work and time each of you put in to help unlock rewards for all drivers to enjoy in-game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/8599738c2453c4b75872488a06e8b4eb461ae732.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/1326618f526bb14a557536671173b2ded35abecd.jpg[/img]

In less than 24 hours, drivers have already completed their personal goals of completing 15 deliveries across Europe/USA and 75 of the 350 hearts and gifts needed to receive the first tier of the community rewards. By the end of the first day of the event, Osnabruck became the first city to max out on both given and received gift deliveries and you, the community, reached the first tier! 

With that kind of momentum, it was no wonder that the final tier of the community goal was achieved on the 27th of December, just 10 days after the beginning of the event! The rate of deliveries completed even had Santa in the North Pole shocked! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/3a329897f6b859e58fb22580c0e52d6a67f42994.png[/img]

We want to thank every single driver who contributed to the event, and to those who really went the extra mile. It really brings a huge smile to the faces of the SCS team to see how much you enjoyed these events, and how you managed to complete them quicker every year, despite the many deliveries we challenge you with. We hope you enjoy the unique Christmas accessories and paint jobs that you have so rightfully earned and use them as a reminder of this year's event. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/82784d7b3e6be412f2155eea249ff119c8ee5e3c.jpg[/img]

However, the #XmasWiseGiving event wasn't the only event you could take part in during the festive period. For the first time ever, we had 2 consecutive World of Trucks events running alongside each other! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/22fc808a55bb4c633169fdaade4f6683fc337d02.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/99edd79d6912927101a783fc475a272dd00b21ee.jpg[/img]

On November 12th, with the release of Colorado for American Truck Simulator, we began the #CruisingColorado event. We set a goal for truckers to drive 60,000,000 combined miles whilst delivering to or from any of the 13 cities in the state of Colorado. With Colorado themed rewards to be earned, it only took our community 7 days to reach the goal of 60 million miles, incredible! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/9d61ff6a2b32b9ed583f3eb07ffe728247851ecb.png[/img]

This really does go to show the strength and power of our community when we work together. We thank you for your support and we look forward to sharing more development news with you in the future.

notes.title: 1.40: New Mexico & Oregon Viewpoints
notes.content:
Back in October last year, Update 1.39 for American Truck Simulator saw the arrival of viewpoints to the states of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015160/American_Truck_Simulator__Washington/?utm_source=steam_ats&utm_campaign=mexico_oregon_viewpoints]Washington [/url]and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104880/American_Truck_Simulator__Utah/?utm_source=steam_ats&utm_campaign=mexico_oregon_viewpoints]Utah[/url] after their popular debut in Idaho! Today we are happy to share with you that our next 1.40 update for ATS will see the introduction of more viewpoints in the states of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/684630/American_Truck_Simulator__New_Mexico/?utm_source=steam_ats&utm_campaign=mexico_oregon_viewpoints]New Mexico[/url] & [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/800370/American_Truck_Simulator__Oregon/?utm_source=steam_ats&utm_campaign=mexico_oregon_viewpoints]Oregon[/url].

You also have the option to skip the viewpoint or replay it if you wish to watch it again.

notes.title: Christmas Wise Giving Update
notes.content:
Happy New Year! We hope you found time to enjoy the festive period and time to relax and settle down with a cup of your favourite hot drink. However, we know that many of you continued to work hard over the Christmas period as you took part in our #XmasWiseGiving World of Trucks event! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/be2a018b89de8b91657893fd7749a92ca45f1d7e.jpg[/img]

With brightly-decorated Christmas gift trailers and festively-painted trucks, drivers from across the world came together to help deliver gifts across the Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator with a goal to achieve, and on the 27th of December you, our #BestCommunityEver, completed the community goal! 

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/1326618f526bb14a557536671173b2ded35abecd.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/1326618f526bb14a557536671173b2ded35abecd.jpg[/img][/url][/td]

notes.title: Happy New Year 2021
notes.content:
The year 2020 is coming to an end in a few hours. It's been a very hard year for most of the world, but we want to focus on something positive here. Despite some setbacks and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/227300/announcements/detail/2889585224616577909]hard decisions to make[/url], the work on new map expansions, new vehicles and parts, new game features, and our 3D engine improvements continued at a solid pace. We have managed to keep our chins up and remain productive, and both American Truck Simulator and Euro Truck Simulator 2 keep getting better.

Allow us to reminiscence and review the content and features we have released throughout 2020!

[previewyoutube=S1zs_fmu1pE;full][/previewyoutube]

Let's all hope that the new year will be way better than the one we are leaving behind. As teased and hinted in our Christmas Special stream ([url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8M1vBAIwz0w]recording here[/url]), our teams are already working on a big pile of very exciting projects and updates, including quite some game-changers. We're looking forward to bringing you more specific news as we develop and release the new features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/01263224e0f02973add7f3866026e7db4ee92a20.jpg[/img]

ːlunar2020ratinablanketː

notes.title: Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
Our dearest #BestCommunityEver,

The festive end of the year is fast approaching, and the team at SCS Software is taking a bit of time off to enjoy the holidays and to recharge our batteries. We will slow down the pace of news updates and social media posts over the next couple of weeks, but we'll be back in January with new energy and lots of new topics to cover.

Meanwhile, we trust that all the automated systems we have put in place will keep on working only with a bit of monitoring needed. So you should be able to enjoy our new Christmas Wise Giving event on World of Trucks...

https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/4492868685530629550

... as well as still being able to catch up on the Cruising Colorado event if you are thinking of getting the new map expansion for American Truck Simulator.

https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/2908724255320776527

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/ab31bc2090a48488942627c778ac6e661523787c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/ab31bc2090a48488942627c778ac6e661523787c.jpg[/img][/url]

To say that this year has been difficult is an understatement. A lot of us have been through really rough times. There is a glimpse of hope on the horizon now with news that the world may have a cure next year, but we need to be patient and keep ourselves and the ones dear to us as safe as possible now. We are proud that our games are a part of life for so many of our fans, and we will be happy to provide you with company again if need be in the coming weeks. Ours is a hobby that fits the limitations of Stay at Home very well - or rather Truck at Home in our case!

So, make yourself a cup of hot chocolate, coffee or tea put on some warm and cozy clothes, get yourself some good and tasty food, watch some classic movies, and let these stories pull you into fantasy worlds where everything is possible. Or grab a steering wheel, a game controller, or just your trusty keyboard and mouse, and play the games you love, including American Truck Simulator and Euro Truck Simulator 2.

Additionally, if you have missed our Christmas Special live-stream on Monday, you can watch the recording now, too. Maybe it can put a smile on your face as we reflect on the good stuff we managed to pull off in 2020, while also teasing and hinting at the future of our games in the years to come.

[previewyoutube=8M1vBAIwz0w;full][/previewyoutube]

No matter how you are going to spend the holidays, have a wonderful time, and please stay safe.

Merry Christmas! ːwinter2019happyyulː

notes.title: Christmas Wise Giving Event 2020
notes.content:
Last year we asked the community to spread the spirit of Christmas giving across all trucking territories in the Christmas Grand Giving event of 2019. The response was outstanding and we all did ourselves proud.

So, you may ask, what could top such a momentous effort? What is better than giving during Christmas time? The answer, this year, is not just giving, but giving wisely! In this way, we bring you the Christmas Wise Giving event of 2020 for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/?utm_source=steam_announcement_ats&utm_campaign=wotr_xmas_2020_start]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/?utm_source=steam_announcement_ats&utm_campaign=wotr_xmas_2020_start]American Truck Simulator[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/0d053ba6d6dc5cf7317ade7ae86411fddb2fbac6.jpg[/img]

We are not only asking you, our #BestCommunityEver, to match the Grand Giving reputation that you earned last year, but we are further challenging everyone to beat it by giving wisely, and we are going to help you do this!

We have fresh trailer loads of much-needed gifts to deliver. It is going to be your kind heart and wise decisions that deliver them to who needs them most. For carrying out this noble deed your actions will be noted twofold, in that we will award Hearts to each city, based on the number of deliveries it gives, and Gifts to each city based on the number of deliveries it receives. It will be the sum total of Hearts and Gifts that will be counted towards the community goal.

The more a city gives or receives, the more Hearts or Gifts that city gets, with a maximum of 5 Heart icons and 5 Gift icons per city.

You’ll be able to track the community progress on [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url] or directly in the game using the updated External Contracts interface:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/9a29aed23c2b4607715bf5b66b25aeb8972bb6c1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/9a29aed23c2b4607715bf5b66b25aeb8972bb6c1.png[/img][/url]

We'll be jump-starting this great event with a special Christmas Wise Giving developer stream on the 17th of December, starting at 18:00 CET. It will be loads of fun, delivering jobs during the event, giving away steam keys, and we'll provide more information on our social media sharing campaign, in which those who'll share an image or video from their participation in the event, under the [i]#XmasWiseGiving[/i] hashtag, will have a chance to win some cool gifts.

[h1]Wise Giving Event rules[/h1]

Using External Contracts with a [i][url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url]-connected profile[/i] in Euro Truck Simulator 2, American Truck Simulator or both, the goal is to get as many Hearts and Gifts as possible awarded to as many cities as possible across all trucking territories. Every city can achieve up to 5 Hearts and 5 Gifts!

[i]For a city[/i] to gain [u]1 Heart[/u] the community must make 1000 deliveries [u]from it[/u], using the provided [i]Gifts[/i] cargo.

[i]For a city[/i] to gain [u]1 Gift[/u] the community must make 1000 deliveries [u]to it[/u], using the provided [i]Gifts[/i] cargo.

Each tier of 350 Hearts/Gifts combined, will unlock a unique community reward.

For a [i]Personal goal[/i], complete [u]at least 15 deliveries[/u] of Gifts cargo in either Euro Truck Simulator 2 or American Truck Simulator.

In quick summary, using Euro Truck Simulator and/or American Truck Simulator:

[list]
[*]To get a Personal goal: 15 deliveries from any cities in either game.
[*]To get a Heart for a city: 1000 deliveries from that particular city.
[*]To get a Gift for a city: 1000 deliveries to that particular city.
[*]Unlock a unique community reward: Every tier of 350 Hearts/Gifts combined, collected from both games.
[/list]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/a7cfd2619fe5a911441528b8b4499704637d3ad3.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/a7cfd2619fe5a911441528b8b4499704637d3ad3.jpg[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/b1e91d8d0cedb518f6f2a36a0a29504e42cc3917.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/b1e91d8d0cedb518f6f2a36a0a29504e42cc3917.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Rewards[/h1]

[h2]Personal goal[/h2]

Your contribution of 15 or more deliveries of Gifts cargo will gain you:

[list]
[*]A [i]World of Trucks Achievement[/i]
[*]A Christmas-themed, [i]Winter Blast[/i], paint job to help you carry out more Gifts deliveries during the event.
[/list]

[h2]Community goals[/h2]

Each tier of [i]350 Hearts/Gifts combined[/i], will unlock unique community rewards. There will be [i]6 tiers[/i] in total, so after 2100 Hearts/Gifts are achieved all community goals will be completed, so let's do this!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/787f5173484df4c3d9baac759954b5b73051cbc4.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/787f5173484df4c3d9baac759954b5b73051cbc4.jpg[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/b281567df330ec42156df61bb82cb37f85decb1a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/b281567df330ec42156df61bb82cb37f85decb1a.jpg[/img][/url]

[i]Note:[/i] In order to qualify for any community reward, you must complete at least your personal goal in Euro Truck Simulator 2, American Truck Simulator or both. Each reward will be a Steam inventory item for both Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator. Once completed, claim your reward on the Events page on your World of Trucks profile.

[i]The event will be concluded on Sunday the 17th of January at 23:59 UTC.[/i]

notes.title: American Truck Simulator's next stop is Wyoming
notes.content:
There's barely been time to admire the sweeping vistas of Colorado, but American Truck Simulator is already speeding to its next stop, with developer SCS today announcing Wyoming as the next US state to be getting the expansion treatment.

"Home to some of the country's most breathtaking national parks, " explains SCS in its announcement post, "Wyoming is best known for its red-walled gorges, hot springs, historic prairie towns, pioneer history, and historical attractions."

To accompany its Wyoming reveal, SCS has shared the briefest of video teasers, offering a peak at just some of the bison-related sights in store for those readying themselves for more hypnotically zen-like hauling across American Truck Simulator's newest state.

Read more

notes.title: American Truck Simulator's next expansion is Wyoming
notes.content:
As American Truck Simulator continues to expand the map eastward across the United States with new DLC, the next stop will be in Wyoming. Ah, the Cowboy State! The tenth-largest state in the contiguous US yet the least populous. Gonna be so long lonely days on the trail, partner. But they might be lovely days, seeing as Wyoming includes parts of the Rocky Mountains and Yellowstone national park. Not that I expect to be doing deliveries directly into hot springs. That would be an environmental disaster.

(more…)

notes.title: American Truck Simulator reveals Wyoming DLC and graphics overhaul
notes.content:
American Truck Simulator's long haul from west coast to east coast continues into Wyoming soon, as developer SCS Software has just confirmed the setting of the next piece of DLC. The studio has revealed a load of screenshots of the digital Cowboy State, and taken the opportunity to debut American Truck Simulator's visual overhaul here, too.

Both of SCS's truck sims are getting a new, more realistic lighting model with their respective 1.40 updates, and that means the studio has had to overhaul the existing visuals in order to match the new lighting. As with Euro Truck Simulator 2's Iberia DLC, ATS's Wyoming is the first location built from the ground up to look its best under the new lighting.

And it looks mighty nice. Wyoming is one of the least-populated states in the country, but its combination of prairies and occasional mountains makes for a gorgeous way to show off the new lighting under a beautiful sun. You can see some more of those images over on the official site.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Introducing Wyoming
notes.content:
After much guessing and debate, many of you came to the conclusion of which state we showcased in our recent teaser trailer. Today we are excited to share with you the U.S State which will be arriving next... 

[h2]Introducing Wyoming for American Truck Simulator[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7928446be65393763db2844cba8c799ea5d53de1.jpg[/img]

[/u][/b]Wyoming may be one of the least populated states in the U.S, but that doesn't mean that it lacks spectacular places to visit and see. Home to some of the country's most breathtaking national parks, Wyoming is best known for its red-walled gorges, hot springs, historic prairie towns, pioneer history, and historical attractions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/771d6c8ad64c1173e84250bdf20ac9bdc78e8d29.jpg[/img]

So why the Bison? Wyoming designated the American bison as the official state mammal in 1985, and to this day you can still find large herds of them grazing across the prairies and protected land which is designated for the conservation of wild bison since their decline across the U.S.

notes.title: Trash up your American Truck Sim cabin with burgers and coffee cups
notes.content:
Say what you want about the drivers in American Truck Simulator, but they’re sparkling housekeepers. Sitting up there in their spotless truck cabs, with nary a crisp packet to betray the long hours spent at the wheel. It’s all a bit sterile, really. Thankfully, this week’s Cabin Accessories pack lets you vandalise the place with tacky nick-nacks and discarded meal deals, making your home on the road feel a little less sterile.

(more…)

notes.title: You can now fill your American Truck Simulator cab with fuzzy dice and fast food wrappers
notes.content:
Trucking is a unique job in that you live inside your place of employment - well, okay, maybe that's not so unique in 2020, but you get what I mean. You've got to do something to make the rig feel like home, and up until now American Truck Simulator has been limited in that regard. Luckily, SCS has rectified the issue with a whole lot of tchotchkes and garbage to fill your cab.

The Cabin Accessories pack is $3.99 / £2.89 / €3.99 on Steam, and adds over 100 items to personalise your cab with. There are fuzzy dice, dashboard hula girls, and even leaf-shaped air fresheners to hang from your rear-view mirror. You can also just fill your cab with food, from hamburger wrappers in the passenger seat to cereal boxes and water bottles.

What do these objects do for you? Well, um... You can look around, and see them. Like, they'll be there in your cab while you're driving around. Listen, I've spent more money on worse times than that.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: ATS: Cabin Accessories Release
notes.content:
Eagle-eyed viewers of our recent Twitch streams may have spotted some accessories in the cab of our truck in American Truck Simulator. With questions and speculation being thrown back and forth around the community, we are happy to put those rumors to bed!

[h3][b]Introducing Cabin Accessories DLC, now available for American Truck Simulator![/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477840/American_Truck_Simulator__Cabin_Accessories/

There is no place like home and for many drivers on the road, their truck cab is their second home. These new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477840/American_Truck_Simulator__Cabin_Accessories/?utm_source=steam_announcement_ats&utm_campaign=ats_dlc_toys_release]Cabin Accessories[/url] allow you to personalize your cab with a collection of practical and decorative items. From power inverters to coffee cups, the possibilities for cab customizations are (almost) endless!

notes.title: The Freightliner Cascadia® has arrived!
notes.content:
The Cascadia® is the most advanced on-highway truck Freightliner has ever offered; and today we are excited to announce its arrival in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url]. Available to purchase from your local in-game dealership, the Freightliner comes with numerous customisation options.

[previewyoutube=oo_9NaudQ2s;full][/previewyoutube]
Its virtual implementation in our game also includes a wide array of configurations including 12 chassis variants, 14 engine choices, 13 transmissions, 4 different cabin types, 4 interior trim options, and loads of other customization options. Whatever journey you have in mind, there will be a Cascadia® ready for the job! As a bonus, we are also including a unique paintjob as seen on Freightliner's promotional videos. This is available for the ownable 53' box trailers.

Bringing this iconic truck to the virtual roads of American Truck Simulator wouldn't have been possible without the help of the team at [url=https://freightliner.com/]Freightliner Trucks[/url], who has helped us recreate the Cascadia® in great detail. A big thank you, of course, goes to all those involved in this project here at SCS Software, from the very first contact to creating the 3D models, interiors, texturing, bug testing, and more, it wouldn't be possible without you!

notes.title: Steam Awards Nomination 2020
notes.content:
Today, the nominations for the annual Steam Awards are opening, along with the start of the Steam Autumn Sale. You may still remember that back in 2016, our incredible #BestCommunityEver was so active during the first year of Steam Awards, that our Euro Truck Simulator 2 managed to claim [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2017/01/steam-powered-fireworks-launched-new.html]victory in two categories[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/de8ce92d86accc6ee8bc5cca5aed7d9fefcccecc.jpg[/img]

However, time flies, a lot of fantastic games have been added to the Steam library over the years, and many of them have rightfully accumulated massive fan-bases as well. Meanwhile, Valve adjusted the rules such that titles launched before 2019 can now be nominated in only one category - The Labour of Love, a category that reflects that a game still gets new updates and active support years after launch. This category will surely be very crowded! But still, we may give it a collective try, what do you think? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/e04c5ce37669785e2c135577d760105505816874.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/539419b571dca8e2aacba66910181cafb4fde8bd.jpg[/img]

If you feel that either Euro Truck Simulator 2 or American Truck Simulator deserves the Labour of Love award, or possibly at least some buzz and visibility for being nominated and in the category, we will appreciate your vote and support. You can cast your vote by heading to this year's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/nominations?snr=1_4_660__promo-steamawards]Steam Awards Nomination Page. [/url]

notes.title: Freightliner Cascadia® Announcement
notes.content:
Over the past weekend, we put out a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NAmtFjCJHHo]teaser video[/url] hinting at a new and upcoming truck that will arrive for American Truck Simulator. Many of our avid fans have immediately identified the make and model of the truck. The hype is real; with the awesome support from Daimler Trucks North America, you will soon get to drive the most popular truck on US' roads!

[h3]Introducing the Freightliner Cascadia® for American Truck Simulator[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4aa86e63ee421dfb5155612b5bbaf218bc0a48d9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b882d6cdc0d864ec83a0e3c26160bd87f3e086c8.jpg[/img]

To quote Freightliner's sales literature, "The Cascadia® is the most advanced on-highway truck Freightliner has ever offered. With more than one million hours of R&D and millions of miles of real-world testing, the Cascadia® is the result of sustained, concentrated investment in the future of trucking. Advanced aerodynamics help it slice through the air and boost fuel efficiency. Freightliner reimagined the Cascadia® interior, starting with the dashboard, which features an all-new instrument cluster and automotive-style steering wheel controls and switch placement, to meet driver needs. The Cascadia® is offered with the Integrated Detroit™ Powertrain, which integrates the most fuel-efficient DD15® and DD13® engines ever designed with the technologically advanced DT12™ On-Highway Series transmissions and specifically engineered Detroit™ steer and high-speed ratio tandem axles for optimal, efficient performance."

notes.title: American Truck Simulator's Colorado DLC tops the Steam top seller chart
notes.content:
It's November 12, 2020. This week has marked some of the biggest launches the videogame industry has seen in years. The Xbox Series X. The PlayStation 5. The Colorado DLC for American Truck Simulator. Wait, you don't think new ATS DLC is that big of a deal? Well, maybe not, unless being the best-selling thing on Steam is important.

Yes, friends, the Colorado DLC for ATS hit the top of Steam's global top seller charts today. The $11.99 / £8.99 / €11.99 expansion outsold Football Manager 2021, Destiny 2: Beyond Light, and even Cyberpunk 2077 to take the top slot - not to mention current Steam megahits like Phasmophobia and Among Us.

Now, it's not clear what the window to make it to the top seller list is - whether it's a game's sales in the span of a few minutes, a few hours, or some other stretch of time. The Colorado DLC remained at the top of the list for several hours today, but it's since been pushed to second place by Sea of Thieves, which is 40% off today. (Clearly, games about moving cargo are all the rage.)

notes.title: Colorado Release
notes.content:
[b]The big day is here![/b] Preparations to release [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209471/American_Truck_Simulator__Colorado/]Colorado for American Truck Simulator[/url] are in top gear. We are also preparing for a special release stream with special guests. So when exactly is Colorado releasing?

[b][h1]Colorado for American Truck Simulator will be released at 7pm Central European Time[/h1][/b][h3][b][i]( 10am PST, 1pm EST, 6pm GMT, 7pm MSK, 2am SST₊₁, 5am AEDT₊₁ , 7am NZDT₊₁ )[/i][/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=SiTFH7WXapU;full][/previewyoutube]
So what exactly does our Colorado DLC have to offer for truckers? These are just a few of the things we think you will love! 

[list]
[*] Drive from the great plains, through the Rocky Mountains to bustling cities and historical towns.
[*] Haul cargo on the Million Dollar Highway
[*] Discover Colorado's important industries like wind power factories or gold mines
[*] Deliver freight to and from the inside of a large cargo aircraft in Denver International Airport
[*] Admire representation of cities like Denver, Colorado Springs and many others
[*] Visit landmarks like the Four Corners Monument and get a bird's-eye view on it with the viewpoint feature
[*] Unlock Colorado-specific Steam achievements
[*] and Much More!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/73cf6522fc6411f7a60c92f785173a3c59cd9419.jpg[/img]

And that shouldn't be the only reason to explore Colorado for yourself! As an added bonus we will also have a World of Trucks event for all new visitors to Colorado with unique rewards to be earned as you visit each city and deliver jobs. Learn more about the rules in our [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2020/11/cruisingcolorado-event-announcement.html]yesterday blog post[/url] and take part in [b]#CruisingColorado[/b] at [url=http://WorldofTrucks.com]WorldofTrucks.com[/url]. We'd love to see your photos across our Social Media channels using the hashtag!

We expect to have this event available to players for an extended period of time, probably way beyond the point of reaching the 60 million miles which is the current community goal. We don't want to motivate you to rush through the DLC in a hurry to make sure you manage to obtain the personal achievement. We simply want to reward early adopters of the DLC for spending quality time with the new content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f12cf0389de88109f624dd8629c78b04f7cdbfac.jpg[/img]
