notes.title: #CruisingColorado Event Announcement
notes.content:
With the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209471/American_Truck_Simulator__Colorado/]Colorado DLC[/url] releasing tomorrow, [b][u]November 12th[/u][/b], we'd like to celebrate by inviting you all to take part in our latest [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World Of Trucks event[/url] - [b]Cruising Colorado[/b]! We know many of you are as excited as we are to visit this beautiful Rocky Mountain state with its breathtaking views and historic places, and we are delighted to announce that this event will reward drivers who contribute to Colorado's local economy and industries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/70b17409415f0de01c5f7b13dd28c479bc1593cd.jpg[/img]

We are asking our [b]#BestCommunityEver[/b] to achieve the [b]community goal[/b] of driving [b][u]60,000,000 miles[/u][/b] (96,560,640 km) while delivering cargoes [b]to or from[/b] any city in Colorado. It doesn't matter what you haul, gold mining supplies, wind turbine parts, lumber, food, beverages, it all counts, every last delivery!
And, of course, you can use your own trailer during all of this in the external market!

Our Colorado DLC offers 13 fantastic and unique cities that we really want you to visit. So, we're offering a special reward for completing your [b]personal goal[/b], which will require you to deliver a job [b]to or from[/b] each of them. All jobs for the event need to be [b]100 miles[/b] each (161 km) or more, so be sure to read the rules.

We will keep the event running until well after Christmas, so there will be plenty of time to relax and enjoy the ride while earning your rewards. 

As you are [b]#CruisingColorado[/b] and adding up the job miles, we guarantee there will be new experiences for you like never before. Not to mention, we have included many new viewpoints, offering handcrafted cinematic views, highlighting the attractions of that area. 
[list][*]Visit the Four Corners Monument, the only point in the United States shared by four states.[/*][*]Take a drive through Wolf Creek Pass, located deep in the San Juan Mountains of Colorado.[/*][*]Drive over Red Cliff Bridge, a steel arch bridge that crosses over a beautiful valley.[/*][*]Truck along the I-70, a major east-west Interstate Highway that passes through Glenwood Canyon.[/*][*]
Take a job from Denver International Airport, the 5th busiest airport in the U.S. and home of famous Blucifer. 
[/*][/list]
Colorado, Nil sine numine (Nothing without providence), is our latest addition to American Truck Simulator. Know that as you wind down your cab window and settle in for the long haul, we'll be right there, cruising with you in spirit.  We can't wait to hear your thoughts about this incredibly beautiful, mountainous, triumphant, epic, and historic state.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/73cf6522fc6411f7a60c92f785173a3c59cd9419.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Rules[/b][/u]

Using [b]External Contracts[/b] or the [b]External Market[/b], with a [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url]-connected profile in American Truck Simulator,[b] the community goal is to drive 60,000,000 miles[/b] (96,560,640 km) while delivering cargoes to or from any city in Colorado.
The cities are: Fort Collins, Sterling, Rangely, Steamboat Springs, Denver, Burlington, Colorado Springs, Grand Junction, Pueblo, Lamar, Montrose, Alamosa, Durango

When a player completes delivery [b]to or from[/b] each of the 13 Colorado cities, it will achieve their [b]personal goal. [/b]

[b]All jobs[/b] for the event need to be [b]at least 100 miles each[/b] (161 km), or more. 

You can check if your recent deliveries met these conditions using your [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/jobs]Log Book[/url] in your World of Trucks profile.

[u][b]Rewards[/b][/u]

[b]Personal goal: [/b]Players that deliver cargo [b]to or from[/b] each of the 13 Colorado cities will gain a personal [b]World of Trucks Achievement[/b] and an impressive Rocky Mountain Bighorn themed [b]ATS truck paint job[/b] Steam inventory item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/24e8a01d8cdb09056ec7dc446aa0a0c029e4873e.jpg[/img]

[b]Community goal[/b]: When the community goal of driving 60,000,000 miles (96,560,640 km) during deliveries [b]to or from any of the 13 cities[/b] in Colorado is met, and if the player has also achieved their personal goal, then they will receive a hanging [b]Rocky Rodeo Gem ornament[/b] Steam inventory item.

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/683ad473ed0f640c43f20fa55b3a05e589927bfb.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/683ad473ed0f640c43f20fa55b3a05e589927bfb.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/99edd79d6912927101a783fc475a272dd00b21ee.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/99edd79d6912927101a783fc475a272dd00b21ee.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

We look forward to seeing drivers new and old exploring Colorado for the first time, and we would love to see photos from your first journeys across the state border! Share your screenshots and videos with us using the hashtag #CruisingColorado on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/scssoftware]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url] profiles and we will share our favourite ones (we may even feature some of them in an upcoming blog post!).

notes.title: Hard Truck Tribute
notes.content:
[url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2020/10/colorado-springs-gameplay-video.html]In a recent blog post[/url], we released a gameplay video from our up and coming Colorado DLC for American Truck Simulator, which showcased a beautiful drive from Denver to Grand Junction. But, did you notice something about the truck we were driving? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/498dd06abdfc65a60a66500fadf084fa681bc578.jpg[/img]

Dedicated fans who have played our truck simulator titles as far back as the early 2000s may have recognized that the Kenworth W900 was sporting a familiar paint job from one of our earlier titles, Hard Truck: 18 Wheels of Steel. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/df364383b6b10aba2ac1e590d717e919c2a6bb71.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f16d0cee8a36f959989d8a6190d03a6f15cd1152.jpg[/img]

Believe it or not, it has been 18 years since we released Hard Truck: 18 Wheels of Steel (August 2002), but that is not all. Denver, Colorado was also the starting location for all new truckers beginning their trucking life in Hard Truck: 18 Wheels of Steel. It's amazing to see how far we've come and we are excited to once again re-visit Denver in our current American Truck Simulator title. 

To celebrate this occasion, we wanted to reward our community with the Hard Truck Tribute Paint Job. This iconic flames design was available for the Kenworth W900 in Hard Truck: 18 Wheels of Steel and was a popular design among many drivers.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/369ec00664eccbaabcf75207d2a47549e6bf4d96.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e3539a71f1960914a01f93942cecda4198eb4db1.jpg[/img]

Every owner of the American Truck Simulator base game will be eligible to receive this paint job as a free gift, which will be available to use on all current truck models. To receive this special paint job, all you need to do is complete the following requirements: 

[list][*]Be registered on [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/]World of Trucks[/url][/*][*]Have your World of Trucks account connected to your American Truck Simulator game[/*][*]Pick any external contracts in American Truck Simulator from any location of your choice, however, the job must be [b]at least[/b] 500 miles long [/*][*]Complete this external contract job [/*][*]Claim your gift on your World of Trucks Event tab which can be found under 'My Page'[/*][/list]

You will have [b][u]until the 7th of February 2021, 23:59 UTC[/u][/b] to claim this Hard Truck Tribute Paint Job. After that time, you will be no longer able to obtain this paint job. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/47355901ae20a0e7c84b9d0755f5fe5e4779bcb2.jpg[/img]

So thank you, our #BestCommunityEver, for all of your incredible support! Whether you have been with us since our humble beginnings or just joined the trucking family recently, it means a lot to us and our team to have you a part of this journey. We look forward to many more years of life on the road with you, we still have a lot of exciting things in the pipeline for our trucking titles!

notes.title: American Truck Simulator's Colorado expansion arrives next week
notes.content:
Fans of American Truck Simulator's wonderfully chilled trundling will have a whole new state to explore next Thursday, 12th November, with the arrival of developer SCS' Colorado expansion.

Colorado will mark the seventh state to be added to American Truck Simulator since its launch in 2016 - following on from Arizona, New Mexico, Oregon, Washington, Utah, and Idaho - and opens up myriad new routes for long-distance haulers (and landscape oglers) to enjoy across SCS' own take on the Centennial State.

As with American Truck Simulator's other states, it's not an exact recreation, but rather an attempt to distill the essence of Colorado down into a space expansive enough to feel appropriately sweeping, but not so big it takes forever to go anywhere or achieve anything.

notes.title: American Truck Simulator adds more sightseeing spots
notes.content:
Driving a virtual truck is a serious job, no doubt, but I make time to appreciate the view in American Truck Simulator. The haul ’em up tentatively introduced sightseeing spots with its Idaho expansion, a few spots where we can roll up to enjoy cinematic views of landmarks and landscapes, and now it’s added more. notes.title: ATS 1.39 Update Release
notes.content:
With lots of testing, feedback, fixing, and fine-tuning, we are excited to announce the arrival of update the 1.39 for American Truck Simulator!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1662589f96b32b35e2e5571134f508f071c37c33.jpg[/img]

We'd like to thank all those who took part in the 1.39 open beta and made bug reports and provided general feedback on this new version. We hope you can now begin to fully enjoy the various new features which are included within this update. So, what can you expect to find in the 1.39 update ATS?

 Lets us give you a quick recap of the most significant changes.

[previewyoutube=QGNhMXpyl6A;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]LAUNCHPAD UPDATE[/b]

One of the first things you may notice when you launch American Truck Simulator with the 1.39 is a redesign of the current launchpad. The main reason why we are introducing this change is to pave the way for future additions; which will introduce new features to our games, that will be accessed through the launchpad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4289432fa0834ba8a4bb521e59abd8c756c1b3c4.png[/img]

Until then, however, you can see that the design has changed quite significantly, especially as user profiles are now accessed via a drop-down option from the top of the launchpad. You will also find that the DLC Browser, Mod Manager, and Profile Manager have been placed together for easier access, along with a new addition to the launchpad, Game Options. 

This allows you to change your game settings without even having to load the game. So if you're just looking to tweak your game before streaming on Twitch or adjusting a few options before heading into your truck, it can all be done from the launchpad screen. 

[b]LOWBOY TRAILERS[/b]

As we previously announced in a [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2020/09/american-truck-simulator-lowboy-trailers.html]recent blog[/url], new Lowboy Trailers will be arriving to American Truck Simulator. These trailers have been reworked from the ground up, offering drivers the option to purchase them and use them in an array of different jobs including [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962750/American_Truck_Simulator__Special_Transport/]Special Transport[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076080/American_Truck_Simulator__Forest_Machinery/]Forest Machinery[/url], and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/620610/American_Truck_Simulator__Heavy_Cargo_Pack/]Heavy Cargo DLC's[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/804ddce8cc740df895427a9a73858ad6a9fbf3e6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7f3d95272c437c806cd95d910de861321b611f60.jpg[/img]

Owners of these trailers will benefit from a wide array of options to customize them in the upgrade shop, such as color, trailer accessories, beacons, chassis options, lengths, articulated axles, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/51d5a97a14118d82f28623764a4048e70d22f03b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/465d859bb422e8fff0097e2e65b88e28f5ea745b.jpg[/img]

You will also be able to spot them being hauled around by other truckers on the road, so make sure to give them plenty of space if you pass by one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5284d04f3c49794e9c17d393a172459264ae8b4e.jpg[/img]

[b]VIEWPOINTS[/b]

The release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209470/American_Truck_Simulator__Idaho/]Idaho[/url] for American Truck Simulator saw the introduction of a brand new feature that has not been placed in any other previous map release. Viewpoints allow drivers to activate a special in-game "cutscene" with a short showcase of a near location or place of interest such as an industry.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/281630782f69e4e74765160e76f2731e32d3432f.jpg[/img]

After Idaho's release, it was evident from the community's response that this was a popular feature and one that many of you would like to see expanded upon. While we continue to improve this new addition, we are excited to announce that viewpoints will be arriving in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015160/American_Truck_Simulator__Washington/]Washington[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104880/American_Truck_Simulator__Utah/]Utah[/url]. Each state will receive 10 new cut-scenes to discover, which can be found nearby famous landmarks, national parks, and industries. 

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/73a466b1602d3f0e150471f2d60b5e1cc927be1e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/73a466b1602d3f0e150471f2d60b5e1cc927be1e.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/21c83666fcc86274da2f38c06abd37fb76f870ab.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/21c83666fcc86274da2f38c06abd37fb76f870ab.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fb90adb1a6238510fe165a3607c08a9d9a371122.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fb90adb1a6238510fe165a3607c08a9d9a371122.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3f712d0e1d64dd99a8598ca3ef956547ae0a3552.jpg[/img][/tr][/table]

That is not all, however, as viewpoints will now feature a few new functionalities for drivers. You will now have the new options to either skip the viewpoint or replay it if you wish to watch it again. Viewpoints will now also show as undiscovered grey '?' icons on your map until you have visited them for the first time. Also, there are more improvements for this cool new feature still in development, as we've gathered them through the amazing and most valuable feedback from our #BestCommunityEver!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/651d6b8fc2ccce82d05429540f3df3e2d4c74326.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bbff0d5aad9de65fa74e7d4d25383937746d6cb4.jpg[/img]


[b]GENERAL BUG FIXES/SOUND CHANGES[/b]

1.39 also features various bug fixes, improvements, and an update to sounds. This includes, but is not limited to, improved interior cab sound mixing, Western Star 49X truck bug fixes, and improvements, and other changes in preparation for new and upcoming content.

One of the changes you can find is the addition of the Turbo sound slider in the game's Options screen. When we introduced a separate channel for turbo sound some years back, it was hailed as a crucial enhancement to the simulation. We did our best to tune it properly based on actual in-cabin recordings. Indeed, many players commented very positively on it. However, over the years we have also been receiving feedback that the whistling sound may be too difficult to bear for some players. The new slider continues the trend of giving you more control over your simulation experience. We hope you enjoy this new addition plus a few other sound tweaks which come with it.

While a majority of the changes in 1.39 are not seen visually in this version, we look forward to bringing you more content and changes in the near future. 

[b]CHANGELOG[/b]

[b]MAP[/b]
[list]
[*] New Viewpoints in Washington and Utah DLCs
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Launchpad Re-design
[/list]

[b]VEHICLES[/b]
[list]
[*] Lowboy trailers (ownable, including articulated ones)
[/list]

[b]FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] Viewpoint improvements (replayability, skip, map status, fade-out)
[*] Sound updates and improvements (turbo slider, sound positioning, cabin spatial mixing, sound distribution to accessories)
[*] Trailer browser & lister shows all valid cargo variants
[*] Experimental transmission input shaft emulation and clutch brake support (g_clutch_brake)
[/list]

notes.title: Colorado Springs + Gameplay Video #2
notes.content:
Located at the foot of Pikes Peak, you'll find the city of Colorado Springs, the state's 2nd most populous city behind Denver. So what makes this part of the state so attractive to residents and tourists alike? Let's find out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/954256776cb8f97a6ef95e9e0b82f579786117ad.jpg[/img]

Colorado Springs is known for its many one-of-a-kind attractions, the most iconic being the city's Garden of the Gods Park, a National Natural Landmark. Featuring 300 million years worth of geological history and incredible towering red sandstone rock formations, it is no wonder it is ranked top of the list of best parks to visit in the US. In Colorado DLC you will have to find a hidden road that will take you there. We don't want to spoil your exploration with detailed screenshots of this place as we'd rather leave it for you to enjoy it with your own eyes first. Plus, the city itself has a lot of beauty to show too!

notes.title: Czech & Slovak Games Week Steam Sale
notes.content:
Today is a very special day not only for the Czech Republic, our home country, but also for our friends in Slovakia. On this very day 102 years ago (October 28th 1918), [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Czechoslovak_declaration_of_independence]Czechoslovakia declared independence[/url]. Many things have changed since that time - most importantly, in 1993, former Czechoslovakia split into 2 separate countries: The Czech Republic and the Slovak Republic. But the year 1918 still remains the most significant milestone in the recent history of both countries to this date.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2dc74a4bbd862d4c061adb6fa4bda98cd9e05161.png[/img]

To commemorate this special day, Tomáš "Timmy" Duda, a producer here at SCS Software, came up with an idea that would bring together game developers from across Czechia and Slovakia - to feature their games in a special Steam event. It all started recently when Timmy noticed and was inspired by a similarly-styled Swiss Developer Sale on Steam. Says Timmy, "I liked the idea of a national sale showcase a lot, it felt like something which would make an impact for the Czech and Slovak game industry... I wanted to highlight not only the best-known games, but also indie games because they need the most support; indies always have to try hard to be visible and have their games discovered." 

As a representative of SCS Software, Timmy went ahead to share the idea with [url=http://gda.cz/]the Czech Game Developers Association[/url]. "I suggested doing this sale together, as it's something I love doing, and several other developers we probed got back to us supporting the notion". It gained so much positive attention that Pavel Barák, The Chairman of the Czech GDA, went on to contact the [url=http://sgda.sk/]Slovak Game Developers Association[/url] to ask if they would like to join in for such an occasion. In the next 3 days, the GDA received an overwhelming response from 50 different developers registering their interest in this idea. 

Still, this was only a start, we had to get Steam/Valve aboard with the idea. It took a while, but we have been fortunate to do so thanks to the united voice of the biggest Czech game developer studios. Many weeks have passed as we were trying to arrange the sale. Finally, with the confirmation in-hand and a looming deadline, this final element was required - artwork for the Steam sale page.

Enter Anna Voříšková, a talented artist here at SCS Software. "I fell in love with the idea right away," she said. "I thought it was amazing and I had to be a part of this project!" Immediately, Anna started sketching up ideas for the artwork that would eventually be featured in front of the massive Steam userbase. She goes on to explain her ideas behind the final featured design... "I knew I wanted to make something cute, playful, and eye-catching, but at the same time, I wanted it to have a homely, familiar feeling to it. I figured placing different video game characters and objects on a gamer's desk and have them interact with each other would be the right idea! And since I like to use unnatural colours in my work, I decided to go for a palette full of bright pinks and purples, inspired by the LED lights that often frame gaming setups".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4308183d46d00f31a633f81dcdcbd89faf4e812f.png[/img]

The final artwork features vibrant colours, objects, and characters from a whole host of games from both countries, as featured in the Steam sale event. "It's been a huge honour for me to have had the opportunity to represent both the Czech & Slovak game industries in my artwork." Anna says "I'm really proud of what we've managed to create together, considering how tiny our team was, and how little time we had. I had a lot of fun creating graphics for the event, it's been a truly unique experience and I really hope I get to be a part of something similar again in the future!"

Thanks to the hard work of Timmy and Anna, today you can find over 160 games on sale from 72 developers. We encourage you to explore and check out the wide array of games available, created by studios large and small, as well as individual developers. We are proud to see that our small region in Central Europe has produced so many fantastic games played by people all over the planet.

The sale only runs until November 2nd, so make sure to check out all the amazing games and the original featured artwork on Steam's [i]Czech & Slovak Games Week[/i] page [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/4036972/sale/CZSKGamesWeek]HERE.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/fd27919447368384f4db136c6ac68e8ae617353f.jpg[/img]

As a historical footnote, you may find this recent [url=https://arstechnica.com/gaming/2020/10/how-indiana-jones-fought-the-communists-and-led-an-era-of-activist-video-games/]article at Ars Technica[/url] of interest. It's a well-researched piece exploring the ancient history of Communist-era illicit text-based games produced by kids in Czechoslovakia as a way to protest against the oppression of the regime - pioneers and to a large extent forgotten heroes at the dawn of what is now the Czech and Slovak games industry.

notes.content:
Colorado has one of the most unique and varied natural landscapes found in North America. From emerald-green national forests to the incredible red rock formations jutting up from the earth at Garden of the Gods, you’ll find it nearly impossible to resist taking the time out of delivering loads to explore the natural beauty this state has to offer.

notes.title: Colorado - Denver
notes.content:
A trip to Colorado is not complete without a visit to the state's capital city. Located where the prairies of the Great Plains meet the Rocky Mountains, Denver is home to an array of historic locations, attractions, and most importantly for truckers, industries! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7dbf5af45427154cd5423eb328a11aef70c2623f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: American Truck Simulator 1.39 Update Experimental Open Beta
notes.content:
With all of the excitement surrounding the recent releases and updates coming to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url], we are happy that the work on the planned 1.39 update has reached an important milestone! We are ready to preview it with the player community in the form of an Experimental Beta.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/682d1e34c88c770f2b1d3619add598f1926c6b89.jpg[/img]

It will still take at least several weeks before the full 1.39 release, so please keep in mind that this is the first open beta iteration and it is very much still a work in progress build which will receive updates throughout the open beta period. That's also the reason, why we have decided to call this an experimental beta, to emphasize that the initial release is rather raw and only recommended for consideration for seasoned testers.

At this time, the 1.39 Open Beta will only be available for Window users. Linux and Mac OS users will receive the option to opt-in to the beta at a later date.

If you want to take it for a spin, you can help contribute by reporting any bugs you may encounter at the [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=276]appropriate section of our official forums[/url]. Your feedback and reports are extremely valuable for our team and we thank you in advance for taking the time to help us out.

So, what can you expect to find in the 1.39 Open Beta for ATS? Let's take a closer look!

[b][u]LAUNCHPAD UPDATE[/u][/b]

One of the first things you may notice when you launch American Truck Simulator with the 1.39 Open Beta is a redesign of the current launchpad. The main reason why we are introducing this change is to pave the way for future additions; which will introduce new features to our games, that will be accessed through the launchpad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4289432fa0834ba8a4bb521e59abd8c756c1b3c4.png[/img]

Until then however, you can see that the design has changed quite significantly, especially as user profiles are now accessed via drop down option from the top of the launchpad. You will also find that the DLC manager, Mod Manager, and Profile Manager have been placed together for easier access, along with a new addition to the launchpad, Game Options. 

This allows you to change your game settings without even having to load the game. So if you're just looking to tweak your game before streaming on Twitch or adjusting a few options before heading into your truck, it can all be done from the launchpad screen. 

This is just the first iteration of the Launchpad design which is subject to changes and tuning throughout the Open Beta period. If you have any feedback to give about this design, please let us know at our [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=276]official forum thread[/url].

[b][u]LOWBOY TRAILERS[/u][/b]

As we previously announced in a [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2020/09/american-truck-simulator-lowboy-trailers.html]recent blog[/url], new Lowboy Trailers will be arriving to American Truck Simulator. These trailers have been reworked from the ground up, offering drivers the option to purchase them and use them in an array of different jobs including [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962750/American_Truck_Simulator__Special_Transport/]Special Transport[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076080/American_Truck_Simulator__Forest_Machinery/]Forest Machinery[/url], and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/620610/American_Truck_Simulator__Heavy_Cargo_Pack/]Heavy Cargo DLC's[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/804ddce8cc740df895427a9a73858ad6a9fbf3e6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7f3d95272c437c806cd95d910de861321b611f60.jpg[/img]

Owners of these trailers will benefit from a wide array of options to customize them in the upgrade shop, such as color, trailer accessories, beacons, chassis options, lengths, articulated axles, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/51d5a97a14118d82f28623764a4048e70d22f03b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/465d859bb422e8fff0097e2e65b88e28f5ea745b.jpg[/img]

You will also be able to spot them being hauled around by other truckers on the road, so make sure to give them plenty of space if you pass by one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5284d04f3c49794e9c17d393a172459264ae8b4e.jpg[/img]

[b][u]VIEWPOINTS[/u][/b]

The release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209470/American_Truck_Simulator__Idaho/]Idaho[/url] for American Truck Simulator saw the introduction of a brand new feature that has not been placed in any other previous map release. Viewpoints allow drivers to activate a special in-game "cutscene" with a short showcase of a near location or place of interest such as an industry.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/281630782f69e4e74765160e76f2731e32d3432f.jpg[/img]

After Idaho's release, it was evident from the community's response that this was a popular feature and one that many of you would like to see expanded upon. While we continue to improve this new addition, we are excited to announce that viewpoints will be arriving in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015160/American_Truck_Simulator__Washington/]Washington[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104880/American_Truck_Simulator__Utah/]Utah[/url]. Each state will receive 10 new cut-scenes to discover, which can be found nearby famous landmarks, national parks, and industries. 

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/73a466b1602d3f0e150471f2d60b5e1cc927be1e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/73a466b1602d3f0e150471f2d60b5e1cc927be1e.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/21c83666fcc86274da2f38c06abd37fb76f870ab.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/21c83666fcc86274da2f38c06abd37fb76f870ab.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fb90adb1a6238510fe165a3607c08a9d9a371122.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fb90adb1a6238510fe165a3607c08a9d9a371122.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3f712d0e1d64dd99a8598ca3ef956547ae0a3552.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3f712d0e1d64dd99a8598ca3ef956547ae0a3552.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

That is not all, however, as viewpoints will now feature a few new functionalities for drivers. You will now have the new options to either skip the viewpoint or replay it if you wish to watch it again. Viewpoints will now also show as undiscovered grey '?' icons on your map until you have visited them for the first time. Also, there are more improvements for this cool new feature still in development, as we've gathered them through the amazing and most valuable feedback from our #BestCommunityEver!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/651d6b8fc2ccce82d05429540f3df3e2d4c74326.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bbff0d5aad9de65fa74e7d4d25383937746d6cb4.jpg[/img]

This is just the first iteration of the viewpoints, which are subject to changes and tuning throughout the Open Beta period. If you encounter any bugs or have any feedback about this feature, please let us know at our [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=276]official forum thread[/url].

[b][u]GENERAL BUG FIXES/SOUND CHANGES[/u][/b]

1.39 also features various bug fixes, improvements, and an update to sounds. This includes, but is not limited to, improved interior cab sound mixing, Western Star 49X bug fixes, and improvements, and other changes in preparation for new and upcoming content.

While a majority of the changes in 1.39 are not seen visually in this version, we look forward to bringing you more content and changes in the near future. 

[b][u]CHANGELOG[/u][/b]

[b]MAP[/b]
[list][*]New Viewpoints in Washington and Utah DLCs[/*][/list][b]UI[/b]
[list][*]Launchpad Re-design[/*][/list][b]VEHICLES[/b][list][*]Lowboy trailers (ownable, including articulated ones)[/*][/list][b]FEATURES[/b][list][*]Viewpoint improvements (replayability, skip, map status, fade-out)[/*][*]Sound updates and improvements (turbo slider, sound positioning, cabin spatial mixing, sound distribution to accessories)[/*][*]Trailer browser & lister shows all valid cargo variants[/*][*]Experimental transmission input shaft emulation and clutch brake support (g_clutch_brake)[/*][/list]

[b]So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an open beta, not a stable public version - so you may encounter bugs, instability, kinks, or crashes. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to move there faster, we'll appreciate all of your feedback on our forum and your bug reports in [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=276]this section[/url].[/b]

[b]Please check our [url=https://modding.scssoft.com/wiki/Games/ATS/Modding_guides]modding wiki[/url] to get details pertaining to mods for the game.[/b]

[b]If you wish to participate in the open beta, you can find this version in the public_beta branch on Steam. The way to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right-click on American Truck Simulator → Properties → Betas tab → experimental_public_beta → 1.39. No password required.[/b]

notes.title: The Western Star® 49X is now available!
notes.content:
The NEXT Western Star® is finally here! As was revealed a few weeks ago, we have worked very closely with Western Star® and Daimler Trucks North America to bring to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] this exclusive new truck. The brand-new (and we do mean brand-new) [b]Western Star® 49X[/b] is now available for purchase from your local in-game dealership with a variety of customization options.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3Co_m8XoCGY

The most tested, durable, and toughest Western Star® truck to-date, the 49X is built to thrive in rugged environments and to take on anything. 

The Western Star® 49X in our game is initially launching with a select choice of configurations, including 2 Set-Forward chassis variants, 12 engine* and 7 transmissions options (including the Detroit™  DD13/15/16 and DT12 transmissions), in day cab form with a sizable variety of customization options. Larger sleeper variants will be added in time.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4cef0717e4e0be2defa5143b70e52b5e2f5d33ff.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4cef0717e4e0be2defa5143b70e52b5e2f5d33ff.jpg[/img][/url]

Helping to bring the newest Western Star® to the virtual roads of American Truck Simulator are 3 senior designers; each one of them dedicated to recreating a different part of the vehicle. A designer for the interior model, one for the exterior, and another for the variety of paint jobs that can be applied. Be sure to check out the unique Wings of Awesomeness paint job for this truck, which is offered as a factory option.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a7dbea83bceb9af152e5669fbe6d19d2855b55c6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a7dbea83bceb9af152e5669fbe6d19d2855b55c6.jpg[/img][/url]

We would like to once again express our utmost gratitude towards [url=https://westernstartrucks.com/]Western Star®[/url] and [url=https://daimler-trucksnorthamerica.com/]Daimler Trucks NA[/url] for this unprecedented opportunity to synchronize the truck's launch. We are extremely proud to have earned their trust and to be a part of this enormous milestone. Their generosity and close collaboration have been absolutely vital to this awesome and exclusive project. We hope that having firmly-established ourselves in the trucking industry, this project serves as a sign of things to come.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9954dd10bbd12ab5bd9fc9c0d8a7c680966645b2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9954dd10bbd12ab5bd9fc9c0d8a7c680966645b2.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Colorado: Million Dollar Highway
notes.content:
Colorado offers a long list of amazing landmarks for visitors and residents alike to admire and visit, but one specific area of this colorful state attracts drivers from across the world.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/60f3269c456a7eda0de94305900819e18abb9fb5.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/60f3269c456a7eda0de94305900819e18abb9fb5.jpg[/img][/url]

Located in the southwest, the U.S. Highway 550 stretches between New Mexico and Colorado serving as a vital link between the two states. However, there is one portion of this route that is more famous than any other, the “Million Dollar Highway”… with a name like that it’s got to be impressive, right?

[table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/744653e402f35ca556cbd2fc64e46bfb5d35c6c6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/744653e402f35ca556cbd2fc64e46bfb5d35c6c6.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/83716e7bb81fe184cbe56c5cde7dce3db05e6e84.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/83716e7bb81fe184cbe56c5cde7dce3db05e6e84.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr][/table]

Offering views of mountains, valleys and gorges, the Million Dollar Highway is a road like no other. Stretching for around 25 miles (40 km) it has been said that it's one of the nation’s most spectacular drives (and for good reason too). The highway delivers jaw-dropping vistas and stunning backdrops on its winding and often dangerous road. 

[table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d393efaa7cc894a056f95e733fe7f0f1eb0d2fa5.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d393efaa7cc894a056f95e733fe7f0f1eb0d2fa5.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/99fdbdf467046b37b6323488cb14002eb92d24c4.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/99fdbdf467046b37b6323488cb14002eb92d24c4.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr][/table]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1ec2ddcdd4d28c88db82a731fd198c4681ab4439.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1ec2ddcdd4d28c88db82a731fd198c4681ab4439.jpg[/img][/url]

So why is this stretch of road named the Million Dollar Highway? There are several stories including that it cost a million dollars a mile to build it and that its fill dirt contains a million dollars in gold ore; either way, we are sure that this will become a popular route for truckers in our upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209471/American_Truck_Simulator__Colorado/]Colorado DLC[/url] for American Truck Simulator.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0926b9fe94f5c3776a1a9986a1ef20a1d60870d6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0926b9fe94f5c3776a1a9986a1ef20a1d60870d6.jpg[/img][/url]
[table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4e9a6840c5585646068a68a4930637abac0b594c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4e9a6840c5585646068a68a4930637abac0b594c.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/18bf18e03dd2590e87e33bf930ed8335ebd7d4b2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/18bf18e03dd2590e87e33bf930ed8335ebd7d4b2.jpg[/img][/url][/td]

Excited to see more? Check out this work in progress gameplay footage from the Million Dollar Highway in American Truck Simulator! And don't forget to check our social media profiles too ([url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs]Facebook[/url]), as you might spot a piece of different content there!

notes.title: American Truck Simulator: Wheel Tuning Pack DLC Update
notes.content:
Traditionally, a trucker in American Truck Simulator will spend their time driving mostly on tarmacked highways and roads on long haul journeys, however with the introduction of new industries in different states, it is no longer uncommon to find a job contract that delivers to an area off-road.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/008b82d76f768b3c712f0e47de8beb2869c63648.jpg[/img]

With the continual development of our trucking titles, comes new industries and jobs, some of which require the drivers to move heavy and often large loads around off-road areas such as active mines on gravel roads and logging areas which are often hilly and muddy. Our next update to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/450550/American_Truck_Simulator__Wheel_Tuning_Pack/]ATS Wheel Tuning Pack DLC[/url] aims to help drivers who take these kind of jobs mores often.  

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e4cc5e83b5995c9f7bdd4db0e7c3e824622a9534.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e4cc5e83b5995c9f7bdd4db0e7c3e824622a9534.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a00e6cd2655100fd716b4a4f7f5d339f0e7e190e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a00e6cd2655100fd716b4a4f7f5d339f0e7e190e.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e10415db0ebc70761834b00ea4ce2d20de4700e4.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e10415db0ebc70761834b00ea4ce2d20de4700e4.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
Today, we are happy to announce that new heavy-duty wheels will be arriving in the Wheel Tuning Pack DLC for American Truck Simulator. The new tyre has a deeper tread, plus a larger and wider size made from thicker rubber, which is the perfect combination for off-road truckers, but that isn't all.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/864f1c49e150220f812da556bd5fd43a326fc258.jpg[/img]

We are also updating all of our existing 14 rim designs so that they can fit our new wider heavy-duty wheels as well as rear super-single wheels. This mean you can continue to use your favorite rim designs for any job on or off-road.

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/feac016eee77198ece1479ca82cbfd37e8f733d3.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/feac016eee77198ece1479ca82cbfd37e8f733d3.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/44a89dc2d87757271f94003bfaea3ec083c0808c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/44a89dc2d87757271f94003bfaea3ec083c0808c.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
We hope you will enjoy this update to the Wheel Tuning Pack for ATS. We know how important it is for drivers to look after their truck with the right equipment and parts, so we are excited to see how the community will utilize these new additions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/27ebefa5f11032cebc1186ecd9f68239b2410807.jpg[/img]

notes.title: American Truck Simulator: Lowboy Trailers
notes.content:
A trucker wouldn't be much without their truck and trailer, and the same is true within our simulation titles. Today we are excited to share with you some news about lowboy trailers in American Truck Simulator that will come with 1.39 update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/64f9b9d056ab7944d0faaf44af17dadb16289d5a.jpg[/img]

Lowboy trailers are specialized flatbed trailers that are great for hauling heavy or oversized loads, thanks to their design that provide a low ride height, they have the ability to carry legal loads up to 12 ft tall, which other traditional trailers cannot. In our next update for American Truck Simulator, we are happy to announce the arrival of a new lowboy trailer that comes in an array of different configurations, as well as a few other features which we know many drivers will enjoy. 

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5284d04f3c49794e9c17d393a172459264ae8b4e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5284d04f3c49794e9c17d393a172459264ae8b4e.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3af5745d28151ec789139ecee2cc922f6a870b88.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3af5745d28151ec789139ecee2cc922f6a870b88.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
Drivers will now be able to purchase their own lowboy trailer and use them in the cargo market. Owners of these trailers will benefit from a wide array of options to customize them in the upgrade shop, such as color, trailer accessories, beacons, chassis options, lengths, articulated axles, and more! 

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7f3d95272c437c806cd95d910de861321b611f60.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7f3d95272c437c806cd95d910de861321b611f60.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/804ddce8cc740df895427a9a73858ad6a9fbf3e6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/804ddce8cc740df895427a9a73858ad6a9fbf3e6.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
Lowboy Trailers have now also been updated to be included in various add-on packages including Special Transport and Heavy Cargo DLC's. We hope you enjoy using these trailers across a variety of different job contracts.

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6e093288db020ff4e38fa8dc81bc2373fed25eab.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6e093288db020ff4e38fa8dc81bc2373fed25eab.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ba5a63f3413d7e636f004fa12856f2ec952746bf.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ba5a63f3413d7e636f004fa12856f2ec952746bf.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
Not only will you be able to take advantage of the new lowboy trailer, but so will other drivers on the road. lowboys will also be now hauled around in traffic as you travel through America, so make sure to give them plenty of space if you pass by them. 

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/51d5a97a14118d82f28623764a4048e70d22f03b.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/51d5a97a14118d82f28623764a4048e70d22f03b.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/465d859bb422e8fff0097e2e65b88e28f5ea745b.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/465d859bb422e8fff0097e2e65b88e28f5ea745b.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
We can't wait for you to get truckin' with these new lowboy trailers in our next update. Let us know what you think of them in the comments below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1c115d99fe2ea5e40a5de4912138022e5fe1fc33.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Colorado: Landmarks
notes.content:
From locations of historical importance to unique structures, the U.S state of Colorado offers a long list of amazing landmarks for visitors and residents alike to admire and vist. So what landmarks will you able to find in the upcoming Colorado DLC for American Truck Simulator? Here is a sample of what you can come across on your travels across this colorful state. 

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/34abdd1020976b9af5b7e90e7c3ff2d78f988f12.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/34abdd1020976b9af5b7e90e7c3ff2d78f988f12.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/78c34f49dc5f6b62497a99cb2975a714b088bcd6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/78c34f49dc5f6b62497a99cb2975a714b088bcd6.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e241ba9bc80b6e1bd775b3f483ba483b6a09ae6c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e241ba9bc80b6e1bd775b3f483ba483b6a09ae6c.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

Nicknamed the 'Switzerland of America' the city of Ouray is home to some of Colorado's most historical buildings which date back to the nineteenth century. Most of the architecture located in the downtown district are listed on the National Register of Historic Places and is a popular destination for many tourists.

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4571b9dce9a896dc7d4fe595963c8b00eb547e60.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4571b9dce9a896dc7d4fe595963c8b00eb547e60.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/428da0745aa32a50bad88b2f0071da7ef422346c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/428da0745aa32a50bad88b2f0071da7ef422346c.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

If you're looking for a country escape, then Steamboat Springs is a must-visit destination for nature lovers and adventure junkies. Best known for its premier family-friendly ski resort, it has become a vacation destination for many. Much like Ouray, it also features a historic downtown area which includes the famous old town square, a must stop for any visitor or driver passing through.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a6c3995b6ce95b777eac07974328035f50986b15.jpg[/img]

Ever wanted to visit 4 states in 1 trip? well now you can! Located in the Navajo Nation Tribal Park, is the Four Corners Monument, the only place place in the U.S where four states meet. Visit Arizona, New Mexico, Colorado and Utah and admire the beautiful surrounding desert-like landscapes.

notes.title: American Truck Simulator is big enough that the devs are getting unreleased truck models
notes.content:
Sure, seeing brand-new car models in racing games is old hat by now, but the same can't be said for the big trucks of the world. Peterbilt and Kenworth offered the developers of American Truck Simulator a limited number of models at launch, and it's taken years worth of updates for manufacturers like International, Mack, and Volvo to join the game. But it seems things are starting to change.

The Next Western Star model, as the manufacturer is calling it, is still under wraps, due to be unveiled to the public on September 29. But the devs at SCS Software have already had access to a prototype to start building a digital version of the truck, which will be released in American Truck Simulator "very shortly after" its real-world counterpart.

"It is a first for SCS Software to work this closely with a leading American truck manufacturer on synchronizing the release of a brand-new truck," the devs say in the announcement blog. "We are extremely proud to have established ourselves firmly within the trucking industry; earning Daimler Trucks North America's trust to get physical access to the prototype truck, which was necessary to start building this truck for our virtual world."

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: The NEXT Western Star® is Coming to American Truck Simulator
notes.content:
Today we are very pleased to reveal a top-secret project that we've been working on for the past few months; one that is hugely special for us too.

We are certain that our community of truck enthusiasts is familiar with an upcoming and still under-wraps truck from Western Star®, currently named and promoted as The NEXT Western Star.

[previewyoutube=_Kjal_FcFn4;full][/previewyoutube]
This new truck is built to thrive in the most rugged of environments, on a heritage of toughness, and built to take on anything. The most tested, durable, and toughest Western Star® truck to-date will be unveiled on the 29th of September. 

You can follow the countdown [url=https://www.westernstartrucks.com/TheNext/]on their dedicated website[/url].

With great honor and pleasure, we can now announce that [b]very shortly after[/b] The NEXT Western Star® truck releases, we will herald its arrival to American Truck Simulator too. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a7cda31ec7669d1d9505c91f0e61e2f899a16e66.jpg[/img]

We greatly appreciate this superb opportunity for such a collaboration with them; it is a first for SCS Software to work this closely with a leading American truck manufacturer on synchronizing the release of a brand-new truck. 

We are extremely proud to have established ourselves firmly within the trucking industry; earning Daimler Trucks North America's trust to get physical access to the prototype truck, which was necessary to start building this truck for our virtual world.

Whilst not being able to show all our cards today, we trust that this comes as a truly exciting announcement (with a few teaser shots) for you as it is for us, to be working on The NEXT Western Star® truck. Stay tuned to the communication channels from us ([url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]Twitter[/url]) or from Western Star® ([url=https://www.facebook.com/westernstartrucks]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/westernstartruck/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/WstrnStarTrucks]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCinl26MPtYLL-j19dWk_Msw]YouTube[/url], [url=https://www.westernstartrucks.com/TheNext/]Website[/url]) to stay updated on this latest truck launch!

notes.title: Colorado: There's Gold In Them Thar Hills!
notes.content:
The year is 1890, Wyoming and Idaho have just been admitted as the 43rd and 44th states in the USA and the last great North American "Gold Rush" has just begun. 73kms southwest of Colorado Springs, a "part-time cowboy and full-time drinker" known as Robert Womack has just found small specks of gold glittering in the local creek, which encouraged him to dig countless prospecting holes in an attempt to find more. The outcome? The richest gold mine in Colorado's history.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/df5608e7f4ba89ad98ef81340a8e0568d842d264.jpg[/img]

Today The Cripple Creek & Victor Gold Mine is still an active mining area, being the only remaining significant producer of gold in the state. In 2019, the mine excavated over 11 tons of gold, which was priced at around $511 million USD. In the same year, the mine had reported to have an estimated 118 tons of proven and probable reserves which have yet to be excavated.

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d1a2d3a1d16aefe5b23388ed8c4a5a92d44655aa.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d1a2d3a1d16aefe5b23388ed8c4a5a92d44655aa.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/25f8376d9083e181de299b078988c02d2d28a0e9.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/25f8376d9083e181de299b078988c02d2d28a0e9.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
With plenty of work still to do, there is no shortage of jobs for drivers who haul important mining equipment and waste rock to and from the mining site. In our upcoming Colorado DLC for American Truck Simulator, truckers will be able to assist in the day to day operations of this enormous open-pit mine located near Colorado Springs. Just make sure to take extra care when driving on the dirt roads that lead into the delivery points.

notes.title: #CruisingIdaho Wrap-Up
notes.content:
On July 16th, we invited you to take part in our [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2020/07/cruising-idaho-event.html]World of Trucks Event #CruisingIdaho[/url], which celebrated the release of Idaho for American Truck Simulator. The community goal at hand was to achieve 30,000,000 miles (48,280,320 km) while delivering cargoes to or from any city in Idaho, and deliver you did.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e74a3c5855ce1ca05554e9aba6d39536eeccc556.jpg[/img]

In one of the fastest event completions we've seen, you achieved the set goal in less than 72 hours, wow! We couldn't believe how fast the goal was met; it just goes to show the amazing power of our #BestCommunityEver. While the community goal was completed, there were still many truckers who hadn't had the time to complete their personal goal to explore all 11 cities in Idaho. So we decided to extend the event not once, but twice, just to make sure everyone got a chance to gain their rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c4906409bb7be8deb73dd75b622f67d6ce2ca0b7.png[/img]

Incredible work truckers! We cannot thank you enough for your support during the release of Idaho and we are excited at the idea of what other unique events we can bring to the American Truck Simulator and Euro Truck Simulator 2. It really does bring a lot of joy to our team to see how much you enjoy participating in these events. We hope you ride with pride with your newly acquired Idaho paint jobs & hanging accessory.

notes.title: Colorado Road Network
notes.content:
Truckers can spend over 300 days per year on the road delivering a variety of loads across different states and countries. That is why our teams spend a lot of time making sure road networks are represented in the best way possible within our titles; and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209471/American_Truck_Simulator__Colorado/]Colorado[/url] for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator [/url]will be no exception.

[/tr][/table]

From unique junctions to famous truck stops, Colorado will feature unique road layouts and landmarks familiar to truckers who drive in the area frequently. One such example is [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mousetrap_(Denver)]the Mousetrap[/url], the nickname given to an interchange located near the city of Denver that was built in the 1950s. Today, its layout has become a landmark known to the millions of drivers that pass through it every year.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/920a88292628438c72e0091eb467e910cc08b1eb.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/920a88292628438c72e0091eb467e910cc08b1eb.jpg[/img][/url]

Truck stops are also another important aspect to truckers in the United States. Every night, these stops become a temporary home and safe space for drivers from around the country as they make their journey. Each one has its own unique look and feel, which we are doing our best to recreate in our title with each new DLC.

notes.title: #CruisingIdaho Extended!
notes.content:
Having received quite a few messages from our #BestCommunityEver about not finding enough free time to finish their personal goal in the currently ongoing [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/2724065888612012350]#CruisingIdaho[/url] World of Trucks event, we started wondering if we should extend its duration a little bit more.

https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/2724065888612012350

Summer is now in full swing, which means that people are spending more time with their families or on travelling and vacations (well, at least for those who can despite the COVID-19 challenges affecting tourism and travelling in general); many may not have met the requirements needed to obtain the event's rewards. We've also gotten quite a few messages from our players who were getting stuck on trying to reach the event's goal, which meant that they needed more time to successfully complete the event. 

We suggest reading the event's rules very carefully. You are asked to pick-up from or deliver a job to all of the 11 cities in Idaho. For example, if you start a job from Boise and complete its delivery to Idaho Falls, this will count as 2 of the 11 cities required for the event's personal goal. However, if you then complete a job from Idaho Falls to Salmon, this job will earn you only 1 additional completed city as Idaho Falls has already served as the start/end point for a previous delivery. You will have to start a delivery from or deliver to all of the 11 cities in Idaho DLC to complete the personal goal. If you're not sure what cities have you had in your recent deliveries, you can always check a few recent jobs you did in the [url=https://www.worldoftrucks.com/en/jobs/]Log Book[/url] on World of Trucks website.

notes.title: #CaptureIdaho Contest
notes.content:
With the recent release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209470/American_Truck_Simulator__Idaho/]Idaho[/url] for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url], the internet has been flooded with screenshots and videos from our community. From the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/trucksim/]/r/TruckSim[/url] Reddit to our [url=https://twitter.com/scssoftware]official Twitter[/url] profile, you have been sharing your journey across this new DLC and your favorite viewpoints along the way.

With so many screenshots to like and re-post, we wanted to give back to our community with the opportunity to earn rewards for sharing their travels; introducing #CaptureIdaho !

The contest is simple, capture a screenshot from the state of Idaho in American Truck Simulator, and share it with us across any of our official social media channels with the hashtag #CaptureIdaho. You could win some great rewards! 
So what should you capture? It can be anything from Idaho! We are encouraging you to get creative with this contest. You could take a photo of your favorite landmark, truck, scenic viewpoint, or even a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hd8vvWppdxg]pedestrian with sweet dance moves.[/url] 
Our team of specialist judges will be keeping a watch and making notes for some of their favorite screenshots. To make sure you understand the contest, here are the rules set to help you understand the entry requirements. 

[h2]Rules[/h2]
[list]
[*]Your screenshot [b]must be[/b] taken in the state of Idaho in American Truck Simulator.
[*]You must post your screenshot to any social media platform and include a tag to our official social media account and the hashtag #CaptureIdaho.
[/list]
You can find our official social media handles here: [url=http://instagram.com/scs.software/]SCS Software Instagram[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/scssoftware]SCS Software Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs/]American Truck Simulator Facebook page[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]SCS Software Facebook page.[/url]

[list]
[*]Third-party modifications, editing, and post-processing [b]IS[/b] allowed (get creative!)
[*]You can enter as many times as you like, however, we encourage quality over quantity.
[*]The contest will end on the [b]3rd of September 2020.[/b]
[/list]
So what prizes can you win? Let's take a look at the rewards on offer here!

[h2]Prizes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]1st Place:[/b] a special T-shirt with + a 100€ voucher which can be used on our official e-shop + a Steam key for any of our released and available products on Steam
[*][b]2nd Place:[/b] a special T-shirt  + a 100€ voucher which can be used on our official e-shop
[*][b]3rd Place:[/b] a special T-shirt + a Steam key for any of our released and available products on Steam
[/list]
[b]PLUS[/b] we will choose 5 more winners who will also receive a special T-shirt!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/57eb0dc27af2351f2921050bbf4ad7f0aed00f66.png[/img]

We look forward to seeing all your entries and how you can #CaptureIdaho in a unique or different way! Plus if you want, join us on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/scssoftware]Twitch[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209470/American_Truck_Simulator__Idaho/]Steam[/url] tomorrow from 18.00 CEST as we will do a live stream full of Idaho gameplay, Steam keys giveaway, and chatting with you, our #BestCommunityEver!

Don't forget, you will also have until the 16th of August to earn your #CruisingIdaho achievements and rewards (in-case you were looking to kill 2 birds with one stone) you can read more about that event at our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/2724065888612012350]previous blog post[/url]. notes.title: The Great Plains of Colorado
notes.content:
As one of the more diverse states in terms of geography and topography, the US region of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209471/American_Truck_Simulator__Colorado/]Colorado[/url] is known for its national parks and modern cities. The state is especially famous for its Rocky Mountains, however, much of the eastern part of the region is dominated by a unique grassland that extends across the American continent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/47125ad2dd4c86d074a6210fd60da7788d245a36.jpg[/img]

From Northern Canada to Southern Texas, the Great Plains is an area that stretches more than eighteen hundred miles from north to south and more than five hundred miles from east to west. Today, much of this expansive prairie is used for agriculture that produces dozens of food and fiber products.

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a6e723d2272c04b5b078756989b08009eac7e826.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a6e723d2272c04b5b078756989b08009eac7e826.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4d9cfa85ebb055c74f726b9044618c4aaf46a6fe.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4d9cfa85ebb055c74f726b9044618c4aaf46a6fe.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/537aab4af4fbff8013257be69b2357e0c84385db.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/537aab4af4fbff8013257be69b2357e0c84385db.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9f485b269708bf135aaab452c170d5ba58276d88.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9f485b269708bf135aaab452c170d5ba58276d88.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
Wheat, barley, canola, corn, cotton, sorghum, and soybeans are just a few types of crops and produce planted and grown by farmers in the Great Plains; but that's not all! This large expanse of land is also perfect for grazing livestock, the majority of them being pigs and cattle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/85496a95b30501cdbd9c03248b45c0f002b71be3.jpg[/img]

In Colorado, nearly half of the states 66 million acres are dedicated just to farms and ranches, which makes it one of its largest industries. Drivers in our upcoming DLC will be sure to play a key role in contributing to this important economy and exporting the states produce across the states. From hay bales to farming equipment, truckers will be the backbone of making sure this important and large industry in Colorado keeps on [i]moo-vin'[/i]!

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/401563329e70a250358aba7df6ff6dbef737c4a6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/401563329e70a250358aba7df6ff6dbef737c4a6.jpg[/img][/url][/td]

If you think that Colorado for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/]American Truck Simulator[/url] will be [i]plain[/i] amazing, then be sure to add it your Steam Wishlist!

notes.title: The First 5 Days of #CruisingIdaho
notes.content:
Five days ago, we released the latest expansion for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url], the state of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209470/American_Truck_Simulator__Idaho/]Idaho[/url]. 
With its release, we also introduced a very special [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url] event for our community, the [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2020/07/cruising-idaho-event.html]#CruisingIdaho event[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/cd9bd0bb899a5d09dca9afcc3711bd6109141f3f.jpg[/img]

We wanted to set the community goal to a number which wouldn't put too much pressure on our players while hoping it would last for at least a week or two, but you, our #BestCommunityEver have smashed right through it and have left us speechless once again!

Your amazing support kicked the Idaho DLC to the first position in Global Top Sellers on Steam to steal a few minutes of fame from other big titles (sorry Death Stranding, but not sorry). Thank you so much for your support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c84f5a8da59d4609a6786f994d6fc7a6b7322639.png[/img]

But that was not enough for you, because immediately thousands of you joined the #CruisingIdaho event and the community goal of 30,000,000 miles was completed on Sunday morning, which left us all astonished!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/54f971e9d23e7416695f4414b5bf2bd598b6dba2.png[/img]

But please do not worry for a second! Because with the community goal finished, it doesn't mean that we are going to end the event anytime soon! We do not want to bring any pressure or make you feel like you have to hurry and rush through this new DLC to complete the personal goal to earn the rewards. You all can slow down your trucks a bit, open windows, let the fresh Idaho air come to your truck's cabin, and enjoy the view a bit.

[b][u]  The event will conclude on the 16th of August, 2020, 23:59 UTC![/u][/b]

Meanwhile, while you're filling up your tanks or taking a rest at some of the new Idaho rest stops, you can watch some of the community videos created in this latest map expansion! notes.title: Idaho Release
notes.content:
The day has come and so has [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209470/American_Truck_Simulator__Idaho/]Idaho[/url]! Preparations for a release party are in top gear! We are also preparing for a special release stream with special guests. So when exactly is Idaho releasing?

[h3][b]Idaho for American Truck Simulator will be released at
09:00 PDT / 12:00 EST / 17:00 BST / 18:00 CEST /
 00:00 ₊₁ SGT / 02:00 ₊₁ AEST[/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=4e0uztR4Ydk;full][/previewyoutube]

So what exactly does Idaho have to offer? This new expansion features:
[list][*]Over 3,300 miles of new roads to discover and explore[/*][*]11 new cities - drive through downtown Boise, Coeur d'Alene set on a gorgeous lake or Idaho Falls with a lovely touristic center[/*][*]A brand new viewpoint feature that gives you a new perspective of the world[/*][*]Expanded fan-favorite industries such as farming, timber harvesting or wood processing[/*][*]Visit the famous Craters of the Moon National Monument and Preserve[/*][*]Over 40 recognizable spots from the Historical Highway Marker program[/*][*]State-specific geographical landmarks such as canyons, valleys or basalt rock formations[/*][*]Many familiar truck stops and rest areas that truckers will know from the real world[/*][*]Finely-tuned road layouts and true-to-life signage[/*][*]Idaho-specific achievements to unlock[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/00eb4813d471592e24614d7076edf43f96337c18.jpg[/img]

And that shouldn't be the only reason to explore the State for yourself! As an added bonus we will also have a World of Trucks event for all new visitors to Idaho with unique rewards to be earned as you visit each city and deliver jobs. Learn more about the rules in our [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2020/07/cruising-idaho-event.html]yesterday blog post[/url] and take part in [b]#CruisingIdaho[/b] at [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]WorldofTrucks.com[/url]. We'd love to see your photos across our Social Media channels using the hashtag!

We expect to have this event available to players for an extended period of time, probably way beyond the point of reaching the 30 million miles community goal. We don't want to motivate you to rush through the DLC in a hurry to make sure you manage to obtain the personal achievement. We simply want to reward early adopters of the DLC for spending quality time with the new content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9f30419431304200efd19f890cc5fe88d618da5f.jpg[/img]

We will also be hosting a special Idaho release live-stream across Steam & Twitch starting at 15:00 CEST. Don't miss out on this broadcast as we talk with members of the map and research teams involved in the creation of Idaho and a special guest appearance from Pavel Šebor CEO of SCS Software! We will be answering questions from the community, talking in-depth about the DLC and of course, releasing Idaho LIVE on stream!

With the release of Idaho, we will also be making a new special Steam discount bundle available. Introducing the Pacific Northwest bundle which includes the American Truck Simulator base game as well as Idaho, Washington, Oregon, Forest Machinery DLCs, and the Classic Stripes Paint Jobs Pack. The way Steam bundles work, it's both a perfect bundle for any new drivers who are keen to make a start in their new truckin' career, as well as a way for the loyal fans to obtain the new DLC at a nice discount if you already own the previous DLCs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/21696c3bcae6dae8b2de6211f450e5bf7364bccb.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy exploring what Idaho has to offer, we will see you on the roads!

notes.title: Cruising Idaho Event
notes.content:
With the release of the[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209470/American_Truck_Simulator__Idaho/] Idaho DLC[/url] just around the corner, we want to invite you, our #BestCommunityEver, to join us in Cruising Idaho - our latest [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World Of Trucks event[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9f30419431304200efd19f890cc5fe88d618da5f.jpg[/img]

We know drivers from around the world are excited to visit Idaho, and we are just as eager for you to get across the border for yourselves. That is why we are happy to announce this new event which will reward drivers who visit the Gem State and contribute to Idaho's local economy and industries.

The most important thing is to be [b]#CruisingIdaho[/b] and clocking up the job miles. We promise it will be worth it, with beauty to behold and a rich history to experience. You can even use your own trailer in the external market!

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e9c0ab203d40e5ce91f1f9ca5d40f79a25a8debe.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e9c0ab203d40e5ce91f1f9ca5d40f79a25a8debe.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fa62ad36799b867e867881e51ce533573499deb9.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fa62ad36799b867e867881e51ce533573499deb9.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/771e7c0a6b438b63eb455ce9e7b57d28d06deb99.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/771e7c0a6b438b63eb455ce9e7b57d28d06deb99.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0241894d04875bc76cbd861632dd47d60d137be0.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0241894d04875bc76cbd861632dd47d60d137be0.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

The community goal is simple. [u][b]Achieve 30,000,000 miles[/b][/u] (48,280,320 km) while delivering cargoes to or from any city in Idaho. Technical supplies, farming produce, mining, and transportation equipment, household and building materials, supermarket goods, automotive fleets, and parts. In fact, you can deliver anything at all!

During your travels don't forget to stop at some of Idaho's many viewing platforms, each offering unique cinematic cutscenes, highlighting the attractions of that area. There's so much to see that we can't list it all, but here are some we can easily recommend.

[list][*]Take in the magnificent mountain vista of Galena summit.[/*][*]Cruise over the historic Perrine memorial bridge with its majestic views, including the Shosone Falls.[/*][*]Experience the volcanic Craters of the Moon National Monument.[/*][*]Take a snapshot at the famous 45th parallel north, halfway between the Equator and North Pole.[/*][*]See if you can spot Sharlie, the famous serpent, in McCalls' Payette Lake.[/*][*]Navigate through the craggy and imposing Grand View Canyon.[/*][*]Pull over to read some of the many Historical Markers that preserve the history of the early pioneers and Native Americans of Idaho.[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9a79576b4f46d09c1099ae8ee96e872fb713ffed.jpg[/img]

There are 11 cities in the Idaho DLC and we want you to see them all. So, we're giving a special reward for completing your personal goal which will require job deliveries to or from all of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/265957df21b12f8d6f68a287e96396ca3e2f554f.jpg[/img]

Both the personal and community rewards are a reflection of Idaho's unique natural history and beauty, and we really think you will like them. But more on that in the rules, so please be sure to read them.

Idaho, Esto Perpetua (It is forever), is our latest addition to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url]. Let's see her sites, breathe the air, and take in the grandness of this incredible and varied state.

[b][u]Rules:[/u][/b]

Using [b]External Contracts[/b] or [b]External Market[/b], with a [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url]-connected profile in American Truck Simulator, the [b]community goal[/b] is to achieve 30,000,000 miles (48,280,320 km) while delivering cargoes to or from any city in Idaho.

The cities are:

Sandpoint, Coeur d'Alene, Lewiston, Grangeville, Salmon, Boise, Ketchum, Idaho Falls, Nampa, Twin Falls, Pocatello.

When a player completes delivery [b]to or from[/b] all 11 Idaho cities, it will complete their[b] personal goal[/b].

All jobs for the event need to be[b] 100 miles [/b]each (161 km) or more.

To verify if you comply with the rules, you can review your recent deliveries in the [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/jobs]World of Trucks' LogBook[/url].

[b][u]Rewards:[/u][/b]

notes.title: American Truck Simulator's new graphical upgrade isn't huge, but it is nice
notes.content:
Just ahead of the new American Truck Simulator‘s launch, developers SCS Software have injected a touch of nitro into the game engine with screen space ambient occlusion (SSAO). This technique for making shadows more realistic is not a mega-fancy and drastic modern technobell or cyberwhistle, but it is a welcome one. The scenery just feels more… present. So simply by downloading a patch, my game has become prettier. Nice.
