We couldn't think of a more appropriate time to announce that Utah will become the seventh state in our game than on Independence Day! 

And why the Bee teaser? Because Utah is nicknamed the Beehive state, as the Beehive represents hard work and industry. It is also connected to the early pioneer Mormon settlers in the region.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1104880/ss_6432ea7d962033bfd97d948bd284c88155b449b9.1920x1080.jpg?t=1562252700][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1104880/ss_6432ea7d962033bfd97d948bd284c88155b449b9.600x338.jpg?t=1562252700][/img][/url]

Today, Utah has a population of more than 3 million spread across on 84,899 square miles and features a dry, semi-arid to a desert climate. Utah's many mountains also guarantee a large variety of climates creating a very specific atmosphere with which we tried our best to recreate.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1104880/ss_ef6754c91b294ff798972af8ff260b0571909c3c.1920x1080.jpg?t=1562252700][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1104880/ss_ef6754c91b294ff798972af8ff260b0571909c3c.600x338.jpg?t=1562252700[/img][/url]

Coming of Utah will also break the "hockey stick" or "L-shape" as you, our community, nicknamed the actual game map. This will allow for a better variety in routes between your destinations and hopefully, bring a richer variety behind the wheel. You will also find new cargoes available since Utah is the center to many different industries.

From now, until the release of this map expansion later this year, you can look forward to more blog posts and articles dedicated to Utah, accompanied with screenshots mapping the development progress. 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1104880/ss_b1af72d640f818e67d7b2df2f241be02afa7bd76.1920x1080.jpg?t=1562252700][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1104880/ss_b1af72d640f818e67d7b2df2f241be02afa7bd76.600x338.jpg?t=1562252700][/img][/url]

Meanwhile, why don't you add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104880/American_Truck_Simulator__Utah/]American Truck Simulator - Utah[/url] to your Steam wishlist?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104880/American_Truck_Simulator__Utah/

notes.title: Crossing the gap
notes.content:
Following the latest mini-update for 1.35 and the recently released [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015160/American_Truck_Simulator__Washington/]Washington[/url] map expansion and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076080/American_Truck_Simulator__Forest_Machinery/]Forest Machinery[/url] DLC, we think that it is time to highlight the most important feature extension.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/7bf79bee1e79d5e3314ef5e25f035d1daaa52145.jpg[/img]

Since the announcement of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/925580/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Beyond_the_Baltic_Sea/]ETS2 Beyond the Baltic Sea[/url], you have been speculating on how we are going to solve the issue that arises when someone owns a map expansion that is without a direct connection to the base game map (and possibly other map expansions one may have). The release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015160/American_Truck_Simulator__Washington/]Washington[/url] marks the first time that this has happened in the history of our games (if a player did not already own the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/800370/American_Truck_Simulator__Oregon/]Oregon[/url] DLC).

Right from the Closed Beta for the 1.35 Update, you've had the option to buy garages online. This is tailored mostly for our seasoned gamers who already have the required number of garages and some spare cash. New players will have to work to unlock this privilege.

For new players who are just getting into our games, we're adding a second option based on a wider range of Quick Job starting locations. This allows for a new trucker to explore any part of the map (enabling one to purchase a garage there) and to then teleport between purchased garages. We hope that this resolves the issue caused by unconnected map expansions for everyone, both for now and for the future.

In more news, we have just added new Steam achievements for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076080/American_Truck_Simulator__Forest_Machinery/]Forest Machinery[/url] DLC (you didn't think we'd leave you achievement-less, right? ːB1ː).

notes.title: Careers at SCS Software
notes.content:
Having a fan community as great as the one we have brings many benefits. You may have noticed that there's a good number of people on the SCS team who were hired from the community. They ended up working full time on what was once “only” their favourite game. We're sure that names like 50Keda, SiSL, Mandelsoft, LondonLad, Natvander, Oscar and others are well known to many among you - and every single one of them has brought a unique approach to help our games grow.

We have had great experiences with modders and content creators joining our team. As we still continue to grow in the effort to improve the quality and scope of future projects, we've decided to approach you, our community about our open job opportunities. If you have ever given any thought about joining SCS Software team, now's the best time to do that!

[url=https://scssoft.com/jobs][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/2438fd9f085f45646a76e2e220292b781b2896e6.jpg[/img][/url]

Currently, we have [u]9 open positions[/u] which you can browse in detail on our [url=https://scssoft.com/jobs]company career page[/url]. For each of these positions, we are open to accepting more applicants. Let's introduce the 3 main openings!

[h1]World/ Map designer[/h1]
We are looking for talented [url=https://scssoft.com/jobs/career-junior-world-map-designer]Junior[/url] and [url=https://scssoft.com/jobs/career-senior-world-map-designer]Senior[/url] map designers. Right now we're looking for a good number of both, as we're trying to expand our map teams and speed up production. So if you already have some game design experience or better yet, experience with making/modifying maps for our games, or you simply feel you got the talent and love for our games, you're who we're looking for!

[h1]3D artist[/h1]
We're also looking for [url=https://scssoft.com/jobs/career-junior-3d-artist]Junior[/url] and [url=https://scssoft.com/jobs/career-senior-3d-artist]Senior[/url] 3D artists. If you have working experience in Maya, Photoshop and a portfolio featuring your professional or private 3D work, do not hesitate to contact us. There's a wide variety of possible work specialisations and we'll be happy to go through them with you to find the one that interests you most!

[h1]Programmer[/h1]
There are two options for you. As a "regular" [url=https://scssoft.com/jobs/career-programmer]programmer[/url]; you are strong in C++ and well versed with common development tasks such as debugging, profiling, and VCS management. You can focus on a specific part of our game development; one which is best suited to your skillset (see "Considerable pluses").

Or if your interest is programming and also graphics, you may be suited for the position of [url=https://scssoft.com/jobs/career-maya-specialist]Maya Specialist[/url]. You will be working in close cooperation with our graphics team to create new tools and improvements, giving them more and better options for future projects!

Languages used in our office are Czech and English, so the ability to speak one of them well is needed. However, the most important part is the passion for our games.

All these positions are full-time and based in our Prague studio, we'll be happy to give a hand if you need to relocate. After all, living in one of the most beautiful and safest cities in Europe while working on something you love sounds like a great idea, right? ːcsdsmileː

notes.title: American Truck Simulator now rolling through forests and mountains of Washington
notes.content:
After several days of thomping basslines and screaming industry professionals in service of games that won’t be out until next year, tonight I am very much looking forward to a quiet drive through forested mountains. American Truck Simulator just launched its Washington expansion, adding another state to haul cargo through – a real pretty state at that. Sea! Mountains! Forests! Bridges! Logging roads! The Grand Coulee Dam! The Space Needle! Another city bearing the cursed name of Aberdeen! Places from Twin Peaks! Just me, the road, a riot grrrl playlist, and eighteen wheels of steel laden with logs that are already two hours late because I got distracted by a river and crashed into a tree.

(more…)

notes.title: American Truck Simulator Update 1.35
notes.content:
We've completed the testing cycle and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] Update 1.35 is now live!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/dfb2a986276a7c5771fc231a7439d7e56222d444.jpg[/img]

First off, let us thank all of you who helped us with your bug reports, opinions and general feedback during the Experimental and Public Beta phases. The changelog is really huge and testing it would have been much harder without you. Its size is also the reason for why we won't describe all the details here again (please read the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1621770561046660399]Public Beta[/url] article).

Most of you have already noticed that since a few days ago, a GPS voice navigation function was added to the Public Beta build of American Truck Simulator. For the initial phase, you can choose from 9 different language options (English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian, Polish, Turkish and Mandarin Chinese). As with most of the new features, you can expect more options and improvements in the future. And while we have already amassed a considerable amount of feedback from the 1.35 update for Euro Truck Simulator 2, don't be shy to add your own feedback on our [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=122]forum[/url] - the more the merrier!

Now here's a short recap video to help you navigate through all the changes and new features before [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015160/American_Truck_Simulator__Washington/]Washington[/url] arrives tomorrow! Are you ready to truck on?!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j3519pQCOs0

[b]To enjoy the 1.35 update, make sure to OPT OUT of beta branches and your game will be automatically updated on Steam.[/b]

Some mods, however, may not have caught up yet - this update can effectively break them; remember that you can always stay on 1.34 or an even older branch. Follow these instructions to access and select them: Steam client → LIBRARY → right click on American Truck Simulator → Properties → Betas tab → select the version you want.

Also, check our [url=https://modding.scssoft.com/wiki/Games/ATS/Modding_guides]modding wiki[/url] to get details pertaining to mods for the game.

notes.title: Washington: Infrastructure
notes.content:
As we near the release of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015160/American_Truck_Simulator__Washington/]upcoming map expansion[/url] for American Truck Simulator, we want to focus on some of the areas that truckers will use most on their travels around Washington and the west coast.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/27da13ee998dabec753dd11828ac55c334a76dc3.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/b68d769778b4ba93c30af7bab24308096b3a8c6c.jpg[/img][/url]

An essential part of any long-haul journey are Truckstops and rest areas. An area where a driver can take a break from the road. Whether you are taking a snooze, filling up on fuel or even weighing your load, with 10 Truckstops, 4 Rest areas and 13 Weigh stations in Washington, you will never be too far away from a stop to take a 10-100.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/516e1e34a43179362bdda06df30163edeef00ba5.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/17e34d9d3855e4aea72451f7994101fca15babc5.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: American Truck Simulator: Washington making Twin Peaks truckdreams come true next week
notes.content:
America would have you believe that California is the locus of important video game happenings next week with E3. Pish. The real American excitement of next week is American Truck Simulator‘s Washington expansion, which developers SCS Software today announced they’ll launch on Tuesday the 11th. E3 be damned, I’m hopping in my virtuarig and driving out Los Angeles, up California and Oregon, past mountains, along coasts, through forests, and to that there Twin Peaks waterfall. Goodbye Geoff Keighley and hello Audrey Horne!

(more…)

notes.title: ATS Washington Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
We have loved sharing with you our progress on Washington, and with the final touches being made to the map, we are now ready to confirm a date...

[h1][b]We are excited to announce that the Washington map expansion for American Truck Simulator will be released on the 11th of June, 2019.[/b][/h1]

We hope that this short trailer will give you a small glimpse on what you will be able to experience for yourself very soon.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rfMXLvxqgoI
And as you can see for yourself, Washington will be rich in content for drivers to explore.

[*] 3,800 miles of dense road network
[*] 16 brand new cities (Vancouver, Longview, Aberdeen, Olympia, Tacoma, Seattle, Everett, Port Angeles, Bellingham, Omak, Wenatchee, Yakima, Kennewick, Grand Coulee, Spokane, Colville)

[*] 10 original truckstops
[*] Keystone-Port Townsend Ferry
[*] Spokane swing bridge
[*] Grand Coulee dam
[*] Washington's iconic mountains (Mount St. Helens and Mt. Rainier)

With the upcoming release of this map expansion, you will see news, reviews, images, and videos appearing online this coming weekend. With a plan to lift the embargo, the media as well as trusted friends of SCS Software will be able to openly start showing their footage from the map.

Additionally, on Thursday the 6th and Saturday the 8th of June we will be hosting a special Washington stream (on both our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/scssoftware]Twitch[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/SCSsoftware]Steam[/url]) featuring gameplay of the new map expansion and special guests who were involved in the making of Washington. They will be guiding you through this new state, hosting giveaways, talking with you in the chats and much more, so make sure to tune in from 4pm UTC on Thursday and 5pm UTC on Saturday!

notes.title: Washington: Grand Coulee Dam
notes.content:
On this day in 1942, the construction of the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Coulee_Dam]Grand Coulee Dam[/url] was completed, after 9 years of construction.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/5812dcf745b687f616e3011d891446ec4a055893.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/eedeadff4f194f9481b645b02d23da9c33df2f33.jpg[/img][/url]

Currently, it holds the title of not only the largest dam in the Columbia River Basin but one of the largest in the world. Located west of Spokane, it provides a whopping 2,300 megawatts of hydroelectric power across the state, which is enough power to continuously supply the needs of two cities the size of Seattle!

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/b7a64b91596ad94182d6c28b027fdf1412d4221b.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/6e6c6f60a0f7a4c642eada25b5f2406887fe9821.jpg[/img][/url]

Taller than the Great Pyramids of Giza, at over 550ft tall from its bedrock base and spanning over a mile long, this impressive landmark has been recreated in spectacular detail using unique assets in our upcoming American Truck Simulator map expansion.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/f4cff231bbd71ab251091c8a5b29a5ca67094985.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/ec50770cf1dee6dbb997850e2b09285e0ad68a7d.jpg[/img][/url]

Amongst one of the new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962750/American_Truck_Simulator__Special_Transport/]Special Transport[/url] routes which you will find in Washington, you will be able to deliver unique and heavy loads to a nearby town, which will offer dam good views of this man-made wonder.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/6c90af68d23b7de44363b8627246661a68623adb.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/ec1bb7ba4460f82c62a1c7bfa4046fb32afbf1ff.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Washington: Seattle
notes.content:
Seattle is the largest city in both the state of Washington and the Northwest region of the USA. Becoming the fastest-growing major U.S. city in 2016 with over 3.5 million residents, it is home to some of America's largest businesses.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/4644e502055a6e4753dfaa55c925b40f16080432.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/7df90c75faba472ad3a6c052b1c1d1d14de8a510.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/c727670b15f47d8aa26d17cc12c6d68ab6b34166.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/e78a3593747070038a7d65ad2c916835a8c9199e.jpg[/img][/url]

With its iconic skyline, famous landmarks and sport stadiums, drivers in our upcoming map expansion will have plenty of scenery to admire, as they travel on the cities' winding highways with its unique interstate junctions. Can you name any of these famous buildings?

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/4761ba2e0c3a5e765431780bf00a0c91b46abf09.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/04a9b4eb39ed37ffea1ce4e2ada1b17ab0e2a33c.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/9c394a007d19fd0b3831d397d301b5ecb895b216.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/c837cf23e144db4bb3fed0c288215c70fb1fc4bc.jpg[/img][/url]

Creating a mega-city like Seattle is no easy task for our map team; it required careful planning and decision-making to fit the scale and limitations of our map. Despite the challenges of ensuring both quality and optimization for our players, we believe we have managed to create a realistic depiction of Seattle and its landmarks.

notes.title: Washington: Bridges
notes.content:
A considerable part of the eastern side of Washington has multiple bodies of water flowing around it; with the city of Seattle being surrounded by Lake Washington and Elliot Bay. Looking at a map of the state, this may seem like a logistical nightmare for any driver. To connect towns, cities, and islands, the state has built an impressive amount of Bridges.

With approximately 7,300 bridges, they form a critical transportation link for residents and industries. In our upcoming map expansion for American Truck Simulator, you will be able to drive on over 20 of these unique and landmark bridges; which have been re-created in impressive detail with unique assets and mechanics. One such example of this is the steamboat slough swing bridge located in Everett, which was built in 1954.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/a9f51a3e05ef87e355fe19aff29bd9d55b2cb729.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4036972/1af995a06284e5c5fc76c86a4dd82e0a177f5933.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Washington: Mount St. Helens
notes.content:
On this day [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1980_eruption_of_Mount_St._Helens]back in 1980[/url], Mount St. Helens erupted in the largest Volcanic event in U.S. history. The devastating effects of this disaster resulted in the loss of over 150 square miles of forest, homes, railways, and roads.

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-wvZXw7AzWMA/XN7JqQwDPsI/AAAAAAAADEQ/PyGqOCCCn04aWYXwiBzzixMELxJ8mI8KwCLcBGAs/s0/002.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-wvZXw7AzWMA/XN7JqQwDPsI/AAAAAAAADEQ/PyGqOCCCn04aWYXwiBzzixMELxJ8mI8KwCLcBGAs/s620/002.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-HGb4Yh-Mvzo/XN7JqeppSvI/AAAAAAAADEM/bJPALpUgmqkZT7VL6BTFt8lVSZkPoC8eQCLcBGAs/s0/001.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-HGb4Yh-Mvzo/XN7JqeppSvI/AAAAAAAADEM/bJPALpUgmqkZT7VL6BTFt8lVSZkPoC8eQCLcBGAs/s620/001.jpg[/img][/url]

Located 96 miles south of Seattle, it has since become a National Park and more importantly a world-famous natural laboratory for the study of volcanoes and how nature responds to a catastrophe. Standing at 8,365ft tall after the eruption, the mountain is still a very impressive sight.

[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-QG_ptmdl_Q4/XN7JvocVf2I/AAAAAAAADEU/p0aRV6Ldf4Ya9Hfa48y5MRK6qipWX63IgCLcBGAs/s0/004.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-QG_ptmdl_Q4/XN7JvocVf2I/AAAAAAAADEU/p0aRV6Ldf4Ya9Hfa48y5MRK6qipWX63IgCLcBGAs/s620/004.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-CvI-vncBMFA/XN7Jvl-9UCI/AAAAAAAADEY/jWatxkcO4OQwJ7aBIoeYwUfVPdo4nZsXgCLcBGAs/s0/003.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-CvI-vncBMFA/XN7Jvl-9UCI/AAAAAAAADEY/jWatxkcO4OQwJ7aBIoeYwUfVPdo4nZsXgCLcBGAs/s620/003.jpg[/img][/url]

Just as magnificent as the view was how our map designer team was able to re-create this landmark. The area was designed in fantastic detail using satellite imagery and land-scans.

[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-7AIooGyYlkA/XN7J8iJrdXI/AAAAAAAADEo/ZwFjf4pnqU8aPuEeuX4j9PdukLjFsf7TgCLcBGAs/s0/006.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-7AIooGyYlkA/XN7J8iJrdXI/AAAAAAAADEo/ZwFjf4pnqU8aPuEeuX4j9PdukLjFsf7TgCLcBGAs/s620/006.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-2u53zYrr7M4/XN7J8a9GrMI/AAAAAAAADEk/7Fecvl4tzCsAWthkKeTuJUDhSq69x2B_QCLcBGAs/s0/005.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-2u53zYrr7M4/XN7J8a9GrMI/AAAAAAAADEk/7Fecvl4tzCsAWthkKeTuJUDhSq69x2B_QCLcBGAs/s620/005.jpg[/img][/url]

In our upcoming Washington State expansion, drivers will be able to drive down to a beautiful viewing spot of Mount St Helens with surrounding forests starting to grow again. This combined with locally adjusted draw distance makes for an impressive sight. It will be hard for you to believe you are only a short journey away from the city.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015160/American_Truck_Simulator__Washington/

notes.title: Washington: Everett Aerospace Factory
notes.content:
At any given time there are on average over 9,000 commercial aircraft flying above us in the skies, and it's a good chance that one of those aircraft was built in Washington. Located in Everett you can find the states largest aerospace factory, which can produce up to an impressive 20 commercial aircraft a month.

[url=//2.bp.blogspot.com/-I8L7-iNUD78/XNw0wGRX_bI/AAAAAAAADuY/KeG8e2hIthciSpwvxxgeQoWMwTCzSoLiQCK4BGAYYCw/s0/ats_hq_5cdc1368_15.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-I8L7-iNUD78/XNw0wGRX_bI/AAAAAAAADuY/KeG8e2hIthciSpwvxxgeQoWMwTCzSoLiQCK4BGAYYCw/s620/ats_hq_5cdc1368_15.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=//4.bp.blogspot.com/-PCZvhS93yRg/XNw1LIzNvaI/AAAAAAAADuk/TiqvMBlPjxwzkVUIo59YXG_nTgPQ_i05gCK4BGAYYCw/s0/ats_hq_5cdc25f2_12.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-PCZvhS93yRg/XNw1LIzNvaI/AAAAAAAADuk/TiqvMBlPjxwzkVUIo59YXG_nTgPQ_i05gCK4BGAYYCw/s620/ats_hq_5cdc25f2_12.jpg[/img][/url]

The size of a small city, the buildings real-life counterpart holds the record for the Worlds Largest Building which has enough space to fit 13 Empire State Buildings inside its walls. As you can imagine, it would take a large workforce for everything to run according to schedule in such a huge space, and truck drivers hold a very important role in the operation of this industry.

[url=//3.bp.blogspot.com/-Ol-aHjjbF_I/XNw1QULvb6I/AAAAAAAADus/9jEIao39GBITqqjqcGUcfwoo1_Edrg9VACK4BGAYYCw/s0/ats_hq_5cdc11bd_14.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-Ol-aHjjbF_I/XNw1QULvb6I/AAAAAAAADus/9jEIao39GBITqqjqcGUcfwoo1_Edrg9VACK4BGAYYCw/s620/ats_hq_5cdc11bd_14.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=//2.bp.blogspot.com/-2MAVWNmOtR0/XNw1UNcHIYI/AAAAAAAADu0/mhzjCVKp6uMkrPP8uBRSah6VuvPpn3hFQCK4BGAYYCw/s0/ats_hq_5cdc0fa9_20.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-2MAVWNmOtR0/XNw1UNcHIYI/AAAAAAAADu0/mhzjCVKp6uMkrPP8uBRSah6VuvPpn3hFQCK4BGAYYCw/s620/ats_hq_5cdc0fa9_20.jpg[/img][/url]

In the upcoming Washington State expansion for American Truck Simulator, drivers will be able to deliver to and from this impressive factory; transporting aircraft parts as well as driving a new Special Transport route for heavy and unique components. The Everett factory has also been created using unique prefabs based on the real building which makes for an impressive sight for anyone driving past.

[url=//1.bp.blogspot.com/-2H2b_r8fvyE/XNw1V0YzkdI/AAAAAAAADu8/8KeHZFQdLYwMgtAQn1qW8rWhBfrlqYYxACK4BGAYYCw/s0/ats_hq_5cdc0e4d_15.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-2H2b_r8fvyE/XNw1V0YzkdI/AAAAAAAADu8/8KeHZFQdLYwMgtAQn1qW8rWhBfrlqYYxACK4BGAYYCw/s620/ats_hq_5cdc0e4d_15.jpg[/img][/url]

We can't wait for you to explore this unique industry for yourself! In the meantime, why not add Washington State to your Steam Wishlist?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015160/American_Truck_Simulator__Washington/

notes.title: ATS Update 1.35 Open Beta
notes.content:
Since version 1.34 for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] was more of a maintenance update, we understand how eager you all are for the 1.35 Open Beta - which is finally here!

[img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-5u_CCP1DUt0/XNQbEDvGHBI/AAAAAAAABkE/Y6VcAuOgaccyL5OLyPZsRZvcuBxrcwErACLcBGAs/s620/blog_ats_1_35_open_beta.jpg[/img]

Where to start? This update is yet again larger than any of its predecessors - and when we say "larger", we mean a LOT! There are changes in almost every part of our game, so let's get on it!

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-l2-iEWc5ARs/XNQxu2TpbqI/AAAAAAAABlQ/gVQeeoy5he0oX5-1xk-uJR2sfUcLHd1ngCEwYBhgL/s0/r02.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-l2-iEWc5ARs/XNQxu2TpbqI/AAAAAAAABlQ/gVQeeoy5he0oX5-1xk-uJR2sfUcLHd1ngCEwYBhgL/s300/r02.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-OEYopAnjqaE/XNQxvEFiqOI/AAAAAAAABlg/m8VA0tPhe00SlvzJzgRm7-pY_9FH_w2RgCEwYBhgL/s0/r03.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-OEYopAnjqaE/XNQxvEFiqOI/AAAAAAAABlg/m8VA0tPhe00SlvzJzgRm7-pY_9FH_w2RgCEwYBhgL/s300/r03.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] will receive two new roads, OR-58 and CA-299. OR-140 will also feature the final segment of its length. The Arizona sign system has also been improved along with Traffic lights (coming in later builds of the Open Beta) which have been re-worked for all current states.

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-HXna1lnFm9A/XNQxwKHG_II/AAAAAAAABlk/tFGASJwmjgY1hVE9riOhi1UEEFRonU81gCEwYBhgL/s0/t2.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-HXna1lnFm9A/XNQxwKHG_II/AAAAAAAABlk/tFGASJwmjgY1hVE9riOhi1UEEFRonU81gCEwYBhgL/s300/t2.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-1UMxVWdKNLE/XNQxvkz7n-I/AAAAAAAABlY/0C8QBKpi9yoD-8j6lB6eEPHWzOlCorGwQCEwYBhgL/s0/t1.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-1UMxVWdKNLE/XNQxvkz7n-I/AAAAAAAABlY/0C8QBKpi9yoD-8j6lB6eEPHWzOlCorGwQCEwYBhgL/s300/t1.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-UGIiki1sU-k/XNQxwC5iX9I/AAAAAAAABlc/WRgS4w6p55girZ6jfITLAo4X0U1h94grQCEwYBhgL/s0/t3.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-UGIiki1sU-k/XNQxwC5iX9I/AAAAAAAABlc/WRgS4w6p55girZ6jfITLAo4X0U1h94grQCEwYBhgL/s300/t3.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-lk60xdE9Zg0/XNQxwRDbxEI/AAAAAAAABlg/4QAx9FE0Z3IDTSJO1ubnM2-udA-X83SzQCEwYBhgL/s0/t4.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-lk60xdE9Zg0/XNQxwRDbxEI/AAAAAAAABlg/4QAx9FE0Z3IDTSJO1ubnM2-udA-X83SzQCEwYBhgL/s300/t4.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Besides the various new trailers listed in the change-log (B-doubles of all types, chip van trailers, container trailers, etc) and new cargoes, vehicles in our game also received some new features. This includes three windscreen wiper settings which will help drivers handle the improved rain, an accessory browser for owned trailers, expandable container trailers and a copy function for your truck and trailer configuration - which will come in handy, as your company continues to grow.

From the list of new general additions, some longtime wishes take first spots. One of those is a highly demanded option to use your own trailers for external contracts ([url=https://worldoftrucks.com/]World of Trucks[/url] jobs). From now on, you can!

DX11 experimental support. It's exactly as it sounds - most of the work on DX11 support is done, so the majority of its aspects are working quite well in our games and feedback from Experimental Beta promises a nice increase of FPS.  Still - it's not in its final state, so use it only at your own risk. Although we'll be grateful for your feedback.

[img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-YBm_wKpILwg/XNQxuM8pYhI/AAAAAAAABkc/L3GHSOeQufcwzjB3a_nZwbLij-bFu77_ACEwYBhgL/s620/drivers.jpg[/img]

Now comes a number of "smaller" additions, based mostly on your suggestions. A large amount of new hireable drivers have been added, so as your trucking empire grows you can expand much more than previously. To help with that growth, we've also added an option to purchase garages online (without the need of having to discover the city previously).

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-pLftbrxu8lU/XNQxw5QlGkI/AAAAAAAABlo/VyYhun_BYewpyo2jmezGlzfSaT16GQ8iQCEwYBhgL/s0/ui.png][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-pLftbrxu8lU/XNQxw5QlGkI/AAAAAAAABlo/VyYhun_BYewpyo2jmezGlzfSaT16GQ8iQCEwYBhgL/s300/ui.png[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-qvPHZNxj6kM/XNQxubBqOLI/AAAAAAAABlk/u2dlA656bwcO29h5-F5KUSczmK1wFmrTgCEwYBhgL/s0/garage.png][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-qvPHZNxj6kM/XNQxubBqOLI/AAAAAAAABlk/u2dlA656bwcO29h5-F5KUSczmK1wFmrTgCEwYBhgL/s300/garage.png[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-R-Y1yRqhtjc/XNQxtXbfImI/AAAAAAAABlg/-54ziWAkTykfvmwbXafjy4nxLjcolG68ACEwYBhgL/s0/01.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-R-Y1yRqhtjc/XNQxtXbfImI/AAAAAAAABlg/-54ziWAkTykfvmwbXafjy4nxLjcolG68ACEwYBhgL/s300/01.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-zmLpgGNkfsM/XNQxtVDWCEI/AAAAAAAABlc/w0D9Se9eO6MR1tM8mzRkHCj3exOMgdoFwCEwYBhgL/s0/02.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-zmLpgGNkfsM/XNQxtVDWCEI/AAAAAAAABlc/w0D9Se9eO6MR1tM8mzRkHCj3exOMgdoFwCEwYBhgL/s300/02.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Another helpful feature is emergency refuelling, which will be an important option for those loving to drive on the edge (why do so many of you like to go with empty tanks?). And to make your travels a little bit more diverse and interesting, you'll now see STAA doubles in traffic.

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-lm3bFt72ro8/XNQxvTvgdPI/AAAAAAAABk0/ThnI9Ru6Ow8Jf5DTuxIs_TFkJYRf9Ob7gCEwYBhgL/s0/razer.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-lm3bFt72ro8/XNQxvTvgdPI/AAAAAAAABk0/ThnI9Ru6Ow8Jf5DTuxIs_TFkJYRf9Ob7gCEwYBhgL/s300/razer.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-7pZFHhfhLF8/XNQxtZXpJTI/AAAAAAAABkU/sqVWTDvENbIn-CYrnE7ueFcQUwuqXMLHACEwYBhgL/s0/Tracker4c_white_bg.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-7pZFHhfhLF8/XNQxtZXpJTI/AAAAAAAABkU/sqVWTDvENbIn-CYrnE7ueFcQUwuqXMLHACEwYBhgL/s300/Tracker4c_white_bg.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Considering all these changes, the UI had to change drastically. Players who helped us by entering the Experimental Beta have reported no serious issues with it, so we hope you'll have no problems as well. And to close the list, there're many new input improvements and official support for external peripheries.

[b]So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an open beta, not a stable public version - so [u]you may encounter bugs, instability, kinks or crashes[/u]. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to move there faster, we'll appreciate all of your feedback on our [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewtopic.php?f=178&t=271053]forum[/url] and your bug reports in [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=263]this section[/url].[/b]

[b]If you wish to participate in the open beta, you can find this version in the public_beta branch on Steam. The way to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right click on American Truck Simulator → Properties → Betas tab → public_beta → 1.35 public beta. No password required.[/b]

notes.title: 1.35 Preview Stream Episode 2 + Another Tobii Giveaway!
notes.content:
We would like to thank you all for your massive support on last week's 1.35 Preview Stream for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url]. We are very thrilled to find out that over 25,000 of you have tuned in with us. As promised, we will be doing a similar stream for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url].

][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-RdNcspPGP0c/XNFJv9COH9I/AAAAAAAADAQ/BlXH8tIrPyIU-xN8GOMffdOHzkauY_towCLcBGAs/s620/blog_banner_1_35_preview_stream_tobii_giveaway.jpg[/img]

The 1.35 Preview Stream for American Truck Simulator will be held on [b]Thursday, 9 May 2019, from 15:00 CET (17:00 CEST) [/b]on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/SCSsoftware]Steam[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/SCSSoftware]Twitch[/url]. We will be showing you some of the new features coming to 1.35 for American Truck Simulator, with a focus on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/2603552833093700029]new additional roads[/url] and map improvements made across the entire map. You will also hear one of our lead map designers, Jakub, who will give you an insight on the map creation process. To put the cherry on the cake, we will be giving away another [i][url=https://gaming.tobii.com/product/tobii-eye-tracker-4c/]Tobii Eye Tracker 4C[/url][/i], as well as game/DLC keys too! More details on how to enter the giveaway will be announced on the stream.
During last week's giveaway of the Tobii tracker, the hashtag #ETS2Tobii was posted on Instagram and Twitter more than 200 times!

[img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-wfVnGQaT8J0/XNFJ6Q1bZtI/AAAAAAAADAU/WNEsEVfDFdsuvu4jWzUvV_Nv5SZXQVgCQCLcBGAs/s620/Tobii_Eye_Tracker4C_White.jpg[/img]

We are happy to announce that the lucky winner of the giveaway is Wesley (@wesmanboy). We will be contacting you soon to help you claim your prize.
For those who have missed our previous stream, or are curious to find out how the Tobii eye tracker works in our games, here's a very short gameplay snippet of reverse-parking while using the device.

[img]https://giant.gfycat.com/EarlyViciousBlackbird.gif[/img]

We had an amazing time doing last week's stream. Don't forget to mark your calendars and join us for another fun stream later this week, where we will show you the features coming to v1.35 of American Truck Simulator. Another [i]Tobii Eye Tracker 4C[/i] is up for grabs!

notes.title: Razer Chroma gets official support
notes.content:
We're happy to announce the upcoming arrival of the official support for [url=https://www.razer.com/chroma]Razer Chroma[/url] in both [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url]. Starting with the 1.35 Update, our games will support Razer keyboards, mouses and RGB mousemats (headset will use only one colour scheme). Sure, you might think what's the big deal about some "game of lights", but take a look at our video and the list of functions below. Adds a little bit extra to the immersion, doesn't it?

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cbaxzoKHCTw

[list]
[*]During the tutorial, the keys being currently explained will be distinguished by colours and the "continue" key will be blinking green[/*]
[*]Some keys will be active only when the truck electrics is on[/*]
[*]Steering left/right and throttle/brake keys are distinguished by colour (typically WASD keys)[/*]
[*]Key for the parking brake is lit when active and blinking when the engine is on[/*]
[*]Lights keys show lights state (parking, low beam, high beam)[/*]
[*]Blinker keys are blinking (the same goes for all speeds of flasher and wipers)[/*]
[*]Gear up/ down keys are active only for non-automatic gearbox[/*]
[*]Camera keys are distinguished by colour and the active camera key is different[/*]
[*]Route Advisor pages keys are distinguished by colour and the active page key is different[/*]
[*]Trailer connect key shows state of the trailer: green for available connect, red for connecting in progress, green blinking for job delivery[/*]
[*]Activation key (typically Enter) is blinking when activation possible (eg. gas station, toll etc.)[/*]
[*]When pumping gas, the keyboard shows tank state and there is a falling wave visualizing flowing gas. When full, the keyboard is green[/*]
[*]Key for the differential lock is lit when the differential is locked and it blinks when there is a differential lock warning in Route Advisor[/*]
[*]When the job is finished, a wave goes across the keyboard, mouse and mousepad in colour of the received medal[/*]
[*]Police fine keyboard blinking[/*]
[*]When the truck is damaged a red wave moves across the keyboard[/*]
[*]All keys and other accessories slowly pulse when the job's time is running out[/*]
[*]Mouse and mousepad's left side LEDs show current player speed in green and in red when the player is speeding[/*]
[*]The cruise control key is yellow when CC can be turned on, blue when it is on. Keys for CC speed up and down are lit when CC is on[/*]
[*]Keys for lifting axle and trailer axle are lit only when lifting is available[/*]
[*]Cvar g_color_feedback can be used to disable colour feedback altogether. This cvar can also be set in Options > Controls > Color feedback.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: US Traffic Lights
notes.content:
You probably noticed that during the last few patches, traffic lights in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] have had some considerable tweaks. From last year June, our research department started work on this project, but there were a few issues we would need to overcome. One of the main problems was to find a system for US traffic lights in our game, as there are many differences found in every state, region, and cities. MUTCD defines the guidelines for the whole United States, but since every State can adjust it, you see where the problem lies. We agreed to make a compromise and choose those most commonly used (which means 50%+ coverage) to be made and implemented in our game.

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-bB_7L7gbKVQ/XMsGUdBIOvI/AAAAAAAAC_Q/sHwKFQOBc4Ml9UpZZiLV01H5P68B5IN4wCLcBGAs/s0/001.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-bB_7L7gbKVQ/XMsGUdBIOvI/AAAAAAAAC_Q/sHwKFQOBc4Ml9UpZZiLV01H5P68B5IN4wCLcBGAs/s620/001.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-NPW4VvshFHE/XMsGUcCnFgI/AAAAAAAAC_U/Hc2gKUeBBFQdOX_T9SoVpivETn0p5zKcgCLcBGAs/s0/002.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-NPW4VvshFHE/XMsGUcCnFgI/AAAAAAAAC_U/Hc2gKUeBBFQdOX_T9SoVpivETn0p5zKcgCLcBGAs/s620/002.jpg[/img][/url]

An (un)expected result was that by mass replacement of the old lights, almost every junction and intersection in American Truck Simulator had broken. Lights colliding with other objects, signs and street name signs had also moved to pretty funny places... good times (especially for our map designers who had to fix this mess).

[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-nY3xLVPLYYA/XMsGUUwaVgI/AAAAAAAAC_Y/x3SzOeuVwIYFE8PC4c6iUUQFiWOYf1zbQCEwYBhgL/s0/003.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-nY3xLVPLYYA/XMsGUUwaVgI/AAAAAAAAC_Y/x3SzOeuVwIYFE8PC4c6iUUQFiWOYf1zbQCEwYBhgL/s620/003.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-47L6Z8FwVkk/XMsGVOrkOeI/AAAAAAAAC_c/TmOXyia3Kx8nDgM4BOkMnsIQowgZVPwYwCEwYBhgL/s0/004.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-47L6Z8FwVkk/XMsGVOrkOeI/AAAAAAAAC_c/TmOXyia3Kx8nDgM4BOkMnsIQowgZVPwYwCEwYBhgL/s620/004.jpg[/img][/url]

But in the end, we managed to overcome these issues and with update 1.35, every State (CA, NV, AZ, NM, OR and upcoming WA) will have real unique traffic lights. So that means you can now enjoy even more authentic roads, with more options now available for possible future additions, like the Flashing Yellow Arrow.

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-7KZHKZpZLGI/XMsGVoBpDcI/AAAAAAAAC_k/PG61M8g4_hkqRYOxXKWmgq3XClzip8GjgCEwYBhgL/s0/005.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-7KZHKZpZLGI/XMsGVoBpDcI/AAAAAAAAC_k/PG61M8g4_hkqRYOxXKWmgq3XClzip8GjgCEwYBhgL/s620/005.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-G9UOC1wYhmw/XMsGVs7xhdI/AAAAAAAAC_g/N5Zchex78ZkCDuCnvyNfpIOwZB8Q0wExgCEwYBhgL/s0/006.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-G9UOC1wYhmw/XMsGVs7xhdI/AAAAAAAAC_g/N5Zchex78ZkCDuCnvyNfpIOwZB8Q0wExgCEwYBhgL/s620/006.jpg[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015160/American_Truck_Simulator__Washington/

notes.title: Kenworth Renton Assembly Plant
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015160/American_Truck_Simulator__Washington/]Washington[/url] state is home to hundreds of large and well-known industries, amongst which one stands out due to its connection to our game - Kenworth's Truck Plant located in the city of Renton, WA. They have been making trucks in the factory since 1993. With numerous new vehicles rolling off the assembly line each day, it adds a whole new level of immersion to include such an iconic truck-manufacturing facility into our upcoming map expansion for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url].

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-A1au-NMCEFw/XMHfpRdEk4I/AAAAAAAABi0/PzqanG2YimIMsXFoXRmBJO-kVay_l-7TgCEwYBhgL/s1600/ats_hq_5cc1b520_21.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-A1au-NMCEFw/XMHfpRdEk4I/AAAAAAAABi0/PzqanG2YimIMsXFoXRmBJO-kVay_l-7TgCEwYBhgL/s1600/ats_hq_5cc1b520_21.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-XKeA7Nsr-eg/XMHfqDXlkUI/AAAAAAAABjE/LUlGByBRtBYAXpr-DkYsF3S5f1TmYUF_wCEwYBhgL/s1600/ats_hq_5cc1bcec_08.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-XKeA7Nsr-eg/XMHfqDXlkUI/AAAAAAAABjE/LUlGByBRtBYAXpr-DkYsF3S5f1TmYUF_wCEwYBhgL/s1600/ats_hq_5cc1bcec_08.jpg[/img][/url]
With courtesy of Kenworth and thanks to their cooperation, we were able to replicate the important parts of the assembly plant. From the goods-receiving section, through to the storage and production halls, and finally to the administrative area - they all come together to form one of the largest depots in both of our truck sims, enhanced with every little detail to be as accurate as possible!

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-tg9-AuT2x9E/XMHfoqeIWFI/AAAAAAAABjM/UXvFTJ6lziALiBBQfD94ZXzOiPaQVDbowCEwYBhgL/s1600/ats_hq_5cc1a8bc_16.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-tg9-AuT2x9E/XMHfoqeIWFI/AAAAAAAABjM/UXvFTJ6lziALiBBQfD94ZXzOiPaQVDbowCEwYBhgL/s1600/ats_hq_5cc1a8bc_16.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-lOb3SgvueHg/XMHfptoHmdI/AAAAAAAABjY/hAYuQGBmezImYF7y25KM8ejahyP368yuACEwYBhgL/s1600/ats_hq_5cc1b6e2_12.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-lOb3SgvueHg/XMHfptoHmdI/AAAAAAAABjY/hAYuQGBmezImYF7y25KM8ejahyP368yuACEwYBhgL/s1600/ats_hq_5cc1b6e2_12.jpg[/img][/url]

We can't wait for you to visit this area and tell us your thoughts. We're excited to have you experience both the truck plant itself and also the new cargo you'll find here (aside from the more regular loads) - a Saddle-mounted truck transport, also known as a Piggyback transport. But for now, here's a fresh batch of pictures - looks great, doesn't it?

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-o48GPHkQENA/XMHfqDbQMAI/AAAAAAAABjU/eR3M3YSJAwI8Rz5psnAOvE7bqPPpLMU_ACEwYBhgL/s1600/ats_hq_5cc1b913_08.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-o48GPHkQENA/XMHfqDbQMAI/AAAAAAAABjU/eR3M3YSJAwI8Rz5psnAOvE7bqPPpLMU_ACEwYBhgL/s1600/ats_hq_5cc1b913_08.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-w8dB9b_XvcE/XMHfo0MDswI/AAAAAAAABjM/LD9l18CCs0QCIFJgtmucAiTaBRi9EJoBgCEwYBhgL/s1600/ats_hq_5cc1b185_12_2.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-w8dB9b_XvcE/XMHfo0MDswI/AAAAAAAABjM/LD9l18CCs0QCIFJgtmucAiTaBRi9EJoBgCEwYBhgL/s1600/ats_hq_5cc1b185_12_2.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: New Road Connections
notes.content:
Today we'd like to present another appetizer of the approaching update 1.35. Players of both [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] can look forward to some (a lot, actually) new tarmac!

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-1kHV79UJz-c/XLDHT5d20qI/AAAAAAAABgg/htoDdrMXBA84z7w3w_ba7QvNMM9ZCsALACEwYBhgL/s0/OR-58_scr_01.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-1kHV79UJz-c/XLDHT5d20qI/AAAAAAAABgg/htoDdrMXBA84z7w3w_ba7QvNMM9ZCsALACEwYBhgL/s300/OR-58_scr_01.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-4r1ji5v26hw/XLDHUHUZsCI/AAAAAAAABgk/uPXfFM-qup89B148tV1tkDthTLUI7lIswCEwYBhgL/s0/OR-58_scr_04.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-4r1ji5v26hw/XLDHUHUZsCI/AAAAAAAABgk/uPXfFM-qup89B148tV1tkDthTLUI7lIswCEwYBhgL/s300/OR-58_scr_04.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Let's start in America. Newly added OR-58 will connect the cities of Eugene and Bend, and there's much to look at! For some time this road tracks Salt Creek river, which will lead you to the Odell Lake. There, far behind it in the shroud of fog, you'll see the majestic Diamond peak, the highest mountain in the region, while on the other side lays the Willamette pass resort Ski area. Pity there's no time to lose when one's working, right?

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-TvoSZrwZm94/XLDHTjxupcI/AAAAAAAABgc/gO1AqIPeDJsiQOEF177VW7jRKNemH8anQCEwYBhgL/s0/OR-140_scr_08.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-TvoSZrwZm94/XLDHTjxupcI/AAAAAAAABgc/gO1AqIPeDJsiQOEF177VW7jRKNemH8anQCEwYBhgL/s300/OR-140_scr_08.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-cF2tCCyF8bE/XLDHTUq0qvI/AAAAAAAABgc/kDto-MBjzLQ5NqRp9VyTKrz4Z5-XKTv_ACEwYBhgL/s0/OR-140_scr_02.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-cF2tCCyF8bE/XLDHTUq0qvI/AAAAAAAABgc/kDto-MBjzLQ5NqRp9VyTKrz4Z5-XKTv_ACEwYBhgL/s300/OR-140_scr_02.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Next comes the last part of well known and liked OR-140, so you'll be able to drive all the way from Medford to Winnemucca finally! Starting in Klamath Falls, you'll probably notice that the city centre was remade and enlarged. The new road will take you past the great Upper Klamath Lake then and through the deep woods of Fremont-Winema National Forest farther to Medford, Nevada.

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-JNdSJahFVrA/XLDHTAUE4SI/AAAAAAAABgs/QkrRClswPP4na88hZjP37TS-u-0sOVX5ACEwYBhgL/s0/CA-299_ats_hq_5ca4d18b_17.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-JNdSJahFVrA/XLDHTAUE4SI/AAAAAAAABgs/QkrRClswPP4na88hZjP37TS-u-0sOVX5ACEwYBhgL/s300/CA-299_ats_hq_5ca4d18b_17.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-okcItpp0d7c/XLDHSdNtC9I/AAAAAAAABgc/cSQno3bHH0cbeGXGJvZNkbcBlArHwYzCwCEwYBhgL/s0/CA-299_ats_hq_5ca4cb43_17.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-okcItpp0d7c/XLDHSdNtC9I/AAAAAAAABgc/cSQno3bHH0cbeGXGJvZNkbcBlArHwYzCwCEwYBhgL/s300/CA-299_ats_hq_5ca4cb43_17.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Last but not least, there's CA-299 offering the option of driving from Redding directly to Canby, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/800370/American_Truck_Simulator__Oregon/]Oregon[/url], adding also a little town of Burney along the road. It's a pretty long drive, which has it all - farmlands, meander climbs, junctions, landmarks, mountains canyons, gorges... you name it!

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-vPZcjlfIS4s/XLRW8rb_C4I/AAAAAAAABhQ/1RiyY58G2P4FCMgwNXbLflHhJFBvalc5wCLcBGAs/s0/Yuma_ats_hq_5cadfe06_09.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-vPZcjlfIS4s/XLRW8rb_C4I/AAAAAAAABhQ/1RiyY58G2P4FCMgwNXbLflHhJFBvalc5wCLcBGAs/s300/Yuma_ats_hq_5cadfe06_09.jpg[/img][/url][/td]

[/tr]
[/table]

In addition to the new roads, there are various changes and additions. With CA-299, Redding received another city part around the junction of Interstate 5 and CA-299, a new garage and a truck dealer. Farmington ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/684630/American_Truck_Simulator__New_Mexico/]New Mexico[/url]) got also a new garage, while Yuma has a new garage, a truck dealer and a brand new truck stop.

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-PHR6zkUyONs/XLDHUd-rKfI/AAAAAAAABgc/NmZKtej7RFcVkNz1A_aGcMhGql5jy7IiwCEwYBhgL/s0/Signs_ats_hq_5caf3c44_10.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-PHR6zkUyONs/XLDHUd-rKfI/AAAAAAAABgc/NmZKtej7RFcVkNz1A_aGcMhGql5jy7IiwCEwYBhgL/s300/Signs_ats_hq_5caf3c44_10.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-Yg_6_OMaDpc/XLDHUrFA92I/AAAAAAAABgk/DcyxFeGHjnM833h2sh_dFeRgMGwUnffTwCEwYBhgL/s0/Signs_ats_hq_5caf3e99_16.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-Yg_6_OMaDpc/XLDHUrFA92I/AAAAAAAABgk/DcyxFeGHjnM833h2sh_dFeRgMGwUnffTwCEwYBhgL/s300/Signs_ats_hq_5caf3e99_16.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-0vMp05hhiuI/XLDHUZfPMCI/AAAAAAAABgs/rEy98AtskKQfbezPuXM8SQ17ZPAonT3QQCEwYBhgL/s0/Signs_ats_hq_5caf38de_10.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-0vMp05hhiuI/XLDHUZfPMCI/AAAAAAAABgs/rEy98AtskKQfbezPuXM8SQ17ZPAonT3QQCEwYBhgL/s300/Signs_ats_hq_5caf38de_10.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-1Oq68IZxff4/XLDHU3emQkI/AAAAAAAABgg/rSfefbjBrUYQI8zR9UZ3JHUxehIjnAvXQCEwYBhgL/s0/Signs_ats_hq_5caf4003_07.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-1Oq68IZxff4/XLDHU3emQkI/AAAAAAAABgg/rSfefbjBrUYQI8zR9UZ3JHUxehIjnAvXQCEwYBhgL/s300/Signs_ats_hq_5caf4003_07.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]

And there's one more considerable improvement - we keep working hard on road signs rework to make it more realistic. If you like to navigate the world "the old way" - turn off the GPS and just watch the signs along the road closely - you should have a much easier time in more regions. The sign system in Arizona, along with several truck stops and the US-95 in California, got a complete overhaul - so the old-school trucking should feel way more natural from now on.

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-RAJNwsYDkGU/XLDHSc-okpI/AAAAAAAABfk/-YexP0wkjh0FcJsSubXnLIuglnVvK0MIgCEwYBhgL/s0/A6-N44_eut2_hq_5ca5e6d9_11.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-RAJNwsYDkGU/XLDHSc-okpI/AAAAAAAABfk/-YexP0wkjh0FcJsSubXnLIuglnVvK0MIgCEwYBhgL/s300/A6-N44_eut2_hq_5ca5e6d9_11.jpg[/img][/url][/td]

[/tr]
[/table]

Finally, let's look at the old continent! New additions here are part of our continuous effort to improve the vast road network Europe has already. Let us mention here two new rural roads in France - one for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/531130/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Vive_la_France/]Viva la France![/url] map expansion, and one for the base game. The first one is connecting highways A10 and A6 and you can find a beautiful city of Montargis near-by, while the second road is connecting A6 with road N44. Since the rural roads in France are very popular, we hope you'll like these too.

Not enough you say? Absolutely right! Revelations are far from over, as some region(s) aren't unveiled at all yet! Remember to check our blog and social media ([url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft/]FB[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/scssoftware]Twitter[/url]) and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/SCSsoftware]follow our Steam developer page[/url], as more info is coming soon.

notes.title: Washington: Landscapes
notes.content:
If you have ever had the chance to visit Washington State in the USA, you may have noticed that almost everywhere you go you will see green, even while driving through the city areas. The state is even nicknamed the 'Evergreen State' and has the Green Darner Dragonfly as their state insect mascot.

notes.title: American Truck Simulator: journey's end
notes.content:
If there’s one game that has, for me, defined my last few years at RPS, it’s American Truck Simulator. That singular nexus of deadly serious simulation and twinkly-eyed, chill-out road trip has helped hold me together at times when both the world and my own world threatened to fall apart, but it’s also been a belated lesson that games need not be defined by skinner boxes and power fantasies. The magic of the ordinary, but the ordinary transplanted to another place, free from all pressures. Most of all, the peace and freedom of the road.

It’s now time for me to say goodbye, to RPS and perhaps to the overall business of writing opinions about videogames. There’s only one way to go out.

One last drive. And, thanks to some very kind folks at ATS developer SCS, I get to make that last drive in a work-in-progress build of the forthcoming Washington DLC – the state I’ve long been most desperate to drag 18 wheels across.

(more…)

notes.title: Important Notice For Our Modding Community
notes.content:
Due to the appearance of mods with sets of our [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/]World of Trucks[/url] event rewards and Steam inventory items - we feel the need to clarify our policy.

[img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-L40uJPcCjEQ/XKSwClokgmI/AAAAAAAABe0/0x6DgE0sOGgYpf0bNLMKgSIYr8KL_ttlwCLcBGAs/s620/Notice_blog.jpg[/img]

Seeing countless mods for our games is great and we're happy that so many talented people are investing their time in adjusting, improving or creating new content - but there are limits of what is and isn't fine. Simply copying our content, without making any meaningful changes (and without making the mod DLC dependable in case of DLC content) absolutely isn't. Steam inventory item modifications are not either. These items are meant as, and should stay so, something special that not everyone has, while also being a part of Valve's Steam market.

This restriction isn't meant to harm our great modding community, it's strictly to protect the value of said items. Every single one of them has to be obtained as a reward for time invested into our many WoTr events, or eventually purchased or traded from someone who earned them that way.

So far we've banned a few of those mods, and some of the authors were warned. From now on, we will take these mods as a direct violation of property rights and we will react accordingly.

We've set up a [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewtopic.php?f=28&t=270259]topic[/url] for questions about this - if there are any - on our forum. We won't reply on questions regarding this restriction anywhere else.

notes.title: Farming in Washington State
notes.content:
From bustling cities to evergreen forests, Washington is a diverse state that is home to many significant industries including one of its largest, Agriculture. Each one of the around 40,000 farms require constant attention to keep running; they depend on truck drivers to deliver their materials, machinery and most importantly their produce to export across America and beyond.

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-Eg4taQISAMw/XJ4sPnefizI/AAAAAAAABdc/rQBF6wJapyASiuvrfnAX5BIy5X5UTLN_QCEwYBhgL/s0/000_wide_wip.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-Eg4taQISAMw/XJ4sPnefizI/AAAAAAAABdc/rQBF6wJapyASiuvrfnAX5BIy5X5UTLN_QCEwYBhgL/s620/000_wide_wip.jpg[/img][/url]

The upcoming Washington State map expansion will feature many farm industries that will not only include growing just crops, but also those that specialise in other produce such as pumpkins, tomatoes and other fruits and vegetables.

Just as important as the produce grown are the farmyards themselves, which can vary from large companies with many acres of fields, to small country family farms. Essential to their operations are the structures which occupy the land such as greenhouses, silos, and most importantly, shelter for the livestock. On your travels, you may even come across farm animals such as pigs, sheep or even large buffaloes known for roaming and grazing, or just enjoying the sunshine.

notes.title: New trailers in upcoming ATS update 1.35
notes.content:
We are working hard on the new Update 1.35 for both [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url]. It's shaping up to be one of the biggest updates ever. We plan for an extensive open beta period, but there is still a lot of internal testing and tweaking left to do before we reach that stage. A series of upcoming blog posts will focus on key new features and new content.

In today's post, we want to focus on new types of trailers and loads coming to American Truck Simulator with Update 1.35. The new additions will be very handy in the Pacific Northwest!

Chip van trailers are coming to service the woodworking industry especially in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/800370/American_Truck_Simulator__Oregon/]Oregon[/url] and in our upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015160/American_Truck_Simulator__Washington/]Washington state[/url] map expansion. They will be available with three body variants: van, moving floor, and iconic belly van. Chip van trailers are ownable and will be available to haul from the freight market.  We also plan to use them to transport other suitable loads in other industries and states.

notes.title: Washington: Logging cliff road
notes.content:
Servicing the logging industry (together with farming industry) will be an important aspect of the in-game economy for the upcoming Washington map expansion. If you are looking for a more challenging drive, you will not only come across beautiful open roads but also winding and dusty ones leading through the thick forests of Washington State. The most interesting example of this is the logging cliff road used to transport tons of logs and wood chips as well as to haul heavy logging machinery.

notes.title: Washington: Prefab building
notes.content:
One of the challenging tasks with every new map expansion is to come up with new industry depots. Since these are the cornerstone of the in-game economy with direct impact on gameplay overall,  their development has come a long way from the same-sized generic prefabs, through landmark-like quality of huge industry areas to modular depots - which you could see for the first time in our recent map expansions of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/800370/American_Truck_Simulator__Oregon/]Oregon[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/925580/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Beyond_the_Baltic_Sea/]Beyond the Baltic Sea[/url].

In Washington, we took another step with modular prefabs. Each dock consists of the foundation stone of our own depot and around it, we gradually build the whole complex, making the process quick and efficient. This also makes each depot unique, as every map designer has a different approach.

Today's batch of screenshots shows depots in general, while some of the future blog posts will go more in depth of the industries found in the state of Washington.

notes.title: Washington: Urban landmarks
notes.content:
Transferring real-world environments into our games universe is always a challenging process. For example, there are many technical and practical limitations which exist, many of which are related to the games' world scale of 1:20. To help us create an immersive experience that allows players to drive in the most realistic environment possible, we use several development tricks; one of these techniques is creating and placing distinctive landmarks in addition to local architecture, which can be natural or man-made structures.

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-vz4nq-QRDQI/XGU2KQHtswI/AAAAAAAACig/oCpbu4IIYg0cyJnWcKBza0MNcuSh6wlswCLcBGAs/s0/washington_pano.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-vz4nq-QRDQI/XGU2KQHtswI/AAAAAAAACig/oCpbu4IIYg0cyJnWcKBza0MNcuSh6wlswCLcBGAs/s620/washington_pano.jpg[/img][/url]

Today we are focusing on showing you urban landmarks which can be found in our upcoming American Truck Simulator map expansion for Washington state. These can all greatly differ in shapes and size, from smaller statues of prominent figures to large bridges spanning across the state. Local experts will know many of these landmarks instantly, and we are sure you will be quick to recognize them in the blog comments below.

notes.title: Steam Awards 2018: Thank you for your vote!
notes.content:
The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards]Steam Awards 2018[/url] are over and the results have been revealed. Earlier this year, it was a nice surprise to see that we had made the first round of voting. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] was nominated for the Most Fun with a Machine category, among so many other fantastic and popular titles and developers nominated. We know this wasn't possible without our devoted community.

We may not have taken the title this time around, but every vote made for us by our community was in our eyes the biggest award. We appreciate every one of you for your continued support throughout the years, and to us, YOU are the champions!

We would like to congratulate all those who received awards this year, especially to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/252950/Rocket_League/]Rocket League[/url] team who won the 'Most Fun with a Machine' Category. You may still remember our cross-promo effort from a few years back ːrloctaneː

https://steamcommunity.com/games/227300/announcements/detail/704061218942797081

From all of us here at SCS Software we would like to thank you once more for your vote. We are already looking forward to this year's Steam Awards for 2019.

notes.title: ATS update 1.34: Buyable log trailer, more roads!
notes.content:
After the content-loaded updates from previous months, 1.34 is a relatively small maintenance update serving primarily to introduce new content prepared by our vehicle department. The next big things planned need more time in development, and we anticipate 1.35 to be a lot juicier. Still, we believe these new additions will please players of both of our games. The limited scope of this update is also the reason why there wasn't an Open Beta. So what do we have for you?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9084219/2336febfec6ba4717e8b91e2464480b0c2ff3ed7.jpg[/img]

American Truck Simulator receives one of the highly demanded additions to the game - buyable log trailers! Our traffic report sources for Oregon shows a large convoy inbound for the wood transport companies, with a high chance of traffic jams on the forest roads, so be careful out there. As an alternative route, we can recommend OR-140, which is now prolonged all the way to Nevada. And if you're still worried about driving in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/800370/American_Truck_Simulator__Oregon/]Oregon[/url], we recommend visiting the Tonopah city, which has been completely refreshed.

notes.title: The Truck Simulator radio stations making waves in the real world
notes.content:
Which radio station do you tune into? Is it Heart in the UK, or BBC Radio something or other? Is it Z100 in New York, or KIIS FM in Los Angeles? (I had to Google those.) Or, is it Truckers.FM?

I know what you're thinking: 'There's a whole radio station for truckers?!' But it's even stranger than that. It's actually a station devoted to virtual truckers, who tune-in via virtual cab radios while thundering down Truck Simulator roads.

In your ear, Truckers.FM sounds like the real thing. It has regular presenters with scheduled shows running right around the clock. There are adverts, just like on the real radio - there are even traffic reports! There are interviews, competitions, shout-outs - all the things you'd expect. Even jingles.

Read more…

notes.content:
American Truck Simulator celebrates three years this upcoming weekend, which we have decided to commemorate with a special stream (and maybe something else which we'll reveal in this stream) focused on its history and development progress. Unlike other streams, this will be focused solely on ATS - and we offer you a chance to participate in it! There's a [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewtopic.php?f=178&t=268126]topic[/url] on our [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/index.php]forum[/url] where you can submit your questions related to the history of American Truck Simulator, from its very beginning to this day.

This was very satisfactory for us, as it's a validation of our effort to bring our virtual worlds closer to the real world.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MyPXE4TWvug

Washington State will be another destination on US soil. notes.title: SCS On The Road 2019
notes.content:
A new year has started and it's time to plan a new season of our travel calendar. We would like to be even more active in traveling the world and visiting gaming and transportation industry expos and events. Ever since we built our custom SCS Sim Trailer, the impact factor that we can deliver on the various shows has grown massively! Being on the road allows us to meet many of you from our community and cross paths with a wide range of industry representatives which can lead to new and exciting opportunities.

[img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-Y9a_Xt8oCso/XEiHcsY02jI/AAAAAAAABTg/nJcP2XHCkMkTvZjSPszQTGmZ1zgyAHQeQCEwYBhgL/s620/scs_on_the_road_blog_banner.jpg[/img]

Everywhere we visit, we are always met with positive responses. Especially if we bring along our Sim Trailer, we always have a lot of visitors interested in trying our games on our motions seats or wanting to meet up with our On The Road crew. And we love meeting you! That's why we thought it would be a good idea to inform our fan base in advance and to share with you our tentative events calendar.

And for 2019 we have a quite the list of 'to-visit' events. Keep in mind that some of these events are still being planned, and it may be that changes are made to our schedule. We cannot make it everywhere with the Sim Trailer, there are just too many places to go, packed too tightly in the calendar. We expect to organize some of the shows in partnerships with our friends from the transportation industry, but anyway, a core team from SCS should participate in all the events listed below. Keep an eye on [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/]our blog[/url] and social media profiles ([url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]FB[/url]) and we'll keep you updated.

Check out our current schedule below, we might be travelling to an event near you!

[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-AWOZenyFhK4/XEiHcgmB6JI/AAAAAAAABTk/aHXydAJSFnE7CBCXe7mLVqKeXr_cuPBzwCEwYBhgL/s0/road-calendar_blog.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-AWOZenyFhK4/XEiHcgmB6JI/AAAAAAAABTk/aHXydAJSFnE7CBCXe7mLVqKeXr_cuPBzwCEwYBhgL/s620/road-calendar_blog.jpg[/img][/url]

Last year we also enlisted the help of some of our local fans willing to help us on some of these events. We think it's a great way to connect with a few of our most loyal fans and offer them a very unique (and also paid) experience.

If you would like to become a part of our crew for a weekend, please let us know. Successful candidates are 18+, native speakers of the region of a given event, have great social skills, they should be knowledgeable players of our games and active members of the fan community, ideally with a history of involvement with our betas, or perhaps recognised creators from the modding community.

If you are free for two days of your time, have the skill and the passion to become a "roadie" and become embedded into our crew, please get in touch with us by mail on ontheroad@scssoft.com.

notes.title: Conclusion of Christmas event
notes.content:
The holiday season is a time of rest for most people, but for the logistics industry, it is the busiest time of the year. The [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/scs_games#announcements/detail/2796070940852901616]International Gift Delivery event on World of Trucks[/url] saw the community unite to bring much needed assistance to the North Pole and deliver gifts on both sides of Atlantic.

[img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-rQBArtwPYgE/XEHwtcu7NwI/AAAAAAAABTU/TnnyisriIIcaJXqom6lq8hk9RgAxFDQFgCEwYBhgL/s620/blog_banner_xmas.jpg[/img]

A large number of our fans took up the challenge and dedicated their time over the festive period to delivering Christmas cargoes. In the first 48 hours, you had delivered over 250,000 cargoes! People actually noticed quickly that with each 250K milestone, a new hanging tree accessory was granted to players who had reached their personal contributions, which provided another boost to motivation. It's no wonder that you were quick to reach the 1 million cargoes delivered community goal, and went even further. The rate of deliveries completed even had Santa in North Pole shocked! Thank you to every single driver who contributed to the event, and to those who really went the extra mile. It really brings a huge smile to the faces of the SCS team to see how much you enjoy these events.

Here are some interesting stats. By the way - the distance of in-game kilometers/miles driven as part of the event could get you from Mars to Sun and back! Pretty impressive, right? ːplanetː

[img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-QbPG9BlkSf0/XEHhK91lg4I/AAAAAAAABTE/uJaFCJ-VpMoEqSjesFxylnErNDYx0moAwCEwYBhgL/s620/CONCLUSION-tab.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Vote for us in Steam Awards 2018
notes.content:
We are really proud that Euro Truck Simulator 2 has been nominated for this year's Steam Awards. We still remember the total surprise when the game was nominated in two categories back in 2016, and the even larger shock when it won the two awards. The competition is always massive, there are so many new great games appearing every year, and so many oldies but goldies still on people's minds. Fortunately, it's obviously also the case with ETS2, and it's truly great to see it nominated for the "Most Fun with a Machine" Award.

We would like to express our sincere thanks to our fans, the nomination is a true sign of the power of the fan community!

Now that the voting starts, we'll once again rely on your kind support. There are five really strong contenders in the category, but we can dream big. ːrlroadhogː A somewhat funny aspect of it is that three of the games nominated for the "Most Fun with a Machine" Award have been developed in our home city - Prague, Czech Republic. notes.title: International Christmas Gifts Delivery Event 2018
notes.content:
It's that time of year again where we sit down and write down lists of presents to send to Santa. Thanks to modern technology at the North Pole, creating gifts and sending them anywhere in the world is easier than ever for Santa's team!

[img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-Za99bi_ovHA/XBdYKoBv-kI/AAAAAAAARFo/cTCS3NHnnhY_lBOcGdsanhDJ64WESTqCgCLcBGAs/s620/blog_body_xmas.jpg[/img]

So it is no surprise that the demand for international gift shipping is higher than ever before. With the Christmas season fast approaching, logistic companies across Europe and the US are under pressure to take on extra drivers to deliver expected gifts internationally and on-time to those eagerly awaiting them.

Logistic companies across both continents are putting out the call to all drivers to aid in this huge effort to ship large amounts of holiday gifts across the USA and Europe, and to help sweeten the deal, offer bonus incentives for drivers who complete at least 12 deliveries to and from the major shipping hubs on both sides of Europe and America!

It won't be an easy task, but if we work together along with some much-needed festive treats, songs and truck decorations, we can all help in bringing some much-needed aid to help deliver Christmas on time!

[h1]International Gift Delivery - Rules:[/h1]

For personal contribution, using External Contracts, complete at least 12 deliveries of Christmas cargo in either [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url]. Personal progress is counted in each game separately.

Any job with the following cargo counts towards event completion:
[list]
[*]Christmas Candy Canes
[*]Christmas Ornaments
[*]Christmas Candles
[*]Christmas Wooden Gifts
[*]Christmas Crackers
[*]Christmas Chocolates
[*]Christmas Socks
[*]Christmas Tree Lights
[*]Christmas Traditional Cookies
[*]Christmas Decorations
[/list]

This is also a transcontinental community event. A combined community effort within [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url]. Aim for [b][u]1,000,000[/u][/b] deliveries to earn a special reward!

[url=https://www.worldoftrucks.com/en/]You can view community progress here.[/url]

[h1]Rewards:[/h1]

For your personal contribution, you will receive:

[b][u]Euro Truck Simulator 2:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]World of Trucks exclusive achievement
[*]An exclusive paint job combo for your truck & trailer - "Starlight Burst"
[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-rFiqv5xPIIg/XBJkGiaYZJI/AAAAAAAARB8/nvLu692mEGs3Idls3v1aj1ocE1adnzOtACLcBGAs/s0/ETS2_reward_xmas_paintjob.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-rFiqv5xPIIg/XBJkGiaYZJI/AAAAAAAARB8/nvLu692mEGs3Idls3v1aj1ocE1adnzOtACLcBGAs/s620/ETS2_reward_xmas_paintjob.jpg[/img][/url]
[/list]
[b][u]American Truck Simulator:[/u][/b]
[list]

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-GuYbgN9R6e4/XBJkYp7I21I/AAAAAAAARCE/VpUdw2no5rwYC9v6jlZzFXhl9FkGGKGKgCLcBGAs/0/ATS_xmas_paintjob_reward.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-GuYbgN9R6e4/XBJkYp7I21I/AAAAAAAARCE/VpUdw2no5rwYC9v6jlZzFXhl9FkGGKGKgCLcBGAs/s620/ATS_xmas_paintjob_reward.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: ATS update 1.33 is out!
notes.content:
We are happy to release American Truck Simulator Update 1.33 out of open beta! Thanks to everyone who helped us verify the stability of the new features. We kept testing the ATS update a bit longer to make sure that there were no surprises with the new detours feature, and fortunately it looks like the reactions to it are all positive. We'll keep tweaking the feature in upcoming updates, and of course we owe it also to players of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] - once we create the relevant new graphics content depicting the blocked roads.

[img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-ZdcyDVkBESw/XAqjHW0R9hI/AAAAAAAABQk/c5TW6LK1BskYiettorLI-nzkTrdTBKE5ACLcBGAs/s620/blog_ats_1_33_update.jpg[/img]

As both our flagship sims are running on the same codebase, American Truck's update benefited from the extended Experimental and Open Beta programs we have tried ahead of Euro Truck 2's new update. We are very likely to repeat the process again for most of the upcoming updates.

Even when we are not currently in open beta, we'd like to invite you to provide your feedback, input, wishes, and critique on our forums. We keep monitoring the message boards pretty much every day. The old school forums often work better for a discussion thread taking place across several days or weeks, compared to the typical quick fire and forget exchanges on newer generation social media.

Features are described in depth in the open beta announcement:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1714079132251894910
Enjoy all the new additions and happy trucking. By the way, which changelog video do you like more?
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bcLccszlsA4
[b]To enjoy the 1.33 update, make sure to OPT OUT of beta branches and your game will be updated automatically on Steam.[/b]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Buyable turnpike double trailers (Nevada only)
