notes.title: The Day of the Updates
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the final version of the 1.4 update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/270880]American Truck Simulator
[/url] and 1.25 for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/227300]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] are now available via Steam. Big thanks to all of you who have contributed with your feedback and bug reports during the Open Beta period!

Let's recap the key features included with these updates:
[list]
[*][b]Trailer selection[/b] - When you pick up a new job the game will now give you a chance to change the trailer  look (or the trailer itself) if it finds that there are alternate trailer styles or textures available for the given cargo.  Even better, it works with modded trailers as well.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zx87hSOrz6Q
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/973160062960382767]Custom steering wheel position[/url] -You'll be allowed to adjust the tilt of the  steering wheel column or telescope it so you can create your perfect driving position.

[img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-uGotmm-H_nE/V5DeezntG4I/AAAAAAAAB5E/f9Z3limdHuISauR-CCr8HVlOdmo1RIZBgCPcB/s0/ATS_adjusting_steering_wheel.gif[/img]
[/list]

Here's a log of the additional fixes and improvements that went into this update:

[h1]CODE[/h1]
[list]
[*]Cruise control is not disabled by the throttle anymore.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/979917389194883245]Interior camera zoom[/url] - You can bind the key for zoom in Options → Key and buttons → Camera controls → Zoom interior camera.
[*]Option to set preferred job length generation in options.
[*]Option to set split shifting input.
[*]More unit display options (volume, consumption).
[/list]
[h1]DATA[/h1]
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/979917389194883245]Steering wheels are now a separate model[/url] with a default and exclusive version for each truck
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/977666485609943946]Steering knobs[/url] - six different steering knobs in each game; you are able to install them at four possible locations on a steering wheel.
[*]Customizable cabin lights and horns on all trucks.
[*]Low air warning sound added.
[/list]
[h1]MODDING[/h1]
[list]
[*]Separated map_data.sii from game_data.sii
[*]Look_presets_defaults[] in interior camera
[*]Change trailer looks to paint jobs.
[/list]

Please also check out our [url=http://modding.scssoft.com/wiki/Games/ETS2/Modding_guides/1.25]modding wiki[/url] to get the best advice for modding either game.

notes.title: The Day of the Updates
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the final version of the 1.4 update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/270880]American Truck Simulator
[/url] and 1.25 for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/227300]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] are now available via Steam. Big thanks to all of you who have contributed with your feedback and bug reports during the Open Beta period!

Let's recap the key features included with these updates:
[list]
[*][b]Trailer selection[/b] - When you pick up a new job the game will now give you a chance to change the trailer  look (or the trailer itself) if it finds that there are alternate trailer styles or textures available for the given cargo.  Even better, it works with modded trailers as well.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zx87hSOrz6Q
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/973160062960382767]Custom steering wheel position[/url] -You'll be allowed to adjust the tilt of the  steering wheel column or telescope it so you can create your perfect driving position.

[img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-uGotmm-H_nE/V5DeezntG4I/AAAAAAAAB5E/f9Z3limdHuISauR-CCr8HVlOdmo1RIZBgCPcB/s0/ATS_adjusting_steering_wheel.gif[/img]
[/list]

Here's a log of the additional fixes and improvements that went into this update:

[h1]CODE[/h1]
[list]
[*]Cruise control is not disabled by the throttle anymore.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/979917389194883245]Interior camera zoom[/url] - You can bind the key for zoom in Options → Key and buttons → Camera controls → Zoom interior camera.
[*]Option to set preferred job length generation in options.
[*]Option to set split shifting input.
[*]More unit display options (volume, consumption).
[/list]
[h1]DATA[/h1]
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/979917389194883245]Steering wheels are now a separate model[/url] with a default and exclusive version for each truck
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/977666485609943946]Steering knobs[/url] - six different steering knobs in each game; you are able to install them at four possible locations on a steering wheel.
[*]Customizable cabin lights and horns on all trucks.
[*]Low air warning sound added.
[/list]
[h1]MODDING[/h1]
[list]
[*]Separated map_data.sii from game_data.sii
[*]Look_presets_defaults[] in interior camera
[*]Change trailer looks to paint jobs.
[/list]

Please also check out our [url=http://modding.scssoft.com/wiki/Games/ETS2/Modding_guides/1.25]modding wiki[/url] to get the best advice for modding either game.

notes.title: Steering Knobs
notes.content:
The Open Beta for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/981043465703723662]American Truck Simulator's[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/227300/announcements/detail/797522500508163927]Euro Truck Simulator 2's[/url] upcoming updates is already in full swing. We'd like to thank you all for the feedback and bug reports you've given us!

To get to the point: once a game update enters public testing, we usually just want to stabilize the new features and release it. But this time we have decided to up the scope of the updates even when the beta test is already in flight. Our artists just finished work on an interesting little set of cabin "toys." Our inner circle of trusted beta testers liked it very much, and so we wanted to share it with you as soon as possible.

So here we are, introducing a new little game feature - streering knobs. We've included six different steering knobs in each game; you will be able to install them at four possible locations on a steering wheel. Steering knobs are an exception rather than a rule, they are not frequently used on long haul trucks, and actually their legal status is somewhat shady in certain territories. But we hope that the new feature will please the group of fans who kept requesting their addition to our games.

[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-_RTrXuBteBw/V8AuxEW-pmI/AAAAAAAACAo/G4vhc3cKEloV6X27kUo6X5P0pxFPLdl2gCLcB/s0/ets2_knob.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-_RTrXuBteBw/V8AuxEW-pmI/AAAAAAAACAo/G4vhc3cKEloV6X27kUo6X5P0pxFPLdl2gCLcB/s620/ets2_knob.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-OYlcEnjV_gQ/V8Auye5sJnI/AAAAAAAACAs/7-5WE0I_wv4K9vDo8yxqp44mB0D6B4C7QCLcB/s0/ats_knob.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-OYlcEnjV_gQ/V8Auye5sJnI/AAAAAAAACAs/7-5WE0I_wv4K9vDo8yxqp44mB0D6B4C7QCLcB/s620/ats_knob.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: ATS 1.4 open beta
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that the open beta of update 1.4 for American Truck Simulator is now available on Steam!

With 1.4 we're introducing a lot of changes to the core game.  You'll find a condensed changelog at the bottom of this blog post, but first let's recap the major features that we'd like to bring to your attention (including a surprise feature - trailer selection).

[h1]MAIN FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/973160062960382767]Custom steering wheel position[/url] - You'll be allowed to modify both the height and the angle of the steering wheel so you can create your perfect driving position.

[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-uGotmm-H_nE/V5DeezntG4I/AAAAAAAAB5E/f9Z3limdHuISauR-CCr8HVlOdmo1RIZBgCPcB/s0/ATS_adjusting_steering_wheel.gif][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-uGotmm-H_nE/V5DeezntG4I/AAAAAAAAB5E/f9Z3limdHuISauR-CCr8HVlOdmo1RIZBgCPcB/s0/ATS_adjusting_steering_wheel.gif[/img][/url]

[*][b]Trailer selection[/b] - We have recently changed how trailer data are organized under the hood in the game engine. More flexibility will come handy; one trailer 3D model can have multiple looks - different "paints" - textures - for example to represent different companies), and there may actually be multiple trailers compatible with the same cargo type. As we are adding new companies, trailers, and cargoes to the game (and so are modders), the old system was no longer sufficient.

When you pick a job to transport, the game will now give you a chance to change the trailer look (or the trailer itself) if it finds that there are alternate possibilities available for transporting given cargo.

[url=http://4.bp.blogspot.com/-EyiFEnJWWw8/V7R9nHyNLUI/AAAAAAAAB9o/9rFrkopiXLkjQyBQYikUp1fvf2XzQue6ACK4B/s0/ats_trailer_selection_01.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-EyiFEnJWWw8/V7R9nHyNLUI/AAAAAAAAB9o/9rFrkopiXLkjQyBQYikUp1fvf2XzQue6ACK4B/s620/ats_trailer_selection_01.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://2.bp.blogspot.com/-hS6wuYA2p4U/V7R9pct2jvI/AAAAAAAAB9w/F86TIAB4680apRR2kaNSleS-3IcTIxoigCK4B/s0/ats_trailer_selection_02.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-hS6wuYA2p4U/V7R9pct2jvI/AAAAAAAAB9w/F86TIAB4680apRR2kaNSleS-3IcTIxoigCK4B/s620/ats_trailer_selection_02.jpg[/img][/url]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zx87hSOrz6Q

[h1]Other Features and Improvements[/h1]

Here's a log of the additional fixes and improvements that went into this update:

[h1]CODE[/h1]
[list]
[*]Cruise control is not disabled by the throttle anymore.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/979917389194883245]Interior camera zoom[/url] - please set the key/button for zoom in Options → Key and buttons → Camera controls → Zoom interior camera.
[*]Option to set preferred job length generation in options.
[*]Option to set split shifting input.
[*]More unit display options (volume, consumption).
[/list]

[h1]DATA[/h1]
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/979917389194883245]Steering wheels are now a separate model[/url] with default and exclusive version for each truck
[*]Low air warning sound added.
[*]Customizable cabin lights and horns on all trucks.
[/list]

[h1]MODDING[/h1]
[list]
[*]Separated map_data.sii from game_data.sii
[*]look_presets_defaults[] in interior camera
[*]Change trailer looks to paint jobs.
[/list]

Please also check our [url=http://modding.scssoft.com/wiki/Games/ETS2/Modding_guides/1.25]modding wiki[/url], to get the best advice for modding of both games.

You can find the beta in the public_beta branch on Steam. (Steam client → LIBRARY → right click on American Truck Simulator → Properties → Betas tab → public_beta - 1.4 public beta).  No password is required.

Please keep in mind that this is still only a test version of the update: it's perfectly okay if you want to hold off until the final release.  But if you are curious, don't mind a little instability, and want to assist us in the polishing process, we greatly appreciate your help. Please report any bugs on our [url=http://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=217]forum[/url].

notes.title: Cab Improvements
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/973160062960382767]Adjustable steering wheels[/url] are not the only in-cabin feature we are going to include in the upcoming update coming for ETS2 and ATS. We are also going to deliver two new features:

[h1]1) Interior camera zoom[/h1]

[img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-MSM4QEgWfmM/V7MJKEkU-nI/AAAAAAAADfs/DEtRevj0dvYsYugV2zIpQqWEkNc3tUzvgCLcB/s0/ats_camera_zoom2.gif[/img]

When inside the cabin, you will be able to do a quick zoom-in by holding the right mouse button. It may be useful while maneuvering, reading far off road signs, or when you would like to see all the info on the dashboard in more detail. Of course you can bind this functionality to any other key or button in the game's options.

[h1]2) Changing the steering wheel[/h1]

[url=http://4.bp.blogspot.com/-FOnNUXSLd5w/V63Hjr06kiI/AAAAAAAAB8M/U3_1EuPjdlgk0ozWWLGY-YiTEpKjlSbAwCK4B/s0/ets2_steering_wheel_1.png][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-FOnNUXSLd5w/V63Hjr06kiI/AAAAAAAAB8M/U3_1EuPjdlgk0ozWWLGY-YiTEpKjlSbAwCK4B/s620/ets2_steering_wheel_1.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://2.bp.blogspot.com/-U4904Zkp8m0/V63HpHrGc6I/AAAAAAAAB8U/2MCtNCSvYPEh8qr8G8TgFboHVCokutOJwCK4B/s0/ets2_steering_wheel_2.png][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-U4904Zkp8m0/V63HpHrGc6I/AAAAAAAAB8U/2MCtNCSvYPEh8qr8G8TgFboHVCokutOJwCK4B/s620/ets2_steering_wheel_2.png[/img][/url]

Decoupling the steering wheel geometry from the rest of the cabin, which was needed for adjustable steering wheels, opened up the possibility to offer changeable steering wheels. Until now, steering wheels were a native part of interior model; the unfortunate consequence of this being that players could not replace a truck's standard wheel with alternate models. With the release of our upcoming update however, trucks which have more than one type of interior will also sport the option of choosing from two different steering wheels. Finally, some people using an external steering wheel feel that having two wheels in sight is a bit disingenuous: so we are going to add a new experimental console command that will allow you to hide the virtual steering wheel.

notes.title: Adjustable Steering Wheels
notes.content:
In both [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/]American Truck Simulator[/url] and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url], players already have the option to modify their interior camera viewpoint by adjusting the seat position, changing head position and modifying the view angle. In earlier game updates, we've also made the in-cabin camera more lifelike by simulating steering and blinker camera rotation as well as physical camera movement. But we still felt the job wasn't done, so now it's time to go one step further in order to fully simulate the range of possible adjustments you could make in real life.

So without further ado: in the following game updates, we are going to add a small new feature: adjusting the steering wheel column position. With this feature you'll be allowed to modify both the height and the angle of the steering wheel in order to give you the chance to create your perfect driving position. With this we're one step closer to making the cabin in ATS and ETS2 just like the real thing. Last but not least, in the Seat Adjustment UI screen we will add the ability to modify the Seat Adjustment window values with the mouse wheel.

We hope you're as excited about these features as we are. In the mean time, here is a short GIF showing it off:

[img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-uGotmm-H_nE/V5DeezntG4I/AAAAAAAAB5A/5Wyv554QRus2RVp8X0t-95n72N0QlhjsACK4B/w620/ATS_adjusting_steering_wheel.gif[/img]

notes.title: Glimpses from our PACCAR Research Center visit
notes.content:
We have finally managed to create a short video from the second leg of our trip to the USA this spring.

A small expedition team from SCS Software received a kind invitation to spend three days at the PACCAR Technical Center in Mount Vernon, Washington, USA. It has been a great adventure for us, we have recorded a ton of truck engine sounds, photographed and scanned whatever we could get our hands on, and spent hours discussing trucking topics.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lIQDjlGch0w

notes.title: Mid-America Trucking Show Impressions
notes.content:
If you follow our blog or [url=https://twitter.com/scssoftware]SCS Software's Twitter[/url] closely, you may remember that back in April we [url=http://blog.scssoft.com/2016/04/scs-software-is-at-mid-america-trucking.html]mentioned[/url] that a bunch of guys from SCS Software were going to visit the [url=http://www.truckingshow.com/]Mid-America Trucking Show[/url] in Luisville, Kentucky.

While there we took thousands of reference photos every day for use in future projects - but aside from the occasional random photo we posted straight from the show floor, we didn't do much detailed reporting on what was really a very exciting trip for us.

Although everyone was very busy after returning to Prague, we always thought that it would be nice to sift through the footage and make a wrap-up report from our time at MATS, but there was always some higher priority task to handle first.  Finally though, with the help of some friends, we managed to create a short compilation of video footage from the trip:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g7LwO62ncFg

Now we're asking - would you be interested in seeing more from the show floor?  This may not be the best platform for it but we could definitely select a hundred or two interesting photos from the trip and publish them, for example, on the [url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs/]American Truck Simulator Facebook page[/url].  Let us know!

notes.title: Hitting The Virtual Roads Of Euro And American Truck Simulator With Retired Truckers
notes.content:
Truck driving games like American Truck Simulator [official site] and Euro Truck Simulator 2 [official site] are popular because they offer a routine, almost meditatively romantic simplicity there’s no lengthy checklist of deadlines to meet and stakeholders to please, no paperwork, no family to feed, no monsters to slay, nor anything else to raise your heartrate. Just you, the open road, and a cargo to haul somewhere.

For one group of players, however, the escapism offered by truck sims goes to another level. It’s not just an escape from the chaos and stress of their everyday life, but also an escape into a former life. For retired truckers, truck sims are a way to return to life on the road a life they loved. In virtual form.

notes.title: Bigger Skies: American Truck Simulator Being Scaled Up
notes.content:
The dream of American trucking is big skies and grand vistas. American Truck Simulator [official site] is okay at that, especially since Arizona arrived, but it can feel a little dinky. Developers SCS Software have a plan. As well as adding extra states, SCS have announced they’re making the whole game bigger by rescaling the world in a future free update. It’ll go from 1:35 scale to 1:20, which SCS say will mean “75% longer roads outside the cities”. They’re also reworking the landscape for a bigger sense of scale and gosh, this is awfully exciting! Give me those grander vistas.

notes.title: The Rescale
notes.content:
We're very excited to make a big announcement, but first we need to give you a little backstory. Back when we were beginning research work on American Truck Simulator, just a few months after the release of Euro Truck Simulator 2, SCS Software was a team of about 20 people. We made, and kept, a commitment to actively support and expand ETS2, so the core team on the ATS project at thatpoint was just a handful of developers. We hoped that some day the team would grow to be a modest 8-10 people large. They were facing a monumental challenge in trying to portray the continent of North America on a reasonable scale within a feasible time frame.

[url=http://4.bp.blogspot.com/-vuTeS0_BL4U/V2vk59SrwwI/AAAAAAAAB1E/CF0XnYEyRdcC5uk0hLDKk2_Jrw3P6k2MwCK4B/S0/golden_gate_6_lines.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-vuTeS0_BL4U/V2vk59SrwwI/AAAAAAAAB1E/CF0XnYEyRdcC5uk0hLDKk2_Jrw3P6k2MwCK4B/s620/golden_gate_6_lines.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]The new Golden Gate Bridge.  Notice anything different?[/i]

Fortunately American Truck Simulator started strong out of the gate, and we are now confident that its sales can sustain an even larger development team than we originally hoped for. SCS Software has since more than doubled in size, and we are in the process of hiring even more map designers and 3D artists. Looking at what we have created so far, and considering all the feedback we've gotten from our fans, we are at an intersection: we can either accept things as they are and continue building the world as is, or we can take a step back and change things before it's too late. It's either now or never, as the more of the world we build, the less likely we are going to be able to make major changes.

[url=http://3.bp.blogspot.com/-2266NsHB-UU/V2vlo3kqXgI/AAAAAAAAB1Q/o9vQ7c7A5-oAIqYMyj4bhH_y8lAr5kKiQCK4B/s0/New_US101_tunnel.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-2266NsHB-UU/V2vlo3kqXgI/AAAAAAAAB1Q/o9vQ7c7A5-oAIqYMyj4bhH_y8lAr5kKiQCK4B/s620/New_US101_tunnel.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]New U.S. Route 101 tunnel[/i]

Having said all that, perhaps the greatest number of complaints from the players of American Truck Simulator have been related to the scale of the map. Your comments are incredibly important to us, and we listen to as many as we can.As such, we had been pondering internally how to meet your feedback for several months while we finished work on the Arizona DLC, and now we have made up our mind: we are, as a free future update, going to increase the scale of the game world of American Truck Simulator. This update will have many clear benefits for you, such as:
[list]
[*]Upping the map scale from 1:35 to 1:20, meaning 75% longer roads outside cities[/*]
[*]Retouching the the existing system of roads and intersections and revisiting the placement of cities and crossroads[/*]
[*]Focusing on a better sense of scale and distance, more space for large vistas[/*]
[*]Adjusting the timescale - meaning a slower day/night cycle and longer intervals between when the driver needs to rest and refuel[/*]
[*]Revamping problematic junctions - no more Interstate intersections![/*]
[*]Revamping the driver experience system to more closely mirror ETS2's system[/*]
[*]More room for densely populated areas in future map expansions[/*]
[/list]

[url=http://1.bp.blogspot.com/-hIAifhpNIVc/V2qWlVnjyiI/AAAAAAAAB0M/Z82gUzcrOqUXTP_Z9DFREx4x6BiAWXmdgCK4B/s0/ats_rescale_comparsion.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-hIAifhpNIVc/V2qWlVnjyiI/AAAAAAAAB0M/Z82gUzcrOqUXTP_Z9DFREx4x6BiAWXmdgCK4B/w620/ats_rescale_comparsion.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]This compares the size of  California, Nevada and Arizona before the rescale and after it[/i]

The new scale is equivalent to that of Euro Truck Simulator 2, so the flow of time in both games will be the same. There is also more room now to go back and improve some of the places that were compromised due to the limited scale and replace them with more realistic depictions.

The benefits are clear - you're going to get a free "take 2" on the West-coast states that you already have in the game, and roomier game world for future expansions. In addition, this expansion will come with new road segments to explore and updated technology for the old roads.

There is one thing that we need from you though - patience. It will take several months to re-scale the existing world before we can move on to  building completely new areas and DLC. The map designers are in fact hard at work already on the re-scaling project. To help reduce the turn around time of new state DLC during this renovation, a large part of the 3D assets team is working on vegetation, buildings, landmarks, and any new prefabs we need for new state DLC. And in the middle of all of this, our hope is to grow the company enough to have two map designer teams working in parallel on growing North America both Northward and Eastward at the same time.

[url=http://3.bp.blogspot.com/-LmUKGuolszU/V2qWr4JXDiI/AAAAAAAAB0U/EeD9dWpMuGQvWcKG6O9_3qbS4oNP1fONwCK4B/s0/new_ats_rescale.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-LmUKGuolszU/V2qWr4JXDiI/AAAAAAAAB0U/EeD9dWpMuGQvWcKG6O9_3qbS4oNP1fONwCK4B/w620/new_ats_rescale.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]Map showing the road segments which will be added during the rescale process.[/i]

We are very excited for this expansion and feel strongly that it is in everyone's best interest. You get more compatibility, new content, and better modding technology for free, and we get the space to expand the North American continent into the truly majestic landscape that it is. This is the right step to take for the health of the game and its community in the long term - two, three, even five years into the future.  We hope that enough of our fans will have the patience to stay with us. It's your continued support that makes our games what they are, and what we do worth doing.

notes.title: The Rescale
notes.content:
We're very excited to make a big announcement, but first we need to give you a little backstory. Back when we were beginning research work on American Truck Simulator, just a few months after the release of Euro Truck Simulator 2, SCS Software was a team of about 20 people. We made, and kept, a commitment to actively support and expand ETS2, so the core team on the ATS project at thatpoint was just a handful of developers. We hoped that some day the team would grow to be a modest 8-10 people large. They were facing a monumental challenge in trying to portray the continent of North America on a reasonable scale within a feasible time frame.

[url=http://4.bp.blogspot.com/-vuTeS0_BL4U/V2vk59SrwwI/AAAAAAAAB1E/CF0XnYEyRdcC5uk0hLDKk2_Jrw3P6k2MwCK4B/S0/golden_gate_6_lines.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-vuTeS0_BL4U/V2vk59SrwwI/AAAAAAAAB1E/CF0XnYEyRdcC5uk0hLDKk2_Jrw3P6k2MwCK4B/s620/golden_gate_6_lines.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]The new Golden Gate Bridge.  Notice anything different?[/i]

Fortunately American Truck Simulator started strong out of the gate, and we are now confident that its sales can sustain an even larger development team than we originally hoped for. SCS Software has since more than doubled in size, and we are in the process of hiring even more map designers and 3D artists. Looking at what we have created so far, and considering all the feedback we've gotten from our fans, we are at an intersection: we can either accept things as they are and continue building the world as is, or we can take a step back and change things before it's too late. It's either now or never, as the more of the world we build, the less likely we are going to be able to make major changes.

[url=http://3.bp.blogspot.com/-2266NsHB-UU/V2vlo3kqXgI/AAAAAAAAB1Q/o9vQ7c7A5-oAIqYMyj4bhH_y8lAr5kKiQCK4B/s0/New_US101_tunnel.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-2266NsHB-UU/V2vlo3kqXgI/AAAAAAAAB1Q/o9vQ7c7A5-oAIqYMyj4bhH_y8lAr5kKiQCK4B/s620/New_US101_tunnel.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]New U.S. Route 101 tunnel[/i]

Having said all that, perhaps the greatest number of complaints from the players of American Truck Simulator have been related to the scale of the map. Your comments are incredibly important to us, and we listen to as many as we can.As such, we had been pondering internally how to meet your feedback for several months while we finished work on the Arizona DLC, and now we have made up our mind: we are, as a free future update, going to increase the scale of the game world of American Truck Simulator. This update will have many clear benefits for you, such as:
[list]
[*]Upping the map scale from 1:35 to 1:20, meaning 75% longer roads outside cities[/*]
[*]Retouching the the existing system of roads and intersections and revisiting the placement of cities and crossroads[/*]
[*]Focusing on a better sense of scale and distance, more space for large vistas[/*]
[*]Adjusting the timescale - meaning a slower day/night cycle and longer intervals between when the driver needs to rest and refuel[/*]
[*]Revamping problematic junctions - no more Interstate intersections![/*]
[*]Revamping the driver experience system to more closely mirror ETS2's system[/*]
[*]More room for densely populated areas in future map expansions[/*]
[/list]

[url=http://1.bp.blogspot.com/-hIAifhpNIVc/V2qWlVnjyiI/AAAAAAAAB0M/Z82gUzcrOqUXTP_Z9DFREx4x6BiAWXmdgCK4B/s0/ats_rescale_comparsion.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-hIAifhpNIVc/V2qWlVnjyiI/AAAAAAAAB0M/Z82gUzcrOqUXTP_Z9DFREx4x6BiAWXmdgCK4B/w620/ats_rescale_comparsion.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]This compares the size of  California, Nevada and Arizona before the rescale and after it[/i]

The new scale is equivalent to that of Euro Truck Simulator 2, so the flow of time in both games will be the same. There is also more room now to go back and improve some of the places that were compromised due to the limited scale and replace them with more realistic depictions.

The benefits are clear - you're going to get a free "take 2" on the West-coast states that you already have in the game, and roomier game world for future expansions. In addition, this expansion will come with new road segments to explore and updated technology for the old roads.

There is one thing that we need from you though - patience. It will take several months to re-scale the existing world before we can move on to  building completely new areas and DLC. The map designers are in fact hard at work already on the re-scaling project. To help reduce the turn around time of new state DLC during this renovation, a large part of the 3D assets team is working on vegetation, buildings, landmarks, and any new prefabs we need for new state DLC. And in the middle of all of this, our hope is to grow the company enough to have two map designer teams working in parallel on growing North America both Northward and Eastward at the same time.

[url=http://3.bp.blogspot.com/-LmUKGuolszU/V2qWr4JXDiI/AAAAAAAAB0U/EeD9dWpMuGQvWcKG6O9_3qbS4oNP1fONwCK4B/s0/new_ats_rescale.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-LmUKGuolszU/V2qWr4JXDiI/AAAAAAAAB0U/EeD9dWpMuGQvWcKG6O9_3qbS4oNP1fONwCK4B/w620/new_ats_rescale.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]Map showing the road segments which will be added during the rescale process.[/i]

We are very excited for this expansion and feel strongly that it is in everyone's best interest. You get more compatibility, new content, and better modding technology for free, and we get the space to expand the North American continent into the truly majestic landscape that it is. This is the right step to take for the health of the game and its community in the long term - two, three, even five years into the future.  We hope that enough of our fans will have the patience to stay with us. It's your continued support that makes our games what they are, and what we do worth doing.

notes.title: Free Arizona map expansion for American Truck Simulator released!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that we are releasing [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/463740/]Arizona DLC[/url] for American Truck Simulator today.

[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-0v5nSbSP5Lc/V1GGzRbAJ0I/AAAAAAAABxI/o620z6atyrwgDWsn4X_JZNaJXWvlYvFvQCK4B/s0/Flag.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-0v5nSbSP5Lc/V1GGzRbAJ0I/AAAAAAAABxI/o620z6atyrwgDWsn4X_JZNaJXWvlYvFvQCK4B/s620/Flag.jpg[/img][/url]

Discover 15 new cities, admire Colorado River with The Grand Canyon, and explore a section of the famous Route 66!

[url=http://3.bp.blogspot.com/-DdlvEs5qX0I/V1GF2m99w5I/AAAAAAAABw8/G0RV46NADlkomIDc_LCR60rC0IeuBMChACK4B/s0/Hoover_Damm.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-DdlvEs5qX0I/V1GF2m99w5I/AAAAAAAABw8/G0RV46NADlkomIDc_LCR60rC0IeuBMChACK4B/s620/Hoover_Damm.jpg[/img][/url]

As promised back in January, the map expansion is automatically unlocked for all owners of the game for free, no matter where or when you have bought it.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=reeBU10VvMI

We would like to thank all the participants of the Open Beta for their feedback. It was very helpful for us, especially the stress and functional tests of World of Trucks improvements, and the help with ironing out the many little details in Arizona!

[h1]Both American Truck Simulator as well as Euro Truck Simulator 2 Updated[/h1]

There is good news for owners of both of our flagship truck sim games - they are getting a bunch of new features as a part of a new game update coming out today, too.

Advanced players will for sure welcome the optional [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/958517213925039248]physically simulated truck and trailer coupling[/url], while the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/958516129945670798]improvements for our World Of Trucks platform[/url] should be appreciated by people playing online contracts.

[url=http://2.bp.blogspot.com/-l-GODkfHAgQ/V0R597SsfQI/AAAAAAAADdY/03R5eCgED8kT5t02Ml5R9sJ83tcbYh1DgCK4B/s0/adv_coupling_scheme.png][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-l-GODkfHAgQ/V0R597SsfQI/AAAAAAAADdY/03R5eCgED8kT5t02Ml5R9sJ83tcbYh1DgCK4B/s620/adv_coupling_scheme.png[/img][/url]  

[url=http://4.bp.blogspot.com/-0je1YXx450E/V0ROogTz_bI/AAAAAAAABt4/vbf1PP8BA_Q5zCrMNqvo36tSoXXtIJImQCK4B/s0/ets2_external_contracts.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-0je1YXx450E/V0ROogTz_bI/AAAAAAAABt4/vbf1PP8BA_Q5zCrMNqvo36tSoXXtIJImQCK4B/s620/ets2_external_contracts.jpg[/img][/url]

Changelog of improvements that are a part of this update:

[h1]MAIN FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved external jobs support in game (direct control, freight market).
[*]Physically simulated truck and trailer coupling (option).
[*]Added external jobs.
[*]Arizona DLC.
[/list]
[h1]CODE[/h1]
[list]
[*]Blinker auto off can be disabled (option).
[*]Speeding highlight can be disabled (option).
[*]Torque converter simulation greatly improved.
[*]Automatic transmission behavior improved.
[*]XInput support added - custom support for XBox controller.
[*]Added UI support for 4th and 5th controller.
[*]Gear shift selectors (range, split) now have UI support for position-based switches.
[/list]
[h1]DATA[/h1]
[list]
[*]New accessories added to 579 and T680 (bullbars, deflectors, sideflares, etc).
[*]Default air horn added to all trucks (attribute air_horn in sound accessory).
[*]New engine sound of W900 (air intake).
[*]Interior sounds of all trucks rebalanced.
[*]US specific engine data.
[*]Added new road from San Rafael to Eureka + new city Ukiah on this road
[/list]
[h1]MOD[/h1]
[list]
[*]Damage params moved out from game_data.sii and some more added (including wear and part damage factors).
[*]Data driven engines (torque curve, rpm limits).
[*]Force feedback data for XInput added (force_feedback.sii).
[*]Torque converter physics data added, separated manual clutch data (physics.sii).
[*]Data change from driven wheel to driven axle.
[*]Added check for internal camera continuity.
[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/463740/

notes.title: The Power of Community #5 - Custom Truck Simulator Shifter Hardware!
notes.content:
We love to be surprised by cool things happening in the truck sim fan community. After blazing through their Kicstarter for [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/skrs/skrs-shifter-knob-for-american-truck-simulator]SKRS 18 Speed USB Shift Knob[/url], Cory & gang at [url=http://csio.tech/]CSIO Technologies[/url] have built a company around a unique business plan - offering high-quality custom hardware tailored for the specific need of truck simulator games. We feel that they deserve a mention here in the Steam hub.

The replacement shifter knob is actually using original Eaton Fuller part with additional circuitry for communication with the game. It is compatible with several high-end shifters: Fanatec, Thrustmaster TH8RS and TH8A, and Logitech G25, G27 and G29 steering wheel shifters.

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-hnSVnS0jHgI/V0wIdCGoI0I/AAAAAAAACMg/secIzqJWW7kRedLt8dE1EfPcacgeeaqiwCLcB/s0/shifter_knob.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-hnSVnS0jHgI/V0wIdCGoI0I/AAAAAAAACMg/secIzqJWW7kRedLt8dE1EfPcacgeeaqiwCLcB/h300/shifter_knob.jpg[/img][/url]

Given the price point, it is something only for the most enthusiastic fans. But as there is quite a lot of people who have been ok with buying a $200-$300 steering wheel just to play our games, CSIO may have a decent chance to be viable in the long term.

For the upcoming updates for Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator, we have improved the setup screens in the game to autodetect the new controller, and to understand the new type of switches on the shifter. We are happy to embed one of CSIO Technologie's YouTube videos on setting up the device in our game (as it currently works in the open beta).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JgWWpI4u7Ps

Talking about community involvement, we had the pleasure last week to welcome two influential Polish youtubers playing our truck sims - our Prague office was visited by [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/bohun1978]Wujek Bohun[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/WolnyKanal]Wolny Kanał[/url].

The guys had a lot of opinions on particular features and suggestions for our games to unleash on us, we felt that it was a very constructive discussion. Mixing together Czech, Polish and English languages, we got along pretty well. Hezký den! Miłego dnia! Have a nice day!

[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-QwUaSpEEx_E/V0hZD7wkDNI/AAAAAAAACMM/5_a4TvqaI7kLQKVpDqr-k3iGCDy_VgcNQCLcB/s0/polish_youtubers.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-QwUaSpEEx_E/V0hZD7wkDNI/AAAAAAAACMM/5_a4TvqaI7kLQKVpDqr-k3iGCDy_VgcNQCLcB/s620/polish_youtubers.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update 1.3 with Arizona expansion going into open beta
notes.content:
The Open Beta of Update 1.3 for American Truck Simulator is available on Steam. And yes, if you are keen to explore it even before the update is officially released for everybody, the testing version contains the much anticipated Arizona DLC!

[url=http://4.bp.blogspot.com/-5bM4jCgfqLA/V0bi47i8KPI/AAAAAAAABuQ/Fff7Nem0ufg-vbxFw2UJqo9rKY2PUHJIgCK4B/s0/16%2B-%2BPage.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-5bM4jCgfqLA/V0bi47i8KPI/AAAAAAAABuQ/Fff7Nem0ufg-vbxFw2UJqo9rKY2PUHJIgCK4B/s620/16%2B-%2BPage.jpg[/img][/url]

Here is out little marketing blurb for Arizona: Drive through the streets of 15 new cities including the largest city and capital, Phoenix, and visit the distinctive southern centers Flagstaff and Tucson. Discover a section of the famous Route 66 with its key landmarks. Cross the Colorado river over unique bridges and explore many wonderful vistas and famous landmarks within this region.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=reeBU10VvMI

The Arizona State is not the only new feature of 1.3 update of course. The list of changes and fixes is much longer, here is a recap of the key ones:

[h1]MAIN NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Arizona DLC
[*]Take World of Trucks Contracts directly from the game, now with ATS support.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/958516129945670798
[*]Physically simulated truck and trailer coupling.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/958517213925039248
[/list]

[h1]CODE[/h1]
[list]
[*]Blinker auto off can be disabled (option).
[*]Speeding highlight can be disabled (option).
[*]Torque converter simulation greatly improved.
[*]Automatic transmission behavior improved.
[*]XInput support added.
[*]Added UI support for 4th and 5th controller.
[*]Gear shift selectors (range, split) now have UI support for position-based switches.
[/list]

[h1]DATA[/h1]
[list]
[*]New accessories added to 579 a T680 (bullbars, deflectors, sideflares, etc).
[*]Default air horn added to all trucks (attribute air_horn in sound accessory).
[*]New engine sound of W900 (air intake).
[*]Interior sounds of all trucks rebalanced.
[*]US specific engine data.
[/list]

[h1]MODDING[/h1]
[list]
[*]Damage params moved out from game_data.sii and some more added (including wear and part damage factors).
[*]Data driven engines (torque curve, rpm limits).
[*]Force feedback data for XInput added (force_feedback.sii).
[*]Torque converter physics data added, separated manual clutch data (physics.sii).
[/list]

You can find the beta in the public_beta branch on Steam. (Steam client → LIBRARY → right click on American Truck Simulator → Properties → Betas tab → public_beta - 1.3 public beta). No password is required. A word of caution: make sure to back-up your profile and save game data before experimenting with beta builds!

Please keep in mind that this is still only a test version of the update, it's perfectly ok for you to wait and stay away from it until it's stable and final. If you are curious though and want to assist us in polishing it, we greatly appreciate your help. Please report any bugs on our [url=http://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=216]forum[/url].

Last but not least, yesterday we released the public beta version of SCS Workshop Uploader tool, that is compatible with latest game updates. More details [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/discussions/-1/364042703853816887/?appid=270880]here[/url].

notes.title: Advanced Trailer Coupling
notes.content:
The upcoming open betas for the new game updates of Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator are coming with a new feature: advanced trailer coupling. They say a picture is worth a thousand words and a video can show even more, so let's take a look at it first:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WBPS1kzOOsE

The new trailer coupling feature is optional - you need to enable it in the game's options to adjust the game's default trailer coupling behavior. Make sure to consider your precise reversing skills before doing so! ;)

The standard trailer coupling allowed for quite some room in the relative positions of the kingpin and the fifth-wheel. You could also "cheat" it by approaching the trailer from an angle. The new trailer coupling option uses full physical collision simulation for the kingpin and fifth-wheel - you will be faced with the same challenge as a real truck driver. Expecting this precision from a newbie player may be too intimidating, so we are keeping the standard simple coupling as a default, but we know that a lot of our experienced truck sim players are asking for more realism, and we hope that you will appreciate that we are improving the game in this regard step by step.

In addition to the kingpin/fifth-wheel simulation, we have also added an additional visual treat to several trailers in the game, with an animation of raising the trailer landing gear.

[spoiler]If you have really sharp eyes, you may notice something in the video which is also a teaser for a whole bunch of new tuning content coming to American Truck Simulator and Euro Truck Simulator 2 soon)[/spoiler]

notes.content:
We are hard at work putting finishing touches on Arizona DLC for American Truck Simulator now. Very soon we should enter first a closed beta and hopefully soon after an open beta phase.

[url=http://2.bp.blogspot.com/-fkWnZoqcEIw/VzMnyapzrjI/AAAAAAAABtU/30cFSmEox6ENLUUtlZ4RSFY5D2dy-_BMwCK4B/s0/02%2B-%2BColorado%2BRiver%2Bnear%2BKingman.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-fkWnZoqcEIw/VzMnyapzrjI/AAAAAAAABtU/30cFSmEox6ENLUUtlZ4RSFY5D2dy-_BMwCK4B/s620/02%2B-%2BColorado%2BRiver%2Bnear%2BKingman.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://2.bp.blogspot.com/-bT7kcmGEg9s/VzMn2JA04HI/AAAAAAAABtc/gCOmbyeEpL80XCVvd3HLXKf_QSqNAlyTQCK4B/s0/03%2B-%2BColorado%2BRiver%2Bnear%2BYuma.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-bT7kcmGEg9s/VzMn2JA04HI/AAAAAAAABtc/gCOmbyeEpL80XCVvd3HLXKf_QSqNAlyTQCK4B/s620/03%2B-%2BColorado%2BRiver%2Bnear%2BYuma.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Coming soon to World of Trucks
notes.content:
[img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-Lq52OMRx1NU/UmBZRqKZGII/AAAAAAAAAQE/YvX8iUmXoHs_Nm3iz9O7nvB1raysLby6ACKgB/s640/wotr_logo.jpg[/img]

The upcoming major Update releases for Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator will contain a host of improvements: from general map tweaks to AI improvements or improved gear shifting code, from xinput support to additional support for CSIO Technologies cool [url=http://csio.tech/]SKRS[/url] transmission shift knob to hardcore trailer connecting mode - more on this later. But today we'd like to focus on enhancements coming to World of Trucks contracts.

The biggest overhaul is hiding under the hood - a lot of our early experimental code running and storing data on our private server farm has been adjusted to run on way more scalable Amazon server infrastructure. As World of Trucks will be adding more game features over time, eating even more bandwidth, we realized that we have to move to the "cloud" pretty much with everything. This change removes several bottlenecks and frustrating hick-ups you may current experience when connecting to World of Trucks.

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-CCL2GZEE23s/Vyx-YDMuTeI/AAAAAAAACY4/JWPQZoWD5cAgP9SwZLnQGMFxYShuB8B3wCLcB/s0/ats_truck_highway.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-CCL2GZEE23s/Vyx-YDMuTeI/AAAAAAAACY4/JWPQZoWD5cAgP9SwZLnQGMFxYShuB8B3wCLcB/s620/ats_truck_highway.jpg[/img][/url]

External Contracts will work across all of the official map content in the games - full support for American Truck Simulator is coming to World of Trucks at last, as is support for the map DLCs in Euro Truck Simulator 2.

We have improved the client part of Contracts, so you will be able to take jobs directly from the game, without the need to Alt+Tab to the web browser and back. It's more comfortable and streamlined, making it equal to Freight Market experience in the standard game. You will be able to easily see the closest jobs around your truck's current position in the world, so making your choice should be simple. But of course you don't get "teleported" to the trailer, you always have to actually drive your truck there.

We have introduced regional setting into World of Trucks, so you will be able to adjust the units according to your local preference.

[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-4Fe5HrZ19Eo/Vyxf7ZAH0LI/AAAAAAAACYo/4GK-iUfZGN4XTfz5f6olpG80icoPPjDxgCLcB/s0/ats_external_contracts.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-4Fe5HrZ19Eo/Vyxf7ZAH0LI/AAAAAAAACYo/4GK-iUfZGN4XTfz5f6olpG80icoPPjDxgCLcB/s620/ats_external_contracts.jpg[/img][/url]

We are now in "code freeze" stage for the upcoming game Updates - already firmly in closed beta territory - bugfixing and polishing the new features with our private group of trusted beta testers. We still have a bunch of issues sitting in our bug tracking database that we want to squish before switching into open beta mode. We are looking forward to another open beta, it's always great to see people interact with the new features, but we are still a couple of weeks from that moment. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Arizona road network
notes.content:
Arizona is not just more of the same. Our work on California and Nevada started well over two years ago, and even though we kept polishing the game all through the development cycle, the map design process and the roads were largely based on our older generation of tools and prefabs. Meanwhile, our tool-chain has matured considerably with the ETS2 team's work on Scandinavia and Vive la France, and for Arizona, the ATS team is using the power of the new modular system to put the road network together.

[url=http://2.bp.blogspot.com/-xaBG7SDUkKk/VyDNXGmLRwI/AAAAAAAABqE/Oob94Dme8SU_byMIRiQnQU6pFvcM_I-ngCK4Bs0ats_arizona_rs_01.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-xaBG7SDUkKk/VyDNXGmLRwI/AAAAAAAABqE/Oob94Dme8SU_byMIRiQnQU6pFvcM_I-ngCK4B/s620/ats_arizona_rs_01.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://4.bp.blogspot.com/-GfX1f8FF77g/VyDNmoSHS3I/AAAAAAAABqM/-ePEa1b_1m8XQwJ93hP_E0HDKkwK-Dw9gCK4Bs0ats_arizona_rs_04b.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-GfX1f8FF77g/VyDNmoSHS3I/AAAAAAAABqM/-ePEa1b_1m8XQwJ93hP_E0HDKkwK-Dw9gCK4B/s620/ats_arizona_rs_04b.jpg[/img][/url]

Things look sharper with higher resolution textures and better continuity of segments. But more importantly, rather than having to do with the limitations of huge monolithic prefabricates in places of intersections, the modular system is bringing way more flexibility. We can get the intersections to look closer to their real-world inspirations at particular locations. There is a greater variety of shoulders and side-walks, we can mix in elements like unique authentic pillar types and matching bridge segments for given interchanges.

[url=http://1.bp.blogspot.com/-exz4i506gQ8/VyDOMJK2tfI/AAAAAAAABqY/AL0zBt74W7skbcRpeFwXo8QmXhMgQM4gwCK4Bs0ats_arizona_rs_07.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-exz4i506gQ8/VyDOMJK2tfI/AAAAAAAABqY/AL0zBt74W7skbcRpeFwXo8QmXhMgQM4gwCK4B/s620/ats_arizona_rs_07.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://1.bp.blogspot.com/-b7-fw6ZB5Ko/VyDOlPxqFZI/AAAAAAAABqs/s7ePKJ1GJ3oYmvji5m7nMP2oAwDB6jXuQCK4Bs0ats_arizona_rs_03.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-b7-fw6ZB5Ko/VyDOlPxqFZI/AAAAAAAABqs/s7ePKJ1GJ3oYmvji5m7nMP2oAwDB6jXuQCK4B/s620/ats_arizona_rs_03.jpg[/img][/url]

In all our truck games ever since the first 18 Wheels of Steel games all the way to current American Truck Simulator maps, we have always been struggling hard with the limited space in our scaled-down version of reality. There never seems to be enough space to squeeze in all the right types of roads and the right types of intersections.

For Arizona, we tried hard to make the combination of road types clearly separated, with country roads and city roads crossing and joining the freeways and interstates with appropriate types of intersections. It has a nice side-effect too, the speed limits can now be harmonized and more logical, which contributes to a significantly smoother ride.

[url=http://2.bp.blogspot.com/-QPjKbJiwcSw/VyDIFYU-tcI/AAAAAAAABpY/97EaxXhpSTwmqmZh03gfrMVqVuCVjbevwCK4Bs0ats_arizona_rs_05.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-QPjKbJiwcSw/VyDIFYU-tcI/AAAAAAAABpY/97EaxXhpSTwmqmZh03gfrMVqVuCVjbevwCK4B/s620/ats_arizona_rs_05.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://2.bp.blogspot.com/-WMfJG-t2sIE/VyDIWmyVHKI/AAAAAAAABpo/zQjXUSbNArUIQypeQ4Jd9LCdrYo9XV8agCK4Bs0ats_arizona_rs_06.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-WMfJG-t2sIE/VyDIWmyVHKI/AAAAAAAABpo/zQjXUSbNArUIQypeQ4Jd9LCdrYo9XV8agCK4B/s620/ats_arizona_rs_06.jpg[/img][/url]

An extensive system of horizontal marking makes the roads and intersections look more authentic. We have also improved the coverage of warning and information markings for Arizona.

notes.title: Arizona road network
notes.content:
Arizona is not just more of the same. Our work on California and Nevada started well over two years ago, and even though we kept polishing the game all through the development cycle, the map design process and the roads were largely based on our older generation of tools and prefabs. Meanwhile, our tool-chain has matured considerably with the ETS2 team's work on Scandinavia and Vive la France, and for Arizona, the ATS team is using the power of the new modular system to put the road network together.

[url=http://2.bp.blogspot.com/-xaBG7SDUkKk/VyDNXGmLRwI/AAAAAAAABqE/Oob94Dme8SU_byMIRiQnQU6pFvcM_I-ngCK4Bs0ats_arizona_rs_01.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-xaBG7SDUkKk/VyDNXGmLRwI/AAAAAAAABqE/Oob94Dme8SU_byMIRiQnQU6pFvcM_I-ngCK4B/s620/ats_arizona_rs_01.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://4.bp.blogspot.com/-GfX1f8FF77g/VyDNmoSHS3I/AAAAAAAABqM/-ePEa1b_1m8XQwJ93hP_E0HDKkwK-Dw9gCK4Bs0ats_arizona_rs_04b.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-GfX1f8FF77g/VyDNmoSHS3I/AAAAAAAABqM/-ePEa1b_1m8XQwJ93hP_E0HDKkwK-Dw9gCK4B/s620/ats_arizona_rs_04b.jpg[/img][/url]

Things look sharper with higher resolution textures and better continuity of segments. But more importantly, rather than having to do with the limitations of huge monolithic prefabricates in places of intersections, the modular system is bringing way more flexibility. We can get the intersections to look closer to their real-world inspirations at particular locations. There is a greater variety of shoulders and side-walks, we can mix in elements like unique authentic pillar types and matching bridge segments for given interchanges.

[url=http://1.bp.blogspot.com/-exz4i506gQ8/VyDOMJK2tfI/AAAAAAAABqY/AL0zBt74W7skbcRpeFwXo8QmXhMgQM4gwCK4Bs0ats_arizona_rs_07.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-exz4i506gQ8/VyDOMJK2tfI/AAAAAAAABqY/AL0zBt74W7skbcRpeFwXo8QmXhMgQM4gwCK4B/s620/ats_arizona_rs_07.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://1.bp.blogspot.com/-b7-fw6ZB5Ko/VyDOlPxqFZI/AAAAAAAABqs/s7ePKJ1GJ3oYmvji5m7nMP2oAwDB6jXuQCK4Bs0ats_arizona_rs_03.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-b7-fw6ZB5Ko/VyDOlPxqFZI/AAAAAAAABqs/s7ePKJ1GJ3oYmvji5m7nMP2oAwDB6jXuQCK4B/s620/ats_arizona_rs_03.jpg[/img][/url]

In all our truck games ever since the first 18 Wheels of Steel games all the way to current American Truck Simulator maps, we have always been struggling hard with the limited space in our scaled-down version of reality. There never seems to be enough space to squeeze in all the right types of roads and the right types of intersections.

For Arizona, we tried hard to make the combination of road types clearly separated, with country roads and city roads crossing and joining the freeways and interstates with appropriate types of intersections. It has a nice side-effect too, the speed limits can now be harmonized and more logical, which contributes to a significantly smoother ride.

[url=http://2.bp.blogspot.com/-QPjKbJiwcSw/VyDIFYU-tcI/AAAAAAAABpY/97EaxXhpSTwmqmZh03gfrMVqVuCVjbevwCK4Bs0ats_arizona_rs_05.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-QPjKbJiwcSw/VyDIFYU-tcI/AAAAAAAABpY/97EaxXhpSTwmqmZh03gfrMVqVuCVjbevwCK4B/s620/ats_arizona_rs_05.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://2.bp.blogspot.com/-WMfJG-t2sIE/VyDIWmyVHKI/AAAAAAAABpo/zQjXUSbNArUIQypeQ4Jd9LCdrYo9XV8agCK4Bs0ats_arizona_rs_06.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-WMfJG-t2sIE/VyDIWmyVHKI/AAAAAAAABpo/zQjXUSbNArUIQypeQ4Jd9LCdrYo9XV8agCK4B/s620/ats_arizona_rs_06.jpg[/img][/url]

An extensive system of horizontal marking makes the roads and intersections look more authentic. We have also improved the coverage of warning and information markings for Arizona.

[url=http://3.bp.blogspot.com/-dNs0C7SjOJY/VyDMmpe6qlI/AAAAAAAABp4/fsjVZJTkB70vYUCLhAqh2Thu6awbn4YlACK4Bs0ats_arizona_rs_02.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-dNs0C7SjOJY/VyDMmpe6qlI/AAAAAAAABp4/fsjVZJTkB70vYUCLhAqh2Thu6awbn4YlACK4B/s620/ats_arizona_rs_02.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: The Grand Canyon State
notes.content:
Arizona has got its nickname The Grand Canyon State thanks to the magnificent steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River. This wonder of nature is playing a very large role for the local tourism with some five million tourists each year, while it just happens to be an obstacle for the transportation industry. But we have been working hard to portray it in a very visible way in American Truck Simulator, inventing some new tricks along the way.

[url=http://4.bp.blogspot.com/-5vA91SKTZ7g/VxdHh_pv1YI/AAAAAAAABng/ft6AULFK2w0s6V-mZ_JFwJXoJFo7N67NQCK4B/s0/Grand_canyon_1.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-5vA91SKTZ7g/VxdHh_pv1YI/AAAAAAAABng/ft6AULFK2w0s6V-mZ_JFwJXoJFo7N67NQCK4B/s620/Grand_canyon_1.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://3.bp.blogspot.com/-NWYNHP7TuRo/VxdHl1wm7AI/AAAAAAAABno/YClgpREzWNgMXVTtQfsSsn7-Uk4TbgbeACK4B/s0/Grand_canyon_2.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-NWYNHP7TuRo/VxdHl1wm7AI/AAAAAAAABno/YClgpREzWNgMXVTtQfsSsn7-Uk4TbgbeACK4B/s620/Grand_canyon_2.jpg[/img][/url]

Arizona gets into shape very visibly now, and we are eager to start internal beta testing in the matter of the next few weeks. We are also ready to commit to take the map expansion through a public open beta test towards the end of the testing period. We would like to give  a chance to the most curious of our fans to experience the incredible beauty of the new region before the final release.

[url=http://1.bp.blogspot.com/-vEeISLEmpgA/VxdI05uw_rI/AAAAAAAABn4/U7bmvuRvWoovKveY_yOdPIrIwiaSviJOACK4B/s0/Grand_canyon_3.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-vEeISLEmpgA/VxdI05uw_rI/AAAAAAAABn4/U7bmvuRvWoovKveY_yOdPIrIwiaSviJOACK4B/s620/Grand_canyon_3.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: PAX East
notes.content:
In 1998, two guys have started an [url=https://www.penny-arcade.com/comic/1998/11/18]innocent webcomic[/url] focused on video games and the games culture. Fast forward to 2016, and [url=https://www.penny-arcade.com/]Penny Arcade[/url] is a massive cultural phenomenon of its own. It is spawning four huge gaming expos every year, and here we are, showing American Truck Simulator at [url=http://east.paxsite.com/]PAX East[/url] in Boston, MA.

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-UPLnk3rfLV0/VxvmooS6xhI/AAAAAAAACLQ/leU9KPmHGlU7lypv9IrbIQtCd0UwDJHtQCKgB/s0/IMG_0483.JPG][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-UPLnk3rfLV0/VxvmooS6xhI/AAAAAAAACLQ/leU9KPmHGlU7lypv9IrbIQtCd0UwDJHtQCKgB/s620/IMG_0483.JPG[/img][/url]

[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-SZrJalzJRo0/VxvmqLuUv6I/AAAAAAAACLY/38zQHUb54kUAy5Rr9ejkHEeE2XIErx8MACKgB/s0/IMG_0486.JPG][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-SZrJalzJRo0/VxvmqLuUv6I/AAAAAAAACLY/38zQHUb54kUAy5Rr9ejkHEeE2XIErx8MACKgB/s620/IMG_0486.JPG[/img][/url]

The scale of the expo is overwhelming, even though not quite as giant as Germany's Gamescom and fortunately not as loud. A tiny team from SCS is on the showfloor as well, manning two demo seats with American Truck Simulator, and definitely not ducking under the pressure as the crowds keep pushing by.

[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-Z-cY1nDEx3A/VxvmmrGViJI/AAAAAAAACLc/-Zeg6lKX-_c9JWUNED1ChsMhSg7l66u7wCKgB/s0/IMG_0475.JPG][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-Z-cY1nDEx3A/VxvmmrGViJI/AAAAAAAACLc/-Zeg6lKX-_c9JWUNED1ChsMhSg7l66u7wCKgB/s620/IMG_0475.JPG[/img][/url]

[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-J9DfwZH7gr8/Vxvmmj5ng9I/AAAAAAAACLc/AfsytEsoDeooScHlLVe2IIYBqWUe3H0egCKgB/s0/IMG_0469.JPG][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-J9DfwZH7gr8/Vxvmmj5ng9I/AAAAAAAACLc/AfsytEsoDeooScHlLVe2IIYBqWUe3H0egCKgB/s620/IMG_0469.JPG[/img][/url]

It is our first time showing the game at a public event since it was released. It is great to see the line of people always waiting for their turn behind the wheel! We have met several dedicated fans of our truck sims with hundreds or even thousands of hours spent in the world of Euro Truck or American Truck, and enjoyed the conversation with them (yeah, we know, we should hurry up with Arizona!). It is also quite an inspiration to see first-time players experimenting with the game, trying foolish things, or some taking it very seriously and driving super carefully.

[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-A7h23U4Vu8o/VxvmoEZD0UI/AAAAAAAACLg/ndTP5gC9Ehka0Ddmt7jbUVe9FarzCpiHACKgB/s0/WP_20160423_063.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-A7h23U4Vu8o/VxvmoEZD0UI/AAAAAAAACLg/ndTP5gC9Ehka0Ddmt7jbUVe9FarzCpiHACKgB/s620/WP_20160423_063.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-4EMUwpvNWOs/VxvmpH6M3MI/AAAAAAAACLg/up_qH0SWz880PlWS2m8B0zSOLrSjWvYrwCKgB/s0/WP_20160423_080.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-4EMUwpvNWOs/VxvmpH6M3MI/AAAAAAAACLg/up_qH0SWz880PlWS2m8B0zSOLrSjWvYrwCKgB/s620/WP_20160423_080.jpg[/img][/url]

We would like to thank our publishing partners at [url=http://www.imgn.pro/]IMGN.PRO[/url] for inviting us to participate at their expo booth. They have managed to strike some great partnerships for the ATS demo stations. The game is running very smooth at 400% scaling on the [url=http://www.xoticpc.com/]XoticPC[/url] computers powered by [url=http://www.nvidia.com/]NVidia[/url] GTX 980 3D cards, and visitors seem to be having great fun driving the big rigs while sitting in [url=http://www.playseat.com/]Playseat[/url] gaming seats equipped with [url=http://gaming.logitech.com/]Logitech[/url] G29 steering wheels. Cannot get much better really. Thanks guys!

notes.title: Truck Simulators Deliver Steam Workshop & New DLC
notes.content:
In news that’s sure to please happy haulers either side of the Atlantic, both American Truck Simulator [official site] and its slightly older European cousin Euro Truck Simulator 2 now have Steam Workshop support. Both already supported mods, but now they’re simpler to install. Also, courtesy of the former’s 1.2 update and the latter’s 1.23 one, a range of options have also been added to both games’ wheel customisation suites, while new Wheel Tuning DLC packs hope to hand you the hottest rims on the open road.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Extra Wheel Tuning Options
notes.content:
Hot on the heels of the recent game updates for Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator, we are bringing you a new batch of optional content building on the new [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/990035444560868257]wheel tuning functionality[/url].

We are introducing a pair of "aftermarket" Wheel Tuning Packs in the form of DLC, with new unique parts tailored for the Euro style and American style wheels respectively. The recent changes in the base games - splitting the monolithic wheel models into multiple parts - have already brought you a lot of freedom in making hundreds possible combinations of wheels. With the new DLC stuff, the number of potential combinations grows by another magnitude or two, especially if you consider that some of the parts can now have any color you wish applied to them.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/450550

The sets of the tuning parts are different and unique for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/450550]American Truck Simulator[/url] and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/388475]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url], so it's not like you would be paying for the same thing twice, but we are making it easier for player of both games to obtain the DLCs for both games. If you buy the DLC for either one of the games, things are set up on the back-end so that the Wheel Tuning DLC is automatically unlocked for free for you in the other game. Have fun!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/388475

notes.title: Update 1.2 is out: Steam Workshop, Ultimate Wheel Customization
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/270880/workshop/][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-BR853593TcU/VwuOh0oWfvI/AAAAAAAABlE/KVTavK6H7i8_DnqEbO11Yw60Ws-vVaEJQ/s620/workshop_41.jpg[/img][/url]

At last, updates 1.2 for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/270880]American Truck Simulator[/url] and 1.23 for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/227300]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] are live. We would like to thank everybody who participated in the extended open beta. We have received a huge amount of valuable feedback that made us re-engineer some elements of Steam Workshop support to make it more robust.

Let us recap the key features coming for both games with the this update wave:
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/990034810354026854]Steam Workshop[/url] - a hub which allows simple distribution of game modifications created by the community. Thanks to Steam Workshop, you can download and install mods effortlessly from a safe and trusted place.
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/270880/workshop/]Visit American Truck Simulator Workshop[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/227300/workshop/]Visit Euro Truck Simulator 2 Workshop[/url]
[/list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/990035444560868257]Ultimate Wheel Customization[/url] - We have split truck wheels models into multiple components: Tire and Disk separation was introduced recently, in addition to it we have added customization of sub-components of the disk: Hubs, Hub Covers and Nuts.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/969770509805138592]SCS Workshop Uploader app[/url] - Modding our games through Steam Workshop will require use of a dedicated tool for mod makers; a new dedicated Steam application - SCS Workshop Uploader. You can grab it from your Steam library under Tools category.
[/list]

notes.title: Open Beta 1.2 is out - Steam Workshop, wheel customization
notes.content:
The open beta of the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/227300/announcements/detail/747967771614054841]ETS2 update[/url] has been live for two days. We want to thank all of you who’ve already participated and given us feedback! It means it’s high time for the ATS beta! Update 1.2 for American Truck Simulator is entering Open Beta on Steam today.

We’re working simultaneously on both ATS and ETS2. The same game engine allows us to make changes to both games in parallel, so some improvements to the game may be familiar to you from the previous blog post about the ETS2 open beta. Among the features and fixes common to both games, you can find a lot of improvements solely for ATS, which we've been working on since the release of the game last month.

[h1]Steam Workshop[/h1]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/270880/workshop/][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-8bO2EDCBsAQ/VulbYbxUHjI/AAAAAAAABjE/sI211xLOTmcpSVthlOrqcB2QULkz9Bw9Q/s620/steam_ats_workshop.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/270880/workshop/]Steam Workshop[/url] is a hub which allows simple distribution of game modifications created by community. Thanks to Steam Workshop, you can download and install mods effortlessly from a safe and trusted place.

Here's a short how-to on downloading and activating mods from Steam Workshop:

[list]
[*]Launch the game, go to the "Mod Manager" screen, and click on the "Steam Workshop" button in the top part of the window.The Steam in-game browser will appear and you will see the game's Steam workshop page.
[*]Go to "Items", select a mod which is interesting for you, and click on the green subscribe [+] button. Steam will automatically download the mod. When it is ready, you willsee the mod in Mod Manager. [/*][*]Double click on the mod to activate it and thenclick on the "Confirm Changes" button in the bottom part of Mod Manager.
[*]Load your profile and try your mod. ([b]note[/b]: pay attention to mod loading priority to avoid mod incompatibilities)
[/list]
[h1]SCS Workshop Uploader app[/h1]

[img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-MfswbOw8irY/Vua4BRkrteI/AAAAAAAACXg/dVSJrP7rUTgHgZIjL_sNBJCHLGxMI56Cw/s620/scs_workshop_uploader_banner.jpg[/img]

Modding our games through Steam Workshop will require use of a dedicated tool for mod makers; a new dedicated Steam application - SCS Workshop Uploader. You can grab it from your Steam library under Tools category.

We have also prepared a [url=http://modding.scssoft.com/wiki/Main_Page]Wiki with full SCS Steam Workshop Uploader documentation and modding tutorials[/url] where you can find guidance how to use our tools for mod creation.

Please note that at the moment we do not include support for map mods in the Uploader, this will come later but it requires more work on sanitization of all the data making up the map.

[h1]Ultimate Wheel Customization[/h1]

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-SI8oQ-UqMCo/Vulb0fjjAWI/AAAAAAAABjI/7Jg2jC13e2cap8fZccpcA2JfqSmwH821w/s0/ats_rims.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-SI8oQ-UqMCo/Vulb0fjjAWI/AAAAAAAABjI/7Jg2jC13e2cap8fZccpcA2JfqSmwH821w/s620/ats_rims.jpg[/img][/url]

As previewed in one of our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/990035444560868257]previous announcements[/url], we have expanded wheel customization options to match real-world customization flexibility. Wheels now consist of a tyre, a disk, nuts, a hub and a hub cover, and you can choose and tune each of them separately. We have recreated the old wheels in the game from these building blocks, but you can mix and match them freely now to get many more combinations. We have also tweaked the materials to bring you alu-disks which are the most regular type of disks used.

[h1]More Features and Improvements[/h1]

Here's a log of the additional fixes and improvements that went into this update:

[b]MAIN FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*]Steam Workshop
[*]Ultimate Wheel Customization
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*]Navigation path (red line) can be disabled (option)
[*]Disable of hidden Route Advisor popups (option)
[*]Autopark feature can be disabled (option)
[*]Speeding highlight on Route Advisor
[/list]
[b]VEHICLES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed cruise control locked on by retarder
[*]Multiple position of engine brake
[*]Improved truck stability during retarder usage
[*]Keyboard steering improved
[/list]
[b]MAP[/b]
[list]
[*]Speed limits polished
[*]Speed limits signs enlarged
[*]Stop signs removed from traffic light controlled crossroads
[*]Turn left traffic light added to some crossroads
[*]Certified scales are now working
[*]Traffic light on interstates removed (where possible)
[/list]
[b]OTHER[/b]
[list]
[*]AI improvements
[*]Steam achievements for Nevada
[/list]
You can find the beta in the public_beta branch on Steam. (Steam client -> LIBRARY -> right click on American Truck Simulator -> Properties -> Betas tab -> public_beta - 1.2 public beta). No password is required.

Report any bugs, as usually, [url=http://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=210]on our forum[/url].

notes.title: Ultimate Wheel Customization
notes.content:
It's not just Steam Workshop support, there is another important feature coming with the next ETS2 and ATS update. Compared to where we were only a year ago with the whole wheel being just one monolithic truck part, there's no other way of putting it: we're going to provide you with ultimate wheel customization!

[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-OYdZuGaFy7I/VtccVB_Ez1I/AAAAAAAACV8/3O0D1asQQ-A/s0/ETS2_wheel_customization.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-OYdZuGaFy7I/VtccVB_Ez1I/AAAAAAAACV8/3O0D1asQQ-A/s620/ETS2_wheel_customization.jpg[/img][/url]

We were never quite happy with the existing system, it was too limiting. Customizing wheels should be more varied, more flexible, more fun! We have split our wheels into multiple components: [b]Tire [/b]and [b]Disk [/b]separation was introduced recently, in addition to it we have now added customization sub-components of the disk: [b]Hubs[/b], [b]Hub Covers[/b] and [b]Nuts[/b].

Check out this little video clip that we have made. Rather than from static screenshots, this feature is easier to appreciate in motion:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0sg6MEuYj8

Advanced wheel customization will come simultaneously to both Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator with the upcoming update. Just splitting the existing wheel models into parts that you can recombine according to your wish will already give you a vast variety of different looks. On top of it, we'll soon release a small but cool DLC with extra wheel tuning options - things like paintable metal parts or crazy nut designs. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Meep Meep: American Truck Simulator Teases Arizona
notes.content:
American Truck Simulator [official site] is a lot better with geology than greenery, I was disappointed to discover. I’d hoped to follow trucking routes through redwood forests and other lush pockets of Northern California but no, it’s all a bit grim and disappointing. ATS doesn’t remotely capture what I remember from a road trip through there. However, its scrubby, desert-y lands are far nicer, which bodes well for the upcoming free Arizona add-on. Developers SCS Software today shared a few screenshots from it and ooh yeah, I can just imagine running Wile E. Coyote round into those rocky stacks, having the top roll off and crush him.

notes.title: Steam Workshop support coming!
notes.content:
[img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-uLqenW_OcK4/Vs2zUaQgLdI/AAAAAAAABhs/Wj2GD0PoK5I/s620/workshop_4.jpg[/img]

We are working now on update 1.23 for ETS2, and 1.2 for ATS. One of the major features coming with the updates is support for Steam Workshop. This feature is a really long time coming, considering that all of our projects always were popular for user modifications.

Right now our Workshop is still in limited testing. Some of our testers are passionate modders in their own. Even during testing there are already some cool mods appearing. Here is how the page looks right now:

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-r39GM4Abxpc/Vs8UPZeBa6I/AAAAAAAACVs/T8qyAjJ8ekI/s0/ets2_workshop.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-r39GM4Abxpc/Vs8UPZeBa6I/AAAAAAAACVs/T8qyAjJ8ekI/s620/ets2_workshop.jpg[/img][/url]

We are looking forward to the public beta where the community for both games will be able to evaluate and test the current implementation.

The ease of use of Steam Workshop is fascinating - you just choose the mod, press the "Subscribe" button, and the mod will be automatically downloaded and appear in your in-game mod manager. The Steam client will take care of automatic updates of the mod in the event that the creator of the mod releases a new version. What is more, if you decide to switch between computers or to reinstall your OS, all the mods will be downloaded in each new installation automatically without any need to create backups.

Each player will be able to rate any mod, so high quality mods should quickly rise to the top. You will be able to sort mods by rank, popularity, or browse the most recent ones.

[h1]There's more for mod authors[/h1]

In order to ship your mod you will need to download SCS Workshop Uploader - a free standalone Steam application we have created just for this purpose. This is what the tool looks like:

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-JfVI-6EjNO4/Vs20-bh4FcI/AAAAAAAABiA/_2nJoOx5iGY/s0/scs_workshop_uploader.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-JfVI-6EjNO4/Vs20-bh4FcI/AAAAAAAABiA/_2nJoOx5iGY/s620/scs_workshop_uploader.jpg[/img][/url]

Alongside the Uploader tool, we are also preparing our own Wiki dedicated entirely to mod creation process.

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-o0vuNdGtVT8/Vs2z_ZldUqI/AAAAAAAABhw/kWA2N1cPtfU/s0/scs_wiki.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-o0vuNdGtVT8/Vs2z_ZldUqI/AAAAAAAABhw/kWA2N1cPtfU/s620/scs_wiki.jpg[/img][/url]

The goal is to have a place where everybody interested in modding SCS games will find all the info needed. It should be the ultimate source covering all areas of official SCS modding tools, their documentation and tutorials, things like for example advice on how to adapt the mods to the newest game version. The Wiki will also provide additional information about our game engine and its possible configuration options.

It will most likely still take us a couple of weeks before we reach this stage, but we are looking forward to seeing you in the upcoming open beta for ETS2 and ATS to sample the new mod support!

Today I spent 17 minutes watching a trucker give a tour of her truck’s cabin, thanks to Adam. It’s fair to say American Truck Simulator [official site] has filled us dreams of big skies and open roads, and I’m sure he wasn’t at all saying “I wish I could be in this truck rather than here with YOU, ALICE. notes.title: Get to Drive Kenworth W900 Now!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the legendary Kenworth W900 truck is now a part of American Truck Simulator. The truck is a free DLC - the game will be updated automatically through Steam. Please check out the little movie that we have made to celebrate this event:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nv6vQe78c4A
There are also several notable changes coming with this game update, let us preview them for you:

Since ATS release, we have heard plenty of complaints regarding relative large fines in the game. Perhaps our tester group is so much experienced already; playing our games for years, that they did not bring it to our attention that this would be a problem especially for new players. We erred here on the side of trying to make this element of the game too close to reality, catering to the veteran fans who want it tough.

[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-z1QenSh6JHk/VsH9O2OHc2I/AAAAAAAACU8/edxY-8yS4YY/s0/ATS_kenworth_w900_001.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-z1QenSh6JHk/VsH9O2OHc2I/AAAAAAAACU8/edxY-8yS4YY/s620/ATS_kenworth_w900_001.jpg[/img][/url]

On second thought, it's not really a good idea to intimidate people coming fresh to the game with crippling fines. Fines are now considerably lower in the early stages of the game, they grow larger only as the player's skill/level grows.

We have also made the detection code for speeding more forgiving, giving the player more time to adjust to a new speed limit. We definitely do not want to make players feel like the game is unfair!

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-6L-y37bgn8Y/VsH9O1DU8II/AAAAAAAACU0/9rBIVPgCchQ/s0ATS_kenworth_w900_003.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-6L-y37bgn8Y/VsH9O1DU8II/AAAAAAAACU0/9rBIVPgCchQ/s620/ATS_kenworth_w900_003.jpg[/img][/url]

More changes in this area are in the pipeline, our map team is hard at work adding more speed limit signs to proper places to explicitly zone the limits. There are also changes to the AI code that are tied to yet more map tweaks, which should further limit the problems with being rammed by overly stupid AI cars and on top of it getting penalized for it. But we will only be able to push out the changes in the map alongside the next major game update, so please have patience with us.

[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-NSFeHGFbYAU/VsH9O96Cg6I/AAAAAAAACU4/DBbvAmODwsY/s0/ATS_kenworth_w900_002.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-NSFeHGFbYAU/VsH9O96Cg6I/AAAAAAAACU4/DBbvAmODwsY/s620/ATS_kenworth_w900_002.jpg[/img][/url]

Finally, we have also improved the detection of 'turn on red' feature in the game. For drivers in Europe, it may be a surprise that in the US it's legally allowed to turn right at red traffic light, unless explicitly prohibited. So in the game, if you properly use your indicator to signal that you are turning right, no red light penalty is applied just as expected.

notes.title: The Flare Path: Truck Stop Temptations
notes.content: I’ve talked about companion texts in Flare Path before , but I’m not sure I’ve ever used this column to air my companion games theory. In short I believe certain games have soul mates titles that compliment them so perfectly that the idea of playing one without the other is almost unthinkable. The two games that make up a companion pair are usually very different. The partnership works because themes cross-pollinate. Because pacing and player demands balance out. Because game (A) creates a craving for game (B) and vice versa. This week by a happy accident I found myself in the presence of the most perfect pair of companion games I’ve ever encountered. This week I’ve been bouncing, like a jet-kicked ball bearing, between American Truck Simulator and The Pinball Arcade. … [visit site to read more]
